title: Operations Manager
description:
**Operations Manager, Talent Enablement | Hyderabad (Hybrid)**

**Working hours:**
1 PM to 10 PM IST

We’re hiring someone to run our Talent Enablement (Compliance and Operations) team at Vertage Global’s Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad.

The function is new and growing. You’ll lead a team of 25+ people, set up how the work gets done, and be the main GCC contact for stakeholders in India and overseas.

**What the job involves**

* Managing and developing Team Leaders and the wider Talent Enablement team
* Owning India compliance work: onboarding, documentation, verification, governance and audits
* Keeping recruitment support processes audit-ready and consistently high quality
* Managing supplier and third-party partners
* Setting KPIs, quality checks and reporting, and improving processes over time
* Working with global stakeholders and helping plan headcount as the team grows

**What we’re looking for**

* You’re currently an Assistant Manager, Manager, or in a similar operations, compliance or onboarding role
* You’ve managed people and helped them grow
* You’ve handled India compliance, audits, onboarding and documentation hands-on
* You’ve worked in recruitment, staffing, RPO, talent acquisition operations or HR shared services
* You’ve built processes or controls from scratch, not just followed existing ones
* You’ve managed vendor or third-party relationships
* You’re comfortable working with teams across regions in a GCC or shared services setup
* Experience with ATS, VMS, Bullhorn or similar systems is a plus

You don’t need UK or US compliance experience. India compliance, audit and governance experience is what matters most to us.

**Why this role**

* You’ll lead a new function and have real say in how it’s built
* You’ll build the team from the start
* You’ll work with colleagues across several regions
* We offer competitive pay and room to grow

Interested, or know someone who might be? Apply or message me directly for a confidential chat.

title: Operations Manager - India
description:
****Our Purpose****
Helping Main Street Businesses Gain an Unfair Advantage in the Marketplace
  
  
****Our Niche****
We embed Tech + Talent to supercharge your business
  
  
****Our Core Values****

* Technology Doesn’t Lead. People Do. We lead with people rather than tools. We use technology for leverage while relying on our people for judgment, empathy, and accountability. We build trust through human connection and execution as we embrace technology.
* Simplify It. Make things easier, clearer and more useful.
* Unbounded Innovation. We don’t accept the phrase, "that’s how it’s always been done." We run toward challenges, question assumptions, and seek better ways forward. We stay adaptable and the best ideas win.
* Under Promise. Over Deliver. Trust is earned through execution. We set honest expectations, commit carefully, and exceed them. We go the extra mile when it matters - without excuses.
* Lead with Understanding. We seek understanding before action. We listen closely, stay curious, and learn quickly. Once clarity is achieved, we execute with urgency, and own the outcome.
* Win Together. Do the Right Thing. We succeed as a team and protect trust at all costs. We share credit, own mistakes, and have each other’s backs. We put clients first, act with integrity, and choose what’s right over what’s easy.

****Our Three Unique’s****

* Built for Main Street Businesses - We understand small and mid-sized businesses - because that’s who we’re built for. We integrate like an internal team. We are not consultants or temps. We support your team at your pace.
* Human Execution, Technology Leverage - We combine real people with the right tech to get things done - faster, simpler, and with clarity. You get outcomes, not more platforms to manage.
* Scales Fast. Stays Out of Your Way - We grow with you without slowing you down. We have white glove service without high maintenance tools.

**Role Overview**
At Javro, we focus on building long-term, multi-year client relationships with enduring value. Our team provides a wide array of services to our clients, and our engagements can differ substantially from client to client. As such, our team is constantly juggling competing priorities to ensure we deliver a great experience to all of our current and prospective clients.
  
  
The
****Operations Manager – India****
is the senior people and operations leader responsible for
****execution, accountability, and scalability****
across all India-based teams supporting Javro’s client delivery.
  
  
This role ensures that strategy turns into
****consistent, high-quality execution****
through clear ownership, disciplined follow-through, and strong leadership at every level. The Country Lead leads through
****department heads and team leads****
, setting expectations, measuring outcomes, and holding teams accountable for results across multiple verticals including
****Financial Services, Forecasting, Automation, Data Management, Sales,****
and
****Medical/DME Operations****
.
  
  
The Operations Manager serves as the
****primary India-based point of contact****
for US leadership, works in-office, and partners closely with HR and recruiting to build teams that execute reliably and operate with ownership.
  
  
Reports to: President
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
****Execution & Accountability Leadership****

* Establish clear ownership, goals, and success metrics for department heads and team leads in partnership with GM.
* Ensure work is executed according to defined processes, timelines, and quality standards
* Hold team members accountable for outcomes, not activity
* Identify execution gaps early and drive corrective action through leaders
* Reinforce a culture where commitments are tracked, reviewed, and completed

****Leadership & Team Oversight****

* Lead, coach, and develop team leads across India operations
* Ensure the right people are in the right seats as teams grow
* Build leadership depth and succession across service lines
* Address performance issues promptly, clearly, and fairly
* Report to GM about performance, scalability, needs and operational excellence strategies

****Financial Services & Forecasting****

* Oversee accounting and financial services teams supporting external SMB clients
* Ensure consistent execution across:


+ General ledger accounting and reconciliations
+ Month-end close and financial reporting
+ Financial modeling, forecasting, and planning support

* Maintain execution quality, prioritization, and accuracy across multi-client, consultant-driven engagements

****Automation, Data Management & Technology-Enabled Solutions****

* Oversee teams supporting automation initiatives, data management, and technology-enabled problem solving for clients
* Ensure clear execution across:


+ AI and automation-driven operational projects
+ Data reading, synthesis, and analysis to support client decision-making
+ SOP creation, documentation, and process standardization

* Partner with US stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable, executable workflows
* Maintain execution discipline as new technical and data-driven services are introduced

****Sales & Commercial Support****

* Oversee operational support for sales and commercial workflows, including:


+ Complex quoting and pricing support
+ Data preparation and analysis supporting sales efforts
+ Process documentation supporting repeatable sales execution

* Ensure accuracy, responsiveness, and alignment between sales teams and delivery operations

****Medical & DME Operations****

* Oversee medical and DME service lines, including:


+ DME Intake Specialists
+ DME Revenue Cycle Specialists
+ DME Team Leads responsible for daily execution and coaching

* Ensure clean execution and accountability across intake, documentation, and billing workflows
* Maintain scalable processes and strong execution discipline in regulated, compliance-aware environments

****HR, Recruiting & US Collaboration****

* Partner with HR and recruiting teams on hiring, onboarding, and workforce planning
* Participate in hiring and development of team leads and managers
* Serve as the primary India-based contact for US leadership and account teams
* Communicate execution status, risks, and capacity needs clearly and early

**Key Competencies And Qualifications**

* 8–12+ years of experience in operations, delivery, or shared services environments
* Proven experience leading managers of managers with accountability for outcomes
* Experience overseeing financial services and/or medical/DME operations
* Strong understanding of execution in process-driven, compliance-aware environments
* Prior hands-on execution experience earlier in career
* Experience working with US-based clients or leadership teams
* Strong communication skills and in-office leadership presence
* Comfortable managing multiple departments and priorities simultaneously
* Proven experience, or a clear readiness, to lead people. You should have experience in peer mentoring, quality checking, or project coordination.
* Sophisticated verbal and written English skills, capable of leading virtual meetings and explaining complex financial discrepancies to US stakeholders.
* A self-starter mindset with the ability to manage high-volume data independently while remaining flexible to Eastern Standard Time (EST) shift requirements.
* Cultural Leadership: A collaborative spirit that thrives in cross-cultural environments and is adept at using remote tools like Google Meet, NinetyIO..
* A strong desire to grow into a senior leadership role within Javro’s expanding Hyderabad operations.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**About IntouchCX**
IntouchCX is a global leader in digital customer experience management, back office processing, trust & safety solutions, and AI services. For over 25 years, we’ve scaled with soul, building trusted long-term partnerships and empowering our people to drive positive change.
  
  
**About The Job**
We’re searching for an Operations Manager to direct and manage all operational activities for certain programs while contributing to the campus’s overall strategic direction. This role will execute day-to-day operational activities including managing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), managing Service Levels and coaching and recruiting Team Leaders.
  
  
As Operations Manager, You Will…
  
  

* Ensure proper planning, staffing and direction of the operational functions
* Manage and supervise teams
* Ensure proficient training, professional development and employee engagement to prepare, grow and retain employees
* Manage operational performance to meet KPI targets and Service Level Agreements through optimum quality and service
* Analyze various reports and statistical data to measure production levels and identify root causes for underperforming areas
* Develop customized reporting to measure and track operational statistics, data and results
* Develop solutions to improve business performance and partner success
* Use analytics, investigation and reasoning to quickly develop solutions for ad hoc issues
* Motivate teams through relationship building and real-time coaching
* Develop and deploy incentive programs to motivate employees to achieve desired outcomes
* Authorize and coordinate changes in staffing schedules by collaborating with the Operations Support Team and/or Workforce Management Team
* Collaborate with other departments within the organization (HR, IT, etc) to resolve issues
* Bring in-depth operational knowledge and a thoughtful point of view when participating in partner meetings

As Operations Manager, You Have…
  
  

* Completion of post-secondary education (a major in Business or Commerce will be considered an asset)
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in the contact center industry
* At least 3 years of experience in an Operations Management role overseeing front-line employees
* Experience in client relationship management and employee development/coaching
* Experience dealing with escalated issues in a contact center capacity
* The ability to successfully work across cross-functional teams
* A positive work ethic and commitment to achieve the best possible outcomes
* The passion to be a role model that exemplifies our 10 Things (cultural values)
* Possess exceptional time management, organizational and prioritization skills to complete work in a timely manner
* Excellent communication skills; listening, verbal and written
* Ability to assess the “big picture” and draw connections between inputs and outputs
* Possess leadership qualities such as critical thinking and problem solving to aid in overcoming difficult situations
* Ability to use spreadsheet applications to maintain and develop operational and financial data reporting
* Ability to type 30 WPM with accuracy
* Ability to work both independently and in a team setting within a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
* Strong knowledge of Google Suite (Sheets, Slides, Docs, Drive) preferred

IntouchCX will never ask for payment, money, financial or banking information during the recruitment process. We only communicate through official channels.
  
  
Should you receive a suspicious job offer, or posting, from anyone claiming to be an IntouchCX employee, please report it immediately to hr@intouchcx.com for review and validation.

title: Manager, Wealth Management Operations [T500-30643]
description:
**About CIBC:**

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.

**About CIBC India:**

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

The Manager, Wealth Management Operations is responsible for leading and managing the Hyderabad-based operations team within Wealth Management, overseeing a large and complex operational unit. This role ensures the seamless delivery of wealth management services by fostering high performance, outstanding client service, and operational excellence.

The Manager is accountable for workflow and resource allocation, employee development, compliance, budget planning, expense management, and risk management. Additionally, the role drives process improvements, enhances service quality, promotes cost containment, and champions a culture of continuous improvement.

By executing these responsibilities, the Manager directly supports CIBC’s global strategic objectives and ensures full compliance with CIBC policies and regulatory requirements.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

**Leadership and Team Development:**

* Provide leadership and direction to employees by setting clear context, defining accountabilities, planning and delegating assignments and providing performance feedback and coaching in order to meet unit goals, objectives and deliverables.
* Manage the Performance Management & Measurement Process including developing Individual Development Plans; conducting interim and annual performance reviews and make recommendations for compensation (e.g. Annual Incentive Plan, Base Salary) to ensure operational efficiency
* Motivate, coach, train and provide development opportunities to ensure employees can perform at or above the necessary professional standards
* Monitor and assess employee output to measure progress against unit goals, objectives and deliverables to identify developmental needs of employees and develop action plans to improve performance
* Provide for the on-going professional development of staff by developing and implementing training and career development plans for continual growth
* Manage all staffing activities ensuring effective deployment of human resources; make decisions and/or recommendations for interviewing, hiring, terminations and transfers to ensure staffing, orientation and promotions are conducted effectively
* Oversee CIBC’s Recognition Program within own operating unit to communicate program content, inspire employees and recognize/reward achievements of high performing employees
* Manage and oversee team-building activities with direct reports (e.g. huddles, team meetings) to actively engage staff, encourage team spirit and create a positive employee experience to build team capability

**Operational Management and Process Improvement:**

* Oversee department operations and productivity ensuring continuous process improvement for operational efficiency and profitability
* Manage production needs and activities including resource allocation, equipment (procurement and maintenance), workflow and system operations to ensure operational efficiency
* Participate in annual planning, analyzing trends and providing recommendations to ensure effective management of resources against volumes
* Manage, implement and monitor changes and new process/business which enhance the operations to ensure smooth implementation and any intended efficiencies are realized
* Identify opportunities for improving control processes and procedural adherence; make recommendations to support continuous improvement and cost containment
* Monitor, review and complete high level root cause analysis and develop action plans and recommendations to address any unit deficiencies
* Partner with the Continuous Improvement Leader to develop and implement plans to ensure effective and efficient operations of the unit
* Manage all complex high-risk issues and escalations of all issues/concerns, providing high quality resolution to ensure timelines and budget requirements are met
* Refine the measurement of “key metrics” which drive performance of unit to maintain service levels (e.g. resource allocation, capacity, tracking, volumes)

**Relationship Management and Communication:**

* Establish effective partnerships and business relationships to facilitate communication between operating units and resolve difficult or complex departmental issues
* Meet regularly with business partners to ensure that Service Level Agreements are in place with clients and are met or exceeded
* Conduct periodic review of stated and actual Service Level Agreements and performance; conduct a root cause analysis and develop recommendations and action plans as appropriate if inconsistent
* Establish effective communication lines to facilitate successful completion of goals and sharing of information (e.g. keep team updated on business goals, strategies, performance objectives, current issues/concerns, new procedures or changes)
* Conduct/lead meetings and formal presentations to provide information, resolve issues and concerns and communicate business goals as required
* Provide consultative services to internal business partners; liaise with and elicit cooperation from other departments within Global Operations to enhance service delivery
* Work with the Leadership Team to implement Global Operations’ strategies and ensure service excellence principles are achieved

**Risk Management and Compliance:**

* Manage departmental risk and ensure compliance with policies, procedures, and controls to minimize losses and support accuracy and completeness
* Ensure adherence to CIBC procedures, policies and guidelines ensuring audit, control and security checks are conducted according to established standards
* Monitor audit controls within the unit ensuring all non-compliant findings are identified, root cause analysis is completed, and resolution is in place to mitigate risk
* Oversee BCP readiness to ensure that all milestones are met
* Review and complete Key Compliance Reports (e.g. Quarterly Key Controls, Quality Management Controls) to ensure documented procedures, processes and policies are followed, trends analyzed to determine root cause and appropriate action taken to resolve issues/concerns; ensure Corporate Governance approval is received as required

**Financial Management:**

* Complete Financial Management activities, including forecasting and preparing annual budgets (e.g. revenue, expenses, resource management)
* Establish unit and transaction costs; control and monitor unit budgets and expenses to ensure that unit is operating within approved budget
* Review monthly results against plan and latest estimates to investigate and report variances
* Prepare and submit annual budgets that includes resource requirements to senior management for approval

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Key relationships with a wide range of internal CIBC employees, teams and departments (e.g. Internal Audit, Branches) at peer level and up to Senior Management/Director levels to share information, ensure compliance and operational efficiencies, present strategies, recommend solutions and resolve issues
* Occasional contact with external Auditors to provide information to resolve compliance issues

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As a manager of people, this job must ensure all employees within the business unit comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a manager of people, this job has the authority to assign tasks to employees within their span of control, select individuals for hire, assess individual performance, make employee compensation decisions and take disciplinary measures up to and including termination

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Leads and manages a large, complex Wealth Management Operations team, overseeing workflow, resource allocation, employee development, and operational performance to ensure seamless delivery of wealth management services and achievement of business objectives.
* Accountable for operational efficiency, risk management, compliance, budget planning, and continuous process improvement, while fostering a high-performance culture and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholder

**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):**

**Must Have Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field; MBA or relevant graduate degree preferred
* Proven expertise in operations management and strategy development at a business unit or enterprise level
* 8+ years of progressive experience in financial services, preferably in operations or wealth management including leadership or senior strategic roles
* Professional or technical qualifications in operations, finance, or related disciplines are an asset
* Strong knowledge of industry regulations and compliance requirements
* Proficiency in English (written and verbal)
* In-depth knowledge of operational processes, procedures, and controls within Wealth Management or Financial Services
* Strong leadership, team management, and coaching skills, with the ability to motivate and develop staff
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills for effective stakeholder engagement
* Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
* Proficiency with internal systems and relevant technology platforms (e.g., workflow management tools, financial systems)
* Strong organizational, time management, and planning skills to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Knowledge of risk management, quality management, and process improvement methodologies

**Privacy:**

By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Core Operations - Manager
description:

* Should have team managing experience (8-10 FTEs in the past)
* Should be able to handle escalation
* Role includes incoming and outgoing claims management, ensuring that claims are resolved timely and accurately, reduce exposure to bank, manage team size of 13-15 staff
* Assist Senior Management in reporting and any adhoc requirement

* Ensuring daily/weekly/monthly reports are delivered in timely manner with 100% accuracy
* Work with corresponding banks or counterparties to reduce overall exposure to the organization
* Ensure that all claims are resolved in timely manner and are escalated accordingly for immediate resolution

* Interest Analysis

* Candidate should have good analytical skills

title: Manager, Portfolio Performance & Process Excellence
description:

title: Warehouse Manager
description:
Limagrain is a global company with deep local roots. Our parent company is an agricultural cooperative based in the Limagne-Val d’Allier plain, in the heart of Central France’s Auvergne region, while we are an international seed and agri-food group with some 9,600 employees working in 53 countries.
  
  
As the 4th largest seed company in the world, we achieved sales of 2.522 billion euros in 2023-2024, with additional sales of 729 million euros from activities carried out in collaboration with our strategic partners.
  
  
HM.CLAUSE is a business unit of Limagrain (https://www.limagrain.com/), an international co-operative agricultural group, specializing in field seeds, vegetable seeds and cereal products.
  
  
With a team of 2,800 professionals in over 30 countries, we are dedicated to the sustainable solutions for the land, successful products for our customers, and intensive research and innovations for the future. HM Clause is a leading vegetable seeds company with successful product development for more than 200 years. Headquartered in France we have operations across countries like Mexico, USA, France, Spain, Italy, India, Vietnam and Thailand. We have a diverse set of customers, across regions, who engage with us at various touchpoints, to gain more information about our products and benefits. Considering our products are launched after years of R&D and the impact on the customer’s life is significant, our communication has been largely product benefits-led. In India, we have been operating for last 10 years and are known for our commercial brand – Clause seeds.
  
  
**Function**
Operations
  
  
**Main Goal**
Warehouse Manager has oversight for all Seed as well as Non-Seed handling from Reception to Dispatch ensuring operational excellence by managing physical Seed inventory vs system with zero deviations and additional responsibility of Plant QC and also Responsible for organizing deliveries, storage and dispatches of goods within the Warehouse or Distribution center or to the direct Customer.
  
  
**Job Description**

title: Lab Cluster InCharge-Technical Operations-MD-Pathology/Biochemistry
description:
**Job Summary**

Responsible for overseeing and managing technical operations of medical laboratory services across assigned cluster of Vijaya Diagnostic Centres (VDC) and their associated Sample Collection Centers ensuring alignment with organization’s policies and procedures. This role entails end-to-end management of laboratory functions with a focus on standardization, quality compliance, optimal resource utilization and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

***Education:***

MBBS, DNB, MD (Pathology,Biochemistry)

Preffered: MBA-Healthcare and ISB's

***Key Skills / Experience***

* Strong analytical mindset to interpret lab performance data and drive corrective or improvement actions
* Ability to handle technical disruptions, complaints, or audits promptly and effectively
* Strong knowledge of NABL/NABH/ISO standards and internal QMS systems, capable of ensuring regulatory and accreditation compliance

***Primary Responsibilities***

**Laboratory Operations Management:**

* Oversee smooth functioning of technical operations across all laboratories and collection centers within the assigned cluster.
* Ensure timely and accurate generation and release of test reports within defined TAT (Turnaround Time).
* Manage and resolve all technical and operational issues in consultation with Lab In-charges, HODs, Operational and Marketing teams.

**Quality Assurance & Compliance:**

* Ensure adherence to QMS and coordinate with Quality Assurance Department for audits, improvements and regulatory compliance (NABL, biomedical waste, PPE protocols).
* Monitor and ensure accurate LIMS usage including report amendments, process flow compliance, QC documentation and data statistics.
* Ensure continuous review and improvement of report formats based on user feedback and evolving requirements in alignment with approved VDC formats and under the guidance of Laboratory Director / Chief of Lab.
* Ensure compilation of data for MIS and submission in a timely manner along with review and feedback for improvements.
* Monitor process flow/QC compliance amendment of reports and any other activities on LIMS with statistics in coordination with lab in charges & lab managers.

**Inventory & Equipment Management:**

* Monitor inventory levels, consumption trends and wastage audits, ensure timely procurement and avoid shortages/excessive hoarding of stock.
* Supervise preventive maintenance, calibration and timely repair of equipment, ensure uninterrupted laboratory services.

**Phlebotomy Overview:**

* Manage phlebotomy operations in coordination with Central Phlebotomy In-charge ensuring high standards of patient service and sample integrity.
* Communicate and reinforce all relevant SOPs and policies to phlebotomists as per established protocols.

**People Management:**

* Actively contribute to manpower planning, including identifying vacancies, participating in interviews and supporting job role training across the assigned cluster.
* Support all centers in developing and implementing training schedules and oversee compliance with competency assessments for all staff including doctors.
* Lead thorough root cause analysis meetings for all customer complaints by involving relevant stakeholders and drive resolution planning to prevent recurrence.
* Review and assess lab fines levied on staff, coordinate with Lab Managers and other stakeholders to understand the reasons and implement targeted retraining programs where necessary.
* Hold regular meetings with all Lab Managers and Lab In-charges to review data, address issues related to inventory, processes and provide feedback and actionable improvement plans to the Director.

***Additional Responsibilities:***

* Provide expert advice on test selection, interpretation and utilization of laboratory services in coordination with the sales team.
* Implement risk mitigation strategies and document continual improvement initiatives in coordination with the Quality Assurance team.
* Undertake additional responsibilities or projects as assigned by the Director – Laboratory Services for organizational benefit.

title: Integration HoD
description:
Eyeline is a global team of risk takers, innovators and perfectionists who achieve creative visions and have fun doing it. A dynamic workforce nestled within the industry’s most intriguing cities, united by a drive to push the boundaries of storytelling. Learn more.
  
  
The Integration HOD — Hyderabad leads a shared capability that turns routine Integration work into a predictable cross-show service rather than separate show-by-show coordination. They combine strong Tracking / Matchmove / RotoAnim / simple Layout judgement with production leadership: triaging requests, routing work through Leads and artists, balancing demand and capacity, setting validation standards and ensuring reliable handoffs. The role gives shows one accountable Integration contact while preserving specialist / show ownership for difficult, ambiguous or highly creative cases. As the team proves readiness, the Integration HOD — Hyderabad expands the range and complexity of work the department can absorb.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own cross-show intake, triage, prioritisation and delivery for agreed Integration work classes.
* Apply specialist-defined standards, workflows and validation gates for Tracking, Matchmove, RotoAnim and basic Layout; ensure cameras, solves, scale and scene context are ready for handoff.
* Direct daily delivery through Hyderabad discipline Leads or Supervisors (as needed) and artists, with clear review gates and escalation paths.
* Partner with Production on capacity, scheduling, utilisation, forecasting and cross-show priority conflicts.
* Act as the accountable Integration contact for CG / VFX Supervisors and show Production, communicating status, assumptions, risks, options and downstream readiness.
* Implement specialist-approved workflows, templates, publishing and scene conventions; identify improvements with specialist HODs and Pipeline / TD teams.
* Build the department by developing Leads and artists, owning people-management and capability growth, shaping staffing and hiring needs, measuring quality / throughput, and expanding scope as readiness improves.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of feature-film or episodic VFX experience with substantial Tracking, Matchmove, RotoAnim, Layout or Integration responsibility.
* Proven leadership experience as a Tracking, Matchmove, RotoAnim, Layout, Integration or CG Supervisor / Lead in high-end VFX.
* Deep understanding of camera and object tracking, RotoAnim, lens distortion, survey / photogrammetry inputs, scene scale, perspective and layout fundamentals.
* Strong cross-show production leadership: planning, prioritisation, capacity management, dependency management and clear communication across departments and locations.
* Experience with USD or equivalent modern scene-description / assembly workflows is highly valued.
* Bachelor's degree in Digital Arts, Computer Graphics or equivalent professional experience.

**About Us**
Eyeline is a global creative studio partnering with storytellers to turn their ambitions into stunning reality. By blending the time-honored craft of filmmaking with breakthrough technologies, we unlock bold, cinematic visions at scale. Our three pillars - VFX, Studios and Labs - form the creative spine of Eyeline, guiding how we think, work, and show up in every frame.
  
  
At Eyeline, we believe technology serves artistry and our people are the soul behind everything we do, deepening creative connection, rather than replacing it. We build worlds with exceptional craft and precision, working hand in hand with our creative partners from concept to final pixel.
  
  
Netflix Investment- Eyeline
  
  
With the support of Netflix’s investment in our pipeline, infrastructure, and workforce, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in visual effects and virtual production technology. In addition to our work with Netflix, we continue to partner with a wide range of long-standing and new clients worldwide.
  
  
Come as you are
  
  
We are looking for those seeking to take risks with us, those driven by passion for their craft. To us, these are key ingredients that we look for in our team. We are committed to ensuring fair and equal treatment of your application. When you apply for a role with us, you will receive consideration based solely on your qualifications.

title: Manager I, Ops, Linehaul
description:
**Description**
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
  
  
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products and enterprise services. APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across Amazon’s transportation network. It ensures hassle-free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
  
  
Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team (RCMT) within NOC is the centralized risk management function for RoW Surface Transportation. This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. Our overarching vision is to ensure that bad actors never derive any benefit from Amazon by exploiting our policies. To achieve this, RCMT relies on sound judgment, technical expertise, and a robust risk management framework. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.
  
  
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock risk coverage across time zones.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Process Expertise & Subject Matter Leadership — Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Surface Transportation processes and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for risk management within the assigned RoW geographies. Maintain subject matter expertise specific to job functions and general industry awareness to provide informed recommendations to leadership.
* Risk Mitigation & Process Improvement — Apply risk-management best practices and methodologies to mitigate identified risk issues. Execute against established SOPs, identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement, draft SOP revisions, and conduct risk assessments for new process implementations to ensure vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated before go-live.
* Team Management & Development — Manage and supervise investigators — including workload assignment, quality review of investigation outputs, SLA adherence monitoring, and calibration. Mentor new hires and participate in the development and delivery of risk management training.
* Trend Analysis & Financial Impact Quantification — Conduct weekly and monthly trend analysis across assigned RoW geographies, including period-over-period comparisons and concentration analysis. Own the financial impact quantification framework — tracking cost leakage, cost avoidance, and cost savings attributable to risk interventions, coordinating with finance for periodic validation.
* Proactive Risk Identification & Expansion — Proactively identify new risk patterns through systematic analysis of investigation outputs and region-specific vulnerability assessments. Drive cross-pollination of risk management learnings into adjacent operational functions and workstreams to expand the program’s impact beyond core scope.

Perform deep-dive analysis and draft COE based on identified deviations and recommend appropriate solutions to ensure leadership visibility into program health and outcomes.

title: Group Lead – Content Approval Excellence & Content Operations
description:
* Hiring Manager: Head – Scientific Communications, Medical Information & Graphics – Medical Hub
* Location: Hyderabad
* % of travel expected: As per business need
* Job type: Permanent and Full time

**About The Job**
Our ambition: deliver best-in-class enterprise services enabling Sanofi to chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Sanofi has been building the foundations of enterprise services over the past few years. With the creation of the global business unit Business Operations two years ago, we have elevated our commitment to innovation and excellence.
  
  
**Our Team**
Sanofi Global Hub (SGH) is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in India and is setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R&D, Data & Digital functions. SGH strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, Globally.
  
  
**Our Critical Success Factors**
We have identified three key drivers:
  
  

* Community - Building a vibrant team that will attract and engage talent, with four global hubs.
* Excellence - Simplifying, standardizing and continuously improving processes to capture synergies, scale effects and productivity improvements.
* Digitalisation - Enabling transparency, data-driven decision-making support, agility and rapid innovation across Sanofi's entire value chain.

**Main Responsibilities**
The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:
  
  

* Provides functional and operational leadership to the Scientific Communications Operations team and Capabilities & Practices operating model, acting as the domain expert for the relevant activities within these teams, engaging stakeholders, developing the team members, and acting as a strategic thought partner aligned with the vision of the Sci Comms team.
* The Group Lead – Content Approval Excellence & Content Operations is accountable for designing, governing and continuously improving the operating framework that enables high-quality, efficient and scalable delivery across Scientific Communications.
* The role brings together content operations, scientific/content standards, process excellence, quality-at-source principles, workflow governance and technology-enabled ways of working to create a seamless end-to-end content lifecycle. The role partners closely with BO Sci Comms Leads, Medical Information, Creative, Digital/Technology, Operational Readiness, Learning & Development, Global Process Lead/GOP Owner and global Sci Comms stakeholders to enable first-time-right quality, predictable delivery, reduced rework and sustained excellence.
* The role also serves as the functional owner of the Scientific Communications quality management framework, integrating capabilities, preventive controls, independent monitoring, issues, and continuous audit readiness.
* This role is accountable not simply for running existing processes, but for continuously challenging, redesigning and improving how work is performed, embedding quality at source and leveraging technology to drive innovation and improve quality, speed, scalability and trust.

**Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities**
Acts as a strategic thought partner to the Hub Function Head of Sci Comms, MI, Graphics and Creativity aligned with the vision of the function. A trusted executive partner who anticipates needs, brings structure to complexity, communicates effectively and ensures priorities translate into timely action—allowing the Function Head to focus on strategic leadership and business outcomes.
  
  
**Content Operations Management**

* Own the operational framework enabling effective delivery across the content lifecycle—from project brief through creation, review, approval and completion.
* Establish clear end-to-end workflows, roles, decision rights and handoffs.
* Oversee content/project operations and ensure effective workflow coordination, disciplined project execution and data records, prioritization, capacity visibility and delivery governance.
* Define operational service levels and performance expectations; identify and eliminate unnecessary handoffs, duplicate activities and administrative burden.
* Establish scalable operating practices across therapeutic areas and content types and oversee relevant operational services within the function’s remit.
* Own the project management support for the Sci Comms delivery ensuring the end-to-end effective project delivery of the designated publication/medical education deliverable across all phases.

**Capabilities & Internal Control Framework Management**

* Own the design, governance and continuous improvement of a risk-based Scientific Communications Quality Management Framework, integrated with the end-to-end content operating model and applicable internal requirements.
* Define controlled scientific/content standards, authoring and technical review standards, quality-at-source controls and role-specific control responsibilities.
* Connect the established competency framework to a documented qualification pathway: foundational training, shadowing, supervised live work, assessment, authorization for independent work and ongoing proficiency monitoring.
* Define consistent qualification criteria, evidence requirements, reassessment triggers and project-role/risk-tier eligibility rules; partner with people managers who retain accountability for individual qualification decisions.
* Design and establish risk-based management quality monitoring, including independent sampling of content and workflow records to verify that required controls operated effectively—not merely that the final asset was acceptable.
* Define quality issue taxonomy, assessment criteria, trend analysis and escalation triggers, distinguishing scientific/content issues from process-control failures; align severity and escalation pathways with relevant leads and owners.
* Lead root-cause analysis of systemic quality failures and coordinate corrective/preventive improvements, documented ownership, follow-up sampling and effectiveness verification.
* Establish periodic management monitoring reviews, with clear reporting of qualification coverage, first-time-right quality, issue trends, control adherence, repeat findings and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Enable continuous audit readiness through controlled playbooks, qualification and training evidence, traceable workflow/review records, monitoring logs, action registers and documented management oversight, aligned to Sanofi records requirements.
* Ensuring quality assurance remains proportionate to scientific risk and avoids unnecessary duplicate checks or new administrative handoffs.

**Sci Comms Content Systems, Digital & AI Integration**

* Act as the Hub Medical Communications champion for content workflow requirements within Veeva and associated content systems.
* Continuous evaluation of business requirements for efficient authoring, reference management, review and approval Veeva workflows.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation and system-enabled quality controls.
* Partner with Digital/IT/Innovation leads, product owner, and other appropriate functions on configuration and technology implementation, while retaining clear boundaries between business-process ownership and technical system ownership.
* Partner with Analytics for content/workflow metrics to identify bottlenecks, adoption gaps and opportunities.

**Knowledge Management Ecosystem**

* Lead implementation and adoption of new processes across teams.
* Partner with people managers to identify recurring capability gaps and embed sustainable improvements.
* Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement and operational discipline.
* Define and monitor measures including first time-right rate, review comments/rework, quality issues, cycle time, time to first draft, review/approval cycles.
* Translate operational data into actionable insights, root-cause interventions and measurable improvement.

**SciComms Vendor Operations & Payments Management**

* Own and oversee the vendor operations for payments, copyrights management.
* Lead and own compliant processes for vendor payments for print & shipment of Sci Comms materials.
* Partner with procurement, finance for effective management of business processes.

**SciComms & MI Operational Excellence**

* Design and improve workflows and processes
* Drive standardization of processes, templates, and tools
* Lead capacity planning, demand management and resource optimization
* Identify scope for further improvement and expansion through new initiatives and accreditations
* Own and maintain Business Continuity Plan (BCP): development, testing, updates, and stakeholder alignment to ensure MI function resilience and continuity during disruptions
* To create synergies and provide functional and operational direction across global business units, segments and key markets operations across various therapeutic areas and processes so that cost savings up to 10 mil euros are achieved with deliveries optimized through multi-layered teams.
* Demonstrates resolve and urgency to accomplish tasks without direct authority or control. Participate in cross-functional project teams as needed. Ensure that assigned projects are completed on schedule.

**People**

* Maintain effective relationships with the end stakeholders across multiple Global business units and products.
* Interact effectively with stakeholders in multiple departments.
* Constantly assist SciComms and MI writers in developing knowledge and sharing expertise.

**Performance**

* Act as a strategic thought partner, operational and functional leader, providing coaching, mentoring, and expertise support.
* Provide functional expert support and oversight of deliverables.
* Supports delivery of projects in terms of resourcing, quality, timeliness, efficiency, and high technical standards.

**Process**

* Support delivery of projects in terms of resourcing, quality, timeliness, efficiency, and high technical standards for deliveries made by the group
* Contribute to overall quality enhancement by ensuring high scientific standards for the output produced by the group;
* Secure adherence to compliance procedures and internal/operational risk controls in accordance with any and all applicable regulatory standards;
* Implement relevant elements of content plans and associated activities for the year identified for the assigned countries.
* Work with selected vendors within the region to deliver the required deliverables as per the defined process.
* Design an overall plan of action basis end-customers feedback & improve course content and delivery, continuous improvement and efficiency.

**Stakeholder**

* Work closely with medical teams globally across GBUs as well as in countries/regions/areas to identify Sci Comms capability needs and assist in developing operating frameworks.
* Support regulatory interactions with various health authorities for inspections or audits, risk management and business continuity.
* Support the Head of SciComms Partner with Sci Comms Leadership Team for business expectations and deliveries Manage Budget, Org data & Headcount planning and ‘play to win’ priorities Oversee governance, demand and resource management, and strategic exercises Drive internal communications and project/change management across teams Represent Head SciComms in internal and external forums as needed.

**Experience**
**About you**

* Approximately 12–15+ years of relevant experience, with capability and demonstrated impact prioritized over tenure. Significant experience in pharmaceutical Medical Communications, Scientific Communications, Medical Affairs/content operations or related functions.
* ≥12 years of experience implementing risk-based quality management, competency qualification, monitoring/sampling, root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective-action mechanisms in regulated content operations for Medical Communications/ Scientific Communications.
* Demonstrated experience designing and improving complex end-to-end content processes.
* Strong experience and understanding of pharmaceutical content development and scientific review/approval workflows.
* Experience with Veeva Vault/MedComms/PromoMats or comparable regulated content-management platforms.
* Experience establishing quality standards, governance and process controls.
* Strong process-improvement, analytical and problem-solving capability.
* Experience leading cross-functional transformation in a matrix environment.
* Strong stakeholder management, change leadership and people leadership capability.
* Experience in content creation or scientific writing for the pharmaceuticals/healthcare industry; At least 10 years of direct medical communications experience in the pharmaceutical company;
* Minimum 5 years of experience in managing global, cross-functional teams and working in, a Matrix environment; strong ability in managing a multi-layered team of ≥20 members; and ability to influence and negotiate difficult situations.
* Preferred Lean/Six Sigma or equivalent process-excellence experience.
* Experience with AI-enabled content workflows, automation or digital transformation.
* Experience with content reuse, modular/structured content and reference/scientific-statement libraries.
* Experience developing operational/process-excellence, talent and leading teams in Sci Comms.

**Soft Skills**

* Lead complex Event Management, Major Incident Management, and Mission Control activities to ensure the stability and availability of critical technology services.

**Job Summary**
Functions as the strategic business leader of the property’s food and beverage/culinary operation, including Restaurants/Bars, Room Service and Banquets/Catering, where applicable. Position oversees the development and implementation of departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures the food and beverage/culinary operation meets the brand’s target customer needs, ensures employee satisfaction, and focuses on growing revenues and maximizing the financial performance of the department. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
  
  
**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
**Education And Experience**

* High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, event management, or related professional area.

OR
  
  

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, event management, or related professional area.

**Skills And Knowledge**

* Customer and Personal Service - Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction.
* Management of Financial Resources - Determining how money will be spent to get the work done, and accounting for these expenditures.
* Administration and Management - Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, human resources modeling, leadership technique, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.
* Applied Business Knowledge - Understanding market dynamics, enterprise level objectives and important aspects of the company’s business to accurately diagnose strengths and weaknesses, anticipate opportunities and risks, identify issues, and develop strategies and plans. Aligning individual and team actions with strategies and plans to drive business results.
* Management of Material Resources - Obtaining and seeing to the appropriate use of equipment, facilities, and materials needed to do certain work.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**
**Developing and Maintaining Food and Beverage/Culinary Goals**

* Sets expectations and holds food and beverage leadership team accountable for demonstrating desired service behaviors.
* Reviews financial reports and statements to determine how Food and Beverage is performing against budget.
* Makes recommendations for CAPEX funding of food and beverage equipment and renovations in accordance with brand business strategy.
* Works with food and beverage leadership team to determine areas of concern and develops strategies to improve the department’s financial performance.
* Establishes challenging, realistic and obtainable goals to guide operation and performance.
* Strives to improve service performance.

**Developing and Maintaining Budgets**

* Develops and manages Food and Beverage budget.
* Monitors the department’s actual and projected sales to ensure revenue goals are met or exceeded and opportunities are identified and addressed.
* Ensures cash control and liquor control policies are in place in food & beverage areas and followed by all related employees.
* Focuses on maintaining profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.

**Leading Food and Beverage/Culinary Team**

* Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
* Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
* Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
* Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
* Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.
* Identifies opportunities to increase profits and create value by challenging existing processes, encouraging innovation and driving necessary change.
* Ensures that regular, on-going communication occurs in all areas of food and beverage (e.g., pre-meal briefings, staff meetings, culinary team).
* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with direct reports and entire food & beverage team. Ensures direct reports do the same for their team.
* Develops a food and beverage operating strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.
* Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
* Stays aware of market trends and introduces new food and beverage products to meet or exceed customer expectations, generate increased revenue and ensure a competitive position in the market.

**Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service**

* Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
* Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
* Reviews findings from comment cards and guest satisfaction results with F& B team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.
* Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
* Empowers employees to provide excellent guest service.
* Estimates cost and benefit ratio, maintaining balance between profit and service satisfaction.
* Shares plans to take corrective action based on comment cards and guest satisfaction results with property leadership.

**Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities**

* Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
* Coaches and supports food & beverage leadership team to effectively manage wages, food & beverage cost and controllable expenses (e.g., restaurant supplies, uniforms, etc.).
* Hires food & beverage leadership team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
* Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.
* Ensures that expectations and objectives are clearly communicated to subordinates; subordinates are also open to raise questions and/or concerns.
* Brings issues to the attention of Human Resources as necessary.
* Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
* Coaches team by providing specific feedback to improve performance.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Informs and/or update the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
* Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
* Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Estimate food, liquor, wine, and other beverage consumption in order to anticipate amounts to be purchased or requisitioned.

description:

We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About Global Business Services**
Our Finance team is not just another department; we're strategic partners and catalysts for change, who use our expertise to drive sustainable growth and create and protect value Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS). Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co-creativity - while learning together - OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Manager - Intercompany Financial Systems is responsible for the design, governance, and continuous improvement of the Intercompany systems landscape. This role serves as the critical link between Finance, Tax, and IT, ensuring that intercompany business requirements are effectively translated into system design and technology solutions.
  
  
The role owns end-to-end process understanding, drives system enhancements and maintains governance standards to support efficient, compliant and scalable operations across the Intercompany Centre of Excellence (CoE).
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Intercompany Operations & Systems
  
  

* Act as the SME for intercompany processes, systems, and tools.
* Manage intercompany operations, system integrations, and data flows.
* Partner with Finance, Tax, Controllership, Master Data, and Technology teams to ensure efficient and compliant processes.
* Translate business requirements into system and process improvements.

Systems, Governance & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Lead system enhancements, upgrades, testing, and change initiatives.
* Assess the impact of business, organizational, and transfer pricing changes.
* Maintain strong controls, data integrity, compliance, and process documentation.
* Identify risks and control gaps, driving timely remediation.
* Drive standardization, simplification, automation, and data quality improvements.
* Promote best practices and operational excellence across intercompany operations.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 8-10 years of experience in Finance Systems, ERP Governance, or Process Excellence.
* Experience managing system implementations, enhancements, or large-scale change initiatives.
* Proven experience working across Finance, Tax and Technology
* Strong exposure to process governance, controls, and operating model design

The skills for success
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business Administration, Technology, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of finance processes, transfer pricing operations, and intercompany accounting.
* Experience with ERP environments, preferably SAP and integrated finance systems.
* Strong knowledge of system design principles, process mapping, testing methodologies, and change management.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical specifications.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt’s potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt’s pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don’t always ‘tick all the boxes’. That’s why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don’t meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law

title: Senior Manager, Fraud Operations - India
description:
Ascensus is the leading independent technology and service platform powering savings plans across America, providing products and expertise that help nearly 16 million people save for a better today and tomorrow.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
Ascensus is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Fraud Operations – India to manage, lead and develop India-based fraud operations team and work in close partnership with the parent company’s Fraud Operations team in the United States. The role will support the effective detection, investigation, mitigation, and prevention of fraud and financial crime through disciplined case management, strong operational controls, timely escalation, insightful reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role suited to a fraud operations professional who has previously managed a similar function or team. The Senior Manager will translate priorities established with U.S. stakeholders into clear team objectives, ensure consistent execution, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture. The role will balance risk mitigation, operational efficiency, quality, and client experience while ensuring adherence to applicable policies, procedures, governance requirements, and data-protection expectations.
  
  
**Job Functions, Essential Duties And Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the day-to-day delivery of fraud investigation and fraud operations activities performed by the India team, ensuring timely, accurate, and consistent case outcomes.
* Own departmental performance, including fraud losses, service levels, productivity, quality, employee engagement, and operational effectiveness.
* Lead, coach, and develop team of fraud investigators and/or analysts; set clear expectations, allocate work, monitor capacity, provide regular feedback, and support skill development.
* Partner closely with the U.S. Fraud Operations team to align on operating procedures, investigation standards, priorities, service expectations, escalation protocols, and risk-treatment decisions.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators, risk metrics, and reporting to evaluate program effectiveness and support executive decision-making.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for significant fraud events, regulatory matters, and business critical risk issues.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, governance standards, and investigative procedures.
* Build and maintain relationships with industry partners, vendors, law enforcement, and external stakeholders to strengthen fraud prevention and response efforts.
* Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.
* At Ascensus we are guided by our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always®. They inspire us every day to prioritize an environment of respect for those we serve and one another and should be visible in your actions on a day-to-day..

**Supervision**

* Lead and develop team leads, and Fraud Investigators, creating a culture of accountability, engagement, and operational excellence.

description:

**Job Title:**

After-Sales / Service Operations & Body Shop

Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Trimulgherry, Secunderabad

Automobile / 4-Wheeler Dealership

Full-Time | On-Site

2. Job Purpose

To lead and manage the overall After-Sales operations, including General Service, Mechanical Repairs, Body Shop, Paint Shop and Customer Service functions.

The AGM will be responsible for driving business growth, workshop productivity, labour sales, body shop revenue, profitability, customer satisfaction and operational excellence while ensuring compliance with OEM standards, company policies and statutory requirements.

3. Key Responsibilities

**A. Workshop & Service Operations Management**

* Oversee day-to-day operations of the General Service and Mechanical Workshop.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, service bays, tools, equipment and workshop infrastructure.
* Monitor workshop loading, job allocation, vehicle repair progress and delivery commitments.
* Drive workshop productivity, labour efficiency, bay utilization and turnaround time (TAT).
* Ensure adherence to OEM repair procedures, service standards and operating guidelines.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective measures to improve workshop performance.

**B. Body Shop & Insurance Operations**

* Manage end-to-end Body Shop and Paint Shop operations.
* Monitor accident repair processes, job allocation and vehicle delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with insurance companies, surveyors and customers for claim approvals and settlements.
* Drive insurance claim conversion, accident repair business and body shop revenue.
* Ensure quality repairs, proper paint finish and timely vehicle delivery.
* Monitor rework percentage and improve first-time-right repair performance.
* Control material consumption, repair costs and body shop profitability.

**C. Customer Satisfaction & Relationship Management**

* Ensure a consistent and superior customer experience across Service and Body Shop operations.
* Monitor customer complaints, escalations and resolution timelines.
* Drive improvement in Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI), customer retention and repeat business.
* Review customer feedback and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure effective coordination between Service Advisors, Body Shop Advisors and customer-facing teams.

**D. Financial & Business Performance**

* Achieve monthly and annual targets for workshop revenue, labour sales and body shop business.
* Monitor service absorption, labour productivity, efficiency and operating expenses.
* Drive revenue growth while maintaining operational profitability.
* Control warranty, goodwill, rework and other operational costs.
* Prepare and review monthly business plans, budgets, forecasts and performance reports.
* Analyse business performance and take corrective action wherever required.

**E. Team Leadership & Manpower Development**

* Lead and manage Service Advisors, Technicians, Workshop Supervisors, Body Shop Advisors, Denters, Painters and other support staff.
* Set performance targets and monitor individual and departmental productivity.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching and development sessions.
* Identify training requirements and ensure technical and behavioural skill development.
* Build a performance-driven culture focused on accountability, discipline and continuous improvement.
* Ensure adequate manpower planning and optimum workforce utilization.

**F. Process, Quality & OEM Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with OEM standards, dealership processes, safety guidelines and statutory requirements.
* Conduct regular workshop audits, quality inspections and process reviews.
* Implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and repair quality.
* Maintain workshop housekeeping, 5S, safety and cleanliness standards.
* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to warranty and service procedures.

**G. Inventory & Resource Management**

* Coordinate with the Parts Department to ensure timely availability of spare parts and consumables.
* Monitor tools, equipment, workshop infrastructure and maintenance requirements.
* Ensure effective control of consumables, paint materials and other workshop resources.
* Minimize resource wastage, vehicle idle time and operational bottlenecks.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters:

* Overall Service and Workshop Revenue
* Labour Sales Achievement
* Body Shop and Paint Shop Revenue
* Insurance Claim Conversion
* Workshop Productivity and Labour Efficiency
* Bay Utilization
* Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI)
* Customer Retention and Repeat Business
* Accident Repair Turnaround Time (TAT)
* Rework and First-Time-Right Repair Percentage
* Employee Productivity and Manpower Utilization
* Warranty Compliance and Cost Control
* Overall Departmental Profitability

5. Educational Qualification

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering.
* MBA or relevant management qualification will be an added advantage.

6. Experience Requirements

* 10–15 years of overall experience in Automobile After-Sales Operations.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in managerial roles such as Service Manager, Workshop Manager, Works Manager, Body Shop Manager or equivalent.
* **Mandatory:**
  Proven experience managing both Service Workshop and Body Shop operations.
* Strong exposure to 4-wheeler automobile dealership operations.
* Experience with Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai, Tata Motors, Mahindra, Kia, Toyota or other reputed passenger vehicle brands will be preferred.

7. Skills & Competencies

* End-to-End Service and Workshop Operations Management
* Body Shop, Paint Shop and Insurance Claim Management
* Business Development and Revenue Generation
* Workshop Productivity and Profitability Management
* Customer Relationship and Escalation Management
* Team Leadership and Manpower Development
* Financial Planning, Budgeting and MIS Analysis
* OEM Process and Quality Compliance
* Operational Planning and Process Improvement
* Strong Communication, Analytical and Decision-Making Skills

8. Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a result-oriented automobile professional with strong leadership experience in managing both Service Workshop and Body Shop operations.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to drive revenue growth, improve workshop productivity, manage insurance operations, enhance customer satisfaction and lead large teams while maintaining high standards of operational efficiency, repair quality and profitability.
