title: Manager Global Product Supply Planning
description:
**Accountabilities:**
Part of a multinational and multicultural organization that is committed to professional development. Reporting to the Head Global Supply Planning within the Global Supply Chain Organization. Responsible for delivering robust global supply plans, providing supply chain reporting, and maintaining master data integrity using Amgen’s planning and execution systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Leading complex and multi-faceted end-to-end product supply chain and network balancing scenario analyses that support critical business decision making.
* Presenting outcome of scenario analyses to Senior and Executive Management
* Develop supply transition strategy for Life Cycle Management initiatives
* Leading supply transition plans amongst existing supply chain nodes based on changes to supply, demand or regulatory approval assumption for Life Cycle Management initiatives
* Provides leadership in balancing supply plans amongst several manufacturing stages/sites that supports demand and maintains safety stock levels (monthly)
* Presents end-to-end Demand & Supply plans, including Supply Planning Quality Checks, to ensure plan integrity at Planning Cycle completion (monthly)
* Performs pre-planning quality checks to ensure MRP integrity (monthly) for a number of Amgen commercial products.
* Establishes supply plans for new supply chain nodes using strategic inputs provided by the Global Supply Chain Lead (GSCL)
* Support & adopts supply chain automation & AI Transformation initiatives
* Is a standing member on the Global Supply Chain Team and provides key risks and insights to anticipate risks & opportunities and closes blind spots in the end-to-end Supply Chain
* Business process owner of the following Supply Chain business processes:
* Annual Working Cell Bank Supply Management
* Global Temperature Excursion Form Generation and updating
* Supply Chain reporting to Tax and Treasury Departments
* Global Master Data Integrity – Request & Maintenance of SAP & RapidResponse Master Data

**Qualifications:**

Doctorate degree OR
  
  
Master’s degree and 2 years of directly related experience OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of directly related experience OR
  
  
High school diploma / GED and 12 years of directly related experience

AOP - OPEX @ 10 – 15 CR and CAPEX 50 – 100 CR (BASED ON THE PROJECTONS)

A team of 40 Airside officers and service providers of approx 150 members engaged for support services

* 15 -20 years experience with minimum 8 years exp in ATC / Airside Operations / Airside Engineering
* Minimum 10 years in airport handling with around 500 Air Traffic Movements (ATMs) per day

title: Supervisor - Managed Services
description:
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
This Managed Services position is responsible for excellent customer service to both internal and external parties. This role encompasses project delivery, implementation, product education, career growth of employees and development. Managed Services seeks a motivated, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast paced and ever-changing work environment. This position oversees Managed Services offerings and other products and services that fall under this classification. This position will report to the Manager of Managed Services while working with other support departments like Product development and Business reporting teams. The Supervisor of Managed Services executes various work requests and tasks for career development, corrective action, customer engagement, product utilization, and special projects as assigned.
**This position requires effective time management skills, a passion for excellent customer service, performance excellence, attention to detail, and a high level of integrity and work ethic.**
**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced knowledge of Excel
* Ability to work with a little direction or guidance
* Create outlines of new projects and process documentation
* Determined, detail oriented, and proactive individual
* Strong accountability and integrity due to sensitive nature of information
* Strong customer support and management skills
* Clear and effective verbal and written communication
* Salesforce knowledge or a relatable CRM tool
* Ability to identify and solve internal and customer problems by aiding in process upgrades
* Prior account management or relatable experience
* Ability to locate areas of time saving enhancements or product improvements for a given product or service
* Ability to participate and provide constructive feedback in developmental meetings with customer and GHX executives
* Ready to be challenged in handling expert associates and guide them to the success
* Ability to analyze data reports and generate insights, provide action plan to save effort and time via scalable/short term automations.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with customers to increase understanding and utilization of the Managed Services offering.
* Provide support via phone, email, and on site to customers and GHX coworkers for escalations and any related product issues.
* Conduct Quality assessment over the team’s output and share feedback at associate level to drive quality.
* Monitor the predetermined quality metrics of a customer and implement resolutions if metrics are below acceptable levels. Escalate when appropriate.
* Proactively create projects and process efficiencies to constantly improve scalability, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Provide clear and actionable instructions to managed service analysts for daily tasks and project work.
* Demonstrate effective time management of projects and meetings while adhering to deadlines.
* Mentor team members, refine processes, and develop resource materials.
* Mentor direct reports for career development and leadership skills.
* Effective Management of bottom performers with an achievable action plan
* Improve self and team work ethic through continuous coaching and education.
* High level oversight of customer activity and account health to increase adoption of GHX’s recommended practices.
* Critically think to resolve technical problems and work cross-functionally when needed.
* Coordinate launch schedules of assigned product offering base and raise staffing needs to management
* Assist with identification and development of new system enhancements to benefit department offerings.
* Independently identify and execute performance action plans to increase engagement of the customer.
* Create, learn, revise, and communicate established process to all team members including internal management.
* Maintain a high performing team and analyze process for areas of improvement and quality assurance.

**Education & Experience:**

* B.Tech/ B.E Required
* 2-3 Years of experience in People Management

title: Service Delivery Leader
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. Primary Responsibilities:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end performance of the function across service, quality, productivity, financials, workforce, risk, and stakeholder outcomes
* Translate enterprise priorities into annual business plans, operating strategies, budgets, capacity plans, and measurable goals
* Lead a large, multi-layered organization through Service Delivery Managers, Deputy Managers, Supervisors, and operational teams
* Ensure delivery against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory or business-control requirements
* Drive Open Enrollment and peak-season readiness across staffing, training, technology, capacity, governance, and contingency planning
* Own budgeting, forecasting, utilization, productivity, cost optimization, and delivery of financial commitments
* Lead OBRs, QBRs, executive reviews, strategic planning discussions, and critical business escalations
* Build trusted relationships with onshore leaders, clients, and cross-functional partners
* Define and sponsor the functional transformation agenda, including automation, AI, analytics, process simplification, and operating-model improvements
* Proactively identify operational and customer risks and ensure timely mitigation, escalation, and sustainable corrective actions
* Build leadership capability through coaching, succession planning, talent development, and clearly defined accountability
* Partner with Product, Technology, Finance, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Compliance, and other business functions
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, employee engagement, and continuous improvement
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements Required Qualifications:
* Overall experience of 15+ years, including significant experience leading large and complex operational functions
* Proven experience managing through multiple levels of leadership, including Service Delivery Managers or equivalent roles
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, capacity planning, productivity management, cost optimization, and business-case development
* Experience in workforce strategy, organizational design, leadership development, and succession planning
* Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of service delivery, people, financials, quality, risk, and stakeholder outcomes
* Solid understanding of Open Enrollment, AEP, Case Installation, Benefit Content, Benefit Configuration, ODM, or comparable healthcare operations
* Demonstrated success in leading transformation, automation, process redesign, or technology-enabled change
* Solid executive communication, business presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, root-cause analysis, and operational excellence practices
* Ability to interpret complex business data and convert insights into strategic and operational decisions
* Willingness to work from the office and provide leadership support during business-aligned shifts, peak seasons, holidays, or critical delivery periods.
* Leadership Expectations:
* Ability to operate with an enterprise mindset and make decisions based on overall business value
* Ability to demonstrate Solid executive presence, business acumen, and decision-making capability
* Ability to own outcomes across operations, customer experience, people, financials, risk, and transformation
* Ability to challenge the status quo and promote scalable, technology-enabled solutions
* Ability to build a Solid leadership pipeline and create an accountable, inclusive, and high-performing organization
* Ability to anticipate business risks and opportunities rather than responding only after issues arise
* Interpersonal Skills:
* Proven e excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proven creative, responsive and adaptive in a dynamic environment and a good team player
* Ability to adhere & drive all established company policies & procedures
* Ability to work independently and creatively research and implement new solutions
* Ability to work under pressure and deliver within required turn-around times
* Should be flexible to adapt to quick delivery models
* Should be flexible to work in Evening/Night Shifts - 6:00/8:30 PM Shift throughout the year
* Flexible to support the team during holidays and work extended hours as per the Business requirement At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

title: Director Imaging Operations Asia
description:

Min Experience: 8+ years
  
  
Location: Hyderabad

Imaging Operations

Asia
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Director of Imaging Operations – Asia to lead and manage the Imaging Operations (iOPs) department, with a primary focus on the Clinical Trials Imaging Specialists (CTIS) team across Asia and other regions as required. The role will be responsible for leading, mentoring, and developing a high-performing team of radiology technologists while ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and adherence to quality management standards.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in clinical research operations and the imaging Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry, along with strong expertise in CT, MRI, and/or PET imaging. This individual will drive departmental strategy, optimize imaging systems and workflows, strengthen team capabilities, and support the successful delivery of clinical imaging services throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.
  
  
**Requirements**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Contribute to the strategic direction of the Imaging Operations and CTIS departments, including defining annual goals, objectives, and growth initiatives
* Lead, mentor, and develop the CTIS team, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and high-performance work environment
* Drive the enhancement and optimization of imaging systems, including Medidata, PACS, OsiriX, and Clindex, while exploring opportunities to integrate AI into operational workflows in collaboration with AI leadership
* Review and improve departmental processes, procedures, training programs, support structures, and performance standards to strengthen efficiency and compliance
* Oversee imaging operations across the complete clinical trial lifecycle, from work orders and study startup through study conduct and closure
* Develop and maintain robust operational procedures, including study-specific processes, training protocols, and verification mechanisms
* Establish effective day-to-day oversight, ensuring consistent adherence to procedures, timely issue escalation, and appropriate support for team members
* Periodically assess the suitability of operational procedures and monitor staff compliance with established standards
* Identify staffing and supervisory requirements, support recruitment, and provide coaching, mentoring, and professional development opportunities
* Optimize departmental structure and workplace practices to attract, retain, and develop qualified professionals
* Coordinate with internal departments and project teams to ensure effective resource allocation, priority planning, project execution, and communication
* Manage departmental compliance with applicable regulations, accreditation requirements, and regulatory agency guidance
* Collaborate with Project Managers and Project Coordinators to support cross-functional deliverables and operational requirements
* Work with Finance and executive management to forecast and track work order revenue and expenses, maximize revenue, and manage operational costs
* Represent Imaging Operations in client meetings, presentations, audits, and inspections as required
* Ensure accurate and timely study status reporting to clients and management
* Perform additional responsibilities as required to support departmental and organizational objectives

Education and Experience
  
  
  

* Master's degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Life Sciences, or a related field
* Certification or qualification as a Radiology Technologist
* Demonstrated expertise in CT imaging, with experience in MRI and/or PET imaging
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in clinical research operations, including leadership responsibilities
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in the imaging CRO industry

Must-Have Skills
  
  
  

* Radiology Technology
* CT Imaging
* Oncology
* Clinical Research Operations
* Imaging Operations Management
* Team Leadership and Development
* Regulatory Compliance and Quality Management
* Clinical Trial Imaging Workflows

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  
  

* MRI Imaging
* PET Imaging
* Imaging Systems and PACS
* Medidata, OsiriX, and Clindex
* AI Integration in Clinical Workflows
* Clinical Trial Management Systems
* Image Transmission, Processing, and Analysis

Required Competencies
  
  
  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Strong strategic and tactical thinking, with the ability to translate departmental objectives into operational outcomes
* Exceptional attention to detail and a consistent commitment to quality, accuracy, and procedural compliance
* Ability to understand complex clinical research protocols and operate effectively within a regulated clinical research environment
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and people-development capabilities
* Ability to manage projects and collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders across departments and regions
* Service-oriented, flexible, and proactive approach to addressing internal and client requirements
* Excellent prioritization, multitasking, time management, and organizational skills
* Ability to work effectively under pressure in a dynamic and complex business environment
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and capable of quickly understanding and implementing new operational requirements
* High ethical standards and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive information and records
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, internet applications, imaging technologies, and clinical trial management systems
* Strong ownership, accountability, problem-solving abilities, and a positive, results-driven attitude

Team Values and Culture
  
  
The role requires a strong commitment to advancing patient care through medical imaging and supporting clinical research that improves the lives of patients, particularly those affected by cancer. The successful candidate will demonstrate integrity, accountability, intellectual curiosity, collaboration, and a consistent commitment to excellence.
  
  
They should be comfortable working within a dynamic global team, supporting colleagues, solving complex problems, meeting deadlines, and continuously improving operational practices. Quality, ethical conduct, teamwork, and patient-focused outcomes must remain central to all activities.
  
  
Physical Requirements
  
  
The position regularly involves using hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, reaching with hands and arms, and communicating through speaking and listening. The employee will frequently be required to sit. The role also requires the visual capabilities necessary to perform imaging operations-related responsibilities.

title: Telecaller Floor Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Anytime Diesel is India’s leading doorstep fuel delivery and fuel management company, transforming how businesses access and control their energy needs. Powered by advanced technology, including IoT-enabled systems, GPS tracking, geo-fencing, AI, and data-driven fuel intelligence, the company delivers safe, tamper-proof, and on-time diesel across India. Serving 10,000+ clients in sectors such as infrastructure, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and residential complexes, Anytime Diesel focuses on reducing downtime, preventing fuel theft, and improving transparency. Its solutions include smart fuel storage tanks, Diesel Cube systems, and Fuelistic IoT logistics technology, creating an integrated fuel management ecosystem built for safety, compliance, and operational control. Through the Fuel for Trees initiative, Anytime Diesel aligns fuel delivery with environmental responsibility, supporting sustainable progress.

**Role Description**
The Tele caller Floor Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Hyderabad Area, responsible for leading and managing a team of tele callers to ensure high-quality customer interactions and efficient call operations. This role oversees daily calling activities, monitors performance metrics, and implements call scripts and guidelines to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction. The Tele caller Floor Manager coordinates call schedules, assigns targets, and provides regular coaching, feedback, and training to team members. The role also involves handling escalations, collaborating with sales and operations teams to align communication with business goals, and generating reports on call outcomes, lead status, and team productivity. The Tele caller Floor Manager maintains discipline on the floor, ensures adherence to company policies, and supports a positive, goal-oriented work environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Team Management & Floor Operations

● Lead, supervise, and motivate the telecalling team to achieve daily, weekly, and

monthly targets.

● Allocate leads, customer follow-ups, and calling activities among team members.

● Monitor attendance, punctuality, login hours, break schedules, and overall floor

discipline.

● Conduct daily team briefings, performance reviews, and regular feedback sessions.

● Support team members in handling difficult customer conversations and achieving

performance targets.

● Identify training needs and improve individual and team productivity.

2. Call Monitoring & Performance Management

● Monitor call quality, call recordings, customer interactions, and follow-up discipline.

● Track key performance indicators such as daily calls, connected calls, qualified leads,

conversions, and follow-up completion.

● Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for management.

● Maintain team dashboards, calling reports, lead trackers, and customer databases.

● Identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions to improve results.

● Ensure adherence to calling scripts, communication standards, and company

processes.

3. Customer Engagement & Lead Management

● Ensure timely follow-ups with prospective and existing customers.

● Guide the team in explaining Anytime Diesel’s services, fuel delivery process, pricing,

and business benefits.

● Improve lead qualification, customer activation, repeat business, and customer

retention.

● Handle customer complaints, escalations, and service-related queries professionally.

● Ensure accurate recording of customer requirements, call outcomes, and follow-up

commitments in the CRM or designated tracker.

● Coordinate with the sales team to convert qualified leads into business opportunities.

4. Sales & Business Coordination

● Drive team targets related to lead generation, customer onboarding, service adoption,

and business conversion, as applicable.

● Coordinate with Sales and Operations teams to address customer requirements and

delivery-related concerns.

● Follow up on inactive customers, pending enquiries, and potential repeat orders.

● Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement and increase business

through structured calling campaigns.

● Ensure that customer commitments are communicated accurately and aligned with

operational feasibility.

5. Process Improvement & Reporting

● Develop and standardize calling processes, scripts, escalation matrices, and follow-up

procedures.

● Analyse calling data to identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.

● Maintain accurate records of team performance, lead status, customer feedback, and

escalations.

● Share daily performance updates and periodic MIS reports with the reporting manager.

● Ensure compliance with company policies, customer data confidentiality, and

professional communication standards.

Required Skills & Competencies

● Strong team leadership and floor management skills.

● Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

● Ability to manage targets, productivity, and performance metrics.

● Strong customer handling, objection handling, and escalation management skills.

● Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets, CRM tools, and reporting dashboards.

● Good analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

● Strong follow-up discipline, time management, and organizational skills.

● Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Eligibility Criteria

● Minimum 5+ years of overall experience in tele calling, tele sales, customer support, or

call center operations.

● At least 2+ years of team-handling or floor-supervision experience preferred.

● Experience managing a team of tele callers in a target-driven environment.

● Prior experience in B2B tele calling, lead generation, customer onboarding, logistics,

fuel, mobility, or service operations will be an advantage.

● Graduate in any discipline preferred.

● Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period may be preferred,

depending on business requirements.

Why Join Anytime Diesel?

● Opportunity to work with a growing, technology-enabled fuel delivery business.

● Exposure to B2B customer engagement and business operations.

● Opportunity to lead a team and contribute directly to business growth.

● Dynamic work environment with scope for professional development.

title: Manager, End User Support
description:

title: Team Lead - Cell Culture
description:
**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.**
is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait.**

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

"

**Job Description**

**Job summary**
  
We are seeking a dedicated professional to lead team activities, supervise lab maintenance, and manage people within the upstream process development function of Biologics. This role involves ensuring on-time delivery of experiments for one/two biosimilar molecules, with a focus on drafting and timely closure of technical reports to meet team deliverables.
  
  
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
  
• You will be responsible for leading and managing the overall scientific, technical, and operational efforts of team members, including guiding teams for the successful execution of experiments, and ensuring the quality of data meets global expectations.
  
  
• You will oversee lab operations and equipment maintenance, actively participate in lab meetings, contribute to troubleshooting potential causes for experimental failures, and coordinate upstream process development for one/two Biosimilar projects within the function.
  
  
• You will be responsible for planning resource requirements to meet project deliverables providing guidance and direction to team members to ensure project schedules are met with quality technical success. You will be responsible for collaboration with various stakeholders within and across teams is crucial for meeting project timelines.
  
  
• You will contribute to performance reviews of team members, identify their developmental needs, communicate them to the responsible authority, and maintain discipline within the team.
  
  
• You will be responsible for data collation, analysis, and interpretation, drawing logical scientific conclusions, and generating technical presentations to communicate technical information within the function.
  
  
• Your role includes drafting scientific reports for team deliverables, such as process development summaries, technical memos, and process description summaries, maintaining global quality and adhering to regulatory standards with support from team members and group leaders to fulfill functional requirements and support regulatory filings.
  
  
• You will be responsible for assuming ownership of specialized process equipment, escalating lab issues for technical support, ensuring compliance with safety standards, supervising safety and lab systems, and verifying the appropriate following of protocols.
  
  
• Additionally, you'll oversee inventory updating, troubleshoot problems related to equipment, and ensure smooth development work in the lab.

**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification:**
A Ph.D. or Master's degree (M.Sc. or M.Tech. or M.E. or M.Pharm.) or Bachelor's degree (B.Tech. or B.E. or B.Pharm.) in Biology, Chemical Engineering, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Biochemical Engineering or other related disciplines of engineering or life sciences.
  
  
  
  
**Minimum work experience**
: 2 years of industrial experience with a Ph.D., 6 years with a Master’s, or 9 years with a Bachelor’s
  
  
  
  
**Skills & attributes:
  
  
  
  
Technical Skills**
  
• In-depth understanding of cell culture process development for Biotherapeutics/Biosimilars, stays informed about current trends in the Biopharma industry, and exhibits a basic understanding of the regulatory framework and IP (Intellectual Property) landscape.
  
  
• Can perform comprehensive data analysis of processes and provide logical conclusions and recommendations.
  
  
• Knowledge of bioreactor operation in batch/fed-batch/perfusion modes.
  
  
• Understanding of chemical engineering principles applicable to biotechnology.
  
  
• In-depth understanding of mammalian cell culture physiology and metabolism for Biosimilar product development.
  
  
• Demonstrates Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical analysis skills using various tools.
  
  
• Understanding of FDA (Food and Drug Administration), EMA (European Medicines Agency), ICH (International Council for Harmonisation), and other regulatory bodies' guidelines for Biosimilar development.
  
  
  
  
**Behavioural skills**
  
• Strong supervisory, team management, and motivational skills, effectively leading and guiding teams.
  
  
• Strong learning orientation, staying updated with current practices in the subject area.
  
  
• Good interpersonal skills, fostering positive relationships and effective communication.
  
  
• Adaptability to a dynamic environment, showcasing flexibility and resilience in response to changes.

**Additional Information**

**About the Department
  
  
Biologics**
  
Currently operates in the Global Biosimilars business - a segment that is poised for attractive and sustained growth over the next 10–15-year time horizon.
  
  
With a robust portfolio of biosimilar products across key therapeutic areas, covering ~US$80+ Bn in innovator sales – future business pipeline covers a variety of product classes and therapy areas, and new modalities. Fully integrated organization with over two decades of experience in developing, manufacturing and commercializing multiple biosimilar products.
  
  
With a Product Development engine that has end-to-end capabilities – in-house clone development, upstream and downstream process development, bioanalytical development and proprietary formulation.
  
  
Supported by a Clinical and Regulatory team with experience in executing complex biosimilar programs with innovative global trial designs.
  
  
We have a proven experience in commercial-scale manufacturing across a variety of technology platforms with global quality standards and a highly competitive cost structure
  
  
Rich experience of commercializing high-quality biosimilars in multiple markets with over 900,000 patients having benefited from our products till date.
  
  
  
  
**Benefits Offered**
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
  
  
**Our Work Culture**
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
  
  
For more details, please visit our career website at
**https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

title: Accounts Receivable - AGM / DGM / GM - US Healthcare
description:
We are seeking an experienced Accounts Receivable Assistant General Manager / General Manager role with expertise in Physician Billing and US Healthcare, would be responsible for managing the billing and collection of payments for medical services provided by the hospital. They will work closely with the billing team and other departments to ensure timely and accurate billing, posting of payments, and follow-up on outstanding balances.

Responsibilities:

* Oversee the hospital’s accounts receivable operations, including billing, collections, and follow-up on outstanding balances
* Manage a team of billing specialists and other staff responsible for accounts receivable functions
* Ensure timely and accurate posting of payments, adjustments, and denials to patient accounts
* Develop and implement processes to improve billing and collections efficiency and effectiveness
* Analyze accounts receivable reports and key performance indicators to identify trends, opportunities for improvement, and potential issues
* Work collaboratively with other departments to ensure accurate billing and timely resolution of payment-related issues
* Maintain knowledge of current US healthcare regulations and reimbursement policies to ensure compliance with billing requirements
* Implement and manage effective policies and procedures for accounts receivable management
* Provide training and support to staff regarding billing procedures, policies, and regulations
* Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field
* At least 15-20 years of experience in hospital billing and accounts receivable management, preferably in a leadership role
* Thorough understanding of US healthcare regulations and reimbursement policies
* Knowledge of healthcare billing and coding systems, including ICD-10 and CPT coding
* Experience managing and leading teams
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, and Word
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and handle multiple tasks simultaneously

If you meet the above qualifications and are interested in this opportunity, please submit your resume to mvuyyala@primehealthcare.com

title: Senior Director, AI and Data Platform Delivery
description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for
**end‑to‑end execution of Teradata’s foundational AI and data platform offerings**
, which underpin the company’s hybrid, multi‑cloud, and on‑premises solutions. This role is critical to ensuring that Teradata’s
**platform continues to scale, modernize, and reliably support customer workloads**
, while enabling company growth through platform differentiation, adoption, and expansion.
  
  
This leader owns the
**execution strategy, operating model, and talent development**
for a combined organization of
**Technical Program Managers (TPMs)**
and
**Global Program Managers (GPMs)**
. Together, these teams drive coordinated execution across the end-to-end
**New Product Introduction (NPI) process**
, ensuring that new platform elements are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.
  
  
Success in this role is measured by
**platform delivery predictability, quality, scalability, and business impact**
, rather than ownership of individual programs.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Platform Execution & Growth Enablement**

* Own execution outcomes for significant areas of Teradata’s core data platform and AI roadmap, including platform modernization, scalability enhancements, cloud parity, and operational hardening.
* Be accountable for execution work that enables Teradata’s growth and retention targets, including platform readiness for new use cases, expansions, and customer adoption.
* Translate product and platform strategy into integrated execution plans that balance stability, innovation, customer commitments, and long‑term technical health.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial leadership to align platform execution with market needs, competitive positioning, and revenue objectives.
* Provide execution transparency and decision support to senior leadership for tradeoffs impacting delivery, quality, and customer trust.

**End‑to‑End New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership**

* Lead the global NPI execution model for core and AI platform capabilities from concept through general availability and sustained customer adoption.
* Ensure cross‑functional coordination across:

+ Definition, development, and testing
+ Product setup, configuration, and entitlement
+ Legal, compliance, and contractual readiness
+ Pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management
+ Go‑to‑market readiness (Sales, Marketing, Solution Architects)
+ Cloud Operations, infrastructure, and SRE readiness
+ Customer support, field enablement, and documentation

* Establish scalable, repeatable NPI mechanisms that support frequent platform releases and long‑lived customer environments.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Provide technical and execution leadership across large‑scale, distributed, data‑intensive platforms, spanning cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem deployments.
* Guide teams through complex platform delivery challenges involving performance, reliability, scalability, security, upgrade paths, and operational continuity.
* Ensure cross‑team technical and operational risks are proactively identified, clearly owned, and mitigated.
* Partner with senior engineering and architecture leaders to ensure execution plans align with long‑term platform sustainability and customer trust.
* Co-own with engineering platform economics and cost‑to‑serve by influencing execution tradeoffs that impact margin, scaling limits, and long‑term pricing power.
* Co-own with engineering and product the platform lifecycle governance and technical debt liquidation at the portfolio level.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and scale a high‑impact organization of Technical Program Managers and Global Program Managers.
* Clearly define and reinforce roles and interfaces between TPMs (engineering‑centric delivery) and GPMs (cross‑functional, post‑code, market and operational readiness).
* Own hiring, performance management, development, and succession planning for the platform execution organization.
* Develop senior TPM and GPM leaders capable of operating effectively at enterprise scale and high ambiguity.
* Establish clear leveling, expectations, and promotion readiness standards for both TPM and GPM career paths.

**Influence, Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Act as a trusted execution advisor to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer organizations.
* Communicate platform execution health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly at the VP and executive level.
* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.
* Provide executive clarity during high‑impact incidents, major releases, or customer‑sensitive platform transitions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product operations, or related technical roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading senior technical and program management professionals.
* Proven success delivering large‑scale, enterprise data platform initiatives.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, database platforms, cloud infrastructure, and hybrid architectures.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution that supports business growth, customer retention, and platform adoption.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication and influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering or operating enterprise data platforms in cloud and hybrid environments.
* Background supporting platform modernization, cloud transitions, or large customer migrations.
* Experience building or scaling global NPI and release governance models.
* Familiarity with operational excellence, SRE practices, and enterprise reliability expectations.

**What Success Looks Like**
A successful Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery:
  
  

* Enables Teradata to deliver and evolve its core platform with predictability and confidence.
* Holds the organization to best-in-breed standards across delivery quality, platform performance, and operational reliability — ensuring Teradata's core data platform earns a reputation for excellence.
* Scales execution capabilities to support platform growth, modernization, and increased customer demand.
* Ensures platform capabilities are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.
* Builds a strong TPM and GPM organization trusted across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Directly supports Teradata’s growth and retention goals by strengthening the foundation of its data platform.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Lead Fraud & Claims Operations Representative
description:

12 Nov 2026

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. title: ServiceNow Senior Manager with AI expertise
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced
**ServiceNow Senior Manager with strong AI and Generative AI expertise**
to lead the offshore ServiceNow development and platform engineering organization. This role will be responsible for driving the strategy, delivery, governance, and operational excellence of the enterprise ServiceNow platform while accelerating the adoption of ServiceNow AI, GenAI, and intelligent automation capabilities across the organization.

The Senior Manager will lead a team of ServiceNow Technical Leads and Platform Leads, providing strategic leadership, technical guidance, and operational oversight for platform development, enhancements, integrations, AI-driven solutions, and platform operations. The role requires a strong blend of leadership, architecture, ServiceNow platform expertise, AI innovation, stakeholder management, and delivery execution.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading large ServiceNow programs, driving platform modernization, implementing AI-enabled solutions, improving engineering effectiveness, and building high-performing technical teams.

**Major responsibilities**

Strategic Leadership & Platform Management

* Lead and manage the offshore ServiceNow development and platform engineering organization.
* Define and execute the ServiceNow platform strategy aligned with business objectives and enterprise technology roadmaps.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives, including ServiceNow AI, GenAI, intelligent automation, and workflow transformation capabilities.
* Establish scalable governance models, development standards, and platform best practices.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to identify opportunities to leverage ServiceNow capabilities across the enterprise.
* Develop and maintain platform roadmaps, investment plans, and delivery priorities.

AI, Automation & Innovation

* Drive adoption of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, Generative AI, Now Assist, and intelligent workflow solutions.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and enhance user experience through AI-driven solutions.
* Collaborate with enterprise AI and architecture teams to integrate ServiceNow with broader AI and GenAI initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and ServiceNow platform innovations to drive continuous improvement.
* Lead proof-of-concepts and pilot programs focused on AI-powered business outcomes.

Delivery & Engineering Excellence

* Oversee end-to-end delivery of ServiceNow platform enhancements, projects, integrations, and operational initiatives.
* Improve team productivity, engineering effectiveness, development velocity, and delivery quality.
* Ensure adherence to Agile, DevOps, SDLC, and platform governance practices.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and delivery metrics to drive operational excellence.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across development, testing, deployment, and support processes.
* Ensure successful execution of platform releases and upgrades.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of ServiceNow Technical Leads, Platform Leads, and platform engineers.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Build organizational capability in ServiceNow AI, automation, platform engineering, and emerging technologies.
* Support workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, and performance management activities.
* Act as a trusted advisor and coach to technical teams and business stakeholders.

Platform Operations & Governance

* Ensure platform reliability, availability, scalability, security, and operational stability.
* Oversee platform governance, change management, risk management, and compliance requirements.
* Drive adherence to platform architecture standards and operational controls.
* Partner with infrastructure, security, application, and business teams to ensure seamless platform operations.
* Monitor platform health, technical debt, and performance optimization opportunities.

Stakeholder Management

* Build strong relationships with global technology leaders, business stakeholders, and ServiceNow product owners.
* Translate business requirements into scalable platform solutions and strategic roadmaps.
* Communicate platform strategy, delivery progress, risks, and business outcomes to senior leadership.
* Influence decision-making through technical expertise, business acumen, and strong executive communication skills.

**Professional Qualifications/Experience**

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

· 15+ years of IT experience, with at least 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow platform leadership and delivery experience.

· Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, Employee Center, HRSD, and platform integrations.

· Proven experience leading large-scale ServiceNow implementations, migrations, and transformation programs in global enterprise environments.

· Demonstrated success managing cross-functional engineering, development, and support teams delivering high-quality solutions.

· Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies, governance frameworks, and service management best practices (ITIL preferred).

· Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to partner with business leaders, product owners, vendors, and executive leadership.

· Experience defining platform roadmaps, driving adoption, standardization, automation, and continuous service improvement initiatives.

· Knowledge of AI-enabled ServiceNow capabilities, Virtual Agent, Generative AI, workflow automation, and digital employee experience solutions is highly desirable.

· ServiceNow certifications such as Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or Certified Application Developer (CAD) preferred.

· Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving, and strategic planning skills with experience managing distributed teams.

title: HDNU Plant Controls  Execution System Architect
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Opportunity to fill the role of a global technical lead for a world class engineering team responsible for the project execution of Integrated Power Plant controls software. Through innovation and active partnering with other GE Vernova engineering teams and external customers you will have the opportunity to guide a team that will design, implement, and automate control software for HRSG/BOP/ST and integrated plant level controls. This leadership role, in addition to closely collaborating with our internal & external customers, is critical in driving a team culture of technical domain depth, contemporary leadership, on-time quality execution and strong customer-focused mindset. Want to be part of the Energy Transformation, have a meaningful career, work on complex solutions like carbon capture, decarbonization, fast power and grid reconstruction & stabilization that will change the way power is delivered to the world? Come join one of the most awesome design teams in the Power Industry, GEV’s Gas Power Controls team. At GEV Gas Power Controls, we design and implement control solutions that have a meaningful impact on people’s lives and enable the transformation of the energy sector. You will be empowered, work in a Scaled Agile Framework environment (SAFe) driving meaningful change and continuous improvement using Lean principles.  You will have a complete life cycle experience from initial concept development through detailed design, implementation, and upgrades, working with over 500 global engineers with a single purpose; deliver the cleanest, most efficient power to our customers with the Operability needed in today’s dynamic power grid.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Act as a Program Manager for Design, develop and execute control system requirements and documentation for the Req NPI’s controls scope. Work with CTH, stake holders and participate in reviews.
* Define scoping boundaries between NPI/new features and standard project execution and develop strategy for the execution of both.
* Responsible for major project milestone new units approval (Design reviews) and quality adherence across all projects for GT/ HRSG/BOP/ST.
* Proactively work with the Global design leader & alliance execution teams to mitigate the risks and develop solutions for specials/custom on the projects, technical reviews, support for ER/commissioning.
* Define and deliver productivity and process improvements that increase the capacity of the Plant Controls team.
* Leading the lean principals and owning the plant process on execution & review, driving the quality adherence for customers deliverables.
* Leading from the front use Lean tools and own the KPI & Metrics at HDNU controls.
* Work with the managers, internal customers, and external customers to gather control and operability requirements to deliver a quality product on time to meet Power Plant start-ups and commissioning.
* Emerging COD & Warranty ER case support & guided to alliance team for technical resolution.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to controls engineers.
* Mentoring team in the design, development, and validation of HRSG/BOP control application Hardware & software.
* Training is conducted on regular basis to build team expertise and roll out new capabilities.
* Maintain strong contacts within the System Engineering community to ensure strong systems solutions.
* Lead and support Agile enterprise tool strategies including CLM & PLM integration.
* Work progress, guidance & clear documentation enable Agile team to execute the projects efficiently.
* Uses judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of operability/product management, manufacturing, technology or engineering. Takes new perspective on existing solutions. Uses technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations.

Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own function to arrive at decisions.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical, Instrumentation & controls or related engineering.
* Minimum of 12 to 15 years of controls engineering experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience with Integrated Power Plant Controls development and/or design.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong communication skills with the ability to motivate and engage teams, customers, and suppliers.
* Proven change agent with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
* Proven experience working in a global matrix environment, with influence and collaboration skills.
* Strong leadership skills, keeping team focused and innovating through dynamic business cycle.
* Deep technical skills and expertise in Integrated Combined Cycle Plant Control and operation.
* System Integration mindset within the Thermal Engineering community for meeting customer demands.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to sell technology through simple and clear messaging.
* Ability to connect with team, sharing commercial strategies and connection to end customers.
* Simplification mindset, acting on feedback, driving productivity initiatives based on AI tools for business results and personal engineering satisfaction.
* Drive ownership and incorporate lessons learned into the standard validation strategies.
* Knowledge or Hands on experience AVEVA tools will be added advantage for execution.

**Note**
**To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA.**
**For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.**

**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Deputy Director Transportation
description:
**Overview**
TMS is an industry leading transportation management solution that enables value to market’s transportation operations through centralized visibility, routing & optimization, process & information, and vendor cost management. PepsiCo’s TMS is deployed to 4 separate instances supporting each sector (NORTH AMERICA, LATAM, Europe, AMESA/APAC). It optimizes aprox. 80% of total global primary transportation spend. TMS Functional Lead is someone who can provide strategic solution leadership, architecture governance, transformation leadership, and innovation ownership in addition to deep functional expertise
  
  
Scope:
  
  

* Act as primary TMS solution lead, super user, and business expert
* Lead system governance activities
* Lead new deployment and sustain activities

**Responsibilities**
Functional Responsibilities:
  
  
Blue Yonder TMS Solution Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the global Blue Yonder Transportation Management System (TMS) Solution Architect and Subject Matter Expert (SME) for PepsiCo's transportation capabilities.
* Executes the TMS solution roadmap, architecture standards, and best practices across sectors and markets.
* Provide thought leadership and advanced solution design guidance for complex transportation planning, execution, visibility, and settlement processes.
* Ensure alignment of TMS capabilities with PepsiCo's global transportation strategy and digital supply chain transformation priorities.

Solution Design & Delivery Excellence
  
  

* Partner with IT delivery teams to architect scalable, standardized, and sustainable solutions for global and regional deployments.
* Lead solutioning for complex business requirements, ensuring optimal utilization of Blue Yonder TMS capabilities while minimizing customizations.
* Drive adoption of standardized transportation processes and system capabilities across sectors and markets.
* Act as the escalation point for critical design decisions, production issues, and solution governance reviews.

Product Capability Expansion & Innovation
  
  

* Lead the introduction and adoption of advanced Blue Yonder capabilities, including but not limited to:

+ Transportation Smartbench
+ Job Server & Automation Framework
+ Ocean Booking
+ Carrier Collaboration
+ Dynamic Routing & Optimization
+ Visibility & Control Tower capabilities

* Evaluate emerging transportation technologies and industry trends to drive continuous innovation and competitive advantage.
* Collaborate with Global Transportation Capability teams to identify, assess, and pilot next-generation transportation solutions.

Blue Yonder Cloud Transformation Execution
  
  

* Support PepsiCo's Blue Yonder Cloud migration and modernization initiatives from a solution deployment perspective.
* Partner with business, IT, infrastructure, integration, and vendor teams to ensure successful program delivery and value realization.
* Drive post-migration stabilization, optimization, and continuous improvement activities.

Vendor Partnerships
  
  

* Act as the primary PepsiCo point of contact for Blue Yonder product management, customer success, and technical leadership teams.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with Blue Yonder to influence product direction and advocate for PepsiCo business requirements.
* Manage vendor escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical production and enhancement requests.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Special Interest Group (SIG) engagements, and roadmap discussions with Blue Yonder.

Operational Excellence & Issue Resolution
  
  

* Provide senior-level support and guidance for complex transportation and system-related issues impacting business operations.
* Monitor and govern the resolution of critical incidents and enhancement requests raised through Blue Yonder Customer Success channels.
* Ensure service reliability, performance optimization, and continuous improvement of transportation processes and platforms.

Organizational Capability Building
  
  

* Establish and drive a comprehensive TMS knowledge management and capability development framework.
* Lead end-user education programs through live training sessions, digital learning content, and knowledge repositories.
* Mentor and upskill TMS delivery teams on solution architecture, advanced configuration, optimization, and industry best practices.
* Drive automation and process efficiency initiatives within the TMS support and delivery organization.

**Qualifications**
Experience
  
  

* 10–12+ years of Supply Chain and Transportation Management experience, including 8+ years of hands-on experience with Blue Yonder TMS (formerly JDA TMS).
* Proven experience leading global TMS implementations, transformations, upgrades, and cloud migration programs.
* Deep expertise across transportation planning, optimization, execution, freight settlement, carrier management, and logistics visibility processes.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong expertise in Blue Yonder TMS architecture, master data, configuration, integration, and optimization.
* Knowledge of transportation integrations including ERP, WMS, carrier EDI/API connectivity, visibility solutions, and supply chain ecosystems.
* Understanding of transportation analytics, KPI frameworks, and process automation.

Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Executive stakeholder management and influencing skills.

title: Associate Director - Grid Integration, Renewable Energy
description:
**About Enfinity Global**

Enfinity Global is a purpose-driven company focused on making a positive impact on the planet by helping companies, governments, and individuals transition to a carbon-free and sustainable economy. Our role as a leading IPP is to develop, finance, build, operate, and own decarbonization assets in the long term in Europe, Asia, and the Americas through our offices in the USA, Spain, Italy, UK, Netherlands, India, and Japan.

Our team of over 400 Enfiniters comprises seasoned finance professionals, as well as experienced project developers and operators with extensive industry experience across all stages of the project life cycle. We pride ourselves on being creative and innovative solution providers to our customers and partners.

**Job Description:**

Enfinity Global is looking for a Senior Interconnection Leader with 10-15 years of experience who will be responsible for managing the transmission-level interconnection process for utility-scale solar, battery energy storage projects and large load interconnection across the United States.

The candidate should possess deep technical expertise in FERC regulations, interconnection studies, and grid integration, while demonstrating strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills. This position requires extensive collaboration with US-based teams, utilities, Independent System Operators (ISOs), Regional Transmission Organizations (RTOs), and engineering consultants.

The role demands an individual who is highly organized, strategic, and capable of managing complex interconnection processes from initial feasibility through Commercial Operation Date (COD). The successful candidate will serve as the primary point of contact with transmission providers and ISO/RTO interconnection departments, managing a portfolio of projects totaling multiple gigawatts.

This opportunity provides significant exposure to the US energy market and interconnection reform landscape including FERC Order 2023 implementation. Candidates will work closely with key stakeholders based in the US and will require flexibility to overlap 3-4 hours daily with US business hours.

**Key responsibilities:**

***Interconnection Process Management:***

·       Lead and manage the complete interconnection queue process for transmission-level renewable energy projects (solar, wind, and battery storage) from initial site selection and feasibility through Commercial Operation Date (COD), ensuring compliance with all regulatory and technical requirements.

·       Coordinate and submit interconnection applications, deposits, study agreements, and all required technical documentation to utilities, ISOs/RTOs including CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP, NYISO, and ISO-NE within prescribed deadlines.

·       Manage queue positions and track interconnection study milestones including Cluster Studies, System Impact Studies (SIS), Facilities Studies (FS), and Affected System Studies across multiple ISO/RTO markets simultaneously.

·       Review, analyze, and challenge interconnection study results including load flow analysis, short circuit studies, stability analysis, and network upgrade requirements to optimize project economics and timelines.

·       Negotiate and execute Interconnection Agreements (IAs), Generator Interconnection Agreements (GIAs), and Large Generator Interconnection Agreements (LGIAs), including cost allocation, construction schedules, and milestone payment terms.

·       Manage interconnection financial commitments including study deposits, security postings, milestone payments, and network upgrade funding in accordance with FERC-approved tariff requirements.

***Technical Coordination & Analysis:***

·       Collaborate with internal engineering teams and external consultants to develop technical specifications, electrical one-line diagrams, and three-line diagrams for interconnection applications, ensuring accuracy and compliance with utility standards.

·       Conduct comprehensive due diligence reviews and technical feasibility assessments for potential project sites, evaluating transmission capacity, congestion patterns, and available interconnection options.

·       Evaluate and forecast network upgrade costs including reliability upgrades, delivery network upgrades, stand-alone network upgrades, and cost allocation methodologies under shared funding scenarios.

·       Assess and recommend alternative Point of Interconnection (POI) options, voltage levels, and interconnection configurations to optimize project economics, construction schedules, and commercial viability.

·       Support transmission planning activities including transmission service requests (TSRs), Network Resource Interconnection Service (NRIS) applications, and participation in regional transmission planning processes.

·       Monitor, interpret, and implement changes to utilities, ISO/RTO interconnection procedures, FERC Order compliance (Order 2023, 2023-A), queue reform initiatives, and cluster study process modifications across all relevant markets.

***Stakeholder Management & Communication:***

·       Serve as primary point of contact with transmission owners, transmission providers, utility interconnection departments, and ISO/RTO interconnection staff, building and maintaining productive long-term working relationships.

·       Coordinate closely with US-based development, origination, engineering, legal, and finance teams requiring regular availability during overlapping business hours.

·       Participate in ISO/RTO stakeholder meetings, interconnection working groups, and industry forums to stay current on policy developments and advocate for company positions on interconnection reform matters.

·       Prepare and deliver regular status updates, risk assessments, and executive summaries to senior management on portfolio-level interconnection progress, upcoming milestones, and potential risks.

·       Lead resolution of interconnection disputes, study delays, and billing discrepancies through direct engagement with utility staff, escalation procedures, and formal complaint processes when necessary.

·       Manage and provide technical oversight to external consultants and engineering firms supporting interconnection studies, deliverable preparation, and utility coordination activities.

***Portfolio Management, Data Analytics & Process Improvement:***

·       Maintain comprehensive interconnection tracking systems, databases, and project management tools for a portfolio of projects totaling multiple gigawatts across various development stages.

·       Monitor queue positions, withdrawal risks, restudy impacts, and queue reform implementation effects across multiple utilities and ISO/RTO markets, proactively identifying opportunities and risks.

·       Develop and maintain interconnection cost forecasts, timeline projections, and risk registers for financial modeling, budgeting, and project valuation purposes.

·       Analyze interconnection study data from customer engagement meetings, scoping meetings, and draft study reports to support informed strategic decision-making and site optimization.

·       Track regional transmission planning processes, proposed transmission projects, and policy changes that may impact interconnection feasibility or project economics.

·       Develop and implement best practices, standard operating procedures, templates, and lessons learned documentation to improve efficiency and reduce execution risk across the interconnection portfolio.

·       Create and maintain interconnection playbooks, process workflows, and training materials for internal teams to ensure consistent execution and knowledge transfer.

**Requirements**

The candidate will require exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong technical analysis capabilities, and experience navigating multiple utilities and ISO/RTO markets. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with ambitious growth strategies.

**Qualifications & experience:**

***Education:***

·       Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related technical field (Master's degree preferred).

***Experience:***

·       10-15 years of hands-on experience managing transmission-level interconnection processes for utility-scale renewable energy projects.

·       Proven track record of successfully navigating interconnection queues with at least 5+ projects through to executed Interconnection Agreements.

·       Direct experience working with multiple U.S. Utilities & ISO/RTO markets.

·       Experience with solar, battery energy storage system (BESS), and large load interconnection projects.

·       Background working with IPPs, renewable energy developers, or utilities in project development roles.

***Technical Expertise:***

·       Deep understanding of FERC regulations, NERC standards, and transmission planning principles.

·       Comprehensive knowledge of Large Generator Interconnection Procedures (LGIP), Large Load Interconnection and interconnection study methodologies.

·       Proficiency in interpreting power system studies including load flow, short circuit, stability, and EMT studies.

·       Working knowledge of power systems modeling software and tools such as PSS/E, PSLF, PSCAD, PowerWorld, or TARA for reviewing and validating study results.

·       Familiarity with electrical single-line diagrams, substation design concepts, protection and control systems, and transmission system configurations.

·       Knowledge of reactive power requirements, voltage regulation, and grid code compliance for renewable generation.

***Skills & Competencies:***

·       Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

·       Strong project management capabilities with ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.

·       Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills with utilities, transmission owners, and system operators.

·       Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, project management, and CRM.

·       Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.

·       Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment.

·       Creative thinker, trying to find new ways of optimizing interconnection strategies.

·       Hands-on mentality and focus on getting things done.

·       Taking ownership and wanting to get things right.

***Preferred Qualifications:***

·       Experience with co-located or hybrid projects (solar + storage, wind + storage).

·       Familiarity with offshore wind interconnection processes.

·       Knowledge of transmission congestion, LMP pricing, and merchant transmission development.

·       Experience participating in ISO/RTO stakeholder meetings and working groups.

·       Background in power systems modeling software (PSS/E, PSCAD, PowerWorld, etc.).

·       Previous experience working for a US-based company from an India office.

In Enfinity Global you will find a very dynamic and multinational environment in one of the most exciting and impactful industries. Here we will foster your professional and personal growth, and you will have the opportunity to actively contribute and make a real impact on climate change.

**Let's build our future together.**

Visit www.enfinity.global to discover more about our culture
