title: Oracle CDP/Unity- Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Oracle CDP/Unity Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on working with Oracle's suite of applications and tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, marketing automation, and customer experience solutions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations
* Analyzing client needs to develop tailored software solutions that enhance customer experience and satisfaction
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications
* Managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization using Oracle's suite of tools
* Building meaningful client connections and fostering relationships to understand and anticipate client needs
* Navigating complex situations and using critical thinking to solve problems and generate new ideas
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including PwC's code of conduct and independence requirements
* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
* Collaborating with teams to deliver quality and strategic objectives in business application consulting
* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery

What You Must Have
  
  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end-to-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, administrators, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.

**Role And Responsibilities**

* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement-gathering and solution-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source-to-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end-to-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.

**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**

* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source-to-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data-science processes, and integrations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and drive resolution of data-processing, integration, identity-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross-sell, up-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next-best-action use cases.

**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**

* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.
* Good understanding of Eloqua integrations, APIs, native connectors, and data synchronization mechanisms.
* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.
* Understand lead management, lead scoring, campaign responses, and lead hand-off processes between Eloqua and CRM systems.

**Integration And Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Oracle Unity REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with:
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer-engagement platforms
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, middleware, batch interfaces, scheduled integrations, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Good understanding of SQL/query concepts, data modelling, data transformation, and data-quality principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration, data-processing, API, identity-resolution, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Understanding of customer-data activation from Oracle Unity into Eloqua and other marketing channels.

**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of Oracle Unity developers, consultants, administrators, and data specialists.
* Estimate effort, prepare delivery plans, allocate resources, and monitor project execution.
* Mentor team members and develop Oracle Unity technical capabilities through knowledge-sharing, technical sessions, and hands-on guidance.
* Review deliverables and ensure adherence to technical, documentation, security, integration, and architecture standards.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and key technical decisions.
* Facilitate design workshops and technical discussions with business, enterprise architecture, security, integration, data, analytics, and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with marketing and Eloqua teams to define customer activation and campaign integration strategies.
* Support project planning, solution estimation, proposals, technical presentations, demos, and pre-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, accelerators, frameworks, automation, and implementation best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement across Oracle Unity implementation, support, data governance, and operational processes.
* Act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Unity technical and functional issues.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong understanding of Customer 360, Customer Data Platforms, customer identity, data unification, segmentation, personalization, and activation.
* Good understanding of Marketing Automation and Oracle Eloqua concepts.
* Understanding of customer consent, privacy, security, retention, and enterprise data-governance requirements.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale customer-data solutions with high data volumes and multiple source systems.
* Experience supporting customer-data activation across CDP, CRM, Eloqua, and digital marketing channels.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining delivery quality.
* Experience working with geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to communicate complex Oracle Unity and integration concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.
  
  
The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals.
  
  
The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.
* Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards.
* Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met.
* Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success.
* Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management.
* Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule.
* Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE)
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities

**Working Conditions**

* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 10-15 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects.
* Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage.
* Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Director- R&D Technical Head
description:
**Responsibilities**
Technical Leadership & Strategy (40%)
  
  
  

* Define and own the end-to-end chip design strategy, methodology, and technology roadmap across all design verticals — SoC, Analog, Digital, Product & Test Engineering, Design Packaging, Verification and DFT.
* Establish design standards, best practices, and quality benchmarks to ensure silicon correctness, power-performance-area (PPA) targets, and first-silicon success rates.
* Evaluate and adopt state-of-the-art EDA toolchains (Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens EDA) and emerging design methodologies to maintain competitive advantage.
* Provide architectural guidance on SoC partitioning, IP integration, mixed-signal co-design, and design-for-manufacturability (DFM) across advanced process nodes.

Team Management & People Leadership (30%)
  
  
  

* Directly manage all vertical leads and engineering managers SoC, Analog, Digital, Product & Test Engineering, Design Packaging, Verification and DFT.
* Set clear goals, conduct regular reviews, and create individual development plans to build a high-performing, future-ready engineering organization.
* Drive talent acquisition strategy in partnership with HR; define technical interview frameworks and competency benchmarks for senior engineering hires.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning across a team of 12–20+ direct and indirect reports.

Project Monitoring & Cross-Vertical Coordination (15%)
  
  
  

* Engage regularly with all vertical leaders and project managers to understand project status, interdependencies, resource constraints, and technical risks.
* Supervise and monitor all active R&D projects from architecture definition through tapeout, ensuring milestones are met and technical blockers are resolved promptly.
* Facilitate cross-functional design reviews, tapeout readiness reviews, and silicon bring-up planning sessions to align all engineering verticals.
* Serve as the primary technical escalation point for critical design issues, guiding root-cause analysis and resolution across SoC, analog, digital, physical, and DFT domains.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting (10%)
  
  
  

* Prepare and present comprehensive R&D project status reports, technical risk assessments, and resource utilization dashboards to senior leadership.
* Interface with global counterparts, foundry partners (e.g., TSMC, GlobalFoundries), and IP vendors to optimize design flows and process node qualifications.

Other Duties (5%)
  
  
  

* Champion R&D innovation initiatives; evaluate emerging technologies such as advanced packaging, chiplets, AI-driven EDA, and next-generation process nodes.
* Support IP strategy, design reuse frameworks, and internal knowledge management across the India R&D center.
* Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned by executive leadership.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, VLSI Design, or a closely related field; Master’s degree (M.E. / M.Tech / M.S.) strongly preferred.
* 20+ years of progressive experience in the semiconductor / VLSI industry, with a minimum of 5 years in a senior engineering leadership or technical management role.
* Proven, hands-on expertise across the complete chip design flow: SoC Architecture, Physical Design, Analog Design, Product & Test Engineering, Design Packaging, Verification Digital RTL Design, and DFT.
* Demonstrated experience managing and delivering multiple concurrent chip design projects from specification through GDS tapeout.
* Deep proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools: Cadence Innovus/Virtuoso, Synopsys Design Compiler/IC Compiler/PrimeTime.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with demonstrated ability to present complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in leading R&D organizations of 25+ engineers across geographically distributed teams.
* Exposure to advanced packaging technologies (2.5D/3D IC, chiplet architectures) and multi-die integration methodologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML-assisted EDA flows and next-generation design automation trends.
* Prior experience with automotive-grade semiconductor design (AEC-Q100, ISO 26262 / ASIL compliance) or high-reliability industrial semiconductor products.
* Strong publication record or patents in semiconductor design, device physics, or related fields.
* Experience working with global foundry partners (TSMC, GlobalFoundries) on advanced process node qualification and PDK evaluation.
* Demonstrated track record in building and scaling engineering teams; prior exposure to HR processes including headcount planning, compensation benchmarking, and performance management.

description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Manager, Customer Service provides operational leadership for the India-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success & Operations organization, with primary responsibility for quote-to-order and order-related customer Success activities. The role oversees the day-to-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Manager translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Manager, Customer Service Has The Following Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the India Customer Service team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Build workforce capability through effective hiring, onboarding, performance management, targeted development, and cross-training that supports business continuity.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Execution**

* Partner with the Senior Manager, Customer Service to translate global strategy, priorities, and performance expectations into clear plans and measurable outcomes for the India team.

* Represent Customer Service requirements and customer impact in cross-functional initiatives, system changes, business reviews, and implementation activities.

**Operational Excellence, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure team execution complies with applicable policies, procedures, quality requirements, and controls related to orders, documentation, controlled substances, permits, customs, licensing, and shipments.
* Lead improvements that strengthen service quality, efficiency, data accuracy, productivity, cost effectiveness, process consistency, and organizational readiness.
* Serve as the lead for ISO audits within the India Customer Service department, coordinating audit readiness, compliance documentation, corrective actions, and adherence to established quality management standards.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Education & Experience**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required in a business, sales or related field.
* Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in customer Success, sales, or related field in a multi-cultural environment, preferably for a global organization
* Minimum of three (3) years of people management experience
* In depth knowledge of customer Success principles and practices
* Previous experience in a customer Success environment required.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Fluency in English required, and a second language strongly preferred.
* Customer Success focused and ability to provide a high degree of customer Success.
* Must possess ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with a high level for stress tolerance while maintaining composure and enthusiasm.
* Excellent organization, problem analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills, and attention to details required.
* Excellent communication skills (written and oral) and presentation skills are a must.
* Individuals must possess the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Results driven with demonstrated successful outcomes.
* Excellent supervisory skills with a history of building high performing and motivated teams.
* Strong team builder and people leader with the ability and desire to work well with diverse employees and customers in a cooperative and friendly manner.
* Must be able to work independently and in a team environment.
* Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft software (word processing, email, spreadsheet, database, and Internet).
* Proficiency in Oracle and CRM systems desired.
* Familiarity with automated order entry systems, Ariba or other EDI processes a plus.

* Familiarity with imports, exports, customs, and business with other countries strongly preferred.

title: Manager - Field Effectiveness
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role the Manager, Field Effectiveness plays a critical hands-on role in supporting the effectiveness of the sales force through high-quality data analysis, reporting, and operational execution. This role sits at the intersection of data analytics, commercial operations, and field strategy, with a focus on enabling actionable insights and operational excellence.
  
  
This position reports to the Sr Manager, Field Effectiveness and will be responsible for the following
  
  
**Responsibilities -**
**Field Data Analysis & Insights**

* Extract, clean, and analyze large datasets from Veeva CRM, distribution partners (e.g., specialty pharmacies/wholesalers), claims data (e.g., Symphony, IQVIA), and internal patient services platforms.
* Conduct analysis of execution for Field Sales teams to assess reach, frequency, HCP engagement trends, and account targeting effectiveness.

**Operational Execution & Field Enablement**

* Execute and manage regular territory alignments, roster updates, and call-plan deployments across therapeutic areas, ensuring accuracy and alignment.
* Ensure operational delivery of tools used by the field—e.g., Veeva CRM, Next Best Action dashboards, digital companion tools, Alerts, and call plan refreshes.

**Sales Force Size/Structure & Deployment**

* Lead end-to-end size & structure, including new product launches, reorganizations, annual realignments and alignment cycles.
* Manage deployment planning to ensure optimal coverage of healthcare providers (HCPs), accounts, and geographies.
* Leverage internal resources in marketing, media, finance to design optimal and performance-driven territories.
* Partner with sales leadership to adjust alignments based on market dynamics and business priorities.
* Develop communication strategies for field force notifications, placement deliverables.

**Field Force Effectiveness**

* Develop and implement strategies to enhance field productivity, including call planning, coverage optimization, and targeting.
* Build KPI dashboards and performance reporting to track territory efficiency, sales team impact, and customer reach.
* Conduct periodic targeting audit, by providing insights into workload balance, call frequency, and engagement quality.

**Compliance, Quality, and Process Optimization**

* Ensure all analytics and reports adhere to promotional and non-promotional field engagement compliance requirements (e.g., Sunshine Act, sampling rules, HCP engagement limits).
* Document processes and assumptions used in analytics pipelines and reports to support internal audit readiness and training.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process refinement using SQL, Python, or ETL tools to reduce manual data handling and improve cycle times.

**Project Management, Issue Tracking and Status Reporting**

* Track, manage, and drive resolution of issues and action items using systems such as JIRA and ServiceNow; ensure timely closure with clear ownership and supporting documentation.
* Apply structured project management approaches to plan, monitor, and deliver cross-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and timely risk mitigation.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation including timelines, decision logs, issue trackers, and closure reports to support governance and knowledge transfer.

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Field Analytics & Operations professional we seek has these qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree & 10+ years of experience in sales analytics, sales operations, and/or field effectiveness
* Master’s degree & 8+ years of experience in sales analytics, sales operations, and/or field effectiveness

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant Bio/Pharmaceutical industry experience
* Ability to write SQL queries and ability to do data analysis, data visualization and creating presentations.
* Execution-Focused Delivery: Own and execute day-to-day analytics tasks, reporting development, and field data operations with speed, accuracy, and minimal oversight.
* Insight Generation: Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that inform territory strategy, account planning, and field engagement performance.

* Communication: Effective communication is key, both in writing and verbally. This includes the ability to present data and findings clearly to stakeholders and team members. Ability to create training documents and communication deliverables based on projects/ needs.

• Lead, mentor and review the work of lease administrators and analysts, setting priorities, deadlines and quality standards.

• Own lease administration, CAM, billing and accounting processes end to end, driving standardization, controls and continuous improvement.

• Act as the escalation point for complex lease interpretation, reconciliation variances and data discrepancies.

• Report KPIs, risks and resolution timelines to property management, finance and asset management leadership. Lease Abstraction & Administration

• Oversee the review and abstraction of commercial lease agreements, amendments, renewals and related documents.

• Capture key lease data, including terms, commencement and expiration dates, rent schedules, escalation clauses, options and tenant obligations.

• Maintain accurate and complete lease records in Yardi and track critical dates, expirations, renewals and rent escalations.

• Organize lease documentation and support lease audits and compliance reviews. CAM Setup & Reconciliation

• Set up and maintain CAM charges, recoveries and allocation parameters based on lease provisions.

• Review lease clauses to determine tenant responsibility for CAM, operating expenses, taxes, insurance and other recoverable costs.

• Own annual CAM reconciliations by comparing actual operating expenses with tenant billings and estimated payments, investigating variances and preparing supporting schedules. Sales Entry & Reporting

• Collect, review and enter tenant sales data, validating completeness, accuracy and compliance with lease reporting requirements.

• Follow up on missing, delayed or inconsistent tenant sales reports.

• Support percentage-rent calculations and generate sales reports with accurate historical records. Accounts Receivable & Tenant Billing

• Reconcile weekly bank report receipts and record deposits and non-sufficient funds (NSF) transactions in Yardi.

• Prepare the pre-authorized payment (PAP) sheet.

• Download tenant invoices and send them to the respective tenants. Property Accounting & Expense Coordination

• Enter monthly income, expenses and GST in QuickBooks and reconcile accounts.

• Manage property assessments and property taxes, including related records and coordination.

• Manage property insurance administration and documentation.

• Send monthly shareholder expense information to the accounting team. Yardi Reporting, Reconciliations & Quality Control

• Reconcile information across executed leases, Yardi records and QuickBooks, and investigate and document discrepancies.

• Prepare reports and dashboards covering lease status, expirations, rent schedules, CAM reconciliations and sales reporting.

• Assist with data validation, variance analysis, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow analysis.

• Maintain audit-ready records, follow internal controls and report outstanding issues and risks to stakeholders. Leasing Documentation & Ad Hoc Support

• Maintain move-out reports and organize leasing folders and supporting records.

• Prepare lease documentation for projects and prioritize urgent lease-renewal dates with timely follow-up.

• Coordinate with property management, finance, accounting, leasing and asset management teams.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Real Estate or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in lease administration, commercial real estate operations, property accounting or lease management, including team leadership or mentoring experience.

• Working knowledge of commercial lease structures, rent schedules, CAM recoveries and lease clauses.

• Experience in lease abstraction, financial reconciliations and operational reporting.

• Working knowledge of Yardi (receipts, deposits, tenant invoicing, PAP schedules, NSF recording) and QuickBooks (income, expense and GST entries, account reconciliations).

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, data validation and reconciliation worksheets.

• Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, documentation practices and time management.

• Willingness to work night shifts from the Hyderabad office.

Good to Have

• Experience with commercial office, retail or mixed-use property portfolios.

• Knowledge of percentage rent, tenant sales reporting, operating expense recoveries and lease escalations.

• Exposure to property management and accounting platforms beyond Yardi and QuickBooks. • Ability to manage high volumes of lease data while maintaining accuracy.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, people leadership and processimprovement skills. Key Performance Indicators

• Accuracy and completeness of lease abstraction and system data.

• Timely CAM setup and annual reconciliation completion. • Accuracy and timeliness of tenant sales entry and reporting.

• Timely weekly bank-report reconciliations and accurate recording of deposits and NSFs, PAP sheets and invoice distribution.

• Accuracy and timeliness of monthly QuickBooks income, expense and GST entries.

• Resolution time for data discrepancies and reconciliation variances.

• Timely tracking of lease expirations, renewals and other critical dates.

• Compliance with internal controls, documentation standards and reporting deadlines.

• Team performance, quality of work reviewed and timely delivery against agreed priorities.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Sr Manager, Procurement Platform Excellence
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best-in-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.
  
  
As Senior Manager, Platform Excellence within Global Procurement’s Center of Excellence Digital Transformation & AI organization, you drive the Source-to-Pay (S2P) platform strategy and roadmap and lead end-to-end management of the S2P platform landscape. This is a collaborative role: you shape one coherent S2P platform direction together with your peer Senior Managers for S/4HANA Transformation, AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, and Data Excellence & Governance. Your portfolio spans sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team, and you lead a team based in Hyderabad, India.
  
  
This is not a SAP or ERP configuration role. The SAP S/4HANA and Ariba transformation is driven by a separate team; you partner closely with them so the S2P platform landscape integrates cleanly with the ERP core and enterprise systems, and every platform decision reinforces one coherent, standardized S2P experience. Similarly, new AI transformation products that are still at an early, incubation stage sit with the AI Transformation team — your accountability is the established S2P platform portfolio and how it is run, integrated, and adopted.
  
  
You set direction and priorities and own value realization measured in real business terms — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality. You bring strong product and user-centered discipline to how the portfolio is run: grounding decisions in user personas, journeys, and end-to-end processes, and owning supplier-supported and third-party products end-to-end, including escalation, supplier performance (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
  
  
This is a people-leadership role. A core part of your mandate is to move platform operations from reactive, ticket-driven support to a proactive, agent-embedded model, and to embed product and user-centered discipline across the portfolio. You develop a team of platform and product professionals and partner closely with AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, Data Excellence & Governance, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Compliance. GP-centric platform products are owned here end-to-end; enterprise-wide systems and IT infrastructure remain with IT — the role does not perform software development or manage infrastructure.
  
  
**▍**
**Key Responsibilities**
A core expectation is to run Global Procurement’s Source-to-Pay platforms as products — end-to-end, value-driven, well-integrated, and adopted — while moving platform operations toward a proactive, agent-embedded model.
  
  
**Platform Strategy & Value Optimization**

* Own the end-to-end S2P platform portfolio strategy and roadmap — including the analytics and reporting platforms — framing business problems into clear product strategies that maximize outcomes over outputs.
* Prioritize opportunities and make build-versus-buy-versus-partner trade-offs, sequencing platform investment against S2P Reimagined and ERP transformation milestones.
* Track value through real business indicators — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality — and engage stakeholders on investment decisions and supplier and technology trends.

**End-to-End Platform Leadership & Lifecycle**

* Lead and be accountable for the S2P platform portfolio across its full lifecycle — sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and analytics platforms — setting clear direction and adapting priorities as needs evolve.
* Own supplier-supported and third-party products for GP-centric solutions, including escalation, supplier performance management (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
* Apply product-management fundamentals — budgeting, cost-versus-value trade-offs, and lifecycle planning — to keep platforms fit-for-purpose as scale and complexity grow, while keeping GP-centric solutions PM-owned and enterprise-wide systems with IT.

**Platform Operations, Integration & Health**

* Own platform stability, configuration, release, environment and test, and incident and problem management across the S2P landscape.
* Ensure the S2P platforms integrate cleanly with the SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core and enterprise systems, so data, controls, and processes flow reliably end-to-end.
* Establish platform health KPIs, service levels, and monitoring, and shift from reactive support to proactive, increasingly self-healing platforms — with agents handling detection, triage, routing, and routine configuration and testing.

**Analytics Platforms, Adoption & Product Performance**

* Product-manage the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team — ensuring the tooling is reliable, well-integrated, and fit-for-purpose, while analytics outputs and insights remain owned by the data analytics team.
* Instrument platforms to measure usage, adoption, and value, and use those signals to refine roadmaps and features.
* Define what “good adoption” means beyond usage — decision confidence, reduced rework, and behavior change.

**User-Centered Solution Design**

* Ground solutions in user personas, journeys, and end-to-end process understanding, balancing usability, feasibility, business value, and enterprise constraints.
* Challenge low-value features and over-customization; advocate scalable, standard-driven design and consistent interaction patterns across S2P tools and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Anticipate adoption risks and continuously improve solutions based on user behavior and usage signals.

**Stakeholder Engagement, Enablement & Change**

* Engage stakeholders, build trust, and bring people along through change; translate needs into clear action plans and resolve issues through influence and partnership.
* Own the platform enablement and support model — training, documentation, self-service, and a responsive support experience across regions.
* Embed change management into the product journey and drive adoption through clear, simple, actionable communication.

**Innovation & Agent-Embedded Ways of Working**

* Reimagine platform operations and enablement with agents embedded — platform support copilot, configuration and testing agents, integration-monitoring agents, and enablement copilot.
* Sponsor rapid experiments, validate impact, and turn the best into reusable building blocks for broader adoption across Source-to-Pay.

**Team Leadership & Enterprise Partnership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a Hyderabad-based team; build depth, ownership, and succession, and coach the team for a product-led, agent-embedded operating model.
* Partner across DTAI pillars, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Compliance, and functional Global Procurement teams, and represent the platform agenda in program reviews and executive readouts.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for platform stability, integration, and adoption risks, translating complex dynamics into clear decisions and tradeoffs for senior stakeholders.

**▍**
**Leadership Expectations**
This leader is expected to embody Micron’s core values and set the tone for the team:
  
  
**People**
Care for each other — build an inclusive, high-trust team; develop talent, grow capability, and plan succession within the team.
  
  
**Innovation**
Shape the future — run platforms as products and champion agent-embedded ways of working; experiment, learn fast, and scale what works.
  
  
**Tenacity**
Nothing shakes our resolve — own platform stability, integration, and adoption outcomes end-to-end through complex, cross-system challenges.
  
  
**Collaboration**
Aligned to win — break silos across DTAI, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and the business; win as one team across time zones.
  
  
**Customer Focus**
Partner and win together — treat procurement stakeholders and end-users as customers; design for their journeys and deliver adopted, high-value platforms.
  
  
**Speed**
Act with purpose and set the pace — make timely, well-reasoned decisions and move prioritized platform work from pilot to scale without losing rigor.
  
  
**▍**
**Leadership Competencies**

* Product & value judgment: Frame problems into value-driven strategy, prioritize outcomes over outputs, and make build-versus-buy-versus-partner calls with clarity.
* User-centered & adoption mindset: Design for real user journeys and adoption, not just delivery, and define value beyond usage.
* Talent & coaching: Develop, coach, and grow a multi-region team; build bench strength and succession within the function.
* Cross-cultural leadership: Work effectively across U.S. and Asia cultures and time zones, partnering with globally distributed stakeholders and peers.
* Influence & partnership: Lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Executive communication: Translate complex platform, integration, and product topics into crisp, decision-ready narratives for senior leaders.
* Change leadership: Drive adoption of new platforms and agent-embedded ways of working through enablement and change management.
* Outcome ownership: Set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and hold the function accountable for measurable stability, adoption, and value.

**▍ Minimum Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* Experience — depth: 13+ years in enterprise platform, digital product, or Source-to-Pay application management, including 5+ years leading platform or digital product delivery and operations and 3+ years leading teams.
* Experience — scale: At least 5 years in a large, multi-region enterprise (5,000+ employees), including environments running on SAP (ECC and/or S/4HANA).
* Experience — domain: Deep, hands-on ownership of a Source-to-Pay platform landscape (several of sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and procurement analytics platforms), with close working knowledge of how these integrate with an SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core.
* Product management: Proven end-to-end product ownership — vision, roadmap, prioritization, and value realization — with a track record of driving outcomes over outputs.
* Supplier / third-party product management: Managing supplier-supported products, including escalation, SLAs, performance reviews, licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
* Analytics & adoption: Working knowledge of analytics and business intelligence (Power BI or Tableau) and of instrumenting products to measure adoption and value.
* Integration: Proven experience integrating SaaS platforms with an ERP core — APIs, middleware, connectors, and cross-system data and controls.
* AI / agentic ways of working: Experience defining requirements for, or embedding, AI agents into platform operations, support, configuration, testing, or enablement.
* Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority on enterprise-scale, multi-region initiatives.
* Ways of working: Able to collaborate across U.S. and Asia time zones, including regular overlap with U.S.-based stakeholders and partners.

**▍ Preferred Requirements**

* Product management certification (Pragmatic Institute, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager, or equivalent).
* Hands-on experience with Source-to-Pay or procurement platforms (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, Icertis, or Ironclad) and procurement analytics platforms.
* Experience reimagining platform operations and enablement with AI or agents embedded.
* Service management (ITIL) and Agile or DevOps ways of working for enterprise applications.
* Depth in Source-to-Pay and Procure-to-Pay processes and the broader procurement platform landscape.

title: Domain Service Manager - HCM
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
  
  
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
  
  
**Who you are:**
You are an experienced service management professional with hands-on experience supporting enterprise People technology services. You understand the importance of stable, secure, and user-centred People services across employee lifecycle processes, talent, recruitment, learning, performance, workforce management, reporting, integrations, and operational support. You are customer centric, commercially aware, and confident operating in a complex global environment. You take ownership of incident restoration, service level performance, change coordination, problem management, service communications, stakeholder alignment, vendor performance, and continuous service improvement for People Function services.
  
  
**What You’ll Own:**

* Act as the key point of contact for People Function service support across People stakeholders, HR operations, business process owners, Enterprise Applications teams, Global Technology Services & Operations, support teams, and internal/external service providers.
* Own all aspects of People Function service management, including incident, change, problem, knowledge management, service communications, service creation, transition, and operation.
* Ensure service lines deliver reliable customer service, incident restoration, service request fulfilment, and service level agreement performance for People processes, platforms, and integrations.
* Monitor, report, and improve the availability and performance of end-to-end People Function services, including business-critical HR processes and downstream integrations.
* Develop People Function standard operating procedures and knowledge-based articles for handover to Level 1 and Level 2 support teams.
* Identify, prioritise, and implement People Function service improvements in collaboration with People stakeholders, technology, operations, and supplier teams.

**Role accountabilities:**
**Service Management:**

* Coordinate incident, problem, service request, change, knowledge management, and service communication activities for People Function services.
* Work with Global Technology Services & Operations and service operations teams to manage incident and problem response, resolution, and service requests with a strong focus on end-user and Key Business User satisfaction.
* Manage service escalations by establishing clear escalation paths, coordinating timely stakeholder updates, driving issue ownership across internal and external teams, and ensuring appropriate prioritisation and resolution of business-impacting People Function service issues.
* Ensure relevant service lines deliver reliable support for People processes, platforms, integrations, access-related issues, service changes, and operational communications.
* Manage operational KPIs for BAU deliveries, including shift rota coverage, continuity, handover, responsiveness, and adherence to agreed service performance measures across People Function service operations.
* Report on People Function service availability, performance, response and resolution times, backlog status, customer satisfaction, and service improvement opportunities.

**Service Alignment & Continuous Improvement:**

* Assess People Function service or regional change requests and coordinate implementation, testing, deployment, and communication across People stakeholders, business users, and service teams.
* Coordinate People Function deployments and releases across Enterprise Applications to ensure controlled implementation, minimal service disruption, and effective release communications.
* Coordinate problem management by ensuring relevant People process owners, internal suppliers, external suppliers, operations, integrations, security, and testing teams are engaged and informed.
* Own service creation and transition activities for People Function capabilities, ensuring changes to systems, integrations, roles, and business processes are communicated back to Global Technology Services & Operations.
* Define and implement the support model for onboarding new HCM technology solutions, including service ownership, support tiers, operational processes, knowledge transfer, handover requirements, service readiness, and integration into BAU support operations.
* Cooperate with other domain service managers to ensure service integration across People services and wider enterprise application, reporting, and integration services.
* Work with stakeholders to continually improve People Function services and ensure the service offering meets current and future People and business needs.

**Vendor Management & Collaboration:**

* Work closely with People Function support teams, process owners, integration teams, security teams, reporting teams, and external service providers to ensure reliable end-to-end service delivery.
* Manage and steer third-party performance to support People Function service performance, agreed service levels, operational outcomes, and end-user experience.
* Collaborate proactively with Domain BPOs, BPEs, KBUs, end users, Global Engagement & Operations domain teams, Enterprise Applications teams, and Global Technology Services & Operations to develop, implement, maintain, and improve People Function services.

**Key Shared Accountabilities:**

* Partner with other Enterprise Applications lanes, People product teams, HR operations teams, and domain service teams to exceed business expectations.
* Support portfolio service management across People and related enterprise application domains, including major incident management with Global Technology Services & Operations where People services or integrations are impacted.
* Contribute to technical solution decisions with the Global Continuous Improvements lane for People Function service improvements.
* Coordinate update, release, and regression testing with the Enterprise Applications Test Manager, People product leads, process owners, and Key Business Users.
* Support People Function integrations with Global System Integrations teams, including upstream and downstream dependencies across payroll, identity, reporting, finance, and other enterprise platforms.
* Develop People Function SOPs and knowledge-based articles with Global Delivery Enablement and coordinate service disruption announcements and end-user communications.

**Decision rights:**

* Owns: Service design, transition, and operation within the People Function service portfolio.
* Owns: Contributing to customer satisfaction through effective People Function service management, vendor management, stakeholder engagement, and service communications.
* Influences: Business decisions on People Function service creation, service transition, process changes, and continuous service improvements.
* Influences: Production deployments that pose significant security, data, operational, employee experience, or business disruption risks.

**The ideal candidate should:**

* Have a minimum of 5 years’ hands-on experience in service management and/or support for major ERP, HR, People, or enterprise business technology platforms.
* Demonstrate strong customer-centricity and a proven track record of achieving service excellence in a complex global organisation with People, HR, business, technology, and supplier stakeholders.
* Have practical experience managing incidents, problems, changes, service requests, knowledge articles, service communications, service transition, and continuous improvement across People Function services.
* Understand the operational importance of People processes, employee data, security/access, integrations, reporting, releases, and business continuity.
* Be able to maintain positive stakeholder relationships and work effectively with external resources and third-party service providers.
* Use service metrics such as end-user and Key Business User NPS, incident/problem/service request response and resolution times, backlog management, availability, CSAT, and OLA performance to drive improvement.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 5 years’ hands-on experience with service management and/or support for major ERP, HR, People, or enterprise business technology systems.
* Experience supporting People or HR business processes, platforms, integrations, reporting, access/security processes, service operations, or enterprise application support.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, service coordination, vendor management, service reporting, and continuous improvement skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with People Function technology services such as core HR, talent, recruitment, learning, performance, compensation, absence, time, payroll integrations, workforce structures, security, analytics, reporting, or employee experience platforms.
* Service management experience with Oracle HCM and/or Oracle ERP platforms would be preferred, particularly in supporting enterprise application operations, integrations, releases, incident management, and continuous service improvement.
* Experience operating in or alongside ITIL-based service management processes, including incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.
* Experience managing third-party service providers and support partners against People Function service expectations, operational measures, and end-to-end service performance.
* Experience supporting service creation, transition, major incident management, service reporting, release testing, regression testing, and continuous improvement plans.
* Relevant service management, ITIL, HR technology, enterprise applications, or vendor management certification would be advantageous.

**Arcadis Key competencies / Values:**
People First: We care for each other and create a safe and respectful working environment where our people can grow, perform, and succeed.

Client Success: We are passionate about our clients’ success and bring insights, agility, and innovation to co-create value.

Why Arcadis?
  
  
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
  
  
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
  
  
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
  
  
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
  
  
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
  
  
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people.

title: Assistant Manager / Manager – Quality Control (QC)
description:
**Job Overview**
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant Manager / Manager – Quality Control to oversee daily analytical testing, instrument compliance, and quality operations across our pharmaceutical laboratories (API/Formulation). In this role, you will lead a team of QC analysts, manage chromatographic data integrity, direct laboratory investigations (OOS, OOT, CAPA), ensure pharmacopeial compliance (USP, EP, BP, IP), and represent the QC function during customer and regulatory audits.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Laboratory Operations & Release: Direct daily QC testing workflows to ensure the timely testing, review, approval, and analytical batch release of raw materials, intermediates, and finished products.
* Data Review & Audit Trails: Oversee electronic chromatographic data systems (Empower, Chromeleon, LabSolutions, OpenLab), conducting thorough data reviews, audit trail assessments, and user access management to maintain strict 21 CFR Part 11 / data integrity compliance.
* Laboratory Investigations: Spearhead root-cause investigations for Out of Specification (OOS), Out of Trend (OOT), laboratory incidents, and deviations; formulate and track robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Method Validation & Transfer: Guide and review analytical method validation (AMV), verification, method transfers, and long-term stability study protocols and execution.
* Equipment Qualification & Calibration: Supervise laboratory compliance programs, including instrument qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), routine calibration, preventive maintenance, and chemical reference standard management.
* Audit & Inspection Readiness: Face and support customer audits, internal laboratory audits, and regulatory inspections, ensuring prompt closure of audit observations.
* Team Leadership & cGLP Training: Mentor, manage, and upskill laboratory chemists on cGLP practices, advanced analytical techniques, and regulatory compliance standards.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Education: M.Sc. (Chemistry), M.Pharm, or B.Pharm in a relevant scientific discipline.
* Experience: Minimum 8–10 years of hands-on experience in pharmaceutical Quality Control laboratories handling API and/or Formulation products.
* Analytical Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of analytical techniques, including HPLC, GC, UV, FTIR, ICP-MS, Dissolution testing, and Wet Chemistry.
* Chromatography Data Systems (CDS): Proven experience managing and reviewing data in systems such as Empower, Chromeleon, LabSolutions, or OpenLab, including audit trail reviews, user management, and data integrity enforcement.
* Investigations & CAPA: Proven expertise in leading laboratory failure investigations (OOS, OOT), deviations, and implementing effective CAPAs.
* Methodology & Stability: Solid background in analytical method validation (AMV), method transfer, method verification, and ICH stability studies.
* Regulatory & Pharmacopeia Standards: In-depth familiarity with pharmacopeial requirements (USP, EP, BP, IP), cGMP/cGLP guidelines, and global regulatory inspection expectations.
* Audits & Compliance: Proven track record of successfully handling client quality audits, internal assessments, and regulatory agency inspections.
* Leadership: Strong team management and operational capabilities to drive timely laboratory testing, report approvals, and data release.

title: Manager – Product Development, Design & Costing
description:
**Designation:**
Manager – Product Development, Design & Costing

**Department:**
Product Development / Design / Costing

**Industry:**
Imitation Jewellery Manufacturing

**Reporting To:**
add cad cam knoledge Management

**Experience:**
5–8 Years (Preferred)

**Qualification:**
Degree / Diploma in Jewellery Design, Fashion Design or Product Development.

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To lead and manage the complete product development process of imitation jewellery, including conceptualisation, designing, sampling, material selection, product costing and coordination with manufacturing teams. The position is responsible for developing innovative, market-oriented and commercially viable jewellery products while ensuring cost efficiency, product quality and timely execution.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Product Development**

1. Lead the development of new imitation jewellery collections based on current fashion trends, market research and customer requirements.
2. Identify new product opportunities, designs, materials, finishes and manufacturing techniques.
3. Develop product concepts from initial ideas to final approved samples.
4. Coordinate with sampling and production teams for prototype development and product modifications.
5. Ensure all new products are commercially viable and suitable for bulk manufacturing.
6. Maintain a systematic database of new products, approved samples and product specifications.

**B. Jewellery Designing**

1. Lead the design and development of necklaces, earrings, bangles, bracelets, rings, pendants and jewellery sets.
2. Prepare creative designs, sketches, technical drawings and detailed product specifications.
3. Ensure designs are aligned with brand identity, customer expectations and prevailing market trends.
4. Guide designers and sampling personnel in converting concepts into finished products.
5. Review and approve design concepts and samples before submission to management or customers.
6. Ensure originality and confidentiality of designs and product developments.

**C. Product Costing & Pricing**

1. Prepare detailed product-wise costing sheets for all newly developed jewellery.
2. Calculate material consumption, stone costs, components, labour, plating, polishing, assembly and finishing charges.
3. Account for wastage, rejection, manufacturing overheads, packaging and other applicable expenses.
4. Establish appropriate manufacturing costs and recommend selling prices based on target profit margins.
5. Compare estimated costing with actual production costs and identify variations.
6. Identify cost-reduction opportunities without compromising product quality.
7. Coordinate with purchase and production departments to obtain updated raw material prices and manufacturing rates.
8. Ensure costing accuracy before finalising product quotations.

**D. Production & Interdepartmental Coordination**

1. Coordinate with production, purchase, quality control, stores and merchandising departments.
2. Ensure approved designs and specifications are followed during bulk production.
3. Resolve technical and design-related issues arising during manufacturing.
4. Monitor sample development schedules and ensure timely completion.
5. Review production feasibility, material availability and manufacturing capacity before finalising new products.
6. Work closely with quality control to maintain consistency in product finishing, plating and workmanship.

**E. Team Management & Reporting**

1. Lead and supervise the product development, design and costing team.
2. Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual and departmental performance.
3. Establish systems for design approvals, sample tracking and costing documentation.
4. Submit periodic reports to management on new product development, costing, sample status and production feasibility.
5. Ensure timely execution of assigned product development projects.

**3. REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

* Thorough knowledge of imitation jewellery manufacturing processes.
* Strong understanding of jewellery components, stones, beads, chains, metal accessories and plating.
* Expertise in product development, design concepts and sampling.
* Good understanding of material consumption and manufacturing costing.
* Knowledge of labour costing, wastage, overheads and profit-margin calculations.
* Proficiency in CorelDRAW, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop or relevant design software.
* Knowledge of market trends and fashion forecasting.
* Leadership, negotiation, communication and coordination skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

**4. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

1. Number of commercially viable new products developed every month.
2. Timely completion of product development and sample approvals.
3. Accuracy of estimated product costing against actual manufacturing costs.
4. Achievement of targeted product cost and profit margins.
5. Reduction in material wastage and manufacturing costs.
6. Design innovation and customer sample approval ratio.
7. Timely coordination and resolution of production-related issues.
8. Overall performance and productivity of the product development team.

**5. AUTHORITY & ACCOUNTABILITY**

* Responsible for product development, design and costing activities.
* Recommend new materials, components and manufacturing processes.
* Recommend cost optimisation measures and design modifications.
* Review and approve samples within the authority delegated by management.
* Submit final product costing and pricing recommendations for management approval.
* Accountable for the accuracy of costing, timely product development and commercial viability of new products.

**6. OVERALL RESPONSIBILITY**

The Manager – Product Development, Design & Costing shall be responsible for transforming creative jewellery concepts into commercially successful products by ensuring effective design development, accurate costing, manufacturing feasibility, cost optimisation and coordination with all concerned departments.
