title: Manager, Indirect Tax Technology
description:
**About The Team**
DoorDash is looking for an experienced Manager, Tax Technology to lead the offshore Vertex & ERP Integrations Center of Excellence (CoE) within our growing Tax Team. The tax engine (Vertex) calculates the correct sales tax and VAT on every order across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo platforms, and this role owns the deep technical expertise that keeps that engine accurate.
  
  
As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and maintaining indirect tax engines, with the integration to ERP systems on both AR and AP sides, who can also lead and develop a team of configuration and testing specialists. You will be the central technical authority the rest of the platform team relies on, blending technical indirect tax knowledge, tax-engine experience, and people leadership.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will report to the Senior Manager of the Tax Calculation Platform & Mx Operations and lead the offshore Center of Excellence — the hub of Vertex configuration, automated testing, and tax-content maintenance. You will set technical standards, oversee the work of Associate Managers, and serve as the senior point of escalation for complex configuration and testing issues.
  
  
The primary focus of this position is end-to-end tax engine solutions for sales and use taxes, food and beverage taxes and fees, gross receipts taxes, and VAT — ensuring the correct tax is calculated on every product, fee, and country before anything goes live.
  
  
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
  
  

* Own the technical configuration of Vertex — tax drivers, taxability mappings, custom rules, and jurisdiction logic — and lead configuration design for high-complexity initiatives.

title: Associate Fonder
description:
**Company Description**
Leadre Proptech is an independent property advisory firm that helps homebuyers make informed, structured decisions before purchase and verifies their property before possession. The firm was created to close the gap in independent evaluation, where buyers often discover issues such as seepage, plumbing defects, or finishing problems only after moving in. Leadre supports buyers at two critical stages: before commitment, through advisory, agreement review, and risk assessment; and before possession, through a detailed 220-point verification framework covering key functional and quality aspects of the apartment. By focusing on clarity, systematic evaluation, and professional reporting, Leadre enables buyers to identify potential risks early and avoid costly post-possession issues. As a buyer-side advisory firm, Leadre operates independently of developers and transactions, ensuring an unbiased perspective that is fully aligned with the buyer’s interests.

**Role Description**
The Associate Founder will play a key role in building and scaling Leadre Proptech’s advisory and verification services, working closely with the founding team on strategy, operations, and client delivery. This full-time hybrid position is based in Hyderabad, with flexibility for partial work from home as business needs allow. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with clients to understand their requirements, overseeing property advisory and verification workflows, and contributing to the refinement of service frameworks and processes. The role involves coordinating with inspection teams, reviewing reports for accuracy and clarity, and ensuring a consistent, high-quality experience for buyers. The Associate Founder will also help shape business development efforts, support partnerships, and provide input on product and technology initiatives that enhance Leadre’s offering.

**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex property and risk assessments into clear, actionable insights.
* Experience in real estate, property advisory, consulting, or related fields, with familiarity around home buying processes and buyer-side needs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings, explain risks, and build trust with clients in a professional, unbiased manner.
* Proven capability in operational management, including coordinating teams, managing workflows, and maintaining quality and consistency across deliverables.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, with comfort in early-stage environments, a hands-on approach to problem-solving, and willingness to take ownership of outcomes.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid model from Hyderabad, managing both in-person interactions and remote collaboration.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, real estate, finance, or a related discipline; advanced degrees or certifications in real estate or consulting are an advantage.
* High ethical standards and a strong commitment to maintaining independence and client-first advisory practices.

title: MS - FDL - Manager - Product Operations
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Data Operations & Technical Oversight**

* Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
* Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
* Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
* Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
* Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
* Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
* Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
* Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
* Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
* Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
* Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
* Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
* Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

**Data Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
* Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
* Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Perform quality checks and reconciliation: regularly audit datasets to ensure completeness, accuracy and clarity, and resolve discrepancies.**

* Prepare operational reporting: prepare analysis on work volume, completeness, accuracy, and data variances for business targets with cross-functional teams.
* Support special projects: provide input and oversight on projects ranging from systems improvement UAT to data reconciliation initiatives.
* Manage a team of analysts: lead a team of analysts who will enter contract details in Rightsline and ensure SLAs are met.

**About You**

* Proven leadership skills in keeping teams accountable and goal execution with an eye on process improvement
* Attention to detail; well versed in understanding contract language and translating terms

title: Lead : Cash & Position Reconciliation
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
The Team Lead will supervise a sub-team of analysts responsible for cash and position reconciliation activities. They act as the first line of operational oversight, ensuring accurate and timely reconciliation output, break resolution, and adherence to process controls. The Team Lead plays a key role in coaching analysts, managing day-to-day workflow, and escalating exceptions appropriately to the Team Manager.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Daily Reconciliation Oversight
* Oversee end-of-day and intraday cash & Position reconciliation across all accounts and asset classes providing both L1 and L2 services.
* Review and validate reconciliation outputs completed by analysts before submission.
* Monitor break queues and ensure timely investigation and resolution of exceptions.
* Coordinate with custodians, counterparties, and internal teams to clear outstanding items.
* Team Supervision & Development
* Allocate daily work to analysts, monitor progress, and ensure SLA timelines are met.
* Provide on-the-job training, guidance, and feedback to analysts.
* Act as the first point of escalation for analyst queries or complex breaks.
* Flag performance concerns and development needs to the Team Manager.
* Controls & Process Adherence
* Ensure team members follow documented SOPs and maker-checker controls at all times.
* Perform quality checks on reconciliation outputs and flag anomalies.
* Maintain accurate records of breaks, resolutions, and exception logs.
* Support the Team Manager in audit preparation and compliance reviews.

title: Director - Infrastructure Engineering
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Digital Infrastructure & Reliability organization is seeking an accomplished engineering and IT leader to serve as Director of Infrastructure Engineering.
  
  
This role blends strategic leadership, deep cross-domain technical competency, platform engineering modernization, and organizational stewardship for our APAC employees. As a core engineering director, you will drive modern platform engineering practices and provide technical direction across multi-cloud (AWS and Azure) and on-premise platforms, network engineering, Linux and Windows engineering, and SRE support for a variety of internal services.
  
  
Simultaneously, you will serve as the site lead for all India-based team members across the Infrastructure and Security organization, including those outside your direct reporting hierarchy. You will champion site culture, foster cross-functional alignment, ensure operational continuity, and act as a pivotal regional escalation point for our internal stakeholders in product, manufacturing, and customer support organizations within the APAC region.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Technical Leadership and Platform Modernization
* Broad-Spectrum Technical Competency: Proven ability to engage in architectural design and technical troubleshooting across a broad variety of engineering practices, including network engineering, systems engineering with Windows and Linux stacks, cloud platforms including AWS, GCP, and Azure management, and on-premise hypervisor ecosystems.
* Automation First Mindset: Advocate and drive adoption of automation practices to eliminate manual configuration drift and increase our delivery velocity. Use automation to build robust patching and infrastructure provisioning practices across network, computer, and cloud domains.
* Core IT Services: Maintain comprehensive technical understanding of enterprise and hybrid data center and office services, including networks, core IT services (DNS, DHCP, PKI), perimeter security, routing/switching, and technical service suites and capabilities.
* Platform as a Product: Support infrastructure teams focused on cloud and on-premise infrastructure. Support sustainable engineering practices, including systematic intake, driving infrastructure management practices, and modern configuration management.
* Regional Escalation Authority
* Site Stewardship: Serve as the senior site leader for our Hyderabad office, cultivating an inclusive, high-performance human-first culture, representing local employees to leadership, and driving community and cross-team engagement.
* Matrixed Leadership: Provide mentorship and operational guidance for India-based teams and employees who report into management teams across the organization.
* Cross-Functional Bridge: Act as the primary operational escalation point for mission-critical incidents and provide clean hand offs between global teams. Support coordination between teams within the broader Infrastructure and Reliability organization.
* Incident Management: Partner closely with global Service Desk, Major Incident Management, and global engineering teams to ensure rapid incident triage, proactive communication, and robust executive engagement to build system and organizational trust.
* Strategic Leadership and Talent Management
* Talent Development: Mentor, develop, and support technical teams, driving a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Global Alignment: Collaborate with global counterparts across Infrastructure, Security, Identity, and Architecture to ensure unified roadmaps and seamless “follow-the-sun” operations.
* Data Driven Decision Making: Define KPIs and metrics to measure operational performance and developer productivity.
* AI Adoption: Help understand use cases and drive AI adoption across the organization. Use storytelling practices to highlight successes and drive organizational decisions for AI use and future state architecture.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in technology infrastructure, systems engineering, cloud architecture, or platform operations, with at least 5+ years in senior engineering leadership roles (Director or Senior Manager).
* At least 2 years of experience functioning as a Site Lead or senior leader helping support multiple teams and coordinating with US based leadership.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, capable of influencing senior executives, cross-functional leaders, and engineers alike without requiring direct line authority.
* Proven track record overseeing large-scale cloud environments and physical data centers in complex enterprise environments.
* Expertise in Agile methodologies and driving team cultures through iterative improvement and technical excellence.
* Expertise in infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible), cloud-native operations, and hybrid networking.
* Deep understanding of developer platforms, including source control (GitHub, GitLab, Perforce, ADO), artifact repositories, CI/CD frameworks, and observability stacks.
* Strong grasp of DevOps principles, ITIL, platform engineering, and infrastructure automation practices.
* Strong foundational expertise in both Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and Windows Server operating systems, as well as core networking protocols, firewall concepts, and load-balancing principles.
* Demonstrable poise when managing high-severity operational outages, security vulnerabilities, or regional business continuity challenges.
* Experience automating away toil, running blameless post-mortems, and shifting from reactive firefighting to proactive observability and self-healing infrastructure.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Advanced industry certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional), Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or ITIL v3/v4 Managing Professional.
* Hands-on familiarity with ServiceNow, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Jira, and enterprise observability suites such as LogicMonitor and DataDog.
* Familiarity with F5 technologies, especially BIG-IP and XC platforms.

description:

We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. **Position:**
Associate Director, Process Scale-Up & Manufacturing Readiness
  
  
**Location**
: Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Working with Us**
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees continually ask, “Who are you working for?” – a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
****Position Summary****
The Associate Director, Process Scale-Up & Manufacturing Readiness serves as a technical leader responsible for assessing, de-risking, and enabling the successful scale-up of clinical drug substance manufacturing processes from laboratory scale through pilot plant and manufacturing scale implementation. This role provides strategic and hands-on expertise in chemical engineering, technology transfer, process scale-up, safe process implementation, and GMP process operations across our growing network of external manufacturing partners located in Asia.
  
  
This individual will be based out of the Hyderabad BMS office and will serve as the Person in Plant (PIP) with our Asian Contract Development and Management Organizations (CDMOs). They will collaborate closely with internal colleagues based in US and/or Europe across chemistry, engineering, manufacturing, and quality to translate laboratory science into reliable, safe, and executable manufacturing processes at scale. The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in small molecule processes and GMP manufacturing, with experience in other modalities (ADCs, oligonucleotides, peptides, radiopharmaceuticals) viewed as a significant advantage. Additionally, the successful candidate will possess excellent communication skills, the ability to frequently travel to CDMO manufacturing sites, and have prior experience navigating CDMO technical relationships including the ability to strategically and tactically drive technical improvements.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Influence manufacturing strategies across a large portfolio of projects while mentoring US- and European-based scientists and engineers to build organizational capabilities in scale-up and GMP manufacturing
* Lead technology transfer and on-site support at multiple external sites, driving proactive assessment and mitigation of potential risks and rapid resolution of realized manufacturing issues
* Identify and improve BMS-CDMO ways-of-working regarding technical transfer and manufacturing readiness
* Lead manufacturing readiness assessments, evaluating process scalability and de-risking scale-up from lab through pilot plant and commercial production
* Serve as SME for chemical manufacturing operations and unit operations, partnering with process chemistry, engineering, and manufacturing to define executable processes
* Apply process safety and risk management principles to lead readiness reviews prior to manufacturing campaigns
* Represent CPD Engineering in cross-functional and enterprise forums, contributing to broader strategic alignment

The successful candidate can walk into a manufacturing plant and rapidly assess:
  
  

* Whether the process will fit the equipment, and where scale-up risks are likely to occur
* Whether environmental health and safety and GMP quality risks are adequately addressed, and if not, have the ability productively raise these risks to internal and external stakeholders and leadership while successfully driving resolution
* Whether the process, equipment, or operations strategy requires modification to maximize the probability of success

****Qualifications & Experience****

* Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering with 8+ years industrial experience; or M.S. with 12+ years; or B.S. with 15+ years of relevant experience
* Extensive experience scaling small molecule manufacturing processes from lab through pilot plant and commercial production, with strong process safety and troubleshooting skills
* Knowledge of cGMP manufacturing and quality systems
* Demonstrated success influencing in a matrixed management environment without direct reporting relationships
* Experience beyond small molecules (ADCs, oligonucleotides, peptides, radiopharmaceuticals) and experience spanning clinical to commercial manufacturing preferred
* This position requires work within facilities handling hazardous chemical agents, which, if improperly handled, may have the potential to affect employee health, including reproductive function and/or embryo/fetal development

*If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.*
**Uniquely Interesting Work, Life-changing Careers**
At BMS, every employee helps advance our vision: Transforming patients’ lives through science™. Here, uniquely interesting and meaningful work happens every day, across high-achieving teams who have transformational opportunities to learn, grow and lead. Help us define what’s possible for the future of science and the patients we serve.

title: Manager - Engineering
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self-healing, self-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
  
  
We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For…**
ScienceLogic is hiring an Engineering Manager for our PowerPack team based in our Hyderabad office. This role will manage a team of approximately 20 software engineers and SDETs responsible for the development, quality, and ongoing evolution of the PowerPack portfolio. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India) and will be a member of the India engineering leadership team. This is a people-first leadership role with meaningful technical responsibility. We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who can build trust, develop future leaders, drive execution, and thoughtfully apply AI-enabled practices to improve engineering outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing…**
You’ll lead a team of approximately 20 engineers comprised of full-time employees and, covering responsibilities across:
  
  
**People & Growth**

* Conduct regular 1:1s with team members, providing coaching, feedback, and career development support.
* Hiring: run screening and calibration with recruiting partners, and own onboarding for new hires.
* Management of Contractors performance monitoring and support through contractor-to-FTE conversion process.
* Performance management and career development conversations that go beyond the annual review.
* Team health across the org: morale and psychological safety, not just velocity metrics.
* Conflict resolution and mediation to keep the team cohesive under pressure.

**Delivery & Execution**

* Weekly alignment with your Product Owner on priorities, roadmap, and backlog, and with the leads you're developing as they take on more scope.
* Sprint execution accountability across both working groups, including capacity planning.
* Handling major or complex escalations, including regular syncs to work through what's outstanding.
* Tracking delivery metrics (velocity, uptime, bug counts, deployment frequency) and reporting progress, risk, and dependencies to stakeholders.

**Technical Leadership**

* Architecture and design review for pull requests, ensuring sound technical decisions across the team's work.
* Promoting engineering best practices: testing, code review, documentation, and CI/CD.
* Sponsoring and helping lead cross-team technical initiatives, such as major platform migrations and release-process automation.
* Running demo sessions and hands-on skill-building with the team on key technical areas.

**AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Identify where AI creates real leverage in your team's engineering workflows, and act on it yourself, not just approve it from a distance.
* Work alongside engineers to design and deliver AI-enabled solutions to real product and delivery problems.
* Build your team's capability to use AI as a working tool, including hands-on training for engineers who are still building that muscle.

**Org Design**

* Today, the org runs flat: you manage all 20 engineers directly, organized across two informally-led working groups.
* A key responsibility of this role is to identify and develop emerging leaders, establish a Team Lead layer, and evolve the organization into a more scalable team structure over time.

**Qualities you possess…**

* Experience:
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline
* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3-5 years leading engineering teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high-impact software products, with the willingness to roll up your sleeves and work directly with engineers when needed.
* Experience managing engineering teams of this size directly, and a track record of developing individual engineers into first-line leaders, even where that title doesn't formally exist yet.
* Self-starter with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Technical Competence:
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture and distributed systems.
* Proficiency in Python and REST APIs, with familiarity across other technology stacks.
* Proficiency in database technologies and event-driven architecture.
* Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD, and testing methodologies.
* Hands-on, personal experience building or shipping at least one AI-enabled feature: you were in the technical problem, contributing to design and trade-offs, not sponsoring or approving someone else's work.
* Leadership & Management:
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with a visible track record of developing engineers with diverse experience levels and career aspirations.
* Demonstrated ability to build, motivate, and retain high-performing engineering teams, with strong delivery instincts across sprint accountability, capacity planning, and cross-team coordination.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills with engineers, peers, and senior leadership.

**As a plus, you have...**

* Experience in a GCC, IDC, or other geographically distributed engineering environment.
* Product engineering background: ownership of outcomes, not just delivery of tasks.
* Familiarity with AIOps, monitoring, observability, or enterprise SaaS domains.
* Engineering background with hands-on depth in Python, REST APIs, or cloud-native development, enough that you're credible in architecture and design conversations, even though you won't be writing production code day to day in this role.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum at scale, where ceremonies drive outcomes rather than checkbox rituals.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and frameworks like React.
* Exposure towards Spec Driven Development(AI-DLC) and or TDD

*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*
**About ScienceLogic**
ScienceLogic is a leader in IT Operations Management, providing modern IT operations with actionable insights to resolve and predict problems faster in a digital, ephemeral world. Its solution sees everything across cloud and distributed architectures, contextualizes data through relationship mapping, and acts on this insight through integration and automation.

title: Team Lead, Product Operations, ICE Climate
description:
**Job Purpose**
ICE Climate Operations supports ICE's Climate Risk Data business, covering physical climate risk, transition risk, nature-related risk, and avoided emissions across public and private companies, sovereigns, and structured finance assets such as mortgage-backed and municipal securities. The Physical Risk team runs the geospatial research and quality assurance function behind this coverage, identifying and validating corporate and sovereign asset locations against wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme-temperature exposure for ICE's global geospatial risk platform.
  
  
Lead the operational delivery and continuous improvement of Physical Risk data projects within ICE Climate Operations. The role manages and develops a team of analysts responsible for asset-location research, geospatial validation, structured quality assurance, and project delivery. It combines people leadership with hands-on oversight of complex research and QA, ensuring data is accurate, complete, traceable, and delivered in line with product and client priorities.
  
  
The team leader is the primary operational contact for Physical Risk workstreams and coordinates closely with Product, R&D, Engineering, Analytics, and Data Quality teams. The role is expected to translate evolving requirements into clear work plans, maintain visibility of progress and risks, and build the team's ability to support product improvements and respond to data-related queries with increasing independence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Team leadership and delivery management

+ Lead, coach, and develop a team of associates and senior associates, setting clear expectations for delivery, quality, accountability, and professional growth.
+ Convert business and project priorities into practical work plans, allocate resources across concurrent workstreams, and adjust assignments as priorities change.
+ Monitor milestones, productivity, quality, and turnaround times; identify delivery risks early and implement recovery actions.
+ Conduct regular one-to-one discussions, goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning; support recruitment, onboarding, and succession readiness.
+ Act as the first point of escalation for operational blockers, quality concerns, scope ambiguity, and resourcing conflicts.

* Physical risk project and product support

+ Lead operational support for Physical Risk initiatives, including industrial and mine location QA, high-materiality asset review, corporate mapping, location weighting, and damage-function research across corporate, sovereign, and private-company asset classes.
+ Coordinate delivery with Product and R&D stakeholders, clarify objectives and acceptance criteria, maintain project status and dependencies, and ensure outputs are usable for downstream product or model development.
+ Keep the team focused on work that improves the quality and coverage of Physical Risk products, including continuous QA of critical asset data and on-demand QA or updates for client-driven requirements spanning wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme-temperature exposure.
+ Build sufficient product and methodology knowledge within the team to support data samples, stakeholder queries, and issue investigation with reduced dependency on Product teams.

* Research, geospatial data, and quality assurance

+ Oversee research to identify, classify, map, and validate corporate asset locations, ownership relationships, operational status, facility type, coordinates, and materiality indicators.
+ Ensure consistent use of authoritative internal data, third-party datasets, company disclosures, mapping platforms, satellite imagery, and documented public sources.
+ Review complex or high-risk discrepancies, confirm source traceability, approve final outputs, and direct root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
+ Oversee QA controls for completeness, coordinate accuracy, classification, duplication, status, source evidence, and conformity with approved methodologies and due-diligence standards.
+ Ensure project outputs are documented, reproducible, and ready for ingestion, analytics, model research, or client delivery as applicable.

* Data, reporting, and operational governance

+ Use SQL and BigQuery to retrieve, join, analyze, and validate entity and location datasets; use advanced Excel and reporting tools to manage and communicate delivery performance.
+ Maintain concise dashboards and status reporting covering scope, milestones, quality, throughput, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
+ Establish clear operating procedures, research playbooks, source hierarchies, QA checklists, and hand-off criteria; keep documentation current as requirements evolve.
+ Support audits, internal reviews, release validation, production issue analysis, and governance activities relevant to Physical Risk data operations.

* Process improvement, automation, and capability building

+ Identify recurring data and workflow issues and implement scalable improvements that reduce manual effort, rework, and turnaround time without weakening control quality.
+ Promote responsible use of AI-assisted research, automated validation, and smart workflows, with human verification and clear evidence retained for material decisions.
+ Develop team capability in Physical Risk methodology, corporate structures and identifiers, GIS and mapping, asset materiality, SQL/BigQuery, QA, and relevant internal platforms.
+ Create a collaborative learning environment through structured training, calibration sessions, knowledge sharing, and review of complex cases.

**Knowledge And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science or Planning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 6+ years of relevant experience in data operations related to geospatial or location data, GIS research, including experience leading people or project delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, resources, quality, and stakeholder expectations in a data-intensive operational environment.
* Working knowledge of corporate entity structures, asset-location data, geospatial concepts, mapping tools, and research-based verification.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, and advanced Excel; practical experience querying and analyzing large datasets. Experience with BigQuery is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, documentation discipline, and ability to resolve ambiguous or conflicting evidence.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to present status, risks, recommendations, and decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**

* Experience supporting Physical Risk, climate risk, catastrophe modelling, asset-level analytics, or commercial geospatial data products.
* Exposure to facility materiality, industrial assets, mines, utilities, damage-function or historical-loss research, and third-party location datasets.
* Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools, workflow automation, and AI-assisted research or validation processes.
* Familiarity with data governance, audit controls, client data samples, and cross-functional product delivery.

title: Senior Manager, Real Estate
description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
******Vanguard’s India Office******
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
This role manages all aspects of operation and maintenance of multiple or large physical facilities. Recommends, plans, and directs the design, maintenance, construction, renovation, and repair of organization facilities. Leads and negotiates multi-year vendor contracts. This role also ensures efficient utilization of real estate assets while aligning facility strategies with organizational growth and operational goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Develops plans and programs that meet present and anticipated space and facility requirements. Evaluates present and future needs for real estate, owned or leased, for the organization.
* Oversees and plans annual facility spending for office services, building and grounds maintenance, and facility expansion or improvement projects.
* Prepares cost estimates for building renovations or space allocations.
* Manages the maintenance, repair, and improvement of physical systems and equipment, related vendor relations, and cost control.
* Monitors and inspects all buildings and equipment to ensure that utility systems are fully operational and that preventive maintenance schedules are being followed. Leads facility staff working on various facility systems, such as water, utilities, generators, lighting, etc.
* Evaluates completed work and checks for conformance to specifications.
* Tracks industry and application trends to contribute to planning current and future real estate solutions. Proposes real estate solutions based on deep understanding of industry forces, emerging trends, and regional best practices.
* Manages KPI targets/performance objectives for the site(s) and drives performance, cost savings, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Ensures compliance with local regulatory requirements, safety standards, and environmental guidelines across all facilities.
* Drives sustainability and energy-efficiency initiatives within real estate and facility operations.
* Collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to align facility management with business continuity and expansion plans.
* Implements and leverages facility management systems and tools for improved operational efficiency and reporting.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualification & Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of related work experience, with at least Three years of real estate or facilities management experience. Supervisory experience preferred.
* Undergraduate degree (such as B.E./B.Tech, B.Arch, or equivalent) or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree (such as MBA, M.Tech, or equivalent) preferred.

******Location******
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
******Our mission******
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
******Our commitment to you******
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
******Financial wellness******
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
******Physical wellness******
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
******Personal wellness******
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
******How we work******
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Senior Analyst/Manager – DESIMOperations and Client Services – Financial Operations
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a highly resourceful, proactive, and detail-oriented individual to join our Operations and Client Services team supporting D. E. Shaw Investment Management (DESIM), our institutional asset management group, based out of Hyderabad and Gurugram, India. DESIM was established in 2005 and currently has over $19.1 billion in assets under management. DESIM builds on the experience and infrastructure of the broader firm to develop and manage active investment strategies that complement the firm’s alternative investment strategies. The group currently operates a platform of systematic, active equity strategies and a platform of discretionary, multi-asset class strategies. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to an inclusive team at ground level and to work with senior leaders at the firm while assuming considerable responsibility.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will be a part of a team that is responsible for designing and implementing processes and controls to support a growing business, executing strategic projects and initiatives, and optimizing internal and external client service. You will provide operational support for fund and managed account launches and liquidations, complex investor transactions, and investment mandate changes. Additionally, you will engage with internal stakeholders on operational matters, working closely with the team on initiatives aimed at improving client service while interacting directly with investors and counterparties. You will contribute to the reporting function within the team, supporting the production of investor reports, managing day-to-day reporting workflows, and coordinating production. Furthermore, you will participate in changing management processes, working closely with the DESIM COO and other internal stakeholders on projects and initiatives aimed at creating automated and efficient processes, along with supporting technology projects to build tools for reporting and analysis, streamlining workflows, and improving the user experience. You will have the opportunity to gain a macro view of the firm’s financial activities and learn about complex legal entity structures and transactions while enjoying substantial interaction with other internal departments, including technical investing groups, corporate development, investor relations, legal and compliance, and software development groups.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A Chartered Accountancy qualification or a master’s degree in finance, along with 2–6 years of experience in fund operations and/or client service roles within the financial services sector
* Proficient project management and critical thinking skills with good commercial judgment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities, a process-oriented mindset, the ability to execute short-term tasks while contributing to long-term projects, and the desire to work as part of a team. Additionally, excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to work are essential
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Knowledge of investor transactions, brokerage/counterparty relationships, and hedge fund accounting functions
* Prior experience in mentoring or coordinating small teams and a track record of contributing to process improvements
* Demonstrated ability to identify and implement scalable automation, AI solutions, and agentic workflows that streamline reporting and improve operational efficiency

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/SrAnaMgrDESIMOCSAug26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
We are seeking an experienced and relationship-oriented
**Information Technology Manager**
to lead day-to-day IT operations for our India Delivery Center in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and effective technology services while maintaining strong operational alignment between our U.S. and India IT organizations.
  
  
The IT Manager will serve as the primary technology leader for the Hyderabad and Noida offices and a key liaison between India business leadership and the broader IT organization. Success in this position requires a combination of strong IT operations leadership, technical knowledge, service orientation, and the ability to build trusted partnerships with business and technology leaders across geographies.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role requiring a consistent on-site presence. The successful candidate will be expected to report to and work from the Hyderabad office daily and travel approximately 10–20% to other India locations, including Noida.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**IT Operations & Service Delivery**

* Lead day-to-day IT operations for the Hyderabad Delivery Center, ensuring technology services are reliable, secure, responsive, and aligned with business needs.
* Oversee local IT infrastructure, end-user technology, workplace technology, network connectivity, conferencing and collaboration capabilities, and related technology services.
* Ensure incidents, service requests, and operational issues are addressed in accordance with established service levels and escalation procedures.
* Coordinate response to significant technology incidents affecting India operations and ensure appropriate communication with business stakeholders and U.S.-based IT leadership.
* Identify recurring operational issues, perform or coordinate root-cause analysis, and drive sustainable corrective actions.
* Maintain operational readiness, including appropriate documentation, procedures, support coverage, asset management, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology resilience activities for India locations.
* Partner with information security, infrastructure, network, application, and other technology teams to ensure compliance with enterprise technology and security standards.

**U.S. & India IT Alignment**

* Serve as a key liaison between U.S. and India IT teams, ensuring consistent implementation of enterprise technology standards, processes, controls, and priorities.
* Maintain regular communication with the Director of IT and other global technology leaders regarding operational performance, risks, business requirements, and emerging needs.
* Coordinate across time zones and geographic locations to ensure issues affecting India operations receive appropriate visibility, ownership, and resolution.
* Help translate enterprise IT strategies and standards into effective local execution while communicating India-specific requirements and considerations to global technology leadership.
* Identify opportunities to improve consistency, collaboration, and knowledge sharing between U.S. and India technology teams.
* Participate in global IT initiatives and represent the operational requirements and perspectives of India offices.

**Business Partnership**

* Develop trusted relationships with India business leaders and serve as a primary point of contact for technology-related needs, concerns, and opportunities.
* Develop a strong understanding of business operations, priorities, growth plans, and technology dependencies across the India Delivery Center.
* Proactively engage business leaders to understand upcoming requirements and ensure IT is prepared to support organizational growth and change.
* Communicate technology issues, risks, priorities, and solutions in clear business terms to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Balance local business requirements with enterprise technology standards, security requirements, and global IT priorities.
* Promote a customer-focused culture within the local IT organization with an emphasis on responsiveness, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and development for local IT personnel and/or technology service providers.
* Establish clear expectations and accountability for service quality, responsiveness, technical standards, and professional conduct.
* Develop team capabilities and ensure appropriate technical knowledge, documentation, and cross-training exist to support reliable operations.
* Collaborate effectively within a matrixed global IT organization in which responsibility for services may span local, regional, and global teams.
* Support workforce planning and resource allocation as India operations grow and technology requirements evolve.
* Manage relationships with technology vendors and service providers as appropriate.

**Governance, Security & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure local IT operations adhere to enterprise policies, cybersecurity requirements, technology standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support internal and external audit activities and ensure identified technology issues or control deficiencies are addressed appropriately.
* Maintain accurate technology asset inventories and support hardware and software lifecycle management.
* Monitor operational performance and service metrics and identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, employee experience, and service quality.
* Participate in technology budgeting, forecasting, procurement, capacity planning, and investment prioritization as required.
* Identify and manage operational technology risks, escalating significant risks to appropriate leadership.
* Champion standardized processes and continuous improvement across India IT operations.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Typically 8+ years of progressive information technology experience, including significant experience supporting enterprise IT operations.
* Typically 3+ years of IT leadership, supervisory, or team-management experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing IT operations in a corporate or professional-services environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT operations, including end-user computing, network and infrastructure services, identity and access management, collaboration technologies, IT service management, cybersecurity, and technology asset management.
* Experience working within a geographically distributed or global IT organization.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with senior business leaders and translate business requirements into technology priorities.
* Strong incident management, problem-solving, prioritization, and escalation-management capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business executives.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.
* Ability and willingness to collaborate regularly with U.S.-based colleagues across time zones.
* Ability to work on-site in the Hyderabad office five days per week.
* Ability and willingness to travel approximately 10–20% within India, including travel to the Noida office and other company locations.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting a large India delivery center, global capability center (GCC), professional-services organization, or similarly complex enterprise environment.
* Experience coordinating IT operations across India and North America.
* Experience with ITIL or other established IT service-management frameworks.
* Experience supporting Microsoft enterprise technologies, cloud services, collaboration platforms, and modern workplace environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise cybersecurity, risk management, compliance, and audit requirements.
* Experience with technology budgeting, vendor management, procurement, and lifecycle planning.
* ITIL, PMP, Microsoft, cloud, cybersecurity, or other relevant professional certifications.

**Leadership Competencies**
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Business Partnership: Builds credibility and trusted relationships with business leaders and understands how technology enables business objectives.
* Operational Excellence: Maintains high standards for reliability, responsiveness, accountability, and service delivery.
* Global Collaboration: Works effectively across cultures, geographies, organizational boundaries, and time zones.
* Leadership: Creates clarity, develops people, establishes accountability, and leads effectively through change.
* Communication: Communicates complex technology topics clearly and appropriately for the intended audience.
* Judgment: Makes thoughtful decisions while appropriately balancing business requirements, technology standards, risk, and urgency.
* Customer Focus: Approaches technology operations as a service to the business and continuously seeks to improve the employee experience.
* Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality, reduce operational risk, and increase efficiency.

**Work Environment & Travel**
This position is based in
**Hyderabad, India and requires daily on-site presence in the Hyderabad office**
. The role is not intended to be a remote or hybrid position.
  
  
Because the position works closely with U.S.-based technology teams and leadership, periodic meetings outside standard India business hours may be required to support effective global collaboration.
  
  
Approximately
**10–20% domestic travel within India**
is expected, including regular travel to the company's Noida office and occasional travel to other India locations as business needs require.

title: Manager, Operations Supply Planner
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The
***Manager, Operations Supply Planner***
supports the supply planning process for both external manufacturing and internal sites. This role ensures alignment with customer and market demand while maintaining operational efficiency. The execution planner will interact with internal and external supply sites, logistics, and other supply chain teams. Responsibilities include assisting in the development of supply strategies, helping to create and execute supply plans, and identifying and reporting any risks or constraints that may affect product availability.
  
  

* Supply Planning and Execution

+ Develop and manage supply plans for materials related to product portfolios
+ Support coordination with internal and external manufacturing sites to help balance customer service with operational efficiency.
+ Maintain accurate inventory levels, ensuring purchase orders are up to date for Drug Substance, Drug Product and Finished goods to meet demand

* Customer and Stakeholder Engagement

+ Build and maintain relationships with global and local supply chain teams and market stakeholders, collaborating to ensure continuity of supply and identify potential risks
+ Attend supply chain meetings to ensure alignment on customer requirements and consumption plans

* Demand & Supply Alignment

+ Use ERP systems (e.g., SAP) to manage demand propagation and supply requirements, ensuring the MRP planning process runs effectively
+ Monitor changes in demand, communicate with stakeholders to adjust production plans, and incorporate these changes into site production schedules

* Risk Management & Problem Solving

+ Monitor and assess inventory risks, including shortages, excess stock, and obsolescence
+ Assist to identify and resolve supply constraints, working closely with necessary stakeholders
+ Support inventory risks related to regulatory or artwork changes

* Metrics and Reporting

+ Track and report on key supply chain performance metrics such as backorders, inventory compliance, and PO accuracy
+ Provide input into inventory projections, budget processes, and root cause analysis for any supply issues
+ Contribute to monthly and quarterly stock overviews, identifying any inventory risks or supply disruptions

* Projects & Continuous Improvement

+ Participate in supply chain improvement projects and other initiatives to optimize supply chain processes
+ Support new product introductions, government tender supply programs, and clinical supply requests when required
+ Ensure that master data is accurately maintained and continuously updated in collaboration with relevant teams

* Digital Acumen, Analytics, and Learning

+ Leverages visualization and data contextualization tools including Excel and BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), integrated APS capabilities, and BMS platforms to monitor KPIs, perform root cause analysis, review best action analysis and provide data-driven decision support.
+ Contributes to process improvements through digitization and automation of planning workflows, supporting improved speed and accuracy.
+ Executes task-level work using available tools (e.g. WMS, SAP, Tableau, Riverlogic, Kinaxis), follows SOPs, fulfills orders, and maintains high level of performance across data and planning accuracy.
+ Demonstrates curiosity and adaptability in learning new digital tools and platforms (e.g., SAP, Kinaxis, forecasting systems), quickly integrating them into daily operations.
+ Strong Planning and financial acumen with understanding of ERP transaction codes, planning/operational software, physical and transactional flows, etc.
+ Familiarity with AI and ML systems features including performance & expectation management, optimization, etc.

**Required Competencies**
**Designee Role and Responsibilities**

* Min. 2 years of experience in supply chain management, preferably within global manufacturing or pharmaceutical environments.
* Knowledge of supply chain operations
* Expertise in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Rapid Response) and related data analysis tools is preferred
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Base understanding of regulatory requirements, particularly in the pharmaceutical industry (cGMP, FDA, EMA).
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively under tight deadlines.

**Required Qualifications And Desired Experience**

* B.S. or BA or BE in supply chain management, science and/or engineering (biotechnology, engineering or related sciences).
* APICS or related professional qualification preferred.

title: Shift Lead (Linux)
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a Shift Lead to run our 24/7 Operations team on a rotational basis. You will be the first point of command during your shift, owning monitoring, incident response, escalations, and handovers for Linux-based production systems. You will guide a team of operations engineers, keep services stable, and ensure incidents are resolved within SLA with clear communication to stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Shift Leadership**

* Lead and coordinate the shift team, assigning work and prioritising tickets, alerts, and incidents
* Run structured shift handovers, ensuring open incidents, risks, and pending changes are clearly documented
* Act as the escalation point for L1/L2 engineers and make timely decisions during live incidents
* Mentor and coach team members; support onboarding, training, and skills development

**Incident and Problem Management**

* Monitor dashboards and alerts, triage events, and drive incidents through detection, resolution, and closure
* Manage major incidents: coordinate bridge calls, assign roles, provide regular updates to stakeholders, and escalate to engineering or management as needed
* Contribute to post-incident reviews and root cause analysis, and track follow-up actions to completion

**Linux Operations**

* Perform first- and second-line troubleshooting on Linux servers (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux), covering CPU, memory, disk, network, and service issues
* Manage users, permissions, services (systemd), cron jobs, log analysis, and package updates
* Support patching, reboots, and routine maintenance using approved change procedures
* Write and maintain Bash scripts and runbooks to automate repetitive operational tasks

**Monitoring and Service Management**

* Work with monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog) to tune alerts and reduce noise
* Follow ITIL practices for incident, change, and problem management using a ticketing tool (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management)
* Track SLA/KPI performance and report on shift activity, trends, and improvement opportunities

**Process and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles
* Identify automation opportunities and work with engineering teams to reduce manual toil
* Ensure compliance with security, access, and change control policies

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 7+ years in IT operations, NOC, or infrastructure support, including experience in a 24/7 environment
* Prior experience as a shift lead, team lead, or senior operations engineer
* Strong hands-on Linux administration skills: command line, file systems, LVM, networking (DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls), SSH, systemd, and log analysis
* Solid troubleshooting skills with the ability to stay calm and decisive under pressure
* Experience handling major incidents and running bridge calls
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes (incident, problem, change management)
* Experience with monitoring and alerting tools and ticketing systems
* Scripting skills in Bash and/or Python
* Excellent verbal and written communication, including clear stakeholder updates and handover documentation
* Willingness to work rotational shifts, nights, weekends, and holidays

**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
  
  
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
  
  
**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply**

title: Talent & Learning Enablement Team Leader
description:

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Own, design, manage, document and take initiative to continually improve processes and operational practices across the team focused on simplification, quality and operational reliability, utilising technology and automation wherever possible.
