* Drive consistent execution of programme co-ordination and learning operations processes across the team, ensuring high standards and a strong global learner experience. Monitor operational compliance to standards (e.g. quality audits, ticket themes, catalogue accuracy, course set-up, training brochures, sharepoint/intranet pages, accurate reporting).
* Design and own a set of KPIs for the Enablement Team, providing regular stakeholder reports on team performance and operational excellence and drive corrective action as needed. Also provide regular data sets for the wider talent & learning team senior managers to manage key KPIs.
* Ensure ServiceNow tickets and learner queries are triaged appropriately and resolved consistently within defined service levels by the global shared service centre and by the learning enablement team, monitor trends and address recurring issues through process improvements and knowledge articles.
* Lead stakeholder alignment with the Talent & Learning Senior Managers to understand the business, learning needs and priorities and take decisions to align these expectations to the team priorities and performance.
* Own resource planning and workload management across the team, balancing BAU delivery and project work, making prioritisation trade-offs explicit and escalating risks early.
* Partner closely with the Talent & Learning Process & Technology Senior Manager and senior specialist to operationalise governance and technology changes, ensuring the Enablement team is trained, ready and compliant with agreed standards.
* Oversee development and maintenance of learning content created in the team, learning communications and enablement content ensuring meeting brand, inclusivity and accessibility expectations. Ensure the team have licences and are trained in quality content creation.
* Oversee and manage talent & learning information and resources for learners ensuring intranet pages, communication/marketing community channels and brochures are up to date, on brand and inclusive. Ensure the team are trained to use the respective platforms and channels.
* Encourage use of approved AI tools and other technologies to explore more efficient ways of working and improve learner experience.
* Personally manage the operations for selected talent & learning programmes and/or experiences end-to-end alongside the Talent & Learning Senior Manager/s including vendor co-ordination (logistics, planning, issue resolution), programme co-ordination (scheduling, enrolment, communications, delivery co-ordination) and programme follow-up (evaluation, reporting, communications).

**Learning projects (~30%)**

* Lead learning projects that improve global learning outcomes and operational scalability, such as compliance training campaigns and design of core learning programmes.
* Bring a fresh and modern approach to designing and delivering learning experiences for employees, being familiar with adult learning styles, human centred learning design and different tools to create self-paced learning.
* Partner with Talent & Learning stakeholders to translate learner and business needs into project plans, clear requirements, stakeholder alignment and measurable outcomes.
* Create and manage project workstreams including timelines, risks, dependencies, communications and delivery governance.
* Ensure projects are operationalised with new processes documented, support model in place to reflect the experience, communications and training completed in a timely manner.
* Track and evaluate project effectiveness, measure outcomes and drive iterative improvements.

**Important Working Relationships**
It is important that the Talent & Learning Enablement Team Manager is comfortable interacting with employees of all levels and positions throughout the company. As a global company, the incumbent requires sensitivity to other perspectives and cultures. The role supports global stakeholders and will require some flexibility to connect across time zones, including the US.
  
  
Close working relationships with the Talent & Learning Senior Managers and the Talent & Learning Process & Technology Senior Manager, is essential to provide a consistent and joined up experience to learning and that learning strategy, technology and governance is embedded into delivery.
  
  
**Key success measures (first 3 months):**

* Enablement playbook for all processes and governance (SOPs, templates, SLAs) establishing a weekly operations and monthly metrics review and quarterly process audit and stakeholder service reviews, all powered by consistent and accurate data
* Key stakeholder cadence established with a clear intake/prioritisation/feedback mechanism
* Team capability and resourcing analysis for the coming 12 months with clear responsibilities that meets stakeholder priorities
* Team upskilling plan for end to end operations delivery, removing single points of failure, setting clear performance expectations, leveraging the full potential of team members and onboarding new team members.

**Essential Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* Strong learning operations, process and programme management expertise in a global/matrixed environment. Likely to have minimum 6-10 years experience in this area.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including driving high performance, coaching, capability building, and hiring/onboarding. Likely to have 3+ years people management experience.
* Good knowledge of Workday Learning (or equivalent LMS) operational administration, system testing and learner experience—able to enforce consistent ways of working.
* Proven ability to design and embed scalable processes, governance adherence, and support models (including ticketing/ServiceNow operations).
* Experience of vendor management and procurement processes.
* Strong analytical skills: confident using data to manage operational performance, identify root causes, and prioritise improvements.
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal): clear, pragmatic, able to create straightforward guidance and drive adoption.
* Strong stakeholder management capability: able to translate needs into clear requirements, drive alignment, and deliver outcomes at pace.
* Strong experience in project management – end to end management of project activities from stakeholder engagement, project scoping & project planning, through to managing timely deliverables and project retrospectives.
* Experience in learning design and delivery, including design of impactful virtual learning experiences
* Experience in virtual facilitation
* Strong knowledge and skills in human centred learning design.
* Experience of using different learning content creation tools.

**Behaviours**

* Service excellence mindset with a strong focus on learner experience and operational reliability.
* Calm, structured problem solver; manages ambiguity and competing demands effectively.
* Continuous improvement orientation—simplifies and standardises while protecting quality.
* Collaborative and transparent; escalates early and communicates trade-offs and risks clearly.
* High integrity and discretion; handles sensitive data appropriately.
* Proactive leader who creates clarity, builds capability, and drives accountability.
* Proactive and shows initiative to bring about change and improvement

title: Head of Operations – D2C (Supply Chain, Fulfilment & Customer Experience)
description:
Location: Hyderabad (in-office)

Function: Operations

Reports to: Founders

Earthful is a clean-label, plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. We sell through our own website, Amazon and Flipkart, quick commerce, and B2B customers, and every order depends on an operation that works. This role owns that operation end to end: planning, contract manufacturing, warehouses and 3PLs, logistics, and customer support. It is a build job. Our SOPs are only partly written and our systems are still taking shape, so we need someone who has done this before at a D2C brand and wants to do it again here.

**Role Overview**

You will run Earthful's operations as one connected system, from the raw material that goes into a product to the reply a customer gets when she writes to us. You will lead the people and partners involved (procurement and contract manufacturing, 3PL warehouses, courier partners, and the customer support floor), put clear owners and written SOPs behind every critical process, and give the founders one reliable view of how operations is performing. You will report to the founders, work daily with Finance, Marketing, the E-commerce and D2C growth teams, and Regulatory & Compliance, and hire and develop the team under you.

**What You'll Own**

**Supply Chain Planning & Procurement**

• Run the weekly demand plan with Marketing and turn it into a rolling plan for raw and packing material, with lead times, MOQs, and risks built in

• Plan production against a 60-day inventory norm, and balance stock-outs against over-buying across all channels

• Shorten the PO-to-GRN cycle, and reduce the cash tied up in raw material, including moving raw material buying to manufacturers where it makes sense

**Contract Manufacturing & Vendors**

• Oversee production at our contract manufacturers: scheduling, batch readiness, finished-goods QC, and timely dispatch

• Identify, evaluate, and onboard new contract manufacturers and vendors, and negotiate cost reductions on the highest-COGS items

• Work with R&D, Quality, and Regulatory so every launch is production-ready on the date it is promised

**Warehousing & Inventory**

• Run our 3PL warehouses against written SLAs and a monthly scorecard: inbound receipt, pick-and-pack accuracy, dispatch time, inventory accuracy, and claims

• Keep inventory accurate through cycle counts, follow FEFO on every dispatch, and keep near-expiry stock visible and moving

• Own stock transfers between locations and the rules for allocating stock to each channel

**Logistics & Last Mile**

• Govern our courier partners on delivery time, RTO, failed-delivery handling, damage and loss, and cost per shipment, using ClickPost and partner dashboards

• Make sure D2C, marketplace, quick-commerce, and B2B orders each meet their own delivery promise: PO fill rate, on-time-in-full, and dispatch windows

• Raise repeating courier problems with evidence, and hold partners to the penalties in their contracts

**Customer Support Operations**

• Own the support operation: the floor, the shifts, the metrics (response time, resolution time, first-time resolution, CSAT, QA), and the quality of our AI chat agent

• Set the escalation protocol for sensitive cases such as product reactions, so Operations and R&D act the same shift

• Use support data to find and fix the operational causes of complaints: delays, wrong items, and damage

**SOPs, Systems & Control**

• Map every critical process, rank them by risk, and write, launch, and audit the SOPs, starting with the most important ten

• Run the operating rhythm: a daily huddle, a weekly ops review on a scorecard, and a monthly report to the founders

• Build one view of orders, inventory, service levels, and support, and choose and tighten the systems behind it (WMS or OMS, ClickPost, helpdesk)

**Cost to Serve & Working Capital**

• Know the true cost to serve each channel (warehouse, freight, packing, returns) and bring it down without hurting service

• Manage inventory value and days of cover, and report cost to serve to the founders every month

Team, Partners & Working With Other Functions

• Build and lead the operations team: hire managers where needed, give every direct report written KRAs, and name one owner for every area

• Hold quarterly reviews with each 3PL, courier, and contract manufacturer

• Agree clear service levels with Finance (dispatch documents and reconciliations), the E-commerce and D2C growth teams, Marketing, and Regulatory & Compliance

**What We're Looking For**

Required: all of these

• 8 to 14 years in operations or supply chain, including at least 3 years leading operations as head of function or senior manager at a D2C or e-commerce brand

• Brand-side background at a D2C, e-commerce, or high-growth consumer brand. Experience only at a 3PL, courier, consulting firm, or supply-chain software company is not a fit for this role

• Has led a team of 15 or more across more than one function, including managers, such as warehousing and fulfilment, logistics, procurement and planning, or customer support

• Has managed 3PL warehouses and courier partners with SLAs, scorecards, penalties, and cost-to-serve targets

• Has built SOPs and an operating rhythm in a business where processes were not yet documented, and audited adherence

• Has owned fulfilment and logistics cost against targets, such as cost per order, freight, RTO, or inventory days

• Has run multi-channel fulfilment: D2C plus at least one of marketplaces, quick commerce, or B2B

• Strong with numbers: has owned an operations dashboard and can tell a story from the data

• Based in Hyderabad, or willing to relocate and work in-office from Hyderabad

Strong plus

• Nutraceuticals, FMCG wellness, food, or personal care, with batch, expiry, FEFO, and FSSAI awareness

• Procurement and contract manufacturing experience

• Customer support operations experience, including an AI chat agent

• Hands-on with ClickPost, a WMS or OMS (such as Unicommerce or Vinculum), and a helpdesk

• Quick-commerce fulfilment (PO fill rate, on-shelf availability) and Amazon FBA or FBF operations

• An MBA or equivalent. This is a plus, not a requirement

This is not a role for someone whose experience is only at very large enterprises, or only at logistics providers. We are looking for a builder.

title: Packaging Supervisor
description:
**Company : Sain Medicaments Pvt Ltd, Uppal, Hyderabad.**

**Job Description: Packing Supervisor**

**Designation:**
Packing Supervisor

**Department:**
Production – Packing

**Experience:**
3 Years

**Industry:**
Pharmaceutical Formulations

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Job Summary**

**We are looking for a responsible and experienced Packing Supervisor to oversee day-to-day pharmaceutical packing operations. The candidate will be responsible for supervising packing line activities, manpower management, ensuring production targets, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring compliance with GMP and safety requirements during primary and secondary packaging operations.**

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Supervise and monitor daily packing activities in accordance with approved production plans and schedules.
* Handle primary and secondary packing operations for pharmaceutical formulations such as tablets, capsules, syrups, and other dosage forms.
* Ensure proper execution of packing activities as per approved Batch Packing Records (BPR).
* Coordinate and supervise packing line operations, including blister packing, strip packing, bottle filling, labelling, cartoning, and shipper packing, as applicable.
* Ensure line clearance before starting packing operations and after completion of each batch.
* Monitor packing machinery and equipment to ensure smooth and uninterrupted operations.
* Allocate manpower and manage shift-wise activities to achieve daily production targets.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of printed packaging materials, labels, cartons, foils, and other packing components.
* Verify product details, batch numbers, manufacturing dates, expiry dates, and other printed particulars during packing operations.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, SOPs, GDP, and safety procedures throughout packing activities.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance (QA) for line clearance, in-process checks, and quality-related approvals.
* Monitor in-process packing parameters and ensure rejection and wastage are maintained within permissible limits.
* Maintain proper documentation of packing activities, equipment usage, production output, and manpower records.
* Identify and report packing-related issues, machine breakdowns, and deviations to the concerned departments.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Maintenance teams for timely resolution of equipment-related problems.
* Ensure proper housekeeping, cleanliness, hygiene, and safety practices in the packing area.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and segregation of finished products and packaging materials.
* Train and guide packing operators and helpers on operational procedures, GMP, and safety requirements.
* Prepare shift-wise production reports and report daily packing performance to the Production Manager.
* Ensure timely completion of batch packing activities without compromising product quality.

title: Enterprise Apps People Technology Lead
description:
Enterprise Apps People Technology Lead

**About the Role**

We’re establishing a People Technology Support Operations capability in our newly created GCC to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable HR technology services. This leader will own the operational excellence of SAP SuccessFactors and adjacent HR platforms, building a high-performing team that provides L2/L3 support, release/change management, and continuous improvement across our employee lifecycle solutions. You’ll partner closely with People Operations, Talent Acquisition, IAM/Security, and Enterprise Systems to uphold SLAs, reduce friction in joiner/mover/leaver processes, and ensure audit-ready operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Leadership & Team Building**

- Build, mentor, and lead a GCC-based support operations team; establish coverage model, runbooks, and a follow-the-sun support cadence aligned to global stakeholders.

- Define and track operational SLAs/KPIs (incident MTTR, change success rate, release quality, data accuracy) and drive continual service improvement.

- Foster a culture of ownership, documentation discipline, and proactive risk management.

**Platform Operations (SAP SuccessFactors)**

- Serve as the operational owner for SAP SuccessFactors, overseeing implementation, configuration, deployment, and steady-state support for relevant modules.

- Manage environment strategy (prod/non-prod), transport governance, regression testing, release calendaring, and change approvals (CAB).

- Partner with HR and Payroll to assess requirements, translate to configurations, and maintain technical/functional documentation.

**HR Tech Ecosystem & Integrations**

- Maintain robust integrations across our stack (e.g., Dayforce Payroll, Workforce Software, SailPoint, Active Directory/Entra, SAP S/4HANA, Concur, and Data Engineering), ensuring reliable data flows and access provisioning aligned to JML policies.

- Partner with IAM/Security on SSO, role modeling, SoD controls, audit logs, and remediation playbooks.

**Service Management, Risk & Compliance**

- Own incident, problem, and change processes (ITIL), including major incident response and root-cause analysis for respective platforms.

- Ensure audit readiness (privacy, access governance, evidence repositories) and support internal/external audits with traceable configuration and test artifacts.

- Drive knowledge management: FAQs, SOPs, self-service guides, and knowledge base articles for People Operations and HR support.

- Responsible for overall delivery of the Enterprise Applications portfolio consisting of Success Factors , HR Platforms and Atlassian tools.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

- 7+ years in HR technology and team leadership, with demonstrated experience running support operations for SAP SuccessFactors (implementation, configuration, deployment, and production support).

- Hands-on experience supporting and integrating HR platforms such as Greenhouse, Beeline, and SmartRecruiters.

- Strong understanding of HR data models and employee lifecycle (joiner/mover/leaver), including integration patterns and error handling across payroll, time, identity, and finance systems.

- Proven track record driving ITIL processes (incident, problem, change), SLAs/KPIs, and continuous improvement in a global support model.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and vendor coordination skills; ability to lead cross-functional triage and CABs.

**Preferred**

- Experience establishing operations in a GCC environment (team setup, documentation standards, knowledge transfer, and governance playbooks).

- Exposure to security & compliance frameworks (SoD, access certification), audit support, and evidence management in HRIS landscapes.

- Familiarity with enterprise integration tooling and delivery methods referenced in our stack (e.g., Workato, Cloud Foundry/SFTP).

**Core Competencies**

- Operational Excellence: Data accuracy, reliability, and disciplined change control.

- Systems Thinking: End-to-end process view spanning HR, IAM, Payroll, Finance.

- People Leadership: Coaching, performance management, and building high-trust teams.

- Customer Orientation: Empathy for HR partners and employees; bias toward frictionless experiences.

- Problem Solving: Root-cause analysis, preventative controls, and measurable improvements.

title: Customer Support Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**

**Important Note for Applicants:**

As part of our application process, you will receive an assessment immediately upon applying. This assessment is designed to take approximately 30 minutes and must be completed on a laptop. Please ensure you have a stable internet connection and a quiet environment to complete the test. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to your application!

**Applications without assessment wouldn't be considered.**

**----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------**

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.

**Job Description**

The Customer Support Team Lead is a strong leader with a mindset that allows them to build strong teams and processes that put our customers first, while providing continuous feedback from customers to various product teams.

The Customer Support Team Lead will provide leadership to the Customer Support Team. Establish and maintain Quality Compliance and other processes required for an exceptional level of customer support. Customer Support Team is the primary point of contact for the Wise customers and forms a large part of the company’s profile. As such, all enquiries to Customer Support need to be acted upon with efficiency and professionalism.

It is the Customer Support Team Lead’s primary responsibility to ensure that expectations are clearly set and that members of the Customer Support team are highly engaged, motivated, armed with all necessary equipment and software, have opportunities to contribute to tactics and strategy, and opportunities to learn and grow.

**The Customer Support Team Lead will ensure that customer service is maintained by:**

* Liaising with the relevant departments to ensure that customer objectives are being met
* Ensuring a high level of product knowledge within Customer Support team members as evidenced through turnaround time of issues and ability of Customer Support to resolve issues independently
* Ensuring a high level of customer focus (internally and externally) with due care and attention to customer priority issues and appropriate levels of customer communications
* Ensuring that regular audits of communications are performed and that appropriate training is provided to personnel in this area
* Assigning and monitoring the customer support tickets and implementing action plans and escalation procedures to address problematic areas
* Developing and maintaining customer satisfaction measurement metrics
* Defining and implementing the procedures and policies to ensure that high-quality service is delivered to customers (both internal and external) and adherence to strict SLA’s
* Seeking feedback and following up information from customers

**Also, communicating the customers’ perception of value and quality to the business and identifying:**

* Any bugs in the product that result in issues for the customer
* Any improvements that could be made to the product itself – its features or functionality – to bring it more in line with what the customer defines as quality or value
* Any improvements to the product’s inbuilt support functionality that could reduce customer frustration / the need to make a support call
* Participate directly in the product design process, to identify gaps between customer expectations and product design as early as possible
* The Customer Support Team Lead is primarily responsible for the implementation and maintenance of a Customer Support Team within the Wise.
* The Customer Support Team Lead will be the customer advocate, ensuring that all customer support requests (be they internal or external) are followed up in a timely fashion, while performing Quality Assurance and Quality Control on customer service requests ongoing.
* We are looking for a human-centric leader who is not just managing metrics, but is a proactive champion for their people and customers, navigating complex issues with emotional intelligence and data-driven insight.

**Qualifications**

Your Experience & Hard Skills:

* Leadership Mastery: You bring 2+ years of people leadership experience, preferably within a high-volume, high-growth, and complex servicing environment like FinTech, Tech, or SaaS.
* Data & Communication Expertise: You seamlessly analyze operational dashboards to make data-driven decisions, coupled with exceptional presentation skills to effectively share insights and generate stakeholder buy-in.

Your Soft Skills & Mindset:

* Human-Centric Retention Mindset: You are deeply committed to retaining both high-value customers and your people, prioritizing work-life balance and engagement to build a resilient, high-performing team.
* Extreme Ownership: You take immense pride in accountability, empowering your specialists to deliver exemplary outcomes while proactively navigating and resolving systemic obstacles.
* Coach & Change Leader: You thrive on guiding others through change, using active listening and empathy to mentor critical thinking, overcome resistance, and foster a culture of adaptability.

**Additional information**

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

Wise.Jobs
.

and

title: Digital Technology Delivery and Performance Lead
description:
About the Job

At Opella, we have one shared mission – we work passionately, every day, to ‘serve healthier, fuller lives’ now and for the generations to come.

In order to do so, we strive to act as a force for good by integrating sustainability along our business and employees’ mission and operate responsibly from both a social and environmental point of view.

Everything we do is centered around people’s interests – our consumers, our customers, healthcare professionals, and our employees – across the world.

We are building loved brands that serve 1bn consumers worldwide, through our key platforms: Allergy, Physical & Mental Wellness, Pain, Digestive Wellness and Cough, Cold & Flu.

We aspire to become the best Fast Moving Consumer Health (FMCH) company in & for the world and we aim to build a work environment where people can thrive, grow, enjoy and be at their best.

**Our team**
designs, delivers, and governs Digital Technology services and capabilities for Opella worldwide.

We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations).

Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world.

Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e.g. DevOps & related framework), FinOps, Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, SAP, Salesforce, RPA, …), Digital Workplace and Cloud Infrastructure.

**Delivery & Performance**
provides the management system that connects strategy, portfolio execution, financial performance, governance, and operational improvement across Technology & Architecture. The team works across domains to create transparency, strengthen accountability, and enable faster, better-informed decisions.

Are you passionate about turning strategy into brilliant execution, improving financial visibility, and simplifying how technology is governed and delivered? Join us as Delivery & Performance Lead within the Technology & Architecture organization and help strengthen portfolio execution, operational performance, and leadership decision-making across Opella.

Delivery & Performance Lead

Job Summary

The Delivery & Performance Lead drives disciplined execution, financial performance, governance, and operational excellence across Opella’s Technology & Architecture organization. The role provides an integrated view of delivery progress, portfolio health, budgets, risks, dependencies, and outcomes, enabling leaders to make timely, evidence-based decisions.

Working across technology domains and in close partnership with Finance, Procurement, project managers, and business stakeholders, the role strengthens ways of working, improves transparency and accountability, and supports simplification of the technology portfolio and landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Delivery & Performance

* Drive execution discipline and delivery performance across the Technology & Architecture portfolio.
* Maintain clear visibility of progress, milestones, outcomes, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Challenge delivery plans constructively, facilitate issue resolution, and support recovery actions where performance is off track.
* Promote outcome-based planning and consistent portfolio delivery practices.

Financial & Budget Management

* Oversee budget tracking, forecasting, purchase order management, and financial performance across Business as Usual and Separation Costs.
* Reconcile actuals, commitments, forecasts, and variances in partnership with Finance, Procurement, and budget owners.
* Improve financial transparency, cost control, and decision-making through reliable data and timely insight.
* Identify financial risks and opportunities and coordinate corrective actions with accountable owners.

Governance & Ways of Working

* Strengthen delivery governance, standards, reporting rhythms, decision forums, and operating models.
* Clarify accountabilities, decision rights, escalation paths, and performance expectations.
* Standardize practical ways of working that improve consistency, speed, and execution efficiency without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Drive continuous improvement based on delivery data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned.

Portfolio & Digital Landscape Simplification

* Create an integrated view of initiatives, demand, capacity, investment, and strategic alignment.
* Support portfolio prioritization and sequencing, balancing business value, cost, risk, dependencies, and delivery capacity.
* Contribute to technology landscape simplification by identifying overlaps, rationalization opportunities, and complexity reduction actions.
* Ensure initiatives remain aligned with Technology & Architecture priorities and Opella’s strategic objectives.

Performance Reporting & Executive Insights

* Define and maintain meaningful KPIs covering delivery, financial health, risk, capacity, quality, and outcomes.
* Develop dashboards and management reporting that provide a trusted, concise view of portfolio performance.
* Translate delivery and financial data into actionable insights, options, and recommendations for leadership.
* Improve data quality and reporting automation to reduce manual effort and accelerate decision-making.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Digital Enablement

* Partner with Technology & Architecture leaders, project and portfolio managers, Finance, Procurement, and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across functions, surface trade-offs, and ensure actions and decisions are followed through.
* Act as a trusted partner to leadership, combining constructive challenge with pragmatic execution support.
* Where relevant, use AI-powered tools and digital solutions to improve productivity, streamline reporting, and simplify ways of working.
* Facilitate animation of team routines and coach our Teams to work in Agile ways of working and according to the Project Management methodology defined by our Digital group.

Core Skills & Expertise

* Technology delivery and performance management.
* Project and portfolio management.
* Budget management, forecasting, purchase order management, and cost control.
* Technology governance, operating models, and decision frameworks.
* KPI development, analytics, and executive reporting.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership.
* Process optimization and continuous improvement.
* Digital transformation and AI enablement.

Required Qualifications

* Significant experience in technology delivery, portfolio performance, PMO, finance, operations, or a comparable role in a complex international organization.
* Proven ability to manage budgets and forecasts, interpret financial data, and drive cost accountability.
* Strong understanding of project and portfolio governance, delivery methodologies, and technology operating models.
* Excellent analytical, communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in ambiguity.
* Pragmatic, structured, detail-oriented, and able to connect strategic priorities with operational execution.
* Fluent English required; additional languages are an advantage.

Tools & Digital Capabilities

* **Project & Portfolio Management**
  : Jira.
* **Collaboration & Knowledge Management:**
  Confluence, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint.
* **Reporting & Analytics:**
  Power BI, Microsoft Excel.
* **AI & Productivity:**
  Microsoft Copilot and generative AI tools like Vibe Coding.
* **Financial & Procurement Processes:**
  budget tracking, forecasting, and SAP.

Success Indicators

* Leadership has a reliable, timely, and actionable view of delivery and financial performance.
* Portfolio milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and accountabilities are transparent and actively managed.
* Budget forecasts are accurate, variances are understood, and financial actions are completed on time.
* Governance and reporting are simpler, more consistent, and focused on decisions and outcomes.
* Prioritization and landscape simplification decisions are supported by clear data and strategic alignment.

Stakeholders recognize the function as a trusted partner that improves execution, accountability, and operational efficiency.

title: Senior Manager, Network Supply Planner
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Lead the development & agreement of a feasible Supply Plan for Finished goods (FG), Drug Product (DP) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) in the tactical planning horizon (typically 3 years), in close alignment with execution planning and the internal/external manufacturing network.
  
  

* Tactical implementation of Brand Supply Chain strategies and planning assumptions within the supply planning process, ensuring seamless supply for patients.
* Responsible for developing what-if supply scenarios and develop recommendations in response to actual or anticipated changes in demand or supply.
* Ownership of the product structure process to ensure demand propagation through the E2E network in BMS planning and execution systems Rapid Response / SAP.
* Global scope with key interface to Pod Leads, execution planners, External Manufacturing, and other SC partners across GPS (Global Product Supply).

* Drive the monthly FG/ DP / API network planning process for assigned brands, aligned with agreed metrics including

+ Inventory Months of Cover, plan Vs budget & previous plan. Manage and communicate deviations.

* Review global analytics of assigned portfolio, including product trends, demand evolution, inventory projections (Heatmaps), supply performance and risks.
* Understand site capacities, capabilities, and supply risks. Issue and bottleneck coordination as appropriate.
* Work closely with BMS sites and External Manufacturing group, to ensure alignment of site manufacturing plans and CMO forecasts according to contract.
* Strong accountability to lead cross functional sub teams to align plans, scenarios, and drive solutions for specified business deliverables / events / situations. Proactively identify risks and opportunities.
* Provide input to the Global Supply Review process to incorporate major supply risks. Drive escalation of risks and manage active communication and action focus.
* Develop and maintain consistent planning information via the product structure template, aligned with Brand and sourcing strategy. Drive the change process and flavor management as required.
* Supply planning MasterData governance and systems management to ensure an accurate demand propagation and supply plan.
* Collaborate with other global partners including

+ Long Range Planning, Business Continuity Management, Product Strategy, Quality Management, Network Strategy & Business Operations.

* Actively participate and support New Product introduction to ensure that supply network plans are optimally aligned and that supply plans are executed in support of the established timelines.
* Identify continuous improvement approach for supply planning tools and planning process; Support systems planning enhancements and capability projects (SAP / Kinaxis Rapid Response).
* Digital Acumen, Analytics, and Learning

+ Leverages visualization and data contextualization tools including BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), integrated APS capabilities, and BMS platforms to monitor KPIs, perform root cause analysis, review best action analysis and provide data-driven decision support.
+ Contributes to process improvements through digitization and automation of planning workflows, supporting improved speed and accuracy.
+ Executes task-level work using available tools (e.g. WMS, SAP, Tableau, Riverlogic, Kinaxis), follows SOPs, fulfills orders, and maintains high level of performance across data and planning accuracy.
+ Demonstrates curiosity and adaptability in learning new digital tools and platforms (e.g., SAP, Kinaxis, forecasting systems), quickly integrating them into daily operations.
+ Strong Planning and financial acumen with understanding of ERP transaction codes, planning/operational software, physical and transactional flows, etc.
+ Familiarity with AI and ML systems features including performance & expectation management, optimization, etc.
+ Actively upskills on emerging digital technologies and analytics techniques, showing agility in adopting tools and machine learning in planning use cases.

**Designee Role And Responsibilities**
The Senior Manager, Network Supply Planning may act as a delegate for the Associate Director, Network Supply Planning. This position may also be a designee for their peers.
  
  
**Required Competencies**

* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and rapid decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated capability in implementing challenging goals, objectives and practices in a complex and ambiguous environment.
* Strong ability in negotiating and influencing without authority in complex, high impact situations.
* Demonstrated proficiency in a rapidly changing cross-cultural environment.
* Strong presentation and communication skills both, oral and written.
* Business Acumen

+ Has a strong understanding of the key business drivers of the industry / organization. Persuades others with fact-based judgments of the business situation.

* Executing for Results

+ Maintains high standards of performance for himself / herself and others and follows through on commitments.
+ Demonstrates integrity and sticks to core values and principles. Takes the long view, and when faced with challenging obstacles, persists over a significant period of time to achieve his / her agenda. Conveys a sense of urgency and drives issues to closure. Makes timely decisions when a quick response is required and a number of possible alternatives are available.

* Building Relationships and Using Influence

+ Establishes credibility and earns respect with a diverse set of internal and external stakeholders including senior executives, manufacturing and other functional leaders, regulatory professionals, contractors and other partners. Is highly articulate and makes arguments in a clear and compelling manner. Can “get things done” without compromising principles. Has excellent negotiating skills and achieves win-win outcomes in difficult situations.

**Required Qualifications And Desired Experience**
Education
  
  

* Undergraduate Degree preferably in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or Life Sciences. advanced degree, diploma or certification in Supply Chain Management (e.g., APICS CIPM / CSCP certification) strongly preferred.

Experience / Knowledge Desired
  
  

* 5 to 7 years of Supply Chain experience for a reputed, global or multi-plant Pharmaceutical or Consumer Product company.
* Experience with ERP and Advanced Planning Systems (preferably SAP ECC and Kinaxis Rapid Response preferred).
* Experience with site capacity planning and / or global product supply planning and knowledge of Biotech, Pharmaceutical Sales & Operations Planning processes.
* Experience in developing and implementing world class, global supply chain planning processes and managing them through deployment of global advanced planning and scheduling systems.
* Good understanding and exposure to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and other regulatory requirements (EMA, TGA).
* Experience in working internationally in a fast-paced, reputed, global pharmaceutical / Bio-Technology or Consumer company organized in a matrix structure.

title: Senior Consultant / Manager - S&BT (Technology Transformation)
description:
The Technology Transformation practice is one of the key practice areas within the Strategy & Business Transformation Practice and works with the technology leaders in the organization (CIO, CDO, CTO) to drive business and technology transformation. We partner with technology organizations to address gaps through business and technology capability roadmaps, technology governance, change management, technology sourcing, operating model strategies and business engagement. We recognize that true technology transformation comes through changes in culture and ways of interacting with business partners.

This is an exciting opportunity for an enterprising individual to build and grow a team of strategy and operations management consultants based in India to support the Technology Transformation practice on client engagements globally. The Manager will work in close collaboration with the Hackett consulting team in the US and support delivery of client engagements. The Manager will also have the responsibility to oversee and guide a local team of Consultants and Senior Consultants in their day-to-day activities.

**Consulting Managers will typically be involved in the following activities:**

* Scoping and planning client engagements
* Managing teams to complete client work in accordance with established budget, workplans, and quality standards
* Identifying and resolving issues critical to the clients' strategic and operational success
* Providing technical/functional content
* Developing and presenting conclusions and recommendations to senior client management
* Providing solution implementation assistance as required
* Developing leading industry insight to present to clients
* Managing client relationships and reporting project progress
* Leading, coaching, developing, and supervising the efforts of junior staff

**Managers/Senior Consultant in the Technology Transformation Practice will demonstrate capabilities in the following areas:**

* IT Operating Model
* Digital Transformation
* Application Strategy & Deployment
* IT Outsourcing Advisory
* IT Benchmarking/Process Improvement
* IT Strategy & IT Governance Frameworks
* Organizational Change Management
* Business Relationship Management
* IT Cost Reduction
* Digital Literacy
* Agile IT Operations

**Managers will typically have:**

* 7+ years of related strategy or transformation (
  not
  system integration) consulting (i.e., working closely with clients on assessments, analysis, problem framing, problem solving, solution identification, initiative prioritization, roadmap development, and transformation implementation) or industry experience in IT Leadership roles showing progression/promotion
* Outstanding analytical capability
* Demonstrated experience with strategy and operations within one or more targeted industries
* The ability to effectively operate independently and in a team environment as well as manage people and project workplans
* Outstanding verbal, written communication, and client facing skills (e.g., interviews, workshops, executive read-outs)
* An MBA or other relevant advanced degrees in Business, Engineering or Sciences from a top educational institution

**Other Preferences:**

* Candidates based in Hyderabad are preferred
* Strong preference for candidates willing to start their days in the afternoon and work into the late evening hours (India Standard Time) to have 3-5 hours of overlap with the US team

title: Director, Program Data Lead
description:
**Summary**
The Director Program Lead provides portfolio level leadership and accountability for Clinical Data Strategy execution across a portfolio of programs, ensuring coherent prioritization, risk resolution, and predictable delivery outcomes aligned with DU direction. This role serves as the single CDO escalation and coordination point at program level, represents CDO on Global Clinical Team (GCT), interfaces with GCO sub teams, with direct operational accountability and people leadership for Study Data Leads. Should be able to perform assigned tasks in an independent capacity, needing minimal to no supervision and support. Should be able to provide mentoring and support to the Program Leads (Associate Director (AD), Snr AD). Perform peer/senior review of some of the critical deliverables, as per allocation by Study Data Leads. Act as delegated authority to CDO DU Leads.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Job Description**
**Major Accountabilities**

* Lead end-to-end clinical data strategy execution across programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives, DU priorities, and enterprise standards.
* Drive consistency and quality across trials through standardized data collection, review, cleaning, and delivery approaches.
* Own portfolio-level prioritization, coordination, dependency management, and integration of data strategies across multiple programs.
* Provide people leadership, coaching, mentoring, and performance oversight for Program Leads while developing organizational capability.
* Serve as the primary escalation and decision-making authority for program-level data, delivery, quality, and stakeholder issues
* Represent Clinical Data Operations (CDO) in Global Clinical Teams (GCTs) and GCO governance forums, delivering unified program-level data strategy direction.
* Embed data strategy, vendor strategy, and operational delivery considerations into program execution plans and Operational Delivery Strategies (ODS).
* Ensure proactive risk management, issue resolution, Quality by Design implementation, and adherence to lean data principles across the portfolio.
* Collaborate with standards, vendor, and delivery teams to drive scalable, fit-for-purpose solutions and continuous improvement of data strategy practices.
* Enhance program predictability, stakeholder experience, and operational excellence while contributing to DU-level capability, resource, and operating model decisions.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 15+ years of Clinical Data Management experience with demonstrated expertise across both study-level and program-level oversight.
* Proven ability to lead multiple clinical trials and complex programs concurrently, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely delivery.
* Strong operational leader with sound decision-making capabilities and deep knowledge of clinical data standards, regulatory requirements, and trial governance.
* Experienced in managing complexity across portfolios, driving alignment and execution across diverse studies, stakeholders, and geographies.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively in a global matrix environment.
* Established people leader and coach, with a track record of building high-performing teams, developing talent, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Why Novartis:**
Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture
  
  
**Benefits and Rewards:**
Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.

title: Customer Support Manager
description:
**A MULTI-BRAND D2C CONSUMER PRODUCTS COMPANY**

**Job Description**

**Customer Experience | Full-Time | India (on-site) | US Customers**

**Customer Scope:**
You will own customer support across our full portfolio of consumer brands. Our customers are based in the United States, and most of our support volume arrives outside India business hours.

**Location**
: Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad

**Employment Type**
: Full-Time

**Work Hours**
: 6 Days WFO

**Shift Timings**
: 10:00AM - 7:00PM

**Notice Period: 15- 30 Days (Maximum)**

We are hiring a Customer Support Manager to own the entire customer experience after the sale. You will lead our day and night support team, set the standard for how we talk to customers, and make sure every email, direct message, chat, and review gets a fast, accurate, and human response. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will coach your team, step into escalations yourself, and use what customers tell us to help the rest of the business get better. For a subscription-heavy

business like ours, great support protects revenue directly, through saved subscriptions, fewer chargebacks, and happy repeat customers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Lead and develop the support team across day and night shifts, including scheduling, coverage, performance reviews, and coaching.

• Own support across every channel, including email, social media direct messages, live chat, marketplace messages, and product reviews.

• Set and track service standards, including first response time, resolution time, backlog, customer satisfaction, and quality scores, and report on them regularly.

• Manage subscription support end to end, including cancellations, updates, pauses, and save offers, with the aim of retaining customers wherever it is the right outcome for them.

• Own refunds, replacements, and returns, and make sure they follow our policies consistently while still treating customers fairly.

• Manage chargebacks and payment disputes, including responding with strong evidence and spotting patterns that cause them.

• Own reputation management, including responding to reviews on platforms such as Trustpilot and TikTok, and resolving negative or hidden reviews quickly.

• Handle escalations personally when needed, and drive upset customers and difficult cases through to a resolution.

• Run quality assurance by auditing a sample of tickets, giving structured feedback, and holding the team to a clear quality bar.

• Build and maintain the support playbook, including macros, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures, and keep them current as products and policies change.

• Recruit, onboard, and train new team members, and plan ahead for attrition and peak periods.

• Turn customer feedback into insight for the growth, product, and operations teams, so recurring issues get fixed at the source.

• Work with our technology team to automate repetitive tasks and improve our helpdesk, storefront, and subscription tools.

• Produce clear daily and weekly reporting on volumes, performance, and open issues.

**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

• At least five years of experience in customer support, including at least two years leading a support team.

• Experience in a direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, or subscription business, supporting customers in the United States.

• Hands-on experience with a helpdesk platform such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, or Gorgias, including reporting, automations, and macros.

• A track record of running support to clear service level targets, using metrics such as response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.

• Experience managing refunds, replacements, and chargebacks, and working within defined policies.

• Excellent written and verbal English, and the judgment to coach others on tone and communication.

• A calm, solution-focused approach to difficult customers and high-pressure escalations.

• Comfort managing a team across day and night shifts.

• A bachelor's degree is preferred but not required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

• Experience with subscription businesses, including cancellation handling and retention or save flows.

• Experience with Shopify and subscription management tools.

• Experience in health, wellness, pet, or other consumer categories where product questions are common.

• Experience managing support for marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, or TikTok Shop.

• Experience building a support team or function from the ground up.

Where We Expect to Find This Person strong candidates are likely to come from one of the following backgrounds.

• A support team lead or manager at a direct-to-consumer or e-commerce company serving US customers.

• A manager at an outsourced customer experience provider who has run teams supporting US consumer brands.

• A senior support specialist ready to step up into people leadership, with a strong record of quality and escalation handling.

**Key Competencies:**

• You are customer-obsessed, and you care as much about how a customer feels at the end of a conversation as whether the ticket is closed.

• You are a strong coach, and you can raise a team's quality through clear, kind, and consistent feedback.

• You are calm under pressure, and you treat an escalation as a problem to solve rather than a fire to avoid.

• You are data-driven, and you use ticket trends and metrics to find root causes instead of only closing tickets.

• You are organized and reliable, and you keep coverage steady across shifts without things slipping through the cracks.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

• Pay is based on experience, in line with market standards.

Success Metrics for the First Three to Six Months

• First response and resolution times consistently meet target across all channels, including night coverage.

• Customer satisfaction and quality audit scores trend upward.

• Backlog stays low, and no ticket sits unanswered beyond the agreed limit.

• Chargeback rates and avoidable refunds decrease.

• A documented support playbook, quality review process, and reporting rhythm are in place.

• The team is fully staffed and trained, with a clear plan for covering absences and growth.

title: Integration Release Manager
description:
Position Title: Integration Release Manager
  
  
**Location : Hyderabad**
**About Opella**
**Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) and Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.**
Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be, serving half a billion consumers worldwide and counting.
  
  
At the core of this mission are our loved brands, global teams, manufacturing sites, and specialized science and innovation centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the maker of brands including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale, and Mucosolvan.
  
  
**As a globally certified B Corp company,**
we are active players in the journey toward healthier people and planet.
  
  
**About The Job**
Join Opella’s Integration Platform team as Release Manager and take full accountability for release management across the global integration landscape. The role owns the end-to-end release lifecycle for integration changes, from planning and readiness through CAB decision-making, deployment coordination, post-release validation, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This is a dedicated operational leadership role designed to provide focus, consistency, and accountability. The Release Manager acts as the central point of coordination across Integration, application teams, Quality, Security, Operations, projects, and external partners to ensure releases are safe, predictable, compliant, and business-aligned.
  
  
Main responsibilities
  
  

* Own, define, and continuously improve the end-to-end release management process for all Integration Platform changes and deployments.
* Prepare, maintain, and communicate the integrated release calendar, aligning deployment windows, release trains, business priorities, dependencies, constraints, and support coverage.
* Lead release planning and readiness reviews, confirming that build, testing, documentation, approvals, operational handover, monitoring, rollback, and validation requirements are complete.
* Coordinate CAB preparation and participation, including change assessment, impact analysis, risk evaluation, stakeholder alignment, decision logging, and escalation of unresolved concerns.
* Facilitate go/no-go decisions and hold clear authority to recommend postponement or rejection when release quality, compliance, or operational readiness is insufficient.
* Oversee the creation, quality review, approval, and execution of release and cutover plans, including sequencing, dependency management, rollback strategies, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate production deployments across integration middleware, and supporting tooling.
* Ensure adherence to Opella governance, security, quality, data privacy, and applicable regulatory requirements, including GxP and SoX controls where relevant.
* Coordinate post-release validation, monitor stabilization, ensure defects and issues are correctly tracked, and lead post-implementation reviews for significant or unsuccessful releases.
* Maintain release dashboards, KPIs, decision records, audit evidence, and stakeholder reporting to provide transparent visibility of release status, risk, performance, and upcoming demand.
* Analyze release performance and release-related incidents to improve success rate, schedule predictability, deployment reliability, automation, cycle time, and stakeholder experience.
* Drive adoption of standardized release templates, checklists, controls, communication practices, and automation across all integration teams, markets, and technology platforms.
* Maintain close collaboration with product owners, architects, project managers, developers, testers, platform teams, application teams, service management, and operational support.
* Own and evolve release-related artifacts in ServiceNow and the integration catalog, ensuring traceability between changes, interfaces, technical assets, approvals, and production outcomes.

**About You**
Technical background required
  
  

* 10+ years of experience as part of a release management ecosystem, with demonstrated 3+ years on end-to-end ownership of complex enterprise releases.
* Proven experience leading release governance, CAB coordination, change assessment, release readiness, go/no-go decisions, deployment control, and post-release reviews.
* Strong practical knowledge of ITIL Change Enablement and Release Management, software development lifecycle practices, DevOps, CI/CD, and deployment automation.
* Experience coordinating concurrent releases across global, cross-functional teams in complex cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments.
* Good understanding of enterprise integration technologies, API lifecycle, messaging and event-driven patterns, middleware, managed file transfer, data integration, and interface operations.
* Familiarity with technologies such as SAP Integration Suite, API gateways, iPaaS, Azure, observability platforms, Git-based delivery, Infrastructure as Code, and ServiceNow.
* Good understanding of application, infrastructure, network, security, and operational dependencies relevant to production integration deployments.
* Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments is strongly preferred, particularly with GxP, SoX, information security, auditability, and data privacy controls.
* Experience with SAP and ERP integration landscapes is an advantage.
* ITIL v4 certification is preferred. Additional certifications in project management, Agile, DevOps, or change management are an advantage.

**Soft Skills Required**

* Exceptional organization and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple releases, dependencies, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong judgment and decision-making under pressure, with the confidence to challenge readiness and escalate risk when required.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical release details into clear business impacts and executive updates.
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to disciplined execution.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and build trust in a global matrix organization.
* Calm, structured, and solution-oriented approach during high-pressure deployment windows and production issues.
* Proactive continuous-improvement mindset, with a strong orientation toward automation, simplification, quality, and measurable outcomes.

Why us?
  
  
At Opella, you will enjoy challenging, purposeful work and be empowered to improve how critical technology changes reach production. This role offers the opportunity to establish a consistent global release discipline for Integration Platforms and to directly influence delivery speed, operational resilience, compliance, and business continuity.
  
  
We Are Challengers.
  
  

* All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other’s backs.
* Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
* Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
* Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.

**Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.**
**www.opella.com/en/careers**

title: GB/G Manager- Financial Reporting
description:

We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress.
  
  
Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background. At BASF, careers develop from opportunities.

BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in
  
  
**About The Role**

* Effectively manage, supervise and support the Financial Reporting team members to deliver services to BASF group companies. Ensuring that services are delivered in accordance with established processes and work procedures and in compliance with BASF policies, Internal Controls requirements and local company legal and statutory requirements.
* Ensure that service timelines and service quality are met in the delivery of Financial Reporting services.
* Coach and develop the Financial Reporting team members to meet defined service standards through structured training and on the job coaching.
* Backup, assist with and perform Financial Reporting tasks.

**What's In It For You**

* Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways
* Access to BASF's world-class learning & development programs
* Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture
* Hybrid work model (mix of on-site and remote)

**Key Responsibilities**
**Functional Tasks (including but not limited to):**

* Manage and review the booking of accounting transactions, master data maintenance, fixed assets and project accounting transactions, calculations, workings and account analysis as performed by the Financial Reporting team members.
* Manage and monitor to ensure month end close steps are executed in accordance with work instructions and month end close checklist

This would include reports for group reporting, internal management reporting, statutory reporting as well as any agreed ad hoc reports required e.g. audit schedules, tax schedules etc

* Coaching and perform trouble shooting to resolve issues related to Financial Reporting processes.
* Coach and support a team to meet the Financial Reporting services requirements.
* Provide guidance and training to Financial Reporting team members to improve their ability on the job.
* Liaise with relevant stakeholders on Financial Reporting work issues and queries.
* Assume hands on / backup role when needed, to meet service delivery needs
* Drive team motivation and morale.
* Act as counsel to Financial Reporting team members as and when needed.
* Act as a backup for Head of Financial Reporting on ad-hoc task as and when required.
* Perform other duties as and when delegated, including job rotation to other functional teams

**Compliance:**

* Enforcing compliance with BASF policies, local company legal and statutory requirements Internal.
* Manage and participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries
* Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control and ISO requirements.

**Others**

* Drive the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives, Internal Control Requirements, Six Sigma, Balance Scorecard and any other ad hoc project roll outs etc.
* Be a “Key User” within the team, providing expert knowledge and support to colleagues and hands on support when required.
* Support the implementation of Business Continuity Plan (BCP) through resource planning, backup and communication.
* Coordination, monitoring and compilation of Key Performance Indexes (KPI).
* Such other tasks as BSSCKL management and changing business environment may require to be performed.
* Contribute and support team strategic plan and objectives.

**Perform the role of Shared Service Centre Accountant.**

* Act as a single point of contact (SPOC) for all related functional work streams for the assigned sub region.
* Collates information and updates by conducting weekly / bi-weekly cross functional meeting amongst all related functional work streams for the assigned sub region.
* Supports Head of Finance in the role of a Business Partner, Advisor and Integrator of the total business view.
* Supports Head of Finance Reporting in the role as a Finance Commentator, explaining business story in numbers and variances.
* Leading role in coordinating and liaising with respective counterparts i.e. Auditors, Local Accountants and Delivery Managers.
* Monitor the preparation and distribution of information that are to be furnished i.e. relating to Prepared by Client (PBC) list, Balances confirmation, notes to the Accounts including ensuring deadlines are met.

**Service Management:**

* Manage the Financial Reporting team members to deliver services within agreed service levels
* Ensure the operations in accordance with the service management framework by providing timely and accurate customer service.
* Review backlog and cycle time reports; supervise team members to improve process flow times.
* Ensure all workflows are processed within agreed service timelines.
* Influence the development of the service level agreement and charging mechanisms for the services provided.
* Ensure customer queries are attended to and resolved in a timely, responsible and proactive manner.
* Monitor SLAs, Balance Scorecard and KPIs, to ensure continue improvement in operations and service to customers.

**Quality and Continuous Improvement.**

* Identify, recommend and develop solutions in consultation with Head of Financial Reporting for continuous improvement opportunities. Ensure successful implementation across the team and in the local companies.
* Ensure update changes to process documentation when required
* Work with the team members to share best practices.
* Contribute and support Global Finance Transformation (GFT) initiatives in General Accounting and Reporting team.
* Contribute and support standardization across regions and globally by focusing on alignment of end to end business process areas, system and tools.
* Drive in improving productivity of General Accounting and Reporting by conducting relevant benchmarking exercise and monitoring through Key Performance indexes.
* Lead to conduct Cross Functional Meeting (CFM) among all functional teams.
* Drive to initiate and participate Regional Review Meeting (RRM) with Local Company

**Knowledge Management:**

* Establish operational and strategic plan, implementation and continuous improvement of Financial Reporting internal functional training to maximize learning process based on current and future business needs.

* Work with the relevant stakeholders to understand service delivery information and technical knowledge and keep up to date on changes that may impact the training content and training delivery.

* Provide feedback and reinforcement to Financial Reporting team members regarding development needs and opportunities, and secure resources to support development efforts.

.

* Service Centre management team.

* Professional Accountant or equivalent Min 10 to 18 years of professional experience in finance or similar.
* Prior experience of leading a team of 10 employees.
* Experience in dealing with Tax Reporting, Asset Accounting, Financial Reporting Compliance, projects management and audit would be important.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and effective communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, fast-paced global environment
* High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy

**Technical Skills**

**About BASF**
At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. We foster a workplace where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth - both for the business and for the individuals within it.
  
  
At BASF, your development never stands still. Employees have access to structured learning pathways, international exposure, and cross-functional mobility across a truly global organization. We are committed to inclusion and equal opportunity, and we actively invest in the wellbeing, development, and long-term career growth of our people. Whether you are early in your career or bringing deep expertise, BASF offers the scale of a world-leading company with the sense of purpose and community that makes it a place where people genuinely thrive.

title: AGM QS & PLanning
description:
**Company Description**
Myhome Constructions Pvt Ltd is a growing real estate and infrastructure development company with a strong presence in Hyderabad. The organization focuses on delivering quality residential and commercial projects with an emphasis on timely completion and customer satisfaction. It is known for adopting structured project management practices and modern construction technologies. Team members are encouraged to collaborate across functions to drive efficiency, safety, and compliance on all project sites.
  
**Role Description**
The AGM QS & Planning role is a full-time, on-site position based in Hyderabad, responsible for overseeing quantity surveying and project planning activities across multiple construction projects. The role involves preparing and reviewing BOQs, cost estimates, and budgets, as well as monitoring project costs, variations, and contractual claims. The AGM QS & Planning will develop and update project schedules, track progress against timelines, and coordinate with project, engineering, procurement, and site teams to ensure alignment with plans. Day-to-day responsibilities include validating measurements, certifying contractor bills, supporting tendering and bid evaluations, and ensuring adherence to company standards and statutory requirements. The role also requires preparing periodic reports, analyzing risks and delays, and recommending corrective actions to maintain project profitability and timely delivery.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong quantity surveying capabilities, including BOQ preparation, cost estimation, rate analysis, measurement verification, and contractor bill certification.
* Proficiency in project planning and scheduling tools (such as MS Project or Primavera), with experience in baseline program development, progress tracking, and resource planning.
* Solid understanding of construction processes, building materials, and civil engineering practices relevant to large residential and commercial projects.
* Experience with contract management, tendering, bid evaluation, variation analysis, and claim preparation within the construction industry.
* Ability to analyze project data, prepare dashboards and MIS reports, and support management decisions with clear cost and time impact assessments.
* Effective communication, stakeholder coordination, and team leadership skills to work with site engineers, contractors, consultants, and senior management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, or Planning is an advantage.
* Relevant experience in real estate or infrastructure projects at a senior level (Assistant General Manager or equivalent), preferably within the Hyderabad market.

Enterprise Risk Management

Data Migration & Technical Readiness
