title: ADN - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-**
**Assurance – Manager**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
  
  
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
* Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement team’s expectations
* Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
* Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
* Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
* Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
* Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
* Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
* Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
* Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
* Experience in either

+ Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
+ MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment.
+ Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager III, Facilities
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about creating exceptional workplace environments that enable teams to do their best work? Amazon is looking for a Facilities Manager to lead operations, drive process improvements, and deliver results across a portfolio of facilities. In this role, you will manage a team responsible for ensuring our spaces run smoothly, safely, and efficiently while continuously raising the bar on service delivery. You will define strategy, set goals, and partner with stakeholders across the organization to solve complex problems and improve the experience for every person who walks through our doors. If you are a collaborative, resourceful leader who thrives on turning ambiguity into action, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and develop a team of facilities professionals, providing coaching, career development support, and performance feedback to build a high-performing, inclusive team capable of delivering independently.
* Define and manage facility operations metrics, service level agreements, and audit mechanisms to measure team progress, ensure operational excellence, and report performance to leadership and key stakeholders.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify risks, negotiate priorities, and align resources to meet both short-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals for your facilities portfolio.
* Establish and refine workflows, maintenance programs, and process improvement initiatives that reduce complexity, eliminate recurring issues, and improve the day-to-day experience for building occupants.
* Evaluate scope and priority across projects, making data-driven trade-off decisions while ensuring downstream impacts are properly assessed and communicated to senior leadership.

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning reviewing facility performance dashboards and triaging any overnight issues with your team. Mid-morning, you join a cross-functional meeting to align on an upcoming space reconfiguration project, working through resource constraints and timelines with partner teams. After lunch, you hold one-on-one meetings with direct reports, discussing development goals and removing barriers to their work. Later, you walk the facility with your maintenance lead to inspect a recently completed improvement project before wrapping up with a narrative review for an upcoming operational planning cycle.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our Facilities team is dedicated to creating safe, efficient, and welcoming environments that support Amazon's operations and the people behind them. We work closely with real estate, engineering, security, and business partners to keep our spaces running at the highest standard. As Amazon continues to grow, our team is focused on scaling operations, simplifying processes, and finding creative solutions to new challenges. If you are excited about leading a team that directly impacts the workplace experience for thousands of colleagues, this is the place for you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, or 7+ years of Amazon experience
* 7+ years of employee and performance management experience
* 5+ years of distribution or manufacturing field with equivalent mechanical or electrical field experience
* 7+ years of facilities management, office management, corporate administrative services, or hospitality management experience
* 4+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience
* 4+ years of Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) experience
* 4+ years of managing department spend and labor budgets, performing root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing continuous improvement (CI) experience
* 4+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt Certification
* Professional Engineering registration
* Knowledge of statistical analysis
* Experience in design review process to incorporate electrical, mechanical, automation controls solutions to drive equipment reliability and standards
* Experience in automated conveyors systems and controls, electrical and electronic principles, blueprint and electrical schematic reading, CMMS programs, preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls , industrial electronics
* Experience leading network level/multi-site maintenance organizations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Supervisor, Customer Service
description:
**Description**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Supervisor, Customer Success provides operational leadership for the India-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success & Operations organization, with primary responsibility for day-to-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Supervisor translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**Leadership And Operational Direction**
The Supervisor, Customer Success has the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Provide visible, inclusive leadership and set clear direction, Success standards, priorities, and accountability for the Customer Success function in India within the global operating model.
* Align routinely with the Senior Manager, Customer Success on functional priorities, performance expectations, customer and business risks, and execution plans for the India Customer Success team.
* Translate Customer Success Operations strategy into executable team plans, goals, measures, and routines aligned with customer, revenue, quality, and operational objectives.
* Lead through change by communicating business context, preparing the team for new processes and technologies, and reinforcing adoption and sustained execution.
* Promote a culture of customer focus, quality, integrity, collaboration, continuous improvement, and equitable employee engagement.
* Exercise sound financial stewardship, manage resources responsibly, and support business priorities within approved budgets.

**Team Management And Capability Building**

* Direct daily team operations and equitably allocate omni-channel work, including orders, quotes, cases, calls, and correspondence, based on volume, skills, priorities, and Success commitments.

* Monitor workload, productivity, quality, data accuracy, and Success results; identify gaps and implement targeted coaching, training, and process improvements.

**Customer Escalation And Resolution Management**

Conduct periodic reviews of SOPs and identify opportunities for process clarification and improvement.

**Operational Governance, Compliance, And Continuous Improvement**

* Develop, maintain, and improve Customer Success policies, SOPs, operating procedures, knowledge resources, and controls to support consistent and compliant execution.
* Ensure adherence to applicable requirements for controlled substances, permits, customs, foreign licensing, shipments, and order documentation.

**Education & Experience**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required in a business, sales or related field.
* Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in Customer Success, Sales, or related field in a multi-cultural environment, preferably for a global organization.
* Experience with artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or other emerging technologies in a customer service or business environment is highly desirable. Relevant AI-related training or certifications are considered a strong plus.

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering - Observability and Monitoring
description:
We are looking for a senior Manager, Engineering for our Observability and Monitoring teams. Someone who can take ownership of two high-visibility teams building the operational backbone of SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how we see, detect, and resolve issues across the company before clients feel them.
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
The AI & Insights area is building the foundation for reliable, intelligent operations of SimCorp's offerings. When something breaks in our systems, we need to know immediately, and our teams need to quickly be able to understand the root cause. Ideally, we see the signals in advance, initiate self-healing, and avoid interruptions for our clients. Observability and Monitoring are how we enable that.
  
  
The Observability team owns the data foundation: a standard, Open Telemetry-based way for every SimCorp system to emit logs, traces, and metrics, collected on a central Operational Data Platform that SREs, monitoring, and AI agents can all use. The Monitoring team owns what we do with that data: one governed monitoring standard with a single alert funnel, a standard alert payload, and one Grafana instance for dashboards and alert rules. Together, the two teams are the data and signal layer for AIOps: AI-assisted root-cause analysis, proactive resolution, and self-healing workflows.
  
  
You will partner closely with the Product Managers for Observability and Monitoring and with the architect to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area.
  
  
**What Will You Be Responsible For**
**Team leadership and development**

* Lead and grow the Observability and Monitoring teams, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
* Develop individual engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, and honest feedbac
* Build one coherent engineering group across two domains, with the right composition, skills, and no single-person dependencies
* Hire and onboard new engineers into fast-moving workstreams as scope grows

**Delivery and operations**

* Own delivery of the Observability and Monitoring roadmaps
* Hold a high bar on quality, security, and operational readiness
* Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health across both teams, keeping delivery and engagement strong
* Remove blockers before they slow the team down, including the ones involving other teams

**Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration**

* Partner with the Product Managers to translate product strategy into an executable delivery plan
* Work with the architect on technology direction, from the OpenTelemetry data plane to the alerting and visualisation stack
* Collaborate with SREs, Operations, SaaS reliability, and the product development teams who instrument their code and consume the data, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders
* Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks

**Strategy and growth**

* Help shape SimCorp's observability, monitoring, and AIOps strategy as scope expands from collecting data to automated root-cause analysis and self-healing
* Anticipate where the teams need to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
* Bring an informed point of view on measuring what matters, such as monitoring maturity, SLOs, and incident detection and resolution times, rather than coverage alone
* Make AI agents part of how the teams work and how SimCorp operates, with people orchestrating, reviewing, and holding the bar.

**What We Value**
**Ownership and independence**
You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through.
  
  
**Management experience**
You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement.
  
  
**Technical grounding in observability and monitoring engineering**
You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with telemetry (logs, traces, and metrics), instrumentation standards such as Open Telemetry, alerting, SLOs, and incident response. You are curious about how AI can speed up root-cause analysis and operations. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off.
  
  
**Communication clarity**
You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Senior Team Leader Brush Power Generation
description:
**Partner with the Best**
As the Senior Team Leader for Brush Power Generation, you will be responsible to deliver technically and commercially sound Electrical/Mechanical machine design for product or services through deploying effective teams from project inception to delivery by setting and meeting project goals and objectives. Your responsibilities will include leading a team of engineers with varied experience to achieve business priorities.
  
  
As Senior Team Leader for Brush Power Generation: you will be responsible for :
  
  
  

* Resource Allocation: Allocate talent to execute meeting project requirements.
* Stake Holder management and Collaboration: Produce, co-ordinate and maintain effective and workable plans across multiple disciplines and team members.
* Workload Estimation and management: Estimate the effort, resources and timescales needed to complete the project to the required quality level
* Technical Leadership: Manage design verification and validation activities.
* Deliverables: Determine the status of a project (technical and process performance) and direct execution that performance is according to the plans and schedule, within project budgets and satisfies technical objectives
* Compliance: Ensure team adherence to HSE and compliance requirements, team productivity and high level of performance to deliver projects on time and budget.
* Demand management: acquire and supply products, services and resources as necessary, balance the allocation of resources to achieve greatest risk mitigation and / or opportunity benefits.
* People Leadership: Own the end-to-end performance management and appraisal process for the team, including goal setting, regular performance conversations, mid-year/year-end reviews, development planning, and recognition. Provide timely, objective and constructive feedback, differentiating performance based on demonstrated outcomes, behaviors, competencies, and business impact. Develop team capability through coaching, mentoring, Individual Development Plans (IDPs), competency assessment, succession planning, and career conversations.

**Fuel your passion**
To be successful in this role, you will need:
  
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Electrical or Equivalent.
* Proven prior experience of more than 12+ years in an engineering position focused on Electrical design, for rotating equipment. Familiarization with BPG execution process is added advantage
* Proficiency in Electrical design and related development tools, along with knowledge of industry codes and standards.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and motivate others.
* Prior experience in managing people is added advantage
* Fluency in spoken and written English.

**Work in a way that works for you**
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
  
  
**Working with us**
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Working for you**
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
  
  
  

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Senior Team Leader, Electrical, Customer Order Engineering
  
  
**About Us:**
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Join Us:**
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

title: Operations Manager, Customer Service
description:
**Overview**
**170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.**
At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  
  
Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.
  
  
The Operations Manager (OM) leads day-to-day operations for the CS India email team within the Business Assurance Centre (BAC). This role manages a team of 6+ supervisors and 24+ associates who process approximately 4,000 emails weekly across three shifts (24/7 coverage). The OM drives operational excellence through active coaching, consistent communication of expectations, and direct accountability for team performance against service level agreements and quality standards.
  
  
This is a contact centre operations leadership role — managing email volume, response quality, staffing compliance, and supervisor development with the same discipline and metrics rigor applied to voice-based contact centers.
  
  
This role requires an active leader — someone who takes control of operational outcomes, drives accountability, and leads from the front. Passive management and reactive decision-making do not fit this environment. The CS India team operates within Corporate Security, handling sensitive security and safety inquiries including medical emergencies, threats of harm, employee well-being concerns, and facility incidents. While deep security expertise is not required, familiarity with security operations and the judgment required to triage sensitive situations is a strong advantage.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Actively coach supervisors on leadership expectations, email quality standards, escalation judgment, and team communication.
* Conduct regular 1:1s with each supervisor to review performance, address gaps, and develop capability.
* Ensure supervisors can independently coach their frontline associates — building capability at the supervisor level that cascades to the team.
* Deliver consistent feedback aligned with the other Operations Manager(s) so that expectations remain uniform across all shifts and supervisors.
* Identify supervisor skill gaps and create targeted development plans.
* Lead, not manage passively — be present, visible, and decisive in setting direction for the supervisory team.
* Own team performance against email response time SLAs (Priority: 30 minutes, Urgent: 1 hour, Standard: 4 hours).
* Monitor daily queue health — email volume, aging, staffing levels, and coverage gaps.
* Drive case quality scores above organizational goals through coaching, not just monitoring.
* Review and act on Process Improvement (PI) scorecard results — translate quality data into specific coaching actions for supervisors.
* Conduct root cause analysis when SLA targets are missed and implement corrective measures.
* Understand the sensitivity and urgency of security-related communications — prioritize life safety, medical, and threat-related emails accordingly.
* Partner with the Workforce Management (WFM) resource on schedule adherence and leave planning.
* Actively monitor daily staffing compliance (minimum staffing thresholds met per shift).
* Communicate proactively with CS leadership when coverage gaps emerge — provide queue status, staffing levels, specific needs, and shift coverage details without being prompted.
* Set and reinforce expectations for email response quality: accurate classification, appropriate tone, correct routing, and stakeholder notification
* Coach supervisors and associates on the distinction between template compliance and thoughtful, situation-appropriate responses.
* Review escalations and sensitive cases to ensure responses meet the standard before sending
* Own corrective actions and after-action reviews (AARs) for handling failures — drive accountability, not deflection.
* Recognize that security communications require judgment beyond process compliance — a theft report and a lost item require different responses.
* Communicate with CS leadership proactively — surface issues, share context, and provide solutions (not just questions).
* Respond to partner team inquiries with ownership and accountability.
* Ensure consistent messaging between both Operations Managers so the team hears one standard, not two.
* Ensure the team does not operate below minimum staffing levels without documented awareness and escalation.
* All other duties, as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Have a minimum 5-years of experience in leading and managing all aspects of an operations center or equivalent experience in a team management role out of which 3+ years managing operations in a contact center, BPO, or high-volume email/case management environment. Bachelor's degree (required) with the background of security operations, corporate security, physical security, or protective services (understanding the sensitivity and urgency of security-related communications). Experience managing teams of 30+ across multiple shifts Familiarity with Salesforce or similar case management platforms Six Sigma, Lean, or continuous improvement methodology experience. Experience managing vendor-contracted teams. Experience in environments where judgment and escalation decisions carry safety or compliance implications
  
  
Experience managing supervisors (not just frontline associates) — demonstrated ability to develop middle management. Proven track record of coaching and developing team leads/supervisors into independent decision-makers. Experience managing SLA-driven operations with defined response time targets. Strong written and verbal communication in English (active voice, clear, concise, professional). Experience with workforce scheduling in a 24/7 environment (understanding of shift coverage, leave management, and staffing compliance). Comfort with data — ability to read dashboards, interpret quality scores, and translate metrics into coaching actions. Demonstrated leadership presence — takes initiative, drives decisions, and holds teams accountable without requiring constant direction from above.
  
  

* Takes control of operational Does not wait for direction, does not default to asking permission, and does not allow the team to drift. Active leadership means being present, visible, and decisive.
* The OM actively develops supervisors — not just tracks their performance metrics. Coaching happens daily, not quarterly.
* Does not wait to be asked for Surfaces issues, provides context, and offers solutions before CS leadership identifies the gap.
* Expectations communicated to one supervisor are communicated to all. Feedback aligns with the other OM so the team hears one standard.

**Working Conditions**
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
  
  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.

Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country-specific law.

title: Systems Operations Manager - CI/CD Platform
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Systems Operations Manager.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage a Systems Operations team of analysts that monitor installed systems and infrastructure
* Engage stakeholders and internal partners associated with the Systems Operations functional area
* Identify and recommend opportunities within Systems Operations to increase system efficiency and lower human intervention time on technical tasks
* Make decisions and resolve issues regarding operating systems, application software, and system management tools to meet business objectives
* Interpret and develop policies and procedures, and understand compliance and risk management requirements for supported system area
* Collaborate and consult with analysts, Information Technology personnel, or vendors
* Manage mid to highly experienced analysts
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Systems Operations
* Mentor and guide talent development of direct reports and assist in hiring

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Systems Engineering, and Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2+ years of Leadership experience

**Desired Qualifications**

* Significant experience in managing CI/CD Operations - managing Infrastructure stability and availability for CI/CD tools like Urban CodeDeploy, Github, GihubActions, Harness, JFrog Artifactory, BlackDuck, Checkmarx, etc.
* Experienced in managing Infrastructure upgrades and lifecycle management for above CI/CD tools like version upgrades, moving from on-premise to vendor SaaS, CI migration like Jenkins to GithubActions, CD migration like UCD to Harness, supporting k8s upgrades, etc.
* Experienced in Incident management - including major Incident management, communication to internal stakeholders in I&P and US, co-ordinating with vendors, driving quick resolution.
* Experienced in Problem management - experienced in regularly identifying improvement opportunities from alerts and incidents, and driving those improvements to actual results, via Problem Management process
* Experienced people manager, who can set challenging but realistic goals for operations engineers for learning new skills, like new CI/CD tools and AI/GenAI skills, mentor them on technical and soft skills and help them achieve these goals

**Job Expectations**

* Run day-to-day CI/CD Platform Operations – spanning on-premise data centers and public/Vendor clouds – to ensure high stability and availability of platform. This includes alert monitoring and timely response.
* Review and help team plan and execute major and BAU changes. Mitigate risk of such changes by ensuring appropriate scheduling, pre-validations, post-change validation, etc.
* Shift management - prepare shift roster for team for weekdays, weekends and holidays to ensure 16x7 coverage from I&P team and monitor/adjust for any unplanned time-offs or ad-hoc events.
* Continuously measure and enable improvement of team’s performance – through DORA metrics like Mean time to resolution (MTTR) reduction and failed changes reduction, and through regular Alert analysis and introduction of new alerts/updates to previous, to continuously improve Observability and monitoring.
* Enhance I.&P. team capabilities by: (1) Ensuring coverage across teams - defining and achieving SME development plan with the team, to ensure sufficient coverage of tools across the team, and (2) Helping senior engineers develop global SME expertise in their area, providing support via relevant trainings and work assignments.
* Collaborate effectively with US platform team, I&P and US Engineering and other stakeholders to achieve above objectives. Own and drive daily handover calls with US platform team
* Automation and AI – Help team define relevant use cases, do technical POC, implement and realize automations in CI-CD Platform tools processes and incidents, to either increase efficiency, reduce manual toil or reduce operational risk.

**Posting End Date**
12 Nov 2026
  
  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Incident Operations Manager
description:
**Company Overview**

Trianz is an
**applied AI solutions company**
that accelerates customer business transformation through AI-powered
**"Transformation Services as a Software Model."**
With 25+ years of transforming enterprises, we've evolved into a product-led, platform-driven organization serving global enterprises across Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, Hi-Tech, Manufacturing, and other industries.

With a global presence across 4 continents, our platform portfolio under the unified
**Concierto brand**
delivers end-to-end transformations including solutions for
**Migrate, Manage, Maximize, Modernize, Insights & Agentic AI, and SecOps**
, delivered through strategic partnerships with leading hyperscalers.

We're building the premier innovation-led organization in the digital transformation space through AI-first methodologies and data-driven excellence,
**RevolutionAIzing Transformations.**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Incident Operations Manager**
to establish and lead our Incident Monitoring and Operations function. The role will be responsible for managing a team of monitoring and incident response engineers, ensuring continuous monitoring of critical platforms and services, driving incident resolution, and improving operational reliability.

The Incident Operations Manager will act as the primary owner for incident management processes, service restoration activities, escalation management, operational governance, and stakeholder communications. This individual will work closely with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, security, and business teams to ensure high platform availability and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

Operations & Incident Management

* Lead and manage the Incident Operations team supporting a 24x7 monitoring and support environment.
* Establish and maintain incident management processes, procedures, playbooks, and escalation frameworks.
* Ensure timely identification, triage, escalation, and resolution of incidents impacting production services.
* Oversee Major Incident Management (MIM) activities and coordinate cross-functional teams during critical outages.
* Ensure adherence to SLA, SLO, and operational performance targets.
* Drive incident prioritization and ensure business-critical issues receive appropriate focus and attention.
* Act as the escalation point for unresolved or high-severity incidents.

Team Leadership

* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing incident operations team.
* Manage staffing, shift schedules, on-call rotations, and resource planning.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and career development discussions.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Monitoring & Service Reliability

* Ensure monitoring coverage across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, databases, and integrations.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve alert quality and reduce false positives.
* Drive proactive monitoring initiatives to identify issues before business impact occurs.
* Monitor operational health metrics and service availability trends.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

* Serve as the primary operational contact for stakeholders during major incidents.
* Provide timely executive and customer-facing communications during outages and service disruptions.
* Coordinate with vendors, managed service providers, and external support teams when required.
* Build strong relationships with application, platform, infrastructure, and security teams.

Continuous Improvement & Governance

* Lead Incident Review and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) activities.
* Identify recurring issues and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Establish operational dashboards and reporting mechanisms.
* Track key operational metrics and provide regular reporting to leadership.
* Drive automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, security requirements, and operational standards.

**Desired Profile:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in Production Support, NOC Operations, Platform Operations, Incident Management, or Site Reliability functions.
* Minimum 3-5 years of experience leading operational or support teams.
* Strong understanding of Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Management processes.
* Experience managing Major Incidents in enterprise environments.
* Proven experience operating within a 24x7 support organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional Certification.
* Experience supporting cloud-native and microservices-based platforms.
* Familiarity with DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles.
* Experience implementing operational automation using PowerShell, Python, Shell Scripting, or similar technologies.
* Experience building or scaling incident management functions

**Key Competencies**

* Incident & Major Incident Management
* Operational Leadership
* Service Reliability
* Escalation Management
* Team Building & Mentoring
* Stakeholder Management
* Crisis Management
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Vendor Management
* Process Improvement
* Executive Communication

title: MSFDL-Manager - Data Audit Framework
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Robot Operator Supervisor
description:
**Job Description**
Company: Nextpower
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India
  
  
Job Title: Robot Operator – Operations
  
  
Experience - 4-6yrs
  
  
**About The Role**
NextPower is expanding its global robotics operations and building an India-based team to support remote robotic inspection missions across solar sites worldwide. The Robot Operator Supervisor – India Operations will serve as a key leader within this growing organization, combining hands-on robot operation with team leadership, operational excellence, and cross-regional coordination.
  
  
This role will work closely with Robot Operators in India while maintaining daily communication with supervisors and operations leaders based in the United States to ensure alignment on scheduling, performance expectations, quality standards, and mission execution.
  
  
Position Overview

title: Vice President Operations
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Vice President Operations**
Lead the operational management and evolution of Domestic Payments, ACH(Automated Clearing House ), RTP(Real time payments) and other Emerging Payments processing within Payments Business Service. The role is accountable for safe, resilient and client-focused execution, driving end-to-end consistency of operational design, efficiency through standardisation and global solutions, and strong risk and control outcomes—while supporting ongoing market infrastructure change and new scheme adoption.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own day-to-day operational performance for Domestic, ACH, RTP and Emerging Payments processing, ensuring delivery against all agreed service levels/PLAs (cut-offs, quality, Audit & Risk outcomes, OOE and operational losses).
* Design, manage and report operational performance using robust MI/KPIs; ensure reporting is accurate, timely and aligned to agreed standards and regulatory expectations. Drive client experience outcomes by reducing client effort and improving transparency (e.g., fewer avoidable rejects/returns, faster resolution of exceptions, clearer status/communications through agreed channels). Lead standardisation and simplification across the functional line, striking the right balance between global consistency and required local/scheme-specific needs.
* Drive productivity and cost transparency; identify and deliver efficiency opportunities through process redesign, automation and improved workflow/tooling. Ensure all change activities (scheme changes, platform upgrades, new products/rails, regulatory deadlines) are communicated, agreed and deployed with minimal operational disruption. Supervise migrations/transitions where applicable, leveraging existing expertise to shorten transition timelines and stabilise performance post-move.
* Ensure appropriate risk and control strategies are in place for all processes under remit; proactively identify control gaps and drive sustainable remediation. Manage incidents (including those caused by external factors such as scheme outages or market events) through effective co-ordination, timely escalation and stakeholder communications. Ensure operational readiness and resilience for evolving payments infrastructure (including new schemes and message format migrations), delivering solutions to mandatory timelines. Partner with Global Businesses, Transformation, Technology and other stakeholders to shape and deliver operational change programmes and innovation across payments workflows. Plan and manage ad-hoc tasks and senior management queries, ensuring relevant and timely responses.
* Build and lead a high-performing and engaged payments operations team; set clear direction, expectations and accountability. Retain talent, manage underperformance and attrition, and ensure development and career progression opportunities across payments talent pools. Role model Operational Excellence and continuous improvement; embed a culture of disciplined execution, learning and “fix it once, fix it properly”.
* Promote an inclusive environment that supports diversity and reflects HSBC values; operate effectively across cultures and geographies. Maintain strong working relationships with peer groups and senior managers to co-ordinate delivery, remove blockers and report progress and results. Contribute to the broader payments governance structure, including policy and decision-making, through active participation in committees/forums.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Recognised as a Subject Matter Expert in Payments Business Service / Payments Operations, with strong understanding of domestic clearing, ACH processing, RTP/instant payments and emerging payment rails (including exceptions, returns, rejects and operational controls).
* 10+ years’ experience in Operations Management, including strong operational control capability and a proven track record in delivery. Strong programme/change/project management skills; able to deliver standardisation, migrations and operational transformation safely. .
* Excellent planning, organising and commercial skills, including strong financial management capability and ability to drive cost transparency. Resourceful and outcome-focused; able to leverage available resources to achieve goals.
* Prior experience driving innovative operational solutions (process, automation, tooling, MI) is an advantage.
* Ensure employees apply compliance and operational risk controls in accordance with HSBC and regulatory standards and policies, recognising the heightened regulatory implications associated with payments. Continually reassess operational risks inherent in the role, considering changes in economic/market conditions, legal/regulatory requirements, operating procedures, organisational changes and new technology.
* Ensure incidents are reported per the incident escalation process in a timely manner; ensure root cause analysis is completed and corrective actions are implemented and sustained. Support ongoing market infrastructure change programmes (new schemes/rails, rulebook changes, message format migrations), ensuring solutions are delivered to regulatory/mandatory timelines.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

title: Director - Transformation Office
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Director – Transformation Office to drive business transformation across the organisation. The role will focus on identifying opportunities to move suitable activities to offshore teams, automate processes, and reduce operating costs.

The person will work closely with business leaders, operations, technology and finance teams to identify improvement opportunities and ensure that these are implemented successfully. The objective is to improve productivity, service quality and turnaround time while building efficient, scalable and cost-effective delivery models.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Offshoring and Process Transition**

* Identify business processes that can be moved to offshore teams or centralised delivery centres.
* Work with business teams to assess process suitability, volumes, costs, resource requirements and operational risks.
* Develop plans for transitioning activities, including process documentation, knowledge transfer, training and handover.
* Ensure that transitioned processes meet agreed quality standards and service levels.
* Work with business development teams to identify potential offshoring opportunities for clients and support solution proposals.

**2. Automation and Technology**

* Identify manual and repetitive activities that can be automated using technology, RPA, AI and other digital solutions.
* Work with technology teams to assess and implement suitable automation solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, errors, duplication and processing time.
* Track the benefits of automation in terms of cost savings, productivity and quality improvement.
* Ensure that appropriate controls are in place for data security, compliance and the use of AI.

**3. Continuous Improvement**

* Review existing processes and identify areas where work can be simplified or made more efficient.
* Identify bottlenecks, unnecessary steps, delays and activities that result in rework.
* Drive initiatives to improve turnaround time, productivity, accuracy and service quality.
* Introduce standard processes, operating procedures and performance measures across teams.
* Encourage employees and managers to identify and implement improvement ideas.

**4. Transformation Project Management**

* Prepare and maintain a transformation plan covering offshoring, automation, cost optimisation and process improvement initiatives.
* Prioritise projects based on business impact, cost, feasibility and expected benefits.
* Work with relevant teams to define timelines, responsibilities and deliverables.
* Monitor progress, resolve issues and ensure that projects are completed as planned.
* Provide regular updates to senior management on progress, challenges, cost savings and business benefits.

**5. Cost Optimisation and Pricing**

* Work with Finance and business teams to understand the cost of delivering different services.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs through better resource utilisation, process redesign, automation and offshoring.
* Help develop cost-per-unit models for services such as applications processed, invoices handled, reports prepared or tickets resolved.
* Support the development of outcome-based pricing models for clients.
* Track whether the expected cost savings and productivity improvements are actually achieved.

**6. Performance Tracking and Reporting**

* Define measures to track the success of transformation initiatives.
* Monitor cost savings, productivity, turnaround time, quality, automation benefits and service-level performance.
* Establish dashboards and periodic reviews to track progress against targets.
* Ensure that the benefits achieved are properly measured and reported.
* Highlight risks, delays and areas requiring management intervention.

**7. Stakeholder Management and Change Management**

* Work closely with business heads, functional leaders, technology, finance and operations teams.
* Explain proposed changes to stakeholders and obtain their support for implementation.
* Support teams in adopting new processes, tools and ways of working.
* Identify training and capability-building requirements arising from transformation initiatives.
* Share successful practices across teams and service lines.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, IT or a related field. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification would be an advantage.
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in business transformation, operations, offshoring, shared services, process improvement or consulting.
* Experience in leading transformation projects involving multiple teams or business functions.
* Good understanding of offshore delivery models, process transitions and shared services.
* Exposure to automation, AI-based solutions and technology-enabled process improvement.
* Experience in process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma would be an advantage.
* Understanding of cost optimisation, productivity measurement, business cases and return on investment.
* Strong project management, analytical and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with senior management and drive initiatives from planning through implementation.

**Key Success Measures**

* Successful transition of identified processes to offshore or centralised teams.
* Reduction in operating costs and cost per unit of service delivered.
* Improvement in employee productivity and utilisation.
* Reduction in manual effort, processing time and rework.
* Successful implementation of automation initiatives.
* Improvement in quality and adherence to service-level targets.
* Timely completion of transformation projects.
* Achievement of planned cost savings and other business benefits.
* Development of scalable and commercially viable service delivery models.

title: Manager I, Operations, Centralised Monitoring Response System Auditing
description:
**Description**
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
  
  
Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
  
  
Within NOC’s umbrella, resides a fast-growing Last Mile support function – AMZL CO (Amazon Logistics Central Operations). AMZL CO is responsible for centrally supporting daily planning and execution of functions that impact Delivery Station (DS) operations across Routing, Scheduling, On-Road and Payments workstreams. The Marcopolo program under AMZL CO strives to operate heavily repetitive processes for NA, EU and JP COs, with standardized mechanisms, tools and technology and with a vision is to build a global Center of Excellence for Last Mile (LM) CO services across WW marketplaces in next 3 years. As a Manager I, Operations in the organization, this role will lead the operations management (tactical execution) charter for Driver support workstream supporting NA/EU. This role will influence and advice multiple senior level leaders and stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities Of a NOC Manager I**
We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, and program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.
  
  
In this role, the manager will work with stakeholders from multiple partner teams to manage Integrated Centralised Monitoring and Response System Auditing function & improve program performance along with lead a team of people managers overseeing operations for a team size of 30+ associates. Manager may be expected to operate in different shift structures (for instance - 6PM IST OR 8PM IST onwards) depending on business requirements.
  
  
The Manager would be responsible to evolve the processes and mechanisms with the growing complexities in the network by working across multiple stakeholders like configuration and design teams. The individual will drive improvements and automations to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.
  
  
This position also manages the planning and execution of the team’s goals, including segmentation of business goals, measurement of goal attainment, evolving and driving various improvements in Business to increase its effectiveness in driving results. They would drive quality and productivity in the team via continuous coaching and feedback mechanisms, scope out team's career development plans through performance assessment, drive associate engagement through 1-1s and team building activities, dive deep and drive action on insights from connection scores, manage exceptions and prepare dive deeps on escalations from Ops, represent the team in Business reviews (WBRs/MBRs), strategize and implement the associate shift planning and rostering to effectively meet the program requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL would be an added advantage. They should be be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, analytical, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. They will need have excellent communication and customer-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders.. They will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Responsible for performing operational audits across miles in FCs, SCs, Lastmile and GSF.
* Prepare audit reports enclosed with findings, visual interpretations captured during audits.
* Working with operational stakeholders to aligning audit related binaries, key operational processes to be covered in audits
* Preparing SOPS, weekly business reviews, newsletters, help-texts, simulations to assist associates in performing audits
* Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
* Track the deliverables of the NOC-ICMRS team, work closely with the operations leadership and drive audit closures.
* Must be willing to share on-call rotations in support of alarms, security incidents, and critical service outages.
* Enhance, track, and report on metrics which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements so that the desired outcomes are achieved to plan and in a timely manner.
* Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, training and documentation
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all key goals and metrics

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree or 3+ equivalent professional experience
* 2+ years of experience in control room management, risk management, supply chain management, or other related field
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Good critical thinking skills and attention to detail
* Experience with security equipment such as CCTV cameras and video review system

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Be solutions-focused, customer-focused, and always deliver excellent follow-up.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

description:

Amazon Flex Investigation and Offboarding (Flex I&O) is looking for a Team Manager to directly supervise a team of individual contributors across our investigations, quality assurance, and offboarding operations. In this role, the problem, strategy, and opportunity are already defined — your key responsibility is directing who does which tasks to meet daily goals while fostering a culture where team members feel valued, trusted, and connected.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on people leader who excels at coaching specialists and analysts, auditing work queues, managing SLA adherence, and driving team-level performance metrics. You will play a critical role in ensuring your team consistently meets performance, quality, and compliance standards across investigations, case audits, appeals processing, and partner liaison activities.

* Directly supervise a team of Investigation specialists, quality analysts, and investigation liaisons, providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and mentorship
* Hire and onboard bar-raising talent, ensuring new team members are effectively integrated and trained on Flex I&O processes, tools, and SOPs

* Evaluate employees against role guidelines and participate in calibration sessions with your manager to ensure fair and consistent performance assessments
* Audit work queues and monitor SLA adherence across investigations, quality audits, and offboarding cases, identifying priorities and managing trade-offs between time and resources
* Monitor team performance metrics, identifying trends and implementing action plans to maintain and raise the performance bar
* Recommend improvements to tools, procedures, and workflows to enhance operational efficiency and case quality
* Manage straightforward problems using technical and domain knowledge, escalating roadblocks to leadership when needed
* Ensure compliance with Flex/SLS policies, regulatory requirements, and established procedures across all queues and markets
* Communicate performance regularly in 1:1s and support promotion discussions for high performers, fostering a culture of accountability and professional growth
* Collaborate with Quality Analysts, Program Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate audit findings into actionable coaching and process improvements
* Support escalation management by ensuring time-sensitive cases within your team are triaged and resolved with urgency and accuracy
