* 2+ years of team management experience
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with experience using data to identify trends and drive decisions
* Excellent organization skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills

We are looking for an experienced Administration & Procurement Manager to support our expanding India operations.
  
  
**The Role**
Based in Hyderabad, you will manage key procurement and administrative processes for Kandou India, working closely with our Finance team in Switzerland, India Operations, employees, vendors, banks, Kandou’s external accounting and compliance provider and other external service providers.
  
  
This is a hands-on role requiring strong ownership of the procure-to-pay process, vendor coordination, payment and import documentation, and day-to-day administration. The role has a strong international dimension, with regular interaction with global teams and overseas suppliers, including management of cross-border payments and the related banking and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage procurement activities across Kandou India, including sourcing, quotations, vendor selection, negotiations, purchase orders and delivery follow-up.
* Manage vendor onboarding, contracts and supplier relationships, ensuring appropriate commercial terms and documentation.
* Coordinate the procure-to-pay process, including PO and invoice matching, approvals, payment documentation and resolution of outstanding items.
* Manage the administrative requirements related to payments to foreign vendors, working with banks and external service providers to ensure complete and timely documentation for cross-border transactions.

A key focus of the area will also be building AI-ready data foundations that support advanced analytics, machine learning, and emerging agentic AI capabilities. title: Network Infrastructure Deployment Manager, Infra Networking
description:
**Description**
Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
The AWS Cloud infrastructure is built around Regions and Availability Zones (AZs). AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones which are connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. These Availability Zones offer AWS customers an easier and more effective way to design and operate applications and databases, making them more highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable than traditional single data center infrastructures or multi-data center infrastructures. How would you like to come be part of the team that builds out that low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant network?
  
  
Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated, technically savvy Network Infrastructure Deployment Manager to help develop and scale one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. The Deployment Manager (DM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced communication construction project schedules achievable. AWS Deployment Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient connectivity solutions in the world.
  
  
As a Deployment Manager you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in fiber construction. AWS Deployment Managers are always at the forefront of the network construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers. Our networks are industry leading in terms of capacity and cost effectiveness. The DM is ultimately responsible for end to end network delivery and management of the contractors. The DM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, fiber splicing, OSP Design, ISP Construction or system installation/commissioning) and be responsible as a team member for delivering some of the most complex networks in the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As NW Infra Deployment Manager working within AWS Infrastructure you will:
  
  

* Interface with key internal stakeholders to understand the technical requirements and ensure the completed project meets these requirements.
* Project management of construction related activities and DWDM network rollout for new builds or general capital projects. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budget;
* Ensure that the construction, fiber and optical network adheres to the defined standards;
* Perform quality audits and ensure issues are remediated;
* Understand the metro fiber market segments, customer base, and industry verticals;
* Drive scaling designs to meet the demand of our customers;
* Interface with data center providers to drive equipment and circuit installations;
* Create detailed network planning packs to build scalable and future proof infrastructure;
* Program management, risk mitigation and reporting status reviews to management and internal customers.
* Develop long-term strategic partnerships in support of our key markets;
* Understand the mechanisms used to operate and maintain one of the world’s most complex networks;
* Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time;
* Ability to work across multiple time zones;
* Willing to travel 25-50% of the time.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience with fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment & troubleshooting methodologies
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service
* Knowledge of software development practices and data center/infrastructure/networking technologies
* 5+ years of technical infrastructure management experience, including network construction management and/or program management in a telecom environment
* Strong technical understanding of transport technologies (Fiber, DWDM, etc.) and data center/infrastructure/networking technologies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of network engineering and deployments for large-scale networks in a corporate environment, including hands-on physical infrastructure installations, hardware integration, racking, and cabling experience
* Experience communicating to a diverse, global audience
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification with experience leading multiple large network construction programs
* Familiarity with GIS platforms, quality assurance processes, and strong knowledge of long-haul transmission systems and regional construction standards
* Experience working in a fast-paced, international environment with strong contacts in fiber, transport, and infrastructure markets

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Job Description**

**Team leadership and service delivery**
— Lead and support the CRM Business Operations Support team. Set priorities, balance incoming demand with improvement work, and ensure requests are handled consistently, documented clearly, and escalated appropriately.

**Recurring issues and communication**

— Represent the support function in team projects, such as CRM Scan or Field Excellence Summit preparations, while maintaining service coverage. Build effective working relationships with business stakeholders, regional teams, the CRM platform team, and Technology teams.

The Manager is accountable for reliable request and ticket resolution while also developing the team’s capability and improving the service. * Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to coordinate across regional and cross-functional teams.

**Measures of success**
Timely, accurate, and consistent support; improved first-time-right execution and fewer repeat issues; effective communication during broad CRM issues; smooth BA onboarding; current guidance and training materials; stronger team capability; and practical improvements in efficiency and user experience.

title: Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**About This Role**
The Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace is responsible for the day-to-day delivery of IT support services to internal employees and business functions across India and the EMEA region. IT Field Engineers at EMEA sites report into this role, making it accountable for field engineering coverage, standards, and service quality across the region.
  
  
In addition to site service delivery, this role is the operational service owner for the digital workplace across the global KGS tenant, covering Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, and Bookings. Ownership means day-to-day service quality, user support, adoption, and migration delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Operations
  
  

* Supervise daily IT support operations, including incident handling, service requests, and problem resolution across the supported sites in India and EMEA.
* Monitor and track service desk performance metrics (ticket resolution time, backlog, first-contact resolution) to ensure adherence to SLAs.
* Serve as an escalation point for operational issues and coordinate resolution with technical teams.
* Provide day-to-day direction and support to service desk analysts, desktop support staff, and IT Field Engineers across the region.
* Provide team leader support for collaboration and coordination of workflow, process, and guidance to other team members.
* Implement process improvements and standard procedures to increase efficiency and consistency.
* Collaborate with internal IT teams (infrastructure, applications, security) to support service delivery needs.
* Maintain documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.
* Contribute to regular reporting on service performance for internal stakeholders.

Digital Workplace Services (Global)
  
  

* Own the day-to-day service quality of the digital workplace and collaboration services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, and Bookings.
* Apply the Teams and SharePoint standards set by the governance and cyber security teams to provisioning, naming, lifecycle, external sharing, and guest access requests.
* Execute license assignment and group membership changes for digital workplace services within approved access policies, escalating exceptions to the policy owner.
* Lead migration and consolidation work, including file share and legacy platform migrations into SharePoint Online and OneDrive.
* Drive adoption and change management through training, champion programs, and communications that raise usage and reduce support demand.
* Monitor tenant health, service advisories, and roadmap changes; assess impact and communicate upcoming changes to the business.
* Action information protection, retention, and eDiscovery requests as directed by the cyber security, compliance, and legal owners.

Service, Incident & Vendor Management
  
  

* Use ITIL Service Request, Incident, Problem, and Change Management principles to complete and reduce tickets in the ITSM tool.
* Prioritize incidents and service requests and ensure timely escalation to third-level support groups to enable resolution within SLA.
* Lead major incident coordination during India and EMEA hours and hand off cleanly to the IT Service Delivery Regional Manager (Americas).
* Engage in Problem Management by tracking and analyzing recurring problems and providing proactive communications on remediation steps.
* Support vendor coordination for routine operational issues (e.g., hardware replacements, software support).
* Partner with the IT Service Delivery Regional Manager (Americas) to keep standards, tooling, reporting, and escalation paths consistent across locations.

**Regional Team Leadership (India & EMEA)**
Lead the IT Field Engineering team across EMEA, with field engineers at regional sites reporting directly into this role.
  
  
Set goals and performance expectations for the regional team, hold regular one-on-ones, and build skills development and succession plans.
  
  
Own the EMEA coverage model, including staffing levels, shift and holiday scheduling, on-call rotations, and after-hours support for critical operations.
  
  
Standardize field engineering practice across EMEA sites so device builds, comms-room standards, onboarding, and escalation paths are consistent from site to site.
  
  
Manage regional managed service provider and contractor performance against contracted service levels, driving remediation where targets are missed.
  
  
Contribute to regional IT budget planning for support staffing, end-user hardware, and site services, tracking spend against plan.
  
  
Site Support (Assigned Site)
  
  

* Support the site with best-in-class service, delivering a reliable end-to-end IT experience for employees, site leadership, and visiting executives; as needed, support both Site leadership and IT Site leadership.
* Build trusted relationships with the Site Leader and functional managers, translating business priorities into IT plans and project commitments.
* Represent site and user needs to the Site Leader, IT Business Relationship Managers, and global IT leadership.
* Support the Site Leader on IT readiness for audits, business continuity exercises, and site-level projects such as moves, expansions, and manufacturing changes.
* Track digital workplace licensing consumption, flagging right-sizing and consolidation opportunities to the platform and finance owners.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 8 years' experience in IT support or service operations.
* Hands-on administration experience with Microsoft 365 digital workplace and collaboration workloads: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, with hands-on Incident, Problem, and Change Management experience in an ITSM tool.
* Experience leading or supervising technical staff across multiple sites, countries, and time zones.
* Able to work onsite at the assigned KGS site in India.
* Ability to travel up to 25%.
* Flexible schedule to accommodate overlap with the Americas and Europe and occasional on-call needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader modules highly desirable.
* Microsoft certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert or Teams Administrator Associate.
* Deep knowledge of ITSM tools (e.g., Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Ivanti).
* Solid understanding of enterprise IT environments (hybrid cloud, on-premises infrastructure, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, endpoint management).
* Experience delivering SharePoint Online migrations and file share consolidation at enterprise scale.
* Experience deploying and supporting the wider Microsoft productivity stack (Viva Engage, Loop, Planner, Project, Visio, Forms, Bookings, Stream).
* Working knowledge of desktop support and endpoint management (Intune, SCCM).
* Experience supporting a manufacturing or distribution site, including IT/OT coordination.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to translate technical issues into business impact.
* Strong customer service orientation, displaying professional standards.
* Keen attention to detail in delivering quality service.
* Analytical mindset, using data to drive decisions and improvements.
* Able to work autonomously and follow direction as provided.
* Highly self-motivated; actively seeks development opportunities.
* Able to manage conflicting priorities and maintain calm under pressure during incidents.
* Coaches and develops others, building capability within the team.
* Works effectively with vendors and managed service providers.
* Collaborates as an equal partner with peers in other locations, sharing standards across time zones.
* Ability to lead projects and/or support roles.
* Challenges the status quo and drives improvement.

Strong organizational and task management skills in a fast-paced support environment.
  
  
**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

title: Manager, Commercial Enablement & EOS
description:
**:**
The Manager, Customer Success – Commercial Enablement and End of Support leads three critical functions which protect and grow revenue across Blackbaud. First, this role owns our temporary-workforce Outbound Caller program, ensuring the quality, consistency, and performance of outbound calls, coaching callers to proficiency, and driving the strategy needed to deliver above-expectations results. This leader partners across the company to reduce noise and friction points, so we target the right accounts, with the right message, at the right time. Second, this role manages our Commercial Enablement CSM, who is responsible for building Customer Success Manager (CSM) proficiency in generating employee sales leads, positioning the impact and value the customer is receiving from the solution, and equipping CSMs to identify and combat risk. Third, this role will manage our End of Support (EOS) CSM, who guides customers through end-of-sale/end-of-life product transitions; including contract restructuring, migration and cutover planning, and partner with internal teams in coordinated cross-sell/up-sell to replacement solutions.
  
  
This role is based in Hyderabad and the expected shift is US hours (6:30pm – 3:30am IST).
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Outbound Program Leadership: Lead and manage the day-to-day performance of the temporary-worker Outbound Caller program, setting clear expectations, workflows, and quality standards for the team.
* Quality & Coaching: Monitor and evaluate call quality, provide real-time and ongoing coaching, and build training and proficiency programs that raise caller performance consistently over time.
* Performance Strategy: Own the strategy to deliver above-expectations program performance, setting goals, tracking results, and continuously refining tactics based on outcomes.
* Targeting & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Data/Analytics, and other teams to reduce noise and friction points in the calling process, ensuring the program targets the right accounts at the right time.
* Commercial Enablement Leadership: Manage the Commercial Enablement CSM, providing direction, coaching, and support to drive the impact of the enablement function across the broader CSM organization.
* CSM Sales Skills Enablement: Guide the development of programs that build CSM proficiency in identifying and generating employee sales leads within their accounts.
* Risk & Churn Mitigation: Ensure CSMs are equipped with the tools, training, and playbooks needed to identify and combat account risk and potential churn.
* Competitive Intelligence: Champion the use of competitive intelligence to inform CSM conversations, protect revenue, and play defense against competitive threats.
* End of Support (EOS) Program Leadership: Manage the End of Support (EOS) CSM, providing direction and oversight as they guide customers through end-of-sale/end-of-life product transitions, including contract restructuring, migration and cutover planning, and coordinated cross-sell/up-sell to replacement solutions.
* EOS Adoption & Retention Oversight: Ensure the EOS CSM drives platform adoption, retention, and success planning for assigned accounts, holding the role accountable for revenue growth and retention outcomes.
* EOS Cross-Functional Coordination: Support the EOS CSM in partnering with Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, Product, Operations, and Support to resolve issues, manage escalations, and channel customer feedback into product and process improvements.
* EOS Performance Accountability: Review key account KPIs and success-plan progress for EOS accounts, ensuring the CSM's efforts translate into measurable client outcomes and a positive customer transition experience.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing, customer success or sales role within a B2B SaaS environment, including 2+ years in a management capacity with direct reports.
* Experience managing a temporary, contingent, or outsourced workforce, including onboarding, quality monitoring, and performance management.
* Demonstrated success coaching individuals or teams to proficiency, with measurable improvements in call quality and performance outcomes.
* Ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, working with Sales, Marketing, and Data/Analytics teams to refine targeting and remove friction from outbound processes.
* Strong analytical and strategic planning skills, with the ability to interpret call and performance data to make data-driven decisions.
* Experience with sales or enablement functions, including building CSM or seller proficiency in lead generation, customer value discussions, risk mitigation, and competitive positioning.
* Familiarity with churn and retention dynamics in a B2B SaaS environment, and how competitive intelligence informs account strategy.
* Excellent communication and coaching skills, with the ability to translate strategy into clear, actionable guidance for frontline team members.
* Familiarity with end-of-sale/end-of-life (EOS) product transitions, including contract restructuring, migration and cutover planning, and cross-sell/up-sell strategy, and the ability to coach a CSM through this process.
* Experience coaching CSMs on consultative, technical account conversations, with the goal of driving value realization, outcome achievement, and retention.

* Strong understanding of NOC operations, incident management, problem management, and escalation processes.

title: Production Application Support Lead
description:
You will own the stability, availability and performance of our production platforms. This is a hands-on lead/manager role that combines production support, DevOps and site reliability engineering (SRE). You will lead engineers, run major incidents, and read the code to find root causes. You will also use AI tools to cut toil and resolve incidents faster.
  
  
**What We Expect Of You**
Accountable. You keep an eye on everything. Every production service, alert, incident and risk in your scope is yours to know about, and nothing should surprise you.
  
  
Responsible. The buck stops with you. When production is at risk, you know what to do, you decide, and you see it through to resolution.
  
  
Leadership. You own your team. You set the standard for on-call, coach engineers, back them during incidents, and answer for their results.
  
  
Technical. You know your stuff. You go deep on the platform, the data stores, the pipelines and the code, and your team trusts your judgment because you have done the work.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Production support and reliability**
‒ Lead the production support function, including on-call rotations, escalation paths and 24x7 coverage.
  
  
‒ Command major incidents from detection through resolution, then run blameless post-incident reviews and drive the fixes to completion.
  
  
‒ Define and track service level indicators (SLIs), service level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets with engineering and product teams.
  
  
‒ Use Datadog to build monitoring, alerting and dashboards that catch problems before users do.
  
  
‒ Run and improve Kubernetes workloads in the cloud, including scaling, upgrades, capacity and cost.
  
  
‒ Support and tune PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Neo4j in production, including performance, backup, recovery and failover.
  
  
‒ Keep Confluent Kafka healthy: throughput, consumer lag, partitioning, retention and schema management.
  
  
‒ Strengthen CI/CD pipelines, release practices, rollback plans and infrastructure as code.
  
  
‒ Report on availability, incident trends, mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR) to senior leaders.
  
  
‒ Hire, coach and develop a high-performing team.
  
  
**Incident and problem management**
‒ Own the end-to-end incident management process: detection, triage, severity classification, escalation, communication, resolution and closure.
  
  
‒ Act as incident commander for Sev 1 and Sev 2 events, coordinating engineering, vendors and business stakeholders, and issuing clear status updates to leadership at set intervals.
  
  
‒ Own problem management: run root cause analysis (RCA), maintain the known error database, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
  
  
‒ Identify recurring incidents through trend analysis, and prioritize permanent fixes ahead of repeat firefighting.
  
  
‒ Set and enforce service level agreements (SLAs) for response and resolution, and report breaches with causes and remedies.
  
  
‒ Run change and release risk reviews with the change advisory board (CAB), and link incidents back to the changes that caused them.
  
  
‒ Maintain on-call runbooks, escalation matrices and major incident playbooks, and test them through regular incident drills.
  
  
‒ Run weekly and monthly incident, problem and service health reviews with engineering, product and business owners.
  
  
‒ Manage third-party and vendor escalations for cloud, platform and software issues, and hold vendors to their support commitments.
  
  
‒ Keep the incident and problem tooling (for example ServiceNow or Jira) accurate, and ensure tickets carry complete timelines, impact and root cause.
  
  
**Quality, CSAT and team performance**
‒ Design and run a customer satisfaction (CSAT) process for all production support resources, with a survey after ticket closure, a defined target score and a review of every low score.
  
  
‒ Gather CSAT from business users, application owners and engineering partners, and turn the feedback into coaching and process fixes.
  
  
‒ Create quality gates for ticket handling: accurate categorization and priority, complete root cause and resolution notes, correct escalation, and knowledge article updates before closure.
  
  
‒ Audit a sample of closed tickets each month against the quality gates, score each engineer and team, and share results openly.
  
  
‒ Create release and handover gates, such as production readiness, runbook and monitoring sign-off, before a service moves to support.
  
  
‒ Measure quantitative performance for each support team and engineer: ticket volume, backlog and aging, first response time, time to resolve, SLA attainment, reopen rate, first-contact resolution and escalation rate.
  
  
‒ Build dashboards that combine quality and quantity metrics, so no one is rewarded for closing tickets fast at the cost of quality.
  
  
‒ Set targets and thresholds for each metric, run corrective plans where teams miss them, and recognize teams that exceed them.
  
  
‒ Use the data in performance reviews, capacity planning and staffing decisions, and report trends to senior leaders every month.
  
  
**Hands-on technical work**
‒ Troubleshoot live production issues hands-on: pod crashes, node pressure, network policies, DNS, ingress, certificates and resource limits in Kubernetes.
  
  
‒ Analyze application logs, distributed traces, thread dumps, heap dumps and metrics to isolate root cause across microservices.
  
  
‒ Review code changes, configuration and release diffs to find the commit, dependency or setting behind a regression.
  
  
‒ Tune PostgreSQL queries, indexes, connection pools, vacuum and replication. Diagnose MongoDB slow operations, sharding and replica set issues, and Neo4j query plans and memory.
  
  
‒ Monitor and resolve Kafka issues: consumer lag, rebalancing, partition skew, broker health, connector failures and schema compatibility.
  
  
‒ Build and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform) and Helm charts, and review changes made by the team.
  
  
‒ Write automation in Python, Bash or PowerShell for remediation, health checks and routine operations.
  
  
‒ Troubleshoot CI/CD pipeline failures, build and deployment issues, and container image and registry problems.
  
  
‒ Run load, failover and chaos tests to validate resilience, and fix the gaps they expose.
  
  
‒ Manage identity, secrets, certificates and network access in the cloud, working with security teams on vulnerabilities and patching.
  
  
‒ Tune cloud and cluster capacity, autoscaling and cost.
  
  
‒ Write and keep current runbooks, architecture diagrams and dependency maps for production services.
  
  
‒ Use Copilot and other AI tools to speed up log analysis, query tuning, script writing and incident summaries, and validate every output before it touches production.
  
  
**Architecture and design**
‒ Review solution architecture and design documents for new and changing services, and flag reliability, scalability, security and operability risks before release.
  
  
‒ Map service dependencies, data flows and failure domains across the microservices estate. Use that view to set resilience patterns such as retries, circuit breakers, timeouts and graceful degradation.
  
  
‒ Partner with architects and engineering leads on platform design decisions, including multi-region and disaster recovery strategy, data store selection, and event-driven patterns on Kafka.
  
  
‒ Set production readiness standards, and gate releases on them: observability, SLOs, runbooks, rollback plans and capacity.
  
  
**Code analysis**
‒ Read and analyze application code to understand behavior in production, including concurrency, memory use, query patterns, error handling and retry logic.
  
  
‒ Review pull requests for operational risk, such as missing logging, unbounded queries, weak error handling and unsafe configuration.
  
  
‒ Trace recurring incidents back to design or code defects, and work with development teams to fix them permanently.
  
  
‒ Use static analysis, dependency scanning and code quality tools to find reliability and security risks early.
  
  
**Platform engineering and AI-driven automation**
‒ Build and improve internal platform capabilities such as self-service environments, standard pipeline templates, golden paths and reusable Helm and infrastructure modules.
  
  
‒ Use AI tools, including GitHub Copilot, to generate and review automation scripts, pipeline code, infrastructure as code and runbooks, then test and validate before release.
  
  
‒ Apply AI to operational workflows: alert triage, log and trace summarization, incident timelines, post-incident report drafts and ticket classification.
  
  
‒ Automate remediation of known failure patterns through self-healing scripts, event-driven workflows and auto-scaling policies.
  
  
‒ Measure toil, set automation targets, and report time saved, incident reduction and MTTR improvement from AI and automation work.
  
  
‒ Define guardrails for AI use in production, including access controls, review requirements and audit trails.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Required**
‒ 10+ years in production support, DevOps or SRE, including at least three years leading teams.
  
  
‒ Career progression from on-premises infrastructure or systems administration into cloud administration, DevOps and SRE, and then into technical leadership. You understand the full stack from hardware, networking and operating systems up to cloud-native services, and you use that depth to troubleshoot.
  
  
‒ Deep hands-on experience with a major cloud platform, Azure or AWS (compute, networking, identity, monitoring, resilience).
  
  
‒ Production-level Kubernetes expertise on a managed service such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), including troubleshooting, Helm and deployment strategies.
  
  
‒ Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Neo4j operations.
  
  
‒ Experience running Confluent Kafka in production.
  
  
‒ Strong grounding in microservices architecture, including service dependencies, API failures and distributed tracing.
  
  
‒ Proven use of Datadog or comparable observability platforms.
  
  
‒ CI/CD experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  
  
‒ Ability to read and debug code in at least one major language, for example Java, C# or Python.
  
  
‒ Track record managing high-severity incidents and communicating clearly with technical and business audiences.
  
  
‒ Practical experience applying AI tools, such as Copilot, in engineering or operations work.
  
  
**Preferred**
‒ Terraform or Bicep experience.
  
  
‒ ITIL or similar service management practices.
  
  
‒ Azure, AWS, Kubernetes or SRE certifications.
  
  
‒ Experience in a regulated or large-scale enterprise environment.
  
  
**How You Will Be Measured**
Availability against SLOs, MTTD and MTTR, repeat-incident rate, CSAT scores, ticket quality gate results, SLA attainment, on-call health, automation gains, and the quality of post-incident follow-through.

title: Risk Manager II-IE, Inventory Evaluations
description:
**Description**
Inventory Trust team (SPIV) works to ensure that bad actors cannot profit from using our services to abuse Customers, Selling Partners or our Store. Our mission is to safeguard our store from bad inventory and bad actors concealing their identities. To accomplish this mission, we withhold funds from bad actors, deny our fulfillment network to bad actors as a means to scale their abuse and ensure that counterfeit/illegal inventory is destroyed, prevent Seller credit abuse, identify and disrupt bad actor “spare accounts”, and generate insights to help SPS understand where bad actors are prioritizing their efforts.
  
  
If we successfully achieve our vision, then Bad Actors will stop committing misconduct on Amazon. While we obsess over customers, we specialize in obsessing over bad actors to identify their friction points and multiply them exponentially in ways that don’t impact good sellers. Our vision is to ensure Bad Actors never receive a dollar from selling on Amazon and abusing our policies. This is done with minimal friction for good sellers, clearly communicated policies, and accurate calculations.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Risk Manager II to own complex projects, take high judgement decisions and manage escalations associated with our program’s expansion. In addition to making the right decisions, the candidate will need to be able to use SQL knowledge and use data as evidence to convince/influence key stakeholders.

* Innovating and designing new or improved processes to support the business needs.

* Maintain a strong understanding of best in class risk and control principles, and regulatory expectations – embed governance processes to perform recurring gap analysis against those expectations, and drive remediation where necessary.
* Identify and develop appropriate data sources and elements which contribute to risk-based assessments.
* Experience working in or supporting a fast-paced operations environment.
* Perform operational deep dives on compliance-related processes and systems. Understand business processes, regulations and controls, work with partners to identify root cause of issues.
* Take leading role in drafting and presenting deep-dive documents, including responses to senior executives and Correction of Errors (COE) reports.
* Analyze existing policy and process gaps, and develop solutions to close them.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3+ years of L5 Manager Role experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
* Experience with SQL and Excel
* Experience in written and spoken English and an ability to compose grammatically correct, concise and accurate written responses
* Experience with operations, risk, fraud investigations etc.
* Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions and implement effective solutions
* Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level

We are currently seeking a IT Senior Director to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).

At NTT DATA, we know that consistent service delivery builds lasting client trust. We invest in operational leaders who combine disciplined execution, technical understanding and strong people leadership to deliver reliable outcomes every day.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Client Delivery Manager (CDM) is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, operational governance, SLA/KPI performance, cost efficiency, resource management and continual service improvement across assigned Cloud, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity engagements.
  
  
Reporting into the Client Delivery Executive (CDE), the CDM converts contractual and client commitments into disciplined daily, weekly and monthly execution. The CDM works with the Client Architect to operationalize transformation roadmaps, automation and AIOps improvements without compromising service stability.
  
  
Lead complex enterprise operations where service reliability, operational discipline and continuous improvement directly shape client confidence. The role operates in a clear three-in-a-box model: the CDE owns the business and client outcomes, the CDM runs service operations, and the Client Architect shapes technology strategy and transformation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Operations & Delivery Control
  
  

* Own daily operations across relevant service towers and ensure delivery meets SLAs, KPIs, SLOs, contractual commitments and operating procedures.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms, including service reviews, delivery dashboards, action tracking and closure governance.
* Maintain operational stability, service quality and business continuity across global, multi-vendor and multi-tower environments.

Incident, Problem, Change & Risk Management
  
  

* Lead operational response for major incidents, outages, missed SLAs and service escalations; ensure timely communication, restoration and follow-through.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, corrective actions and service improvement plans to prevent recurrence.
* Govern change execution, operational risks, audit actions, security/compliance obligations and continuity or disaster-recovery readiness.

Resource, Vendor & Asset Management
  
  

* Manage workforce demand, staffing, shifts, skills, utilization, onboarding/offboarding, knowledge transfer and succession coverage.
* Coordinate tower leads, operations managers, partners and vendors; establish clear ownership and consequence-based closure of commitments.
* Oversee operational hardware/software assets, licenses and vendor dependencies within the service scope.

Cost Efficiency & Financial Operations
  
  

* Control delivery costs in line with the account operating plan and provide accurate operational inputs for revenue, cost, margin and forecast reviews.
* Drive productivity, pyramid optimization, capacity alignment, leakage prevention and efficient ramp-up/ramp-down of resources.
* Track operational benefits from automation, continuous improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives; escalate forecast or cost gaps with corrective actions.

Client Operations & Governance
  
  

* Serve as the primary contact for client operations leadership and lead service reviews, operational governance and action closure.
* Maintain clear and timely communication on performance, risks, incidents, recovery plans and improvement priorities.
* Support the CDE with MBR, QBR inputs, client escalations, renewals and delivery-led opportunities while keeping ownership centered on operational execution.

Automation, AIOps & Continual Improvement
  
  

* Identify repetitive work, ticket drivers and process gaps suitable for automation, AIOps and intelligent service management.
* Partner with the Principal Client Architect and practices to implement approved improvements and embed them into standard operations.
* Measure realized outcomes such as ticket reduction, faster restoration, reduced manual effort, improved reliability and better user experience.

People Leadership
  
  

* Coach delivery and operations leaders, set clear expectations and build a culture of accountability, ITIL discipline, collaboration and customer focus.
* Develop operational capability, certifications, cross-skilling, engagement and retention across geographically distributed teams.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 14+ years in IT services or managed services, including substantial responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cloud or cybersecurity operations.
* Proven leadership of day-to-day service delivery across complex, global and multi-tower accounts with measurable SLA/KPI and customer outcomes.
* Strong experience in major incident, problem, change, risk, transition, service improvement and operational governance.
* Working financial knowledge covering cost control, forecasting inputs, productivity, utilization and margin drivers.
* Broad understanding of cloud, compute, storage, backup, virtualization, operating systems, networks, cybersecurity and ITSM operations.

GCC Technology Advisory Manager

07 – Manager

GCC (Global Capability Centers) Strategy, Digital & Technology Strategy, Technology Operating Model Design, Sourcing Strategy, Business Case Formulation, IT Processes & Governance

Tech M&A Advisory, IT Shared Services, Agile Operating Model, Workforce Transformation, AI in SDLC, Data Visualization Tools, Enterprise Architecture
  
  
**Job Summary:**

* Manage defined workstreams within GCC strategy and digital transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high-quality outputs within agreed timelines along with budgeting and forecasting activities
* Own and lead projects – guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
* Prepare client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
* Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks, and support models for GCC setup and digital strategy assignments
* Apply a technology and business perspective across GCC processes, IT governance design, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as AI-enabled transformation
* Contribute to business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development and managing BD cycles
* Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* GCC Strategy and Setup: lead analysis of BOT/ABO setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GCC tooling landscape assessment, capability maturity evaluation, and process taxonomy design for new GCC entities
* Cost Analysis and Value Realization: develop detailed cost models covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GCC and technology transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
* KPI Design and Performance Frameworks: design KPI frameworks for GCC performance management, covering operational, delivery, financial, and strategic metrics; develop KPI dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
* Capability Maturity Assessment: conduct structured maturity assessments across GCC functions, IT processes, and technology capabilities; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
* GCC Processes and Tooling: Design GCC-specific operating processes including demand management, project intake, service catalogues, and performance reporting; assess and recommend tooling platforms (ITSM, PPM, reporting) suited to GCC operating contexts
* IT Governance Design: Design IT governance frameworks for GCC and enterprise technology contexts, including governance councils, decision rights, escalation structures, and policy frameworks aligned to organizational objectives
* RACI and Interaction Model Design: Develop RACI matrices and IT interaction models defining roles, responsibilities, and collaboration patterns between the GCC, parent organization, business units, and third-party vendors
* Operating Model Design: Design integrated IT operating models for GCC setups including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition planning considerations
* AI in SDLC: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on AI integration into software development lifecycles within GCC contexts – covering AI-assisted coding, automated testing, and intelligent release management

**Professional & Technical Skills:**

* 7–10 years of total experience in strategy consulting, technology advisory, or in-house corporate strategy; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
* Experience leading workstreams in GCC strategy, digital transformation, or technology operating model engagements
* Working knowledge of at least 2–3 of the following: GCC/Captive Center setup, Digital & Technology Strategy, IT Governance, Operating Model Design, IT Shared Services, Sourcing Strategy, Agile Transformation
* Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks for technology and GCC transformation contexts
* Experience designing KPI frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
* Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches – capability, process, or technology maturity – and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
* Familiarity with IT governance frameworks (e.g. COBIT, ITIL) and ability to design practical governance structures including RACI models and interaction frameworks
* Understanding of GCC tooling ecosystems – ITSM platforms, project portfolio management tools, reporting and analytics platforms
* Awareness of AI adoption in software delivery including AI-assisted development tools and their implications for GCC workforce and process design
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills

**What’s in it for you?**

* Opportunity to work on GCC and digital strategy programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries

+ Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams

* Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

description:

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Our HR Team are the force for good that bring Reckitt's ambition to life. Now is an exciting time to be part of shaping the future of HR, influencing an exciting global organisation, while developing business and functional leadership skills, all at the same time. **About The Role**
Reporting into Global Payroll Process Owner (GPO) in leading payroll governance, vendor performance, transformation programmes, and strategic initiatives across our global payroll landscape. This is a unique opportunity to operate at the centre of Payroll, HR, Finance, IT&D, Tax, and external provider networks, helping shape the future of payroll delivery globally.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and coordinate global payroll governance forums, including agenda management, executive reporting, presentations, minutes, action tracking, and stakeholder accountability.
* Support the GPO in driving the global payroll strategy and transformation roadmap.
* Act as a key partner across Payroll, HR, Finance, Tax, IT&D, and external vendors to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and delivery objectives.
* Support to manage payroll vendor governance, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), global performance management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Review vendor KPIs, SLAs, controls, and service delivery metrics, providing meaningful insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Drive operational excellence and process standardisation across payroll hubs and regions.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 13+ years of payroll experience within a large multinational organisation or complex global payroll environment.
* Strong understanding of payroll operations, governance, controls, compliance, vendor management, and payroll service delivery.
* Proven experience leading or supporting payroll transformation, process improvement, or large-scale change programmes.
* Experience partnering with IT&D teams on payroll system implementations, integrations, interfaces, testing, and technology enhancements.
* Strong project and programme management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders across functions and geographies.
* Experience managing outsourced payroll providers and holding vendors accountable to service commitments and performance standards.

The skills for success
  
  
Global Payroll, Payroll Transformation, Payroll Vendor Maangement , Payroll Process Improvement; Process management, Process Improvement, Process excellence,Execute plans, Strategic mindset, Digital literacy, HR Data Analysis; Data management; Employee data management, Operational Excellence, Commercial accumen, Solutioning.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: CTOi CIB Cloud lead
description:

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our Chief Technology Office team in the role of
**CTOi CIB Cloud lead.**
**The Opportunity**
Head of Corporate and Institutional Banking Cloud is accountable for the strategy, governance, engineering standards, adoption and operational management of cloud services across all Corporate and Institutional Banking functions globally.
  
  
The role holder will lead the development of a consistent, resilient and cost-effective cloud capability across Corporate and Institutional Banking, working in close partnership with the central Chief Technology Office Cloud team to support platform build, adoption and standardization. The role will provide senior leadership across FinOps, infrastructure management, risk and controls, regulatory requirements, cloud architecture, solution design and engineering practices.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define the target state for cloud adoption, platforms, operating models and engineering capability, aligned with wider Chief Technology Office, Corporate and Institutional Banking and Group technology strategies.
* Provide senior leadership across cloud engineering, architecture, infrastructure and governance communities, setting measurable objectives and developing skills, succession and delivery capability.
* Establish governance for budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, chargeback or show back, optimization and variance management. Drive transparent reporting, value assessments and cost-conscious engineering without compromising resilience, security or regulatory obligations.
* Ensure cloud platforms and workloads meet required standards for availability, capacity, performance, resilience, recoverability and operational support across their full lifecycle.
* Own the cloud risk and control agenda, ensuring effective assessments, evidence, testing, issue remediation, dependency mapping, recovery planning, scenario testing and tolerance compliance.
* Act as a credible senior technology representative in regulatory reviews, audits and assurance activities, explaining cloud arrangements clearly and ensuring findings, commitments and obligations are addressed within agreed timescales.

* Define and embed reusable cloud patterns, guardrails and practices covering infrastructure as code, automation, CI/CD, observability, security, resilience and self-service. Partner with the central Chief Technology Office Cloud team to shape platforms, roadmaps, service catalogues and adoption plans.
* Lead cloud adoption, infrastructure modernization, application migration, data platform and engineering productivity initiatives, ensuring dependencies, risks, costs, operational impacts and benefits are managed through to sustainable adoption and measurable outcomes.
* Working alongside Chief Technology Office central team to set enterprise cloud architecture direction, govern solution design and establish technology standards.

**To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:**

* Leadership experience across cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering or technology transformation in a large, regulated organization.
* Extensive expertise in public and hybrid cloud, including networking, compute, storage, databases, identity, security, monitoring and automation.
* Proven ability to set enterprise cloud architecture direction, govern solution design and establish technology standards.
* Experience in Google Cloud Platform is required
* Strong engineering expertise across Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration and delivery, observability and platform engineering.
* Experience building or operating FinOps capabilities covering cost governance, optimization, forecasting and accountability.
* Strong understanding of technology risk, control frameworks, operational resilience, audit requirements and regulatory expectations, including representing
* technology in formal reviews and assurance engagements.
* Experience partnering with central cloud platform teams to build, adopt, govern and standardize enterprise cloud services.
* Proven success leading geographically distributed direct and virtual teams to deliver major cloud migration or modernization programmes.
* Excellent communication skills with an ability to translate complex technical matters into concise, decision-ready advice for executives, engineers, risk partners, auditors and regulators.

title: Sand Mining Engineer Manager

title: Senior Manager Asset Care
description:
**Job purpose**

To ensure the smooth functioning of the plant in order to achieve the budgeted production for the year. To minimize the break downs of the machines to ensure delivery of plant capacity as per KPI. To ensure that all the asset in the plant is in the good condition. To drive safety and environment initiatives.

**Maintenance and productivity:**

* Maintaining all the machines in plant to ensure maximum uptime.
* Tune up the machinery to ensure delivery of budgeted capacities.
* Review the performance with team members regularly and try set in place a continuous improvement system for down time and capacity delivery.

* Ensuring delivery of budgeted capacities.

* Ensure compliance with PCB norms.
* Set in place a system for monitoring and continuously reducing impact on the environment.

* Identify areas which need improvement and plan projects in these areas in coordination with unit head and HO projects.
* Prepare estimates, make capex requests, follow up for approval and ordering and monitor implementation.

title: Site Security Manager
description:
**Overview**
**170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.**
At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  
  
Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.
  
  
The Site Security Manager, assigned to one of Pinkerton's largest global clients, will provide operational support in the application of physical security operations at the client's campus to ensure a safe working environment and support the organization's core business objectives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Provide operational support in the application of physical security operations to ensure a safe working environment.
* Assist in the evaluation, development, and implementation of regional security strategies.
* Implement site security plans, security assessments, site specific risk/threat analysis and training awareness programs with the assistance of law enforcement agencies.
* Support the regional internal communication program.
* Liaise with government, consular and private sector agencies to enhance security operations.
* Provide support to Regional Security Manager regarding contingency planning, risk/threat assessments, and the maintenance of effective networks across all business groups.
* Assist with the intelligence gathering process regarding the protection against high security threats, emergencies, and contingencies.
* Assist with the Building Emergency Reaction Readiness Program through the collaboration with key stakeholders.
* Support the creation and review of regional level strategic relocation planning.
* Preserve the business infrastructure at local and region level through the implementation of strategic business objectives.
* Provide multi-level communication between the business units in cooperation with individuals, teams, and vendors.
* Conduct periodic review sessions with vendors to achieve quality service delivery provision by suppliers and vendors.
* Manage and direct all security staff and daily on-site security operations and ensure correct and continuous business operations.
* Assist in the development of internal and external service optimization.
* Respond immediately to all security incidents and emergencies, as dictated by policy.
* Provide operational support to the Regional Security Manager during incidents and emergencies.
* Act as the global security representative during initial stages, as dictated by policy.
* Support established systems including but not limited to; access control, system trouble shooting, and access card management.
* Coordinate security support for both internal/external events.
* All other duties, as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree preferred with at least five years of corporate security operations experience.
  
  

* Able to carry out responsibilities with little or no supervision.
* Effective written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Able to multi-task and organize workload for effective implementation.
* Client orientated and results driven.
* Able to interact effectively at all levels and across diverse cultures.
* Able to prioritize duties and responsibilities in accordance with level of importance.
* Able to adapt as the external environment and organization evolves.
* Computer skills; Microsoft Office.

**Working Conditions**
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
  
  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.

Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country-specific law.

description: Key responsibilities Lead and develop reliability engineering teams delivering aftermarket services for the in-service engine fleet. Proven record of sustaining engine fleet support programs with measurable service level performance. Demonstrated business development success, including drafting proposals, converting ideas into SOWs and winning contracts, with documented revenue results. Proven ownership of engine configuration, life-limited part (LLP) tracking, SB/AD compliance and shop visit trend analysis. Track record of cutting unscheduled events, shop visit rates or cost with documented, quantified results. Direct experience managing OEM, airline, lessor or MRO customer escalations, with SLA and contract accountability. Hands-on P&L, budget and pricing ownership, including estimating, change orders and acceptance-based invoicing. Working knowledge of export control and trade compliance, with a clean audit record. Experience running onshore/offshore delivery with measurable utilisation, quality and attrition targets.

title: Product Squad Lead
description:
**Squad Lead Job Description**
We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative
**Squad Lead**
to join the
**Campaign Data Standards Product Team**
. This role serves as the operational leader for the squad, responsible for driving delivery, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement across campaign metadata, tagging, taxonomy, and data standards capabilities.
  
  
The Squad Lead will work closely with Digital Product Management, business stakeholders, data governance teams, marketing operations, analytics teams, and technology partners to ensure the successful adoption and evolution of enterprise campaign data standards. This role will play a critical part in enabling connected customer experiences, improving data quality, and creating a consistent metadata framework across Amgen's global commercial ecosystem.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong leadership, Agile delivery expertise, data governance knowledge, and business acumen with experience supporting enterprise marketing technologies. This individual will help drive the strategy, execution, and adoption of Claravine and related metadata management capabilities across the organization.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead day-to-day squad operations and delivery activities for the Campaign Data Standards Product Team.
* Partner with Product Managers to translate strategic objectives into executable roadmaps, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Coordinate work across business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and data governance partners to ensure successful delivery of business outcomes.
* Drive adoption and governance of enterprise metadata, tagging, taxonomy, naming conventions, and campaign data standards.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives, and PI Planning activities.
* Partner with global commercial marketing operations, analytics, media, and digital teams to establish and maintain consistent data standards across channels and platforms.
* Support the development and implementation of metadata frameworks that improve data quality, interoperability, reporting, and measurement capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to streamline campaign setup, tagging, and metadata management processes through automation and standardization.
* Monitor and manage dependencies, risks, and impediments impacting delivery or adoption of campaign data standards.
* Collaborate with analytics, customer engagement, and data platform teams to ensure metadata standards support downstream reporting, measurement, activation, and AI use cases.
* Drive continuous improvement through stakeholder feedback, performance metrics, and operational reviews.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Claravine capabilities, metadata governance, and campaign taxonomy best practices.
* Support organizational change management, communications, training, and adoption initiatives related to campaign data standards.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8 - 13 years of experience in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, IT or related field

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Claravine or comparable metadata, taxonomy, or marketing data governance platforms.
* Experience supporting Marketing Operations, Digital Marketing, Commercial Operations, Customer Engagement, or Data & Analytics organizations.
* Strong understanding of metadata management, taxonomy development, tagging strategies, and data governance principles.
* Experience implementing campaign naming conventions and enterprise data standards across marketing ecosystems.
* Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, media, and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale data quality, governance, or master data management initiatives.
* Experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.
* Experience supporting global teams and operating models.
* Knowledge of customer engagement, omnichannel marketing, campaign execution, and measurement processes.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across business and technology organizations.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and driving execution in Agile environments.
* Strong understanding of metadata, taxonomy, tagging, and data governance concepts.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable operational processes and technology solutions.
* Experience managing priorities, risks, dependencies, and competing stakeholder needs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and data quality.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Experience using Agile delivery and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Azure DevOps.
