title: TechOps - FICO - MANAGER - GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP FICO Manager 1 TechOps (Application Management) Consultant**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an
**SAP FICO Manager**
to join the
**EY GDS Team.**
As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP FICO across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
* Lead and mentor the cross functional team fostering culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement
* Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP FICO solutions and designs.
* Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
* Mentor and train junior SAP functional and technical Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* 10-14 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP FICO preferably with Global client
* Deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes and methodology and how it interacts with the application lifecycle management principles
* Ability to manage cross functional and technical team, give them directions and drive functional and technical discussions with various stake holders
* Proven track record of successfully driving solutions in a complex, multi-platform environment
* Extensive in client management working with various regions in a global setting
* Depth of experience in setting up, growing, transforming, and delivering application management teams
* Strong leadership and team building skills with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization
* Strong client management, analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to think strategically and make data driven decisions
* Responsible for providing support SAP FICO module incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
* Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
* Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
* Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite model.
* Defect resolution and defect analysis related to FICO.
* Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* Experience as SME with FICO module (G/L, Account receivable, Accounts Payable, Banking Accounting, Asset Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Project System, Results Analysis, Unsettled Costs, Month End & Year end close, Overhead assessment and settlement)
* Strong knowledge of FI integration points with other SAP modules like MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.
* SAP Certification in SAP FICO

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. title: Director Securities Operations
description:
**About the Role**

This is a opportunity to build and scale AssetMark’s securities operations function in India. As Director, Securities Operations, you’ll establish and lead a best-in-class securities operations platform at our Hyderabad Technology Center, supporting financial advisors and their clients across the end-to-end securities lifecycle. You’ll shape the operating model, hire the leadership team and define how these functions run for years to come.

You’ll oversee trade processing, reconciliation, transaction and tax lot accounting, corporate actions, asset servicing, custody, middle office and investment performance. Working closely with U.S. leadership, you’ll transition and grow critical operations, put robust controls in place, drive rapid detection and resolution of outages, and deliver exceptional service at scale. The work you lead will support a platform serving 10,000+ financial advisors and $180B+ in platform assets.

**What You’ll Do**

- Build and lead the Hyderabad securities operations function: define the operating model, hire the leadership team, plan the workforce and transition processes from the U.S., while developing managers and succession plans.

- Oversee the end-to-end trade lifecycle (model rebalancing, trade processing, settlement, breaks and fails) across equities, fixed income, mutual funds, options and derivatives.

- Oversee transaction and tax lot accounting, custody and asset servicing (corporate actions, income, cash movement, transfers), reconciliation, security master, pricing, fee and billing, and investment performance reporting.

- Set and report KPIs (SLA, accuracy, cost per transaction, cycle time, resolution speed) to U.S. leadership, and drive continuous improvement and rapid outage detection and resolution.

- Maintain a strong control environment: ensure regulatory compliance, audit readiness and root cause remediation of incidents, partnering with Risk, Compliance and Audit.

- Lead automation, AI and platform consolidation initiatives with Product, Technology, Client Service and Finance, and manage budgets and cost per account targets.

**What You Bring**

- 10-15+ years in financial services or investment operations, with 5-8+ years leading multi-function, large-scale teams.

- Track record of building, scaling or transitioning U.S.-facing operations teams from India, ideally in a GCC or captive environment.

- Deep knowledge of the U.S. securities lifecycle: trade processing, T+1 settlement, transaction and tax lot accounting, reconciliation, custody, corporate actions and asset servicing.

- Experience in wealth management or RIA platforms, and with trading, custody and back-office systems such as Broadridge, Vestmark, Aladdin, SimCorp, Eagle, Advent or FactSet.

- Expertise in operational controls, risk management and regulatory compliance, with a data-driven approach and experience reducing cost per account.

- Executive communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and lead platform transformation, automation or AI initiatives.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with TAMPs, model portfolios, separately managed accounts (SMAs) or multi-strategist offerings.
* Exposure to investment performance measurement, GIPS and attribution.
* Lean Six Sigma, process excellence or transformation leadership experience.
* CFA, CIPM or FRM certification.
* MBA or advanced degree.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics or a related field (required).
* MBA or advanced degree (preferred).

**Role Details**

* Working hours: 4pm - 2am, with overlap with U.S. business hours as needed
* Experience: 10–15+ years
* Team: Securities Operations, Hyderabad Technology Center

**About AssetMark**

AssetMark is a leading U.S. wealth management platform with one clear mission: to help independent financial advisors make a profound difference in the lives of their clients. Founded in 1996, we’ve spent 30 years combining powerful technology, curated investment solutions and expert business consulting to help advisors grow their practices and deliver stronger outcomes for the families they serve. Today, AssetMark is independent and privately owned, and continues to grow with purpose.

**Our impact by the numbers**

* 10,000+ financial advisors partner with AssetMark
* 340,000+ investor households served
* $180B+ in platform assets
* 1,100+ employees across the U.S. and India
* Headquartered in Concord, California, with offices in Phoenix, Chicago, Charlotte, Atlanta and Hyderabad

**Recognised by the industry (2025)**

* Technology/Solutions Provider of the Year - MMI/Barron’s Industry Awards
* America’s Best TAMPs: Best Overall, Best Advisor Development and Best Service - WealthAdvisor
* CEO of the Year, Michael Kim - ThinkAdvisor Luminaries
* Top 10 Operations Team - OnCon Icon Awards

**Built in Hyderabad, trusted across America**

Our Hyderabad Technology Center is a vital part of AssetMark’s India GCC. Teams here build and run the platforms, operations and digital experiences that thousands of financial advisors depend on every day. You’ll work side by side with colleagues across the United States on work that directly shapes how families plan, invest and secure their financial future.

**What we stand for**

* **Heart**
  - We make a real difference for our teammates, clients, investors and communities.
* **Excellence**
  - We learn fast, keep improving and innovate together to find better solutions.
* **Respect**
  - We are authentic and inclusive, and we value every voice while winning together.
* **Integrity**
  - We do the right thing, always, even when it’s hard.
* **Client Success**
  - We focus relentlessly on what matters to our clients and build lasting relationships.

**Why AssetMark?**

We are a company on the move, shaping the future of financial services. Here, your ideas are heard, valued and turned into meaningful change. You’ll be part of a team that combines technology, insight and collaboration to create new possibilities for advisors, for our investors and for each other.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

AssetMark values diversity of thought and background and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Ready to grow your career in global wealth management? Apply now.

Follow @AssetMarkGlobalwealth on LinkedIn for life at our Hyderabad Technology Center and new openings.

title: Manager - Travel & Immigration - Human Capital
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a Travel Manager to join our team in Hyderabad and own the firm’s travel function end to end—policy, supplier negotiations, platform and vendor management, ticketing oversight, and the billing and reporting that sit behind it. This is a hands-on, single-owner role for someone who can run day-to-day travel operations reliably while also treating travel as a spend category to be benchmarked, negotiated, and continuously improved. The Immigration and travel team manages the firm’s global needs, by liaising with employees for their visa, travel and permanent residency processes across entities while coordinating with embassies, consulates, travel vendors and external immigration consultants.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will own and monitor the firmwide travel policy—covering class-of-travel entitlements, advance-booking windows, rate caps, per diems, approval thresholds, and the exception process—and benchmark it against peers and published market data, comparing policy terms, negotiated rates, service fees, and traveler entitlements to recommend changes with a clear cost and traveler-experience rationale. You will run periodic corporate fare and hotel programme negotiations with airlines, hotels, and ground-support providers, securing discounted fares, corporate rate codes, volume-based rebates, and soft benefits such as upgrades, lounge access, waived change fees, and last-room availability, and manage the firm’s travel vendors and booking platform. You will oversee pricing and ticketing—the issuance, reissuance, cancellation, and refund of tickets, including turnaround times and the accuracy of routing, fare rules, and traveler details. You will track unused tickets, credit shells, and refunds due from airlines and hotels to ensure they are applied or recovered before they expire, a common source of leakage, and review booking lead times and change patterns to address the behaviors that drive avoidable cost. You will also verify billing and handle reconciliation, accounting, and controls, and analyze the firm’s travel patterns—spend against budget, savings realized against negotiated rates, compliance rate, cost per trip, average ticket price, and supplier performance—while building the annual travel budget and forecast with Finance and explaining variances. Finally, you will manage stakeholders and communication, coordinating group and event travel for offsites, recruiting events, and large internal meetings, and working with the firm’s other offices and global travel counterparts to keep terms, suppliers, and the traveler experience consistent where it makes sense.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold -
  
  
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* Roughly 10 years of relevant experience in corporate travel—either in-house at a large corporate, ideally a multinational or financial services firm, or in the travel industry (travel management company or online travel platform) servicing large corporate accounts
* At least 3 to 4 years owning a travel program end to end, rather than executing bookings within someone else’s program
* A demonstrable track record of negotiating airline and hotel agreements and delivering measurable, evidenced savings
* Hands-on experience with an online booking and expense platform (for example, SAP Concur, Navan, or a comparable tool) and working familiarity with a GDS
* Practical knowledge of domestic and international ticketing, fare construction and fare rules
* Experience of invoice verification and reconciliation, and of working with Finance on accruals, cost allocation, and audit queries

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* An MBA or a postgraduate qualification in travel and tourism, hospitality, supply chain, or finance
* IATA/UFTAA certification or GDS certification (Amadeus, Sabre, or Galileo)

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/MgrTraImmHCAug2026
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.

description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

* Responsible for the overall operation and maintenance (both routine and emergency) of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations of Data Centers. Has primary responsibility for availability zone of Data Centers.

* Liaising with internal teams & management groups. Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency
* Participates in strategic planning projects. Helping in design, build and bring online new Data Centers. Negotiates and rolls out contracts and space.
* Assisting & managing relationships with vendors & contractors.
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance. Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes.
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management and reporting. Deliver quality service and ensure all customer demands are met.
* Participates in recruiting efforts and performance management of the existing team. Continually raises the bar.
* Conducts financial analysis and contributes to financial decisions. Procurement for DCEO related expenditure
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers.
* Responsible for asset and inventory management.
* Assist in the design and build out of new facilities & multiple projects to increase current facility efficiency. Oversee the build out of Facility-specific infrastructure in existing locations.

About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth

title: Clinical Trial Supply Manager
description:
**Summary**

It is not intended to represent all of the specific responsibilities of the position. -Has operational end to end responsibility for assigned supply activities. Leads and manages projects of different complexity and local network activities and participates in cross-functional teams. -Produces, packages and manufactures drugs to be used in clinical trials. Responsible for distribution, warehousing, transportation, packaging, randomization, blinding, and labeling of material for clinical trials in conformity with guidelines of the International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP). -Has operational end to end responsibility for assigned supply activity. Leads and manages demanding projects and network activities and participates in cross-functional teams.

**About The Role**
**Major Accountabilities**

* Represents GCS as a core member in the Clinical Trial Team (CTT); defines and advises the CTT on the optimal clinical trial supply strategy in terms of, but not limited to, packaging design, technical and timeline feasibility, efficiency, and risk management.
* Reviews overall clinical trial protocol/protocol amendments, provides inputs to develop optimal packaging design, clinical trial supply design and visit schedule.
* Creates and maintains complete and accurate clinical supply demand for assigned study in alignment with protocol requirements, key study parameters and milestones, patient projections, with appropriate overage and by using defined processes and systems.
* Creates and drives finalization of the packaging design (Clinical Packaging Request) and a comprehensive label strategy for all participating countries in the clinical trial.
* Defines clinical supply parameters for IRT set up and initiates subsequent updates throughout the duration of the clinical trial.
* Develops and executes a trial-level project plan together with all other relevant roles.
* Identifies, assesses, and proactively communicates supply risks to all relevant stakeholders along with appropriate mitigation strategies to ensure supply continuity.
* Collaborates with all relevant line function partners for country submission and approval timelines to develop optimal supply strategy.
* Generates optimal distribution plans for investigational medicinal products (IMPs), jointly with partner functions. Triggers and tracks shipments of IMPs from central depot to regional hubs and local depots.
* Develops, maintains, and executes an optimal resupply strategy with proactive planning, appropriate lead-time, and replenishment quantities to ensure compliance and continuity of clinical supplies, including proactive expiry management of clinical supplies.
* Is responsible to consolidate, maintain and track the clinical trial budget with key stakeholders for overall GCS external cost (e.g., labels, packaging, distribution, and comparators).
* Actively contributes to the GCS sub team as a full member. Ensures adequate, proactive exchange of relevant knowledge & information between the GCS sub team and the CTT. Fully supports, prepares the GCS PL to adequately address GCS-considerations at various cross-functional teams e.g., TRD sub team, ICT, etc.

**Minimum Requirement**

* > 5 years of practical experience in clinical supplies within the pharmaceutical industry
* Strong operational excellence with high attention to detail. Advanced project management, good organization, and planning skills
* Broad technical knowledge in appropriate Supply Chain systems used for forecasting and demand planning (minimum 3 years of expertise with SAP). Data & Digital savviness with high learning agility
* Knowledge of relevant regulations (e.g., GMP, HSE etc.)
* Master’s or Doctorate in life sciences (or MBA with bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience in life science)

This role flexes across two tracks depending on team needs and where your strengths lie: an Audience-facing track, where you act as the primary bridge between a specific line of business and the Workforce Management function, translating business goals into capacity plans and performance reporting; and a Technical track, where you directly supervise the team of planners who build the forecasts and schedules for all in-house and outsourced sites, focusing on the technical accuracy of capacity models and the tools behind them. * Manage and develop a team of Workforce Planners, Schedulers, and Real Time Analysts (typically 5-7 direct reports), setting clear priorities and holding the team accountable to results

* Directly supervise the team of planners building forecasts and schedules for all in-house and outsourced sites
* Own the technical accuracy of capacity models, forecasting methodology, and underlying assumptions
* Ensure planning tools and systems are used to their full potential, and lead improvements to the models, templates, and tools themselves
* Translate high-level goals into precise, data-driven staffing blueprints the broader team can execute against

* You have 5-7 years of experience in workforce management, capacity planning, or operations, including experience leading or directly managing a team

description:

As Manager GES H2R Hyderabad and in line with the GES vision, you will lead and manage the GES H2R Hyderabad organization driving end-to-end service delivery across Learning, Mobility and Benefits, with a strong focus on exceptional user experience, operational excellence, data-driven performance, and continuous improvement. You will build capabilities, lead change, and enable innovative solutions across processes, tools, and partnerships, while ensuring that the Hyderabad team operates with strong governance, compliance, customer orientation, and global stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate the GES vision into clear priorities for the GES H2R Hyderabad organization, positioning the team as a strategic partner that creates value for HR, employees, people managers, business leaders, and global stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the Hyderabad-based GES H2R teams across Learning, Mobility and Benefits, fostering a high-performance, customer-focused culture and building scalable capabilities for a sizeable and growing organization.

* Drive operational excellence through disciplined service management, process simplification, quality improvement, automation opportunities, and effective use of HR technology, tools, data, and partner solutions.
* Lead key GES H2R projects, initiatives, and change management activities, ensuring strong execution, stakeholder engagement, adoption, and sustainable value realization across processes and services.
* Manage and influence senior stakeholders globally, including HRLT, Global HRBPs, Regional HR Heads, Business Leaders, People Managers, HR Effectiveness, internal partners, and external vendors, ensuring transparency, trust, and alignment on service expectations.
* Define, monitor, and drive performance against KPIs and success measures, including employee satisfaction, turnaround times, accuracy, productivity, compliance, cost effectiveness, governance, and risk management, using insights to continuously enhance service quality and user experience.

**We bring**

* A science‑led company with cutting‑edge research and creativity at its core.
* A collaborative, people‑centered culture where diverse perspectives are valued and encouraged.
* Opportunities to grow through curiosity, continuous improvement, and exposure to a global environment.
* A strong focus on inclusion, development, and shared ownership.
* A workplace where your expertise and voice directly contribute to serving our customers better.

**You bring**

title: Advisory Deputy Manager - Class Action Settlement Administration
description:
**Job Description**
At EisnerAmper India, we welcome individuals who share a passion for new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Deputy Manager**
to join our growing Advisory Team to help us in Settlement Administration Services.
  
  
**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry.
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance.
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards.

+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions.
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation.
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work.
+ Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion (DE&I) efforts.

**What work you will be responsible for:**
The Deputy Manager, Settlement Administration Services position performs various assigned tasks related to client engagements. The Deputy Manager communicates with team members, vendors, and clients, and performs various project management and data analysis functions. As the Deputy Manager assumes and demonstrates the ability to perform greater levels of responsibility, work assignments of increasing difficulty and complexity are assigned. The position may supervise the work of Staff and Intern Consultants, as needed.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Legal Administration professionals, providing regular coaching, feedback, and performance support.
* Allocate resources and manage team workload, and assist leadership with capacity planning, resource forecasting, and operational planning, to ensure timely completion of project deliverables.
* Conduct quality reviews, and establish and monitor quality control measures and process compliance standards, to maintain consistency, confidentiality, and adherence to firm standards and protocols.
* Support project planning and documentation by gathering requirements.
* Oversee multiple class action administration and legal administration engagements simultaneously, completing tasks efficiently and ensuring delivery within agreed timelines and budget constraints.
* Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, and implement mitigation strategies.
* Comply with professional and firm requirements, including time entry and employee handbook guidelines.
* Communicate issues or concerns to supervisors and proactively seek guidance when needed.
* Demonstrate strong analytical skills and perform tasks with professionalism and integrity.
* Develop proficiency in firm software, training materials, and presentations while exhibiting adaptability and leadership skills
* Drive process enhancement initiatives—including identifying automation opportunities and collaborating with technology teams—to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability of Legal Administration operations.
* Develop, review, and maintain SOPs, operational guidelines, and best practices across projects.
* Analyze operational data and trends to provide insights and recommendations to leadership on productivity improvements, risk reduction, and project performance.
* Support knowledge management initiatives and establish reusable templates, training materials, and process repositories.

**Other Responsibilities:**

* Able to periodically work overtime and weekends to meet project or client needs.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Post graduate / Bachelor’s degree in fields related to Business, Legal, Information Systems and Decision Sciences, Data/Computer Science, Marketing/Communications, or an approved related field is required.

**Preferred / Desired Skills:**

* Five or more years of consulting advisory (Legal Administration/ Settlement Administration) or knowledge or prior/academic experience related to (a) Legal Administration consulting and advisory services or (b) Legal Administration project management services is preferred.
* Possess a capacity for quickly understanding new concepts, workflows, and systems.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks with a strong attention to detail and accuracy; PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or a related credential preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills. Professionally and appropriately communicate with a diverse group of individuals.
* Demonstrate a positive attitude and proactive nature.
* Critical thinking skill capabilities are essential.
* Exhibit a high degree of professionalism and maintain the highest level of confidentiality.
* Able to work in a highly organized manner within a fast-paced, innovative, and continuously changing environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and with teams.
* Advanced proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (specifically Excel, Word, and Outlook), Power BI, Monday.com, Power Automate, or similar project management and automation tools.
* We strongly believe in a supportive work environment where all our colleagues can succeed. EisnerAmper India is proud to be an Equal Opportunity merit-based employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste & religion, disabilities, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status.

**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 4500 employees and more than 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
  
  
Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms, and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India:**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 900 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.

**Key Skills**

* Experience Design

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

**Job Description Summary:**
**Job Description: Team Manager, RCM Coding**

At ModMed, we are placing doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty-specific cloud platform. We envision a world where the software we build increases medical-practice success and improves patient outcomes.
  
  
When you join our team, you embody our core values:
  
  
Create customer delight
  
  
Save time
  
  
Innovate boldly, then make things happen
  
  
Align passion with purpose
  
  
Think big. Have fun. Do good.
  
  
**Position Title Team Manager, RCM Medical Coding**
Reports To Wendy Rogers, Manager, Medical Coding
  
  
Role Type - People Manager
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Team Manager, RCM Coding (Supervisor, Medical Coding & Auditing)\*\* serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in multi-specialty medical coding, documentation compliance, and quality assurance. In this role, you will direct and empower an internal coding team, streamlining day-to-day workflows, auditing performance, and driving continuous process improvement. You will also oversee the accuracy and quality of our global coding vendor partners, ensuring our BOOST clients receive high-caliber coding support that optimizes practice success.
  
  
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**
Operational Leadership & Quality Assurance Management
  
  
Direct and manage the internal department’s day-to-day coding and auditing processes.
  
  
Establish quality assurance workflows, establish guidelines, and delegate work across internal and global teams to optimize operational efficiency.
  
  
Oversee coding and billing compliance monitoring for gGastro/gMed and EMA/PM BOOST clients.
  
  
Subject Matter Expertise & Query Support
  
  
Serve as the primary coding SME for ModMed India COE coders and the broader BOOST team.
  
  
Resolve complex coding queries, documentation clarifications, and billing items to ensure accurate claim generation.
  
  
Vendor Oversight & Denial Mitigation
  
  
Partner with the Manager of Medical Coding and Auditing to conduct recurring quality calls with global coding vendors.
  
  
Analyze coding denial trends, drive root-cause analysis, lead knowledge transfer sessions, and conduct regular trainings for internal and vendor teams.
  
  
**Process Innovation & Documentation**
Proactively design, create, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), and client-specific instruction sets for gMed and EMA/PM platforms.
  
  
Develop client-facing communications and workflow guides to elevate client understanding of coding best practices.
  
  
People Management, Compliance & Team Development
  
  
Partner with the People Team (Talent Acquisition and Business Partners) to recruit, interview, onboard, and train top talent.
  
  
Conduct regular 1:1 performance meetings (weekly/biweekly) and execute annual and mid-year performance reviews.
  
  
Mentor staff to maximize potential, efficiency, and professional growth.
  
  
Participate in BOOST committee calls to assess coding requirements and resolve compliance items.
  
  
**Key Attributes & Organizational Scope**
**Leadership Competencies (Priority Focus)**
Team Leadership: Builds high-performing, engaged teams through empathetic leadership, continuous coaching, and strategic talent development.
  
  
Results Driven: Consistently achieves high-quality outcomes, overcomes obstacles, and inspires others to excel.
  
  
Customer Focus: Establishes strong relationships internally and externally, delivering client-centric solutions that create true customer delight.
  
  
Business Savvy: Applies technical and industry coding expertise to elevate team efficiency and positively impact overall business health.
  
  
Communication & Analysis Complexities
  
  
Global Scope: Communicates cross-functionally across multiple business units, countries (US & India), and globally across the enterprise.
  
  
Disseminates critical operational updates internally and externally.
  
  
Problem Solving & Decision Making: Solves complex coding scenarios, resolves team workflow roadblocks, and establishes guidelines for client success.
  
  
Acts as the final authority on operational coding procedures and day-to-day task delegation.
  
  
Innovation: Continuously modernizes workflows, develops training presentations, and builds comprehensive knowledge-transfer materials to boost accuracy
  
  
**Job Qualifications & Requirements**
**Minimum Requirements**
Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Required Certification:Active certification in at least one of the following:
  
  
Certified Professional Coder
  
  
Certified Outpatient Coder
  
  
Certified Coding Specialist - Physician
  
  
**Experience & Skills:**
Demonstrated background in multi-specialty medical coding and documentation auditing.
  
  
Proven leadership capability or team management experience.
  
  
Strong expertise with physician billing workflows and electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Active \*\*Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA)\*\* certification in addition to CPC, COC, or CCS-P.
  
  
Direct experience working with EMA/PM or gGastro/gMed platforms. Previous experience managing global vendor performance and remote team dynamics.

**Role Title: VP, IAM End User Operations (L14)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are
  
  
shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.
  
  
Specifically,
  
  

* Lead and manage the IAM End User Operations team focused on End User Services, including IAM automation engineers, administrators, and support specialists.
* Oversee day-to-day operations of user identity lifecycle management, access provisioning/de-provisioning, access reviews, self-service workflows, and password management tools.
* Drive continuous improvement in IAM operations by optimizing automation, workflows, and integration with IT service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Collaborate closely with IAM Solution Architects, Security, IT infrastructure, and business partners to ensure operational readiness, platform health, and scalability of IAM solutions.
* Develop and enforce operational standards, SLAs, and KPIs to monitor service performance and user experience quality.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution efforts related to end-user identity and access issues.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI, NIST).
* Champion adoption of best practices around zero trust, privileged access, and identity governance in daily operations.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for the operations team.
* Partner with automation and DevSecOps teams to deploy and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automated IAM provisioning processes.
* Facilitate communication and training for end-users and support teams to improve IAM awareness and compliance.
* Stay current with emerging IAM operational technologies, tools, and industry trends to continuously enhance the IAM service portfolio.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
* Proven experience leading or managing teams responsible for IAM service delivery, identity lifecycle management, and end-user access support.
* Strong communication skills and executive presence needed.
* Knowledge of IAM tool platforms used for standard and privileged access management as well as authentication (ie. Delinea, Okta, SailPoint IIQ)
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools such as SailPoint, Okta, Beyond Identity, Delinea, Microsoft Entra ID, and directory services like Active Directory.
* Experience managing identity provisioning, password resets, authentication services, and access governance activities at scale.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, SCIM) in operational contexts.
* Familiarity with cloud IAM models (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating hybrid IAM ecosystems operationally.
* Knowledge of automation tools and DevSecOps principles applied in IAM environments (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD).
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with proven stakeholder management experience.
* Demonstrated commitment to exceptional customer service and continuous operational improvement.
* Experience working within regulatory frameworks affecting IAM operations such as SOX IT-404, GDPR, PCI, and financial industry controls.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Okta Certified Administrator, SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer, or similar.
* Experience managing large-scale IAM operational teams in financial services or regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust principles as applied to IAM operations.
* Self-starter, able to adapt and thrive in a fast-changing, dynamic environment.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
  
  
**Work Timings**

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. title: Manager / Senior Manager – Quality
description:
**Company:**
Deccan Enterprises Private Limited

**Company Description:**
Deccan Enterprises Private Limited is a leading manufacturer in India’s power transmission sector, specializing in 765kV HVAC and 800kV HVDC composite insulators and advanced transmission solutions. As India’s largest manufacturer of composite insulators, Deccan serves customers across 35+ countries, supporting grid reliability, renewable energy integration, and infrastructure development. As a
**Great Place to Work® Certified**
organization, Deccan is committed to fostering an employee-centric workplace built on growth, collaboration, and continuous learning, where attitude and aptitude are valued above formal qualifications and prior experience.

**Role Description:**
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Quality Manager / Senior Quality Manager to lead the Quality function at our manufacturing facility. The role involves ensuring consistent product and process quality, compliance with IEC/IS standards, effective implementation of the Integrated Management System (IMS), customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise, hands-on manufacturing quality experience, and the ability to independently lead audits, resolve quality issues, and drive process improvements.

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Mode of Work:**
100% In-Office (On-Site)

**Experience:**

**Manager – Quality:**
8–12 Years

**Senior Manager – Quality:**
10–15 Years

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Product & Process Quality:**

* Manage incoming, in-process, and final quality inspection of FRP rods, silicone compounds, metal end fittings, and finished composite insulators.
* Establish and maintain Quality Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), Control Plans, SOPs, and work instructions.
* Monitor critical process parameters in silicone moulding, crimping, assembly, and finishing, implementing Statistical Process Control (SPC) for key characteristics.
* Ensure routine, sample, and acceptance testing in accordance with IEC 61109, IEC 62217, IEC 62231, IEC 61952, and customer specifications.
* Conduct supplier audits, evaluate supplier performance, and drive supplier quality development.

* **Laboratory & Testing:**

* Ensure calibration, Measurement System Analysis (MSA), and traceability of all inspection, measuring, and testing equipment.
* Oversee mechanical and electrical testing activities, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and compliance with applicable standards.
* Experience with NABL laboratory accreditation is an added advantage.

* **Integrated Management System (IMS) & Audits:**

* Lead implementation and maintenance of IMS covering ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001, including document control, records, management reviews, and compliance.
* Plan and conduct periodic internal audits as per the annual audit schedule, ensuring timely closure of non-conformities with effective corrective actions.
* Lead certification body surveillance and recertification audits, targeting zero major non-conformities.
* Independently manage customer audits, vendor approval audits, and inspections by utilities, EPC contractors, and international customers.

* **Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement:**

* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using 8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa, Pareto, FMEA, and Poka-Yoke, ensuring effective implementation and verification of CAPA.
* Handle customer complaints and field failures, ensuring timely investigation, corrective action, and closure.
* Monitor and analyse quality KPIs, including rejection rates, rework, First Pass Yield (FPY), PPM, customer complaints, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
* Conduct monthly quality performance reviews and present findings and improvement plans to management.
* Collaborate with Production, Maintenance, Purchase, and Engineering teams to reduce defects, improve process capability, and strengthen overall product quality.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from a reputed institution.
* Manager: 8–12 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control in manufacturing.
* Senior Manager: 10–15 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control in manufacturing.
* Automotive component manufacturing quality experience is preferred.
* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification is mandatory. ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 Internal Auditor certification is preferred.
* Proven experience independently managing customer audits, certification audits, and quality improvement initiatives.
* Strong hands-on experience with mechanical and electrical testing equipment.

**Key Skills & Technical Competencies:**

* Six Sigma methodologies: DMAIC, DFSS, and structured process improvement.
* Statistical Process Control (SPC): Cp, Cpk, Process Sigma, and process capability analysis.
* Core Quality Tools: RCA, Fishbone Diagram, FMEA, PFMEA, CAPA, PPAP, 8D, 5 Why, and Poka-Yoke.
* Advanced Excel proficiency, including data analysis, Pivot Tables, quality dashboards, and MIS reporting.
* Equipment calibration, MSA, measurement traceability, and test result analysis.
* Strong understanding of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and applicable IEC/IS standards.
* Strong leadership, analytical thinking, technical problem-solving, cross-functional coordination, and communication skills.

title: Senior Director, India- CFO Organization
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
Seismic is seeking an experienced and versatile business leader to provide India leadership across the Finance, Information Technology and Information Security organizations.
  
  
This is a broad general management role within the CFO organization. The Senior Director will lead and enable accomplished functional leaders including Directors, Senior Managers and subject matter experts while ensuring strong alignment between India priorities and the global strategies of Finance, IT and Information Security.
  
  
This position will have dual reporting to the President and Managing Director, India and the Global Chief Financial Officer. The role will also work closely with global functional leaders responsible for Finance, IT and Information Security.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong business judgment, the ability to lead senior functional talent, and experience operating effectively within a complex, globally matrixed organization. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in at least one of the relevant functions, along with demonstrated leadership, oversight or partnership across the others.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* At least 20+ years of progressive leadership experience across corporate or general and administrative functions, with substantial experience in Finance, Information Technology, Information Security or a closely related area.
* Deep functional expertise in Finance, including adequate knowledge of IT or Information Security, combined with demonstrated experience leading, overseeing or partnering effectively across the other functions.
* Experience leading senior managers, functional leaders and subject-matter experts in a multidisciplinary environment.
* Significant experience operating in India within a US-headquartered multinational organization; experience in a SaaS or enterprise software company is preferred.
* Experience working within a global matrix and balancing local organizational needs with global functional strategies, standards and accountabilities.
* Strong general-management orientation, commercial judgment, and the ability to connect functional priorities with broader business outcomes.
* Demonstrated success in building organizations, developing leadership capability, and creating high-performing, engaged teams.
* Strong executive presence, with excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to build trusted relationships and influence outcomes across different functions, geographies, and levels of leadership.
* Strong critical thinking, analytical, problem solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Experience managing multiple complex initiatives, setting priorities, and driving execution in a fast-moving environment.
* Sound understanding of governance, compliance, controls and enterprise risk in the Indian business environment.
* Bachelor's degree in business, Finance, Technology, Engineering or a related discipline is required.
* Master’s degree / Professional Certification in Finance, Technology or a related discipline is preferred.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Provide leadership for employees across Finance, Information Technology and Information Security, while maintaining close alignment with the respective global functional leaders.
* Lead, coach and enable a team of experienced functional leaders and subject-matter experts, creating clarity of ownership, accountability and collaboration across the organization.
* Translate global functional strategies into effective India execution plans, taking into consideration local business priorities, regulatory requirements and talent-market conditions.
* Partner with the President and Managing Director, India, the Global Chief Financial Officer and other executive leaders to understand business priorities and ensure that the India CFO organization is positioned to support them.
* Serve as a member of both the India leadership team and the CFO leadership team, representing the India organization and contributing to enterprise-wide decisions.
* Establish an effective operating rhythm across the three functions, including business reviews, workforce planning, priority setting, risk management, the escalation of critical issues and driving AI-led growth opportunities.
* Build strong relationships with CFO organization peers and functional leaders in other geographies to ensure consistency, transparency, and effective global collaboration.
* Partner with functional leaders and People teams to attract, retain, develop and engage high-performing talent across Finance, IT and Information Security.
* Build leadership capability and succession pipelines within the India organization, with particular focus on developing strong functional leaders and future enterprise talent.
* Promote a culture of collaboration in which local and global teams share knowledge, solve problems collectively, and operate with clear accountability.
* Support appropriate governance, controls, compliance and risk-management practices across the functions, in partnership with the relevant global subject-matter experts.
* Sponsor and oversee cross-functional programs and transformation initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness, operational scalability, and employee experience.
* Provide clear, timely, and executive-level communication regarding business progress, organizational health, risks, dependencies, and decisions.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
  
  
Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
  
  
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Customer Support Operations Manager - D2C & E-commerce
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad (in-office)

**Function:**
Customer Experience & Operations

**Reports to:**
Operations Lead / Founders

Earthful is a plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. This role owns the support floor: every customer ticket, every escalation, every delivery exception that reaches us, and the SOPs and AI chat agent that handle them. It is a brand-side D2C role. We are looking for someone who has already led an in-house support floor at a D2C or e-commerce brand and wants to build the system behind it.

**Role Overview**

You will lead Earthful's customer support floor end to end: the team and its shifts, more than 300 tickets a day across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, email, and calls, and the daily handling of delivery exceptions in ClickPost. You will own the metrics the floor runs on (first response time, resolution time, first-time resolution, CSAT, QA score, and first-attempt delivery), the SOPs that keep every executive and our AI chat agent consistent, and the weekly audit of the AI agent's conversations. Earthful's support SOPs are only partly written today, so you will write and tighten them, not just maintain them. You will work closely with HR on staffing, with 3PL and courier partners on delivery issues, and with Supply Chain, Product, Marketing, and Tech on problems that keep coming back.

**What You'll Own**

**Floor Leadership & Staffing**

• Lead the team of support executives and plan the monthly shift schedule, with full coverage on all days including government holidays

• Run the 9:30 daily huddle and hourly check-ins, and watch real-time dashboards so you see slippage before the customer does

• Track attendance, breaks, and adherence, and flag exceptions to management and HR

• Step in personally during volume spikes and escalations, and assign cases to the executives on shift

• Manage inbound call volume and missed calls

**Ticket & Case Operations**

• Own end-to-end resolution and correct categorization of the daily ticket volume (300+ cases a day) across WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, Instagram and Facebook comments, Messenger, email, and calls

• Oversee order management: cancellations, address updates, profile and item changes, returns, and refunds

• Review refund and replacement requests to confirm the SOP was followed before refunds are processed

• Make sure customer-reported issues (damaged orders, partial delivery, quality issues) are documented accurately and escalated to QA and Operations on time

• Keep replies on YouTube, Instagram, marketplaces, Judge.me, and Kwik Engage timely, on brand, and complete

• Work with the Social Media and Marketing teams so queries from every campaign are answered properly

**Delivery Exceptions & ClickPost**

• Work in ClickPost every day: tracking, delayed shipments, NDR (non-delivery) cases, and fake-delivery claims

• Make sure every NDR gets customer contact on the same day and a recorded outcome

• Raise repeating courier problems with 3PL and courier partners, with evidence, and track them to closure

• Report first-attempt delivery and NDR resolution by courier, and use them to push courier performance

**Metrics & Reporting**

• Own the support metrics: first response time (FRT), average resolution time (ART), average handle time (AHT), first-time resolution, CSAT, NPS, QA score, and backlog ageing, plus first-attempt delivery

• Publish the weekly performance report and present week-on-week progress, with the reasons behind every movement

• Agree targets with management in the first 30 days and hold the team to them

**SOPs, Quality & Training**

• Write and maintain SOPs for every support workflow, from scratch where none exist, and update them when policy, products, or escalation patterns change

• Audit resolved cases every week for SOP adherence, tone, accuracy, and resolution quality, with structured feedback to each executive

• Personally contact every customer who leaves a 1–2 star CSAT rating and make sure it is resolved

• Train new and existing executives on processes, tools, and escalation rules, and keep training records

• Review RCA and R&D inputs from the team and feed the learnings back into the SOPs

**AI Chat Agent Quality**

• Audit the AI chat agent's conversations every week for accuracy, policy adherence, tone, and correct handoff to a human

• Maintain the knowledge base and rules the AI agent works from, built from the same SOPs the team follows

• Track the agent's resolution rate, handoff rate, and CSAT, and fix the failure patterns you find

• Flag any safety-sensitive reply, such as a product reaction or a health question, to Operations and R&D the same day

**Cross-Functional Escalation**

• Be the main point of contact for escalated issues that need more than one team to resolve

• Work with the QA team so cases are documented accurately (issue, batch number, images) and proper RCA is done

• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Product, Marketing, and Tech on repeated issues, and fold the fixes back into the SOPs

• Work with the CRM and other external partners, report tool issues, and evaluate new tools for support operations

**What We're Looking For**

**Required: all of these**

• 4 to 8 years in customer support or customer experience, including at least 2 years leading a live support floor team of 5 or more

• Brand-side background: in-house support at a D2C or e-commerce company. Experience only at an outsourced BPO or call-centre operation is not a fit for this role

• Has run a floor day to day: shift scheduling, adherence, huddles, real-time monitoring, and stepping in during spikes, at 200+ tickets a day across several channels including WhatsApp and Instagram

• Has written SOPs, trained a team against them, and audited adherence

• Has owned a weekly metrics report and can explain what moves each number: FRT, ART, AHT, first-time resolution, CSAT, NPS, QA score, backlog ageing, and first-attempt delivery

• Hands-on with ClickPost for tracking, NDR, and delivery exceptions

• Has audited or trained an AI chatbot or AI chat agent for customer support, reviewing conversations for accuracy, policy, tone, and handoff

• Excellent written English, and comfortable with Hindi

• Comfortable with the working pattern: Mon–Sat, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, alternate Saturdays off

**Strong plus**

• Hands-on with a helpdesk or CRM such as Freshdesk or Zendesk, and WhatsApp Business tooling

• Has handled complaints about health, wellness, or supplement products, including product-reaction escalations

• Has worked with courier or 3PL partners on escalations and performance reviews

• A real discomfort with unresolved problems: someone who chases an issue until it is actually fixed, not just logged

The Ask IS&T Center Operations Lead is a key role within Apple’s IS&T team,responsible for managing day-to-day operations, providing technical guidance, andensuring high-quality support for Apple employees, contractors, and vendors. This rolerequires strong leadership, decision-making, and technical skills to support Apple’sglobal IT infrastructure and services

Ask IS&T Center Operations Leads have a highly developed technical skillset and awide variety of responsibilities ranging from managing and supporting the dailyoperations, making decisions regarding work assignments, workflow, and scheduling (ifadjustments are necessary). As part of IS&T Support Management, Operations Leadsare required to display excellent leadership skills and decision-making ability, along withhaving highly developed time management and prioritization skills. Members of thisteam understand the intricacies and complexities of Apple’s business as well as theoperational dependencies on various applications and services for all of IS&T supportedsystems. Operations Leads also work proactively, seeing around corners to identifyemerging high priority issues and action items impacting Apple’s business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver an Extraordinary Customer Experience: Champion Apple’s service ethos by maintaining an inviting, high-touch center environment; advocate for users end-to-end, resolve pain points across walk-in and appointment touchpoints, and actively monitor customer sentiment (CSAT/CSX).

* Champion Events & Community Engagement: Support campus community engagement initiatives, including site pop-up clinics, Guided Setup for new hires, and technical/AV support for hybrid executive events and presentations.
