title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About SmartQ**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…

**Are you excited to join our team as Key Account Manager?**

Are you passionate about operational efficiency and committed to fostering strong, value-driven client relationships, we invite you to explore this opportunity.

As a Key Account Manager at SmartQ, your primary goal will be to ensure client satisfaction, long-term retention, and sustainable growth across food court operations. Fostering, sustainable, and profitable relationships with key clients to maximize business opportunities lies at the heart of this role. In addition, a combination of interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of the clients and products will keep you functioning a cut above the rest.

**Key roles and responsibilities:**

**Client & Food Court Account Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for food court clients, mall management, and key stakeholders, ensuring high service standards and strong long-term partnerships.
* Lead regular client meetings, food committee discussions, and food court performance reviews to evaluate operations, sales, and customer experience, and to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive client satisfaction, retention, Net Promoter Score (NPS) improvement, and sustainable growth of food court accounts.
* Develop and present commercial proposals, partner onboarding plans, and business recommendations aligned with food court and client requirements.

**Food Court Operations Management**

* Oversee end-to-end food court operations, including multiple brand partners, daily service delivery, promotions, special events, pop-up counters, and special activations.
* Ensure food court operations are executed in line with SmartQ standards, SLAs, contractual terms, and applicable statutory regulations.
* Monitor food quality, service delivery, hygiene, safety, and customer experience consistently across all food court outlets.
* Ensure optimal utilization of resources, including manpower, utilities, infrastructure, and SmartQ technology platforms.
* Plan and manage manpower deployment and scheduling across the food court within approved budgets, aligned with footfall and sales trends.

**Brand Partner & Vendor Management**

* Manage end-to-end relationships with food court brand partners and vendors, including onboarding, negotiations, performance management, and compliance.
* Work closely with brand partners to improve sales performance, introduce new menu concepts, optimize pricing, and reduce food wastage.
* Ensure timely settlements, accurate documentation, compliance adherence, and effective resolution of operational or commercial issues.
* Support partners with operational insights, best practices, and improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and profitability.

**Financial & Commercial Management**

* Own food court–level P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and expense control in alignment with approved financial plans.
* Coordinate with the finance team to ensure accurate invoicing, revenue reconciliation, and timely payment follow-ups.
* Analyze food court sales, wastage, and cost metrics to implement revenue enhancement and cost-optimization initiatives.
* Drive upselling, cross-selling, and promotional opportunities across food court brands to maximize overall revenue.

**Compliance, Audits & HSEQ**

* Ensure strict adherence to HSEQ, food safety, hygiene, and statutory compliance standards across all food court outlets.
* Conduct and manage operational audits, QHSE audits, hygiene inspections, and partner compliance reviews.
* Prepare, implement, and track corrective action plans in coordination with the HSEQ team and food court partners for identified non-conformities.
* Maintain accurate documentation, compliance records, and audit reports for client, statutory, and internal reviews.

**Data Analytics & Reporting**

* Leverage data analytics to track food court performance, footfall-to-sales conversion, partner productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Prepare Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), MIS reports, dashboards, and client presentations focused on food court KPIs.
* Use insights from customer feedback, surveys, audits, and sales data to drive continuous improvement in service quality, partner performance, and menu mix.

**Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor, and guide on-site food court operations teams, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and customer focus.
* Ensure team performance management, training, engagement, and retention across food court operations.
* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders—technology, finance, HSEQ, central operations, and sales—to ensure seamless food court management.
* Maintain continuous coordination with the technology team to ensure smooth functioning, adoption, and optimization of SmartQ food-tech platforms.

**Branding & Growth Initiatives**

* Support food court branding, marketing campaigns, festivals, and customer engagement initiatives at client locations.
* Communicate updates on new brand onboardings, menu launches, promotional offers, and operational enhancements to clients and stakeholders.
* Drive food court growth initiatives by identifying expansion opportunities, new partnerships, and experience-led improvements.

**Qualifications:**

* Overall, 6+ years of experience, with a minimum of 4 years in a similar role.
* Graduate/Diploma in Hotel Management or related discipline.
* Flexible and willing to take on various tasks to support team efforts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound knowledge and experience working with food, technology, and leveraging people.
* Results-oriented, accountable, and able to hold others accountable.
* Proven experience in managing successful teams in a similar environment.
* Basic Food Hygiene certificate and knowledge of HSEQ standards.
* Self-motivated, agile, and able to adapt to a changing environment.

**Message from CEO:**

We've come to realize that we're not merely in the B2B Food service industry; we're in the business of 'Capturing Hearts.' We find ourselves in a unique position to turn ordinary, mundane corporate cafeterias into places of pure delight, where individuals can freely express themselves, find inspiration, and share happiness. Such a profound transformation opportunity is a rare gift, where the purpose of our enterprise transcends the ordinary. If this vision resonates with you, we invite you to join us in our mission to spread joy and happiness in a world weighed down by stress and pressure. Together, let's play our part in making this world a more beautiful place.

**YOU**
to be a part of it.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role: ITSM Manager or Trainer
  
  
Exp: 8-10 Yrs
  
  
Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore/Kolkata
  
  
**Summary**
The ITSM Lead (Sr. Manager) is responsible for defining, governing, and continuously
  
  
improving IT Service Management processes across a rapidly growing global
  
  
organization. This role ensures IT services are delivered consistently, efficiently, and
  
  
with a relentless focus on the customer experience.
  
  
As the company continues to expand its international footprint, this position becomes
  
  
essential in aligning global service delivery to business priorities and maintaining a
  
  
unified ITSM strategy. The ITSM Lead will play a central role in overseeing the launch and
  
  
ongoing performance of a Global Service Desk spanning India, Poland, and Latin
  
  
America, ensuring alignment of processes, standards, and outcomes.
  
  
The ITSM Lead will also drive the evolution of ServiceNow, with a specific focus
  
  
on optimizing Incident and Request Management workflows, enabling process
  
  
automation, and improving transparency and reporting across IT. This position will
  
  
report directly to the Global Head of Support & ITSM.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Service Management Leadership
* Define, mature, and govern ITSM processes across the enterprise—including Incident, Request, Problem, and Knowledge Management—aligned with ITIL best practices and business needs.
* Lead ongoing ServiceNow improvement initiatives, with a strong focus on enhancing Incident and Request Management workflows, automation, and end[1]
* Partner with development teams to design, test, and deploy new ServiceNow capabilities, ensuring scalability and efficiency across global support operations.
* Establish and maintain SLAs, KPIs, and OLAs to drive accountability, transparency, and measurable service quality.
* Ensure all ITSM processes are consistent and adaptable across multiple regions and time zones.
* Global Service Desk Oversight
* Provide leadership and governance over the Global Service Desk operations across India, Poland, and LATAM, ensuring a unified delivery model and consistent customer experience
* Define the operating framework for regional Service Desk pods, ensuring alignment with global ITSM standards and service delivery expectations.
* Monitor global performance metrics, identify trends, and drive initiatives to improve first-contact resolution, response times, and customer satisfaction.
* Partners with regional lead to foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Support the establishment of a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 service continuity and seamless user support globally.
* Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
* Champion process simplification and automation through ServiceNow and other ITSM tools, leveraging analytics to drive continuous improvement.
* Use data-driven insights to identify service trends, eliminate recurring issues, and enhance global operational efficiency.
* Develop and deliver regular executive reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into service health, volume trends, and improvement opportunities.
* Drive ITSM maturity through standardization, governance, and consistent process adoption across all regions.
* Customer Experience & Stakeholder Partnership
* Serve as the voice of the customer, ensuring IT services continuously evolve to meet the needs of the business and end users.
* Collaborate closely with business and IT leaders in the U.S. to ensure alignment between technology service delivery and organizational objectives.
* Provide strategic recommendations on ITSM process improvements, tool enhancements, and support models to optimize service performance.
* Partner with other IT functions (Engineering, InfoSec, Facilities, HR) to ensure seamless collaboration and end-to-end service delivery.
* Leadership & People Development
* Lead, mentor, and develop global ITSM and Service Desk teams, promoting a

culture of collaboration, innovation, and service excellence.
  
  

* Provide clear direction, training, and guidance to ensure alignment with ITSM

standards and best practices.
  
  

* Partner with offshore and regional leaders to build strong local teams

while maintaining centralized governance and process ownership.
  
  
Collaborate with peer IT leaders to ensure global consistency in IT operations
  
  
and customer support.
  
  
**Skills**

* 10+ years of progressive IT operations or ITSM experience, including 5+ years in a
* leadership role within a global or multinational organization.
* Proven experience designing and optimizing ServiceNow Incident and Request
* Management workflows, including automation, reporting, and dashboarding.
* Deep understanding of ITIL best practices and how to apply them in dynamic,
* growth-oriented organizations.
* Experience overseeing or partnering with global Service Desk operations across
* multiple regions or delivery centers.
* Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale process improvement and service
* transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to present data[1]

title: Senior Manager, Growth and Commercial Delivery
description:
**Opportunity Overview**
We are seeking a high-caliber, results-oriented
**Senior Manager, Growth and Commercial Delivery**
to sit at the intersection of sales, account management, and implementation. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end commercial lifecycle for health plan (payer) clients—from driving growth and supporting late-stage sales cycles to leading complex, cross-functional implementations. You will be responsile for ensuring that our commercial commitments translate into operational success and long-term revenue growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Growth & Commercial Strategy: Partner with executive leadership and sales teams to accelerate the growth pipeline, design commercial proposals, and define go-to-market strategies for health plan clients.
* Deal-to-Delivery Transition: Serve as the primary bridge between the sales pipeline and operations, owning the transition from contract signing to live operational delivery.
* Implementation & Delivery Leadership: Oversee cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Data Science) to deploy our AI-driven utilization management solutions on time, within scope, and aligned with client metrics.
* Relationship Management: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and clinical leaders at partner health plans, managing governance structures and steering committees.
* Value Realization & Retention: Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and clinical value metrics to prove ROI, drive contract renewals, and identify upsell opportunities.
* Process Scaling: Build and refine repeatable playbooks, governance models, and delivery frameworks to support rapid company scaling.

**ISMS Roles And Responsibilities**

* Good knowledge of Information security
* Oversee specific business processes within the ISMS.
* Responsible to manage the ISMS documentation, conduct risk assessments, and implement risk treatment plans.
* Risk Owners are responsible for identifying, assessing, and managing risks within their areas of responsibility.
* They are also responsible for implementing risk treatment plans.
* Conduct the BCP and other test related to information security continuity along with CISO
* Responsible for monitoring and reporting on the performance of the ISMS.
* Responsible for implementation of security policies and procedures and report any issues to the CISO.

**What You’ll Need**

* Experience: 6–9 years of professional experience, with at least 3–4 years in healthcare management consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or specialized healthcare firms) or a commercial delivery/implementation role at a high-growth digital health/health tech company.
* Payer Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of US health insurance operations, utilization management, prior authorization, payment integrity, value-based care, or network management.
* Project Management Skills: Proven track record of managing large-scale, multi-million dollar software implementations or strategic transformations with health plans.
* Analytical Rigor: Strong financial and operational acumen with the ability to translate complex data and clinical outcomes into a compelling business case for clients.
* Communication Style: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with comfort navigating difficult conversations and aligning diverse stakeholders.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, or related field required. An MBA or MHA is highly preferred.

**Ability To Commute/relocate**

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

**Interview Process\*:**

* Connect with Talent Acquisition
* Meet with the Hiring Manager
* Behavioral Interview(s)
* Case Study
* Interview with Senior Leadership
* Subject to change

**About Cohere Health**
Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans’ strategic goals and providers’ needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer-provider decision-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction.
  
  
With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we expanded our AI-native platform with a comprehensive Payment Integrity Suite that spans data mining, clinical and coding validation, authorization and claims reconciliation, and end-to-end payment integrity services across pre- and post-pay workflows. By connecting clinical and payment insights, our transparent, AI-powered solutions help health plans proactively improve payment accuracy, reduce waste and vendor dependency, strengthen provider relationships, and build smarter, more efficient payment integrity programs.
  
  
Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry-wide recognition. We’ve been recognized on TIME’s World Top HealthTech Companies 2025 list, the 2025 Inc. 5000 list, in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022-2025), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 & 2024.
  
  
**We can’t wait to learn more about you and meet you at Cohere Health!**
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Cohere Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all. To us, it’s personal.

title: Manager, Configuration Management and CMDB
description:
Role Responsibilities

* As the Manager responsible for the Configuration Management practice, you will own the Configuration Management process and supporting documentation, including policy and standard implementation, procedures, operating controls, RACI, CI ownership, exception management, and evidence required for internal and external assurance activities.
* You will translate the Configuration Management strategy into tactical plans, priorities, and measurable outcomes, ensuring consistent adoption across technology teams, product teams, service owners, support groups, and delivery partners.
* You will report to the Senior Manager, Configuration Management and IT Asset Management (ITAM) and will lead the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of the practice across policy, standards, processes, governance, people, data, and technology.
* You will lead and develop a team responsible for CMDB governance and operations, Discovery, Service Mapping, configuration data quality, reporting, and operational support. You will establish clear roles, accountabilities, work practices, and performance expectations.
* You will govern the enterprise CMDB as an authoritative technology system of record, defining CI scope, classes, attributes, relationships, lifecycle requirements, naming standards, ownership, and approved data sources in alignment with the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
* You will improve CMDB health by establishing controls and remediation routines for completeness, correctness, compliance, duplicates, stale records, lifecycle status, ownership gaps, orphan records, and missing or inaccurate relationships.
* You will oversee ServiceNow Discovery and MID Server operations, including coverage, schedules, credentials, connectivity, error remediation, platform health, data freshness, identification rules, reconciliation rules, and onboarding of new infrastructure and cloud environments.
* You will lead Service Mapping capabilities that connect business applications and services to supporting infrastructure, enabling dependency visibility, operational impact analysis, risk assessment, incident response, change planning, resilience, and auditability.
* You will partner with application, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, architecture, IT Asset Management, Change Enablement, Incident, Problem, Availability, and ServiceNow platform teams to ensure configuration data supports end-to-end service management outcomes.
* You will establish CI certification and attestation routines with technical owners and support groups and drive timely remediation of discrepancies, missing relationships, lifecycle inconsistencies, and discovery gaps.
* You will define Critical Success Factors, Key Performance Indicators, control measures, dashboards, and management reporting for the practice. You will present performance, risks, decisions, and improvement recommendations through regular management reviews and governance forums.
* You will manage practice risks, issues, dependencies, audit findings, and remediation plans, escalating material concerns to the Senior Manager and technology leadership with clear options and recommendations.
* You will govern managed service and vendor delivery for in-scope Configuration Management activities, ensuring that contractual commitments, service levels, process controls, documentation, and quality standards are met.
* You will maintain a prioritized improvement roadmap that increases automation, expands discovery and service coverage, reduces manual effort, improves data trust, and strengthens integration between CMDB, ITAM, security, monitoring, vulnerability, cloud, and other authoritative data sources.
* You will support organizational change, training, communications, and stakeholder adoption so that CI owners and support teams understand and consistently perform their Configuration Management responsibilities.

title: Manager III Operations, Quick Commerce Central Flow, NOC, NOC - Central Flow Quick Commerce
description:
**Description**
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). Building on this legacy, Amazon is now redefining speed through Quick Commerce — delivering to customers in minutes, not days.
  
  
APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control tower for 'Quick Commerce Execution' across Amazon's ultra-fast delivery network. It ensures the hassle-free, on-time flow of inventory across all hops — from hubs to Micro-Fulfillment Centers (MFCs) and onward to the customer. In case of any exceptions, the NOC steps in to resolve the issue in real time and keeps all stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving, the NOC is charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline hyperlocal operations — work that involves live network monitoring and significant analysis of high-velocity delivery data.
  
  
Overall, Quick Commerce Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's ultra-fast delivery promise, and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to delight its customers in minutes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Role**
This role sits at the heart of Central Flow for Quick Commerce, owning end-to-end network flow health across all hops — from hubs into MFCs and every flow in between. As the network's flow steward, the incumbent will:
  
  
Identify egregious metrics in real time — spotting flow disruptors, bottlenecks, and exceptions before they cascade.
  
  
Coordinate actions across teams — mobilizing operations, tech, program, and field teams to keep the network in flow when disruptions hit.
  
  
Build learnings for next time — codifying every intervention into playbooks and reusable recovery frameworks so the network responds faster with each recurrence.
  
  
Track until normal state — owning each disruption from detection through recovery, confirming stabilization before closing the loop.
  
  
Leadership Scope: The incumbent will lead a team of L2s, L3s, and managers. As Quick Commerce scales, this role will continuously evolve to take on new workstreams — the successful candidate must be energized by ambiguity and comfortable building the plane while flying it.
  
  
What We're Looking For: An experienced, hands-on Manager passionate about using data to drive efficiencies and influence decisions. Deep functional knowledge, program-design ability, and defect-reduction experience required. Strong analytical skills and Excel expertise essential; SQL and R/Python a plus. Superb communication, project management, and stakeholder skills, with adeptness in AI tools (Kiro, Amazon Quick).
  
  
**About The Team**
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). Building on this legacy of innovation, Amazon is now redefining speed itself through Quick Commerce — delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes, not days.
  
  
APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control tower for 'Quick Commerce Execution' across Amazon's ultra-fast delivery network. It ensures the hassle-free, on-time flow of inventory from dark stores, micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs), and neighborhood hubs to the customer's doorstep within the promised delivery window (typically 10–30 minutes). In case of any exceptions — a delayed rider, an out-of-stock item, a demand surge, or a hyperlocal supply gap — the NOC steps in in real time to resolve the issue and keeps all stakeholders informed on the proceedings.
  
  
Along with this tactical, real-time problem solving, the NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions across dense delivery zones and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline hyperlocal operations. This second aspect involves live network monitoring, demand forecasting, and significant analysis of high-velocity delivery data.
  
  
Overall, Quick Commerce Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's ultra-fast delivery promise and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to delight its customers in minutes.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* 3+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience establishing processes, workflows, standard procedures and change management

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Triage escalations within the team — and resolve many personally by getting on the phone with the customer; route true escalations to the pod L3 and DEEP with clean, complete handoffs.

**You've Got What It Takes If You...**
3+ years people management in technical support (enterprise SaaS preferred) with hands-on troubleshooting credibility; hiring and onboarding experience at pace.
  
  
Fluent English.
  
  
Certified in the products of your assigned pod area within 90 days — the manager holds the certification, not just the dashboard.
  
  
Data-fluent: queues, coverage strips, and sentiment trends turned into at least one decision a week.
  
  
Builder’s energy with a steady hand: first-90-days chaos doesn’t rattle you; psychological safety is your foundation; standards are your frame
  
  
**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

title: Product Supply Planning Manager
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
**About The Role**
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. Our Supply Chain team is growing, and we are looking to strengthen it with a passionate and driven team member. If you are eager to be part of a dynamic, global, and fast-growing organization—where a positive mindset, personal development, and making a meaningful impact on people’s health are valued—we could be the perfect match. As Product Supply Planning Manager, you will own the end-to-end supply plan for our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), collaborate across departments, and play an active role in shaping the future of our company.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and maintain the supply plan for CMOs on a monthly basis, considering inventory and open orders (firmed and planned), to identify and communicate status to internal and external stakeholders.
* Based on the supply plan, issue Purchase Orders and forecasts to CMOs, and monitor deliveries of purchase orders against requested dates.
* Proactively manage supply constraints to minimize business impact.
* Provide accurate and complete supply planning parameters and purchasing conditions for all SKUs; act as the Expert User for key planning Master Data.
* Set and maintain all required Master Data and ensure its integrity and correctness.
* Create and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external partners.
* Oversee the successful launch of new products into the market, ensuring timely supply, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with manufacturing and distribution teams.
* Propose stock holding levels within the supply chain through a detailed understanding of key planning parameters and the E2E process (safety stock, lead times, supply reliability, demand variability, service objectives), in line with Working Capital targets.
* Perform monthly inventory reconciliations, ensure inventory accuracy, and minimize discrepancies.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* Minimum 10 years of proven experience in end-to-end (E2E) planning within the pharmaceutical industry, including direct interaction with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) in an international environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and evolving business needs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent communication abilities.
* Proven track record of effective collaboration with both internal cross-functional teams and external partners.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks efficiently.
* Quick learner with a proactive and adaptable mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Oracle ERP systems; functional knowledge is an advantage.
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) or equivalent supply chain qualification.
* Experience supporting new product introductions/launches in a regulated (GMP) pharmaceutical environment.
* Experience working across multiple time zones with global CMO networks.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Associate Manager, Corporate Safety and Security
description:
**About the Team**
The Global Safety and Security team advances DoorDash through the protection of people, property, operations, brand, and reputation. We manage safety and security risk and provide value across the business through technology, and a people-first approach. Our team strives to always be in front and there for our people anytime, anywhere.
  
  
**About the Role**
DoorDash is seeking an
**Associate Manager, Corporate Safety and**
Security to join our Global Safety and Security team. This role is based in Hyderabad, India, and supports multiple offices, with occasional travel required to the assigned sites to onboard and support team members, assess site conditions, and maintain strong operational presence. This is an on-site, shift-based role that helps keep employees, visitors, and workplaces safe and secure throughout a 24x7 support model.
  
  
In this role, you will serve as a regional owner for site-level safety and security execution. You will directly manage Security vendors, Associates, Contract guard personnel, ensure consistent security coverage in the designated area of operations, and act as a trusted local decision maker during incidents. The work is hands-on and operational, balancing day-to-day execution with clear communication, documentation, and coordination across partners.
  
  
You will partner with Global Safety and Security, Workplace Experience, the Global Operations Center, Facilities, and other local teams. The role requires sound judgment, calm communication, attention to detail, and flexibility to work rotating shifts, including night shifts, as operational needs require.
  
  
**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**

* Own day-to-day safety and security operations across offices in India.
* Support Secure transportation services through preventive security practices and escort services
* Operate access control, visitor management, CCTV, alarms, and related systems; investigate exceptions and escalate technical issues promptly
* Verify employee, contractor, and visitor access, support credentialing, and follow established procedures for deliveries and restricted areas
* Respond to security, safety, and medical incidents, coordinating immediate actions, employee support, notifications, and escalation under established playbooks
* Inspect site conditions, report hazards or control gaps, and track corrective actions with Workplace, Facilities, and security service partners
* Support emergency readiness through drills, evacuation procedures, business continuity activities, and practical follow-up after incidents
* Coordinate with security vendors and cross-functional partners to maintain professional coverage and a safe, welcoming employee and visitor experience across assigned sites
* Directly manage and develop contract security personnel, including onboarding, training, and reinforcement of SOPs
* Maintain regular site presence through travel to assigned offices to build relationships, assess risk, and support operational consistency
* Coordinate with Workplace Experience and Global Operations Center on off-site corporate employee event security planning and execution
* Act as a local decision maker during incidents, ensuring calm response, clear escalation, and strong written follow-through
* Identify gaps in site security posture through assessments and signal detection, and drive remediation with the right partners
* Build trust with cross-functional partners by showing up reliably, communicating clearly, and setting appropriate boundaries

**We're excited about you because you…**

* Have 6+ years of experience in corporate safety, security operations, or a related field, with exposure to multi-site or regional environments
* Are comfortable operating independently and making sound decisions in real-world, time-sensitive situations
* Have working knowledge of physical security operations, including access control, visitor management, and incident response, including life safety and first aid response.
* Communicate clearly and calmly, especially in moments of uncertainty or escalation, and document decisions effectively
* Know how to partner cross-functionally with Workplace, HR, Real Estate, and other teams without blurring ownership
* Are execution-oriented, with a bias toward action and accountability rather than over-engineering solutions
* Are comfortable using data, basic metrics, and emerging tools including AI to improve visibility and operational effectiveness
* Take ownership of outcomes and follow through, even when paths are not fully defined
* Have hands-on experience working in a shift-based security operation, including incident response, patrols, access control, and shift handovers
* Are willing and able to work in rotating shifts, including night shifts, weekends, and holidays when required for 24x7 coverage

**About DoorDash**
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Director, PE Shared Services
description:

A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
  
  
Director, PE Shared Services
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, IN
  
  
Most companies call it HR. But at Electronic Arts, we made the deliberate decision to brand our organization People Experience (PE). PE is not just a play on words: it’s a team of cultural stewards who carefully create programs and talent strategies that directly impact our teams’ experience. For the better. We enable our People to achieve the most meaningful work of their careers.
  
  
We’re responsible for recruiting the best talent on the planet. But it doesn’t stop there. We also support their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation, and leadership development. We listen to our employees and dive into analytics to anchor our recommendations and decisions to keep engagement high. Last but not least, we’re responsible for a total rewards strategy that incentivizes equitably, provides outstanding benefits, and ensures a safe and inspiring workplace for our team
  
  
The People Services team’s vision is to power an extraordinary candidate and employee experience that energizes EA’s talent through strategic programs and operational excellence. The team designs and deploys critical HR infrastructure support, and creates shared operational support for PE teams in service to scaling. This team manages high-visibility projects for the People Experience function and executes core talent programs. Come work with a team dedicated to fostering inclusion, talent fluidity, and a culture where people can do their best work.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Director, PE Shared Services is a people leader role that reports to the Senior Director, People Services. This is a hybrid role, with at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
This role is pivotal in driving the evolution of our PE shared services, focusing on innovation, efficiency and exceptional service delivery. Join us in shaping the future of People Services and delivering a transformative employee experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Leading Shared Services**

* Leadership of the largest PE team in our Hyderabad office, responsible for the day-to-day delivery of all Shared Services including employee queries, high-volume transactions, data integrity in Workday and other areas.
* Continually review the work the Shared Services team delivers by identifying, developing and delivering programs for continuous professional development and reskilling. This includes identifying training needs, providing opportunities for skill enhancement, and fostering a culture of learning and development.
* Adopt our automation and AI first philosophy when reviewing new and existing processes to develop the way we work, enhancing the employee experience, and drive efficiency in service delivery.

**Driving Shared Services Evolution**

* Assist the Senior Director, People Services with developing and implementing strategic plans for the Shared Services organization, ensuring alignment with the overall business strategy. Track and report performance against plans to key stakeholders.
* Create operational strategies by conducting needs assessments, performance reviews, capacity planning, and cost/benefit analyses; identifying and evaluating productivity, quality, and customer-service standards and SLAs; contributing information and analysis to organizational strategic plans and reviews.
* Accomplish organizational goals by accepting ownership for new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value and increase team capabilities.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation, leveraging technology to streamline processes and improve service quality.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge by tracking emerging trends in service center operations management; attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; benchmarking state-of-the-art practices; and participating in professional societies.

**Operational Delivery**

* Utilize data analytics to gain insights into service delivery performance and identify areas for improvement. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to provide visibility into key metrics and trends. This includes overseeing SLA targets and managing process improvement programs; overseeing case management systems.
* Oversee budget for the shared services function, ensuring efficient use of resources. Identify cost-saving opportunities and make recommendations for investment in new technologies or process improvements.
* Ensure that all processes and activities within the shared services function comply with relevant regulations and company policies. Identify and mitigate risks, and conduct regular audits to ensure adherence to standards.

**Team Leadership**

* Assure Shared Services team performance by recruiting, training and coaching while fostering an inclusive environment that emphasizes diversity and belonging. This includes setting clear objectives, defining key performance indicators, and monitoring progress towards goals.
* Clearly communicate job expectations and conduct performance assessments in line with EA’s global processes. Enforce policies and plan compensation actions to ensure fairness and equity within the team.

**Required Skills**

* Understands and exhibits “customer-first” thinking and design.
* Strong people leadership skills
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Experience working within a fast-paced global environment and being part of a global team
* Proven ability to creatively solve problems

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in HR, Business, or Operations preferred.
* 15+ years’ experience in global HR services or operations, including 10+ years in a managerial role
* 4-5 years of HRIS operations (Workday preferred) and case management solutions, (ServiceNow preferred)
* Experience in implementing AI Assistant and/or Chatbot solutions.

**About Electronic Arts**
We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
  
  
We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. title: Major Incident Manager (24*7 environment)
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Take command of major incidents across Keyloop, chairing bridge calls and driving them to resolution at pace — not simply monitoring status, but actively directing resolver teams and third-party suppliers.
* Own business-critical escalations end-to-end, from identification through to resolution and stakeholder sign-off, ensuring SLA compliance and managing breach risk proactively.
* Line-manage the MI Co-ordinator team, including the on-call/shift model and 24x7 coverage, setting standards for incident handling, communication and RCA quality.
* Lead root cause analysis for all major incidents across Keyloop and third-party providers, feeding Problem Management and driving continuous improvement across people, process and tooling.
* Prepare and drive leadership and executive updates during and after major incidents, using AI assistants (Copilot/Claude) to draft meeting outcomes and summarise bridge calls efficiently.
* Create and maintain operational dashboards for real-time monitoring and major incident reporting.
* Enforce ITIL-aligned incident, major incident and problem management processes, keeping all systems current with accurate status, actions and timelines.
* Coach, develop and manage the performance of the MI Co-ordinator team, and act as an escalation and decision point for incident, process and supplier issues.
* Undertake other duties as reasonably required in support of Service Assurance objectives.

**Essential skillsets:**

* Have a minimum of 8+ years' experience in IT including demonstrable Major Incident leadership.
* Have a proven track record of leading high-severity major incidents and influencing outcomes on live bridge calls.
* Have advanced proficiency in Jira, preferably JSM, and strong command of the ITIL framework and incident management best practice.
* Using AI in day to day work — hands-on use of AI assistants (Copilot/Claude) for drafting meeting outcomes, leadership updates, dashboard creation and metrics/trend analysis.
* Have excellent english written and verbal communication; calm, decisive and credible during high-severity escalations.
* Be a diplomatic, professional communicator across all levels of stakeholder, with a hands-on, strong-ownership approach.
* Clear and confident communicator in English, able to collaborate effectively across time zones and cultures.
* Have strong working knowledge of application integration, AWS and other cloud services, middleware, data centres, networks, compute and databases.
* Have experience leading or mentoring a small team.
* Be willing to work in shifts to support 24x7 major incident coverage.

**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
  
  
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
  
  
**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply**

This role will work closely with technology leaders, product owners, business stakeholders, finance partners, delivery teams, and vendor partners to ensure that the ICC portfolio is strategically aligned, transparently governed, financially disciplined, and executed with operational excellence.

title: Director, Market Access Operations, DHH India Capability Hub
description:
**Job Description**
**Director, Market Access Operations, DHH India Capability Hub**
Our Digital Human Health (DHH) organization is advancing the future of Market Access by building scalable, technology-enabled capabilities that strengthen access, revenue optimization, compliance and operational excellence across the U.S. market. As customers, payer models, contracting arrangements, government programs and Gross-to-Net dynamics become increasingly complex, Market Access Operations must evolve into an integrated, controlled and digitally enabled capability while maintaining compliant tools and processes.
  
  
The Director, Market Access Operations (India Hub) will serve as a senior India-based leader responsible for building, scaling, and integrating assigned Market Access capabilities supporting the U.S. business.
  
  
The role operates as part of a globally distributed Market Access Operations organization and partners closely with Market Access Operations leaders in the U.S. DHH organization, Finance, Contracting, Pricing, Revenue Management, other business stakeholders and strategic service partners. The role will advance the transformation of contracting activities and establish sustainable delivery models spanning Market Access systems, Gross-to-Net operations, contract management, rebate and chargeback processing, reporting, deal modeling and contract pull through capabilities, and process excellence.
  
  
The position reports to the Executive Director, DHH India Hub Delivery and would be based out of Pune or Hyderabad, with international and domestic travel as required by business.
  
  
This is a Market Access Operations role. Market Access Insights, market research and insights generation are managed through separate roles and are outside the primary scope of this position.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Market Access Operations Strategy & Leadership**

* Serve as a senior leader for Market Access Operations capabilities in India and contribute to the long-term capability vision, operating model, governance and growth roadmap in partnership with U.S. Market Access Operations leadership.
* Build scalable capabilities supporting assigned U.S. Market Access Operations workstreams, with clear accountability for service quality, controls, productivity, business continuity and continuous improvement. All development is subject to internal and external audits.
* Provide strategic thought partnership to U.S. Market Access Operations leaders and business stakeholders on operational transformation, capability expansion, risk management and technology modernization.
* Evolve portfolio governance, demand prioritization, service-level measures, operational reviews and value-realization mechanisms across capabilities.

**Gross-to-Net & Revenue Operations**

* Serve as a senior subject matter expert in U.S. Gross-to-Net, including the operational and financial drivers that convert gross sales to net revenue.
* Lead assigned capabilities supporting all government programs and pricing, commercial rebates, chargebacks, administrative and distribution fees, contract performance, deductions, reconciliations and related revenue-management processes.
* Partner with Finance, Pricing, Contracting and Revenue Management to strengthen accrual support, forecast inputs, transparency, data quality, controls and revenue integrity.
* Drive standardized GTN governance, operating procedures, metrics, issue management, audit readiness and root-cause resolution to reduce leakage and improve predictability.

**Market Access Systems & Model**

* Provide business and operational leadership for assigned U.S. Market Access platforms and associated contract, pricing, rebate, chargeback and revenue-management systems.
* Apply good working knowledge of Model N and its capabilities across contract management, payer and provider management, rebates, chargebacks, government pricing and revenue management.
* Build internal expertise in system administration, configuration, master and reference data, access controls, interfaces, reporting, release readiness, incident management and user support.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to improve Model N-enabled workflows, controls, reporting, integrations and operational performance.

**Partner & Operational Leadership**

* Collaborate with strategic service partners to drive delivery quality, productivity, controls, capability enhancement, knowledge continuity and continuous improvement.
* Establish effective partner governance, performance measures, risk mitigation and issue-resolution mechanisms to protect service continuity, quality and compliance.
* Ensure effective integration of partner resources and internal teams while maintaining clear accountability, appropriate oversight and strong stakeholder communication.

**Contracting, Rebate & Chargeback Operations**

* Evolve assigned capabilities across customer contracting, contract administration, contract setup and maintenance, amendments, eligibility, payment and reconciliation workflows to meet changing business requirements.
* Establish disciplined controls for contract interpretation, claim and invoice validation, exception handling, dispute management, approvals and documentation.
* Ensure connectivity between contract terms, system configuration, transaction processing, financial outcomes and business reporting.

**People & Capability Development**

* Build and lead high-performing, globally connected teams of Market Access Operations professionals.
* Define workforce strategy, role architecture, career paths and targeted learning across GTN, contracting, rebates, chargebacks, systems, data and operational excellence.
* Create a culture of patient focus, ownership, inclusion, control consciousness, continuous learning and measurable business impact.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* Required BA/BS in Business, Finance, Economics, Healthcare, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Information Systems, Operations or a related field. Preferred Advanced degree such as MBA, PharmD or relevant master’s degree.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, consulting or life-sciences services industry, including significant experience supporting U.S. Market Access Operations.
* Deep expertise in Gross-to-Net and its core components, including commercial and government rebates, chargebacks, fees, deductions, reconciliations, accrual support and net-revenue drivers.
* Strong experience in U.S. contracting operations, revenue management, rebate administration, chargeback operations, and customer contracting.
* Good working knowledge of Model N and its capabilities across contract management, rebates, chargebacks, government pricing and revenue management. Customer supplied data validation, all government programs
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven record of building, scaling and developing high-performing operational teams.
* Proven leadership of strategic partner governance, knowledge transfer, operating-model transformation or shared-capability buildout.
* Strong understanding of operational controls, compliance, audit readiness, data governance, access management, change control, business continuity, and disaster recovery
* Ability to translate business priorities into process, data, technology and workforce solutions and influence senior stakeholders across global, cross-functional teams.

title: Factory Operations Lead
description:
**Job Title – Factory Operations Lead**

**Location – Leanwatts HQ, Hyderabad, India**

**About us**

At Leanwatts, we develop innovative power electronic solutions for electric mobility and energy applications through continuous research, engineering, and manufacturing. Our “Designed and Made in India” approach drives us to build reliable, high-performance products for the future of transportation and energy.

**What is this role about?**

We are looking for a Factory Operations Lead to take ownership of day-to-day factory operations at Leanwatts. You will bring together Production Planning & Control (PPC), Production, Quality, and Supply Chain to deliver products safely, at the required quality, on time, and within agreed cost targets.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring a strong presence on the factory floor. You will turn sales demand into achievable production and dispatch plans, resolve operational bottlenecks, and coordinate with Sales and, when required, customers on delivery schedules, order progress, and operational issues. You will also work with R&D and Engineering to move new products into stable production.

**What you will do at Leanwatts**

* **PPC Coordination & Delivery Planning:**

  Coordinate with PPC, Sales, and Supply Chain to translate confirmed orders and forecasts into weekly and daily production plans. Review capacity, manpower, material readiness, and bottlenecks; agree realistic delivery dates, track plan adherence, and drive recovery actions when schedules slip.
* **Production Execution:**

  Lead daily manufacturing, assembly, testing, packing, and dispatch readiness. Set priorities with production supervisors, allocate people and resources, monitor output and work-in-progress, and resolve issues affecting throughput, productivity, and delivery.
* **Quality Ownership & Improvement:**

  Work with the Quality team to maintain incoming, in-process, and final inspection and testing controls. Ensure traceability, containment of non-conforming material, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions. Reduce defects, rework, and customer returns while maintaining required quality-release approvals.
* **Supply Chain, Stores & Logistics:**

  Coordinate Purchase, suppliers, Stores, and logistics partners to secure materials and meet production needs. Review shortages and supplier commitments, ensure accurate inventory and timely material issues, monitor subcontracted work where applicable, and coordinate dispatch and delivery tracking.
* **Sales & Customer Coordination:**

  Act as the factory’s operational point of contact for Sales. Provide reliable order-status updates, flag delivery risks early, and agree feasible responses to priority changes. Join customer discussions when required on production progress, delivery commitments, quality concerns, and recovery plans, in coordination with Sales and Quality.
* **New Product Introduction & Engineering Coordination:**

  Work with R&D, Engineering, Production, and Quality on pilot builds and production handover. Ensure approved BOMs, drawings, work instructions, test procedures, tools, and training are ready; control engineering changes and build feedback so production uses the correct revision.
* **People Leadership & Daily Coordination:**

  Lead daily factory reviews, assign clear owners and deadlines, and follow actions through to closure. Develop supervisors and operators, build skills across the team, plan manpower and training, and promote accountability and effective coordination across functions.
* **Safety, Maintenance & Factory Readiness:**

  Maintain safe working practices, housekeeping, and 5S discipline. Coordinate preventive maintenance, equipment breakdown response, tool availability, and facility upkeep with the responsible teams. Ensure operational checks and applicable factory requirements are followed and escalate risks promptly.
* **Performance, Cost & Continuous Improvement:**

  Track plan adherence, on-time dispatch, output, productivity, quality yield, rework, scrap, downtime, inventory, and operating costs. Review results against agreed targets, control overtime and waste, and lead practical improvements in capacity, process flow, and delivery reliability.

**Must have requirements****1. Education & Relevant Experience**

* **Education:**

  Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, mechanical, industrial, or production engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical manufacturing leadership experience may also be considered.
* **Experience:**

  Proven experience leading factory or manufacturing operations, with responsibility across production planning, production execution, quality coordination, and supply chain. Experience managing supervisors and operators and delivering against operational targets is essential.
* **Hands-On Ownership:**

  Ability to independently run daily factory reviews, identify constraints on the floor, resolve cross-functional issues, and follow actions through to measurable results.

**2. Planning, Supply Chain & Systems**

* **Production Planning:**

  Ability to balance customer demand with capacity, manpower, material availability, and lead times. Comfortable reviewing BOMs, material requirements, work-in-progress, production schedules, and dispatch plans.
* **ERP & Reporting:**

  Working proficiency in ERP/MRP or manufacturing inventory systems and Excel or Google Sheets. Ability to use reliable production, inventory, procurement, and quality data to make decisions and report exceptions.

**3. Manufacturing & Quality Management**

You should understand the complete manufacturing flow and be able to keep production, quality, and material readiness aligned as priorities change.

* **Process Control:**

  Practical experience with assembly and testing operations, standard work, traceability, process discipline, and controlled engineering changes. Ability to work with technical teams on production readiness and recurring manufacturing problems.
* **Problem Solving:**

  Experience investigating defects and delays, using structured root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and improving productivity, quality yield, and delivery performance.

**4. Leadership & Business Coordination**

* **Team Leadership:**

  Ability to lead supervisors and operators, plan manpower, coach team members, set priorities, and hold teams accountable while maintaining safe working practices.
* **Sales & Customer Communication:**

  Clear communication of order progress, constraints, and recovery plans. Ability to coordinate with Sales and participate in customer discussions when needed, making commitments grounded in factory capacity and material readiness.
* **Operational Judgement:**

  Ability to balance delivery, quality, cost, and safety; escalate decisions that require management approval; and work effectively with Purchase, Stores, Finance, R&D, Engineering, and Quality.

**5. Preferred Advantages**

* **Industry Exposure:**

  Experience in electronics, electrical equipment, power electronics, EV products, or related engineering manufacturing, including assembly, functional testing, and production ramp-up.
* **Improvement Experience:**

  Exposure to Lean manufacturing, 5S, capacity expansion, supplier development, subcontract manufacturing, quality systems, or building operational processes in a growing manufacturing business.

Working in partnership with Market Access leaders in the U.S. DHH organization, business stakeholders, technology teams and strategic service partners, the role will manage teams and workstreams that align to selected Market Access systems, which may include contract administration, customer contracting, rebate and chargeback operations, reporting, deal modeling, contract performance pull-through, data quality, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This is a Market Access Operations role. Market Access Insights, market research and insights generation are managed through separate roles and are outside the primary scope of this position.
  
  
The position reports to the Director, Market Access Operations, DHH India Hub Delivery and would be based out of Hyderabad, with international and domestic travel as required by business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Market Access Operations Delivery**

* Lead day-to-day delivery across assigned U.S. Market Access Operations workstreams, ensuring quality, timeliness, control effectiveness, compliance and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Own operational planning, work allocation, service-level performance, issue escalation, root-cause analysis, corrective actions and continuous improvement for assigned projects and systems.
* Partner closely with Market Access leaders in the U.S. DHH organization, Finance, Contracting, Pricing, Revenue Management, Technology and other business stakeholders.

**Market Access Systems & Model N**

* Build and maintain strong domain and operational expertise across U.S. Market Access systems, with good working knowledge of Model N and its capabilities across contract administration and adjudication, payer and provider management, rebates, chargebacks, government pricing and revenue management.
* For specified systems, lead assigned system operations including user support, access administration, configuration coordination, reference and master data, workflow monitoring, reporting, incident triage, release readiness and documentation. Lead teams supporting assigned systems for contract setup and maintenance, amendments, eligibility, pricing terms and operational governance.
* Partner with business, technology and product teams to translate business needs into systems, workflows, validations, payments and reporting. This includes configuration and development activities, testing, deployment and post-release stabilization.
* Perform selected activities associated with data needs including validation, exception handling, approvals, payment support, reconciliation, dispute management and audit documentation.
* Drive data quality, process integration, controls and automation across connected Market Access platforms.

**Partner & Process Leadership**

* Collaborate with strategic service partners to improve delivery quality, productivity, controls, knowledge continuity and operational outcomes.
* Lead capability development, knowledge transfer, documentation, process improvement and operational-maturity initiatives in partnership with strategic service providers and internal teams.
* Implement standard operating procedures, controls, metrics, review forums, escalation paths and clear accountability across internal and partner-supported workstreams that are consistent with current ways of working.

**Gross-to-Net Operations**

* Act as a subject matter expert in U.S. Gross-to-Net operations and the drivers that convert gross sales to net revenue.
* Lead assigned development / operational activities to provide systems supporting commercial and government rebates, chargebacks, administrative and distribution fees, deductions, contract performance, reconciliation and related GTN processes.
* Support accurate and timely GTN reporting, accrual inputs, forecasts, true-ups, balance explanations and variance investigation in partnership with Finance and business teams.
* Identify control gaps, data issues, duplicate or invalid claims, contract leakage and process inefficiencies, and lead cross-functional resolution.

**People Leadership & Capability Building**

* Recruit, onboard, coach and develop Market Access Operations talent with the right mix of domain, systems, data and operational skills.
* Establish structured learning pathways in U.S. Market Access, GTN, contracting, rebates, chargebacks, systems, controls and process excellence.
* Create a collaborative, inclusive and high-accountability culture across India, U.S. and partner teams.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* Required BA/BS in Business, Finance, Economics, Healthcare, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Information Systems, Operations or a related field. Preferred Advanced degree such as MBA, PharmD or relevant master’s degree.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, consulting or life-sciences services industry, with strong experience supporting U.S. Market Access IT Development and Operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas commercial or government rebates, chargebacks, revenue management, or customer contracting.
* Good working knowledge of Model N and its capabilities, with experience supporting Market Access, contract or revenue-management workflows.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, with demonstrated success in building and managing delivery and operational teams, and collaboration with multiple teams.
* Experience leading strategic partner collaboration, knowledge transfer, process improvement, operational-maturity initiatives or capability buildout.
* Experience in IT development tools and methodologies, SDLC, and AI.
* Strong understanding of operational controls, SOPs, audit readiness, data quality, reconciliations, issue management, access governance and change control.
* Ability to interpret contracts and business rules and translate them into system configuration, operating procedures, validations and reporting requirements.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills across globally distributed business, technology and partner teams.
