title: Sr. Service Operations Engineer
description:
Lead Support Operations Engineer
  
  
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology & Ancillary Clinical Systems**
**About The Role**
Providence Global Center is seeking an experienced Lead Support Operations Engineer to lead reliable, secure and efficient support for
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and other ancillary clinical applications**
. The role combines hands-on L2/L3 technical ownership with operational leadership, service governance, major-incident coordination, problem management, change oversight and team capability development. The engineer will partner with clinical stakeholders, product teams, infrastructure teams, vendors and senior engineers to maintain application availability, protect patient-care workflows and drive continual service improvement across on-premises and Azure Cloud environments.
  
  
**Role Outcomes The Role Is Accountable For**

* Stable and resilient clinical application services with effective monitoring, incident response and recovery.
* Consistent SLA performance, clear operational ownership and timely stakeholder communication.
* Reduced recurring incidents through root cause analysis, problem elimination, automation and knowledge reuse.
* Controlled delivery of patches, upgrades, interface changes and production deployments.
* Strong team readiness through work allocation, technical coaching, documentation and succession coverage.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Service Operations Leadership**

* Lead day-to-day support operations across Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and ancillary clinical applications.
* Provide technical direction for L2/L3 incidents, complex service requests, application defects and workflow disruptions.
* Prioritise work based on clinical impact, urgency, risk and agreed service levels; coordinate workload across the support team.
* Maintain operational readiness, support coverage, escalation paths, runbooks and handover practices.
* Review service performance, ageing work, repeat incidents, backlog, availability risks and improvement actions with relevant stakeholders.

**2. Clinical Workflow & Application Support**

* Support end-to-end clinical workflows, including laboratory order-to-result processes, medication-management workflows, imaging order-to-report processes and associated ancillary-service workflows.
* Translate clinical and operational impact into clear technical investigation, restoration and follow-up actions.
* Partner with clinical SMEs and business stakeholders to validate workflow behaviour, configuration changes and recovery outcomes.
* Ensure support decisions consider patient-care continuity, data integrity, operational safety and downstream system dependencies.

**3. Integrations, Interfaces & Data Exchange**

* Lead troubleshooting of integrations among clinical applications, medical devices or instruments, middleware, interface engines, EHR platforms and downstream systems.
* Investigate HL7 message failures, queue backlogs, interface interruptions, data mismatches and mapping issues using logs and monitoring tools.
* Support clinical terminology, coding and mapping where applicable, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Coordinate with interface, infrastructure, network, database, security, vendor and application teams to restore and stabilise services.

**4. Incident, Major Incident & Problem Management**

* Own or coordinate high-impact incidents from triage through service restoration, validation, communication and closure.
* Provide concise technical updates, impact statements, recovery status and decision points during major incidents.
* Lead root cause analysis for recurring or significant issues and track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
* Identify opportunities to automate, correct or eliminate repeat work and reduce avoidable support demand.

**5. Change, Release & Environment Management**

* Assess operational readiness and risk for application changes, patches, upgrades, cloud migrations and integration releases.
* Coordinate implementation plans, validation steps, rollback plans, support coverage and post-deployment verification.
* Support environment health, configuration consistency and production-readiness checks across on-premises and Azure Cloud services.
* Ensure changes follow applicable ITIL, security, compliance and change-management controls.

**6. Monitoring, Reliability & Continual Improvement**

* Strengthen proactive monitoring, alert quality, service dashboards and early-warning indicators for critical clinical applications.
* Analyse incident trends, recurring failure patterns and operational bottlenecks; recommend measurable improvements.
* Promote automation, self-service, standardisation and knowledge-centred support to improve reliability and team efficiency.
* Contribute to service continuity, disaster recovery testing and operational resilience activities.

**7. Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Coach support engineers on technical troubleshooting, clinical workflows, incident ownership, documentation and stakeholder communication.
* Delegate work with clear accountability; review technical quality and support the team during complex escalations.
* Build cross-training and backup coverage across supported applications and domain workflows.
* Work closely with SMEs, product owners, developers, vendors and cross-functional teams across geographies.
* Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge-base articles, known-error records, support models and troubleshooting guides.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of application support or service operations experience, including ownership of complex or business-critical applications.
* Strong experience supporting one or more clinical domains such as Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology or ancillary clinical systems, with the ability to build cross-domain knowledge.
* Demonstrated L2/L3 troubleshooting experience across applications, interfaces, middleware, logs, infrastructure dependencies and data flows.
* Working knowledge of HL7 messaging, interface support and integrations among clinical applications, devices or instruments, middleware and EHR systems.
* Understanding of clinical terminology, coding or mapping standards where relevant, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Experience with incident, major incident, problem, change and release management in an ITIL-aligned environment.
* Exposure to Azure Cloud and on-premises application environments, including monitoring, availability and operational support concepts.
* Experience leading technical investigations, coordinating cross-functional teams and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, prioritisation, documentation and decision-making skills.
* Ability to mentor engineers, distribute work, manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a 24x7 support environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multiple clinical application domains or enterprise healthcare platforms.
* Familiarity with interface engines, clinical middleware, medical-device integrations, PACS/RIS, pharmacy platforms or LIS/LIMS solutions.
* Experience with scripting, workflow automation, observability tools or service-management reporting.
* Participation in application upgrades, cloud migrations, disaster-recovery exercises or major clinical go-lives.
* ITIL, Azure, healthcare interoperability or relevant vendor/product certification.
* Experience working with distributed teams and external vendors in a regulated healthcare environment.

**Core Competencies**
**Technical & Domain**
**Operational Leadership**

* Clinical application support
* HL7 and integration troubleshooting
* Cloud and on-premises operations
* Monitoring and reliability
* Major-incident coordination
* Problem elimination
* Change and release oversight
* Risk-based prioritisation
* Clinical stakeholder partnership
* Coaching and delegation

**Success Measures**

* Reduction in repeat incidents, ageing backlog and avoidable support demand.

title: Program Leader, Tech Transformation (Mobility & Delivery + New Bets) - Field Operations

You will partner with Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets operations leaders, Product, and Engineering to design solutions where AI handles the bulk of processing across support, ops, and quality queues, freeing humans to focus on exceptions and higher-judgment work. **What You Will Do**

* Own identification, prioritization, and transformation of high-volume, high-friction workflows across Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets COE queues into AI-first, largely automated processes
* Build fluency in current-state workflows across each LOB - volumes, TAT, quality, cost-to-serve, failure modes - and build the case for automation, sequencing by impact and feasibility
* Partner with Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets operations leaders, Product, and Engineering to design solutions and the human-in-the-loop review experience
* Drive delivery from pilot to scaled rollout across LOBs and geographies, adapting the approach to each business's maturity and volume profile
* Define and track metrics - automation rate, accuracy, TAT, cost-to-serve, capacity impact - per LOB, and report impact to Field Ops and LOB leadership
* Act as the connective tissue between LOB leadership, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, keeping the roadmap grounded in real operational needs across businesses
* Scan the internal/external AI landscape for opportunities applicable across Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets
* Build enablement and change-management plans tailored to each LOB's frontline teams

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 8+ years of experience in program management, operations strategy, consulting, or technology-driven operations transformation, ideally across more than one business line
* Demonstrated experience partnering directly with Product and Engineering to scope, prioritize, and ship technical solutions
* Working understanding of how AI/ML and GenAI tools apply to high-volume operational workflows across marketplace businesses, including where human review is still needed
* Strong analytical/quantitative skills - sizing opportunities, defining success metrics, and measuring impact across multiple LOBs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate operational pain points from different businesses into clear, buildable requirements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong stakeholder management skills across multiple LOB leadership teams with differing priorities and maturity levels
* Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity, especially for New Bets where workflows and volumes are still evolving

Enabled by innovative technologies, key offerings include HR and recruitment solutions, recruitment process outsourcing (RPO), managed services programs (MSP), statement of work (SOW), outplacement, coaching and total talent solutions.

**Position Overview**

The Director – Global Client Services & Operations Transformation Lead is a strategic leader responsible for driving world-class delivery, operational transformation, and commercial scaling across our global recruitment and scheduling operations.

Operating with an innovative, transformational mindset, this leader will oversee specialized outsourced talent acquisition services—including end-to-end RPO/MSP delivery and high-volume global scheduling operations—for premier enterprise tech clients. ● Global Delivery Standardization: Institutionalize a "One Voice" service delivery model across APAC, NAM, and global execution hubs to ensure uniform "Premier" service experience regardless of geography.

● Enabling Function Accountability: Establish rigorous ROI tracking for operational enabling functions (e.g., Training, Quality Assurance) to maximize individual productivity and service consistency.

3. Financial & P&L Management

● P&L Responsibility: Oversee complete delivery budget and P&L across global accounts, ensuring targets for profitability, margin expansion, and cost-of-delivery ratios are achieved.

● Cost Efficiency & Contractual Rigor: Continuously evaluate SLA performance and operational delivery costs to identify savings, streamline workflows, and mitigate commercial risk.

● Capabilities & Upskilling: Build a continuous learning ecosystem utilizing Individual Development Plans (IDPs), structured upskilling programs, and proactive succession planning.

● Culture & Engagement: Cultivate a high-accountability, inclusive, and agile workplace culture that encourages innovative problem-solving and high performance.

Core Competencies & Transformational Mindset

● Embracing Ambiguity & Change Leadership: Decisive leadership in uncertain, rapidly changing environments; skilled at building structured frameworks within newly consolidated or evolving entities.

● Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to translate complex operational datasets and statistical modeling into actionable strategic risk mitigation and process improvements.

● Strategic Vision & Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen combining deep understanding of financial P&Ls, client growth strategies, and enterprise talent acquisition trends.

● Agility & Execution Courage: Ability to balance competing multi-stakeholder priorities (global, regional, client) while maintaining rigorous operational control and driving long-term strategic needle-movers.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

● Operational Efficiency & ROI: Measurable reduction in cost-to-serve and cycle time through automation, AI tools, and process optimization.

● Financial Growth: Portfolio profitability, revenue expansion, and strict adherence to target P&L margins.

● SLA & Delivery Rigor: 98%+ global adherence to contractual SLAs, quality benchmarks, and workforce management metrics.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience:

title: Business Lead – Smart Kiosk
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next-gen, clean-label beverage brand in Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch. We are expanding through smart, automated beverage kiosks across corporate campuses and other high-footfall locations. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**Role Description**

The Business Lead owns our smart vending kiosk channel end to end. Based in Hyderabad, you decide where machines go, how much each one sells, and whether the network makes money. You work with the founder, the machine vendor, maintenance, and the brand team. This role suits someone who likes building a channel from zero and being judged on its numbers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Identify, negotiate, and secure kiosk locations across tech parks, gyms, hospitals, colleges, and residential societies.

2. Own the P&L of each machine, including daily sales, uptime, wastage, rent, revenue sharing, and profitability.

3. Coordinate with the machine vendor for timely deployment, preventive maintenance, servicing, and spare parts availability.

4. Plan and optimise restocking routes, inventory levels, and replenishment schedules with the maintenance team.

5. Review sales and CRM data weekly, identify underperforming machines, and take corrective action, including relocation or withdrawal where necessary.

6. Develop and execute a scalable rollout plan, growing the network from the first 10 machines to 100.

7. Prepare and present monthly network performance reports to leadership, highlighting achievements, challenges, and action plans.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

1. 2–5 years of experience in vending, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or B2B location sales.

2. A proven track record of identifying, negotiating, and closing location agreements with facility managers, property owners, or landlords.

3. A strong understanding of unit economics, P&L management, and proficiency in spreadsheets and data analysis.

4. Good knowledge of Hyderabad's commercial areas and business hubs. Proficiency in Telugu and Hindi is preferred.

5.
High ownership and a bias for action

**What We Offer**

1. Fair, competitive compensation: Pay is in line with industry standards and based on your experience, capability, and track record. Strong performers grow faster than a standard annual cycle.

2. Fast-track growth: You work directly with the leadership team and see how a consumer brand is built from zero. Good people grow into bigger roles as the business scales.

3. Broad exposure: You see product, brand, events, retail, and operations, not one narrow slice.

4. Real ownership: Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

1. You are not based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.

2. You want a role with a fixed playbook already written.

3. You are not comfortable owning a P&L number.

*We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.*

title: Mfg Process Ops Assoc Leader

* Experience in Supply Chain processes including Order Management, Master Data, and OTC flows

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
Reporting to the Head of Project Delivery and working in close collaboration with colleagues, you will manage the end-to-end delivery of Tech projects in line with our technology strategy. You will also be responsible for the planning, management and delivery of other technology and operations projects from ideation through to completion.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
You will:
  
  

* Skilfully manage both internal stakeholders and external third-party suppliers to deliver complex projects and change programs
* Be responsible for the end-to-end planning and delivery of high priority technology projects, including infrastructure, operations and IT security

title: AVP – Strategy and Enterprise Transformation
description:
Providence India is aimed to digitally enable our vision of Health for a better world. The Providence India Global Center is focused on driving growth, efficiency and transformation for the organization. With over 1500+ strong, the organization has achieved several milestones and in the five-year journey.

The Corporate Strategy Team at Providence is responsible for building a blueprint of growth and value acceleration for the Center, including building technology transformation roadmaps, strategic growth initiatives and driving a rigor-oriented run of the business. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, challenging conventional thinking and converting strategy into measurable business outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITES

As the AVP for Strategy and Enterprise Transformation you will:

• Build the blueprint of enterprise transformation: identify and drive high-priority initiatives across the organisation, translating strategic priorities into defined programs, workstreams, owners and measurable outcomes. Act as the single-threaded owner for critical transformation programs, across capability and Corp function teams

• Drive business impact: partner with capability teams to identify AI, automation, data and tech / engineering opportunities that transform business processes and deliver top line and bottom-line impact for the organization with a global delivery model including efficiency, and value.

• Measure impact: establish clear success metrics and track the clinical, financial and operational impact of transformation programs. Coordinate with stakeholders and teams, set milestones, KPIs and accountability structures, and ensure delivery of measurable business outcomes.

• Solve ambiguous, high-impact problems: work directly with senior leadership in India and US to evaluate opportunities for driving efficiency and better health outcomes with technology. Drive the overall change and transformation agenda for the organization.

• Stakeholder Management: identify execution risks and unblock through effective stakeholder management.

• Lead with a Builder Mindset: mentor a small, high-performing strategy team working across Initiatives and capabilities.

• Establish ways of working: establish ownership, analytical rigour, speed and

Providence accountability and develop enterprise transformation frameworks that can be replicated across the organization.

LEADERSHIP CHARACTERISTICS

• Collaboration and Influence: The executive must be able to build strong and enduring relationships across the organization and facilitate collaborations, transparent communications, and alignment between diverse constituents. S/he must have the ability to move seamlessly between various stakeholders, gaining support for key initiatives.

• Driving Results: Knows how to get things done in the organization; successfully mobilizes people, processes, culture and technology. Effectively navigates relationships and organizational politics within a matrixed organization.

• Inspirational Leader: Demonstrates emotionally intelligent leadership and interactions. Courageously communicates and inspires an ever evolving and changing organization. Is action-oriented; consciously and effectively urges others toward the goal.

• People Focused: Clearly sets direction and expectations for direct reports and holds them accountable for results. Provides feedback and coaching to both good-performers and under-performers. Conscientiously builds a diverse talent pipeline of highly capable caregivers. Demonstrates the value of diversity and inclusion in leadership efforts.

• Thought Leader: Knowledgeable about current business and healthcare practices. Capable of critical operational and financial analytics. Leverages best business practices to solve problems. Leverages strategies that grow and develop the organization. Stays on top of emerging business and healthcare trends. Thinks innovatively and facilitates creativity in others. Is mentally agile; “thinks well on their feet.” Introduces break - through thinking, enabling new mental models to emerge.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS

• 18 years of professional experience in strategy, consulting or a GCC in corporate strategy or tech transformation area.

• Tier 1 MBA with experience in digital transformation, AI/GenAI, automation or technology-led business transformation.

• Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, with the ability to work comfortably with business metrics, financial data and business cases.

title: IT Manager – Systems & Administration
description:
**About us**

At Gameopedia, our journey began in Norway with a simple mission: to be the geeky gamer friend who helps people discover great games and have better gaming experiences. From humble beginnings, we quickly made our mark, landing our first major customer just a year later, one of Norway’s largest news publications. That milestone led us to expand to India, where five passionate gamers began building Gameopedia around a dining table in a small apartment.

Today, with offices in Oslo and Hyderabad, we provide industry-leading video game data, metadata and insights to some of the world’s biggest companies, powering experiences and decisions for millions of gamers every day.

Over more than 15 years, we have built deep gaming expertise and one of the industry’s richest and most structured sources of video game data. As technology and AI transform how games are discovered, understood and experienced, we believe trusted, comprehensive and high-quality data will become more important than ever.

Our ambition is to make Gameopedia the
**data truth for gaming**
: the trusted foundation that companies, products and AI systems rely on to understand the world of games. Our vision is to empower businesses across the gaming ecosystem to create extraordinary experiences for a billion gamers every day.

If you want to help build the data foundation powering the future of gaming, we’d love to have you on the journey.

**The Role: IT Manager**

We’re looking for an IT Manager to lead and scale our IT operations globally. You’ll design, build, and manage a secure, robust, and efficient IT infrastructure, ensuring seamless support for a growing, multi-location organization. As both a strategist and a hands-on leader, you’ll help us achieve operational excellence and empower our teams to innovate.

**What We Are Looking For:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong practical experience in several of the following:
* Google Workspace administration
* Windows and macOS administration
* Identity and access management
* Endpoint/device management
* Networking, Wi-Fi, firewalls and VPNs
* SSO and MFA
* SaaS administration
* Backup and recovery
* Endpoint security
* IT asset management
* IT ticketing/service management tools
* Basic automation of IT administration
* Experience with cloud-first technology organizations is preferred.
* Working Style and Capabilities

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Takes ownership and follows issues through to resolution
* Can work independently without constant technical supervision
* Is hands-on and technically curious
* Can research unfamiliar technologies and form a recommendation
* Solves root causes rather than repeatedly fixing symptoms
* Creates clear, structured documentation
* Has strong written and spoken English
* Communicates effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders
* Is comfortable challenging vendors when necessary
* Can prioritize effectively
* Is proactive rather than reactive
* Understands when to solve something internally and when specialist help is required
* Uses data and evidence when making recommendations

**Qualifications**

* Relevant degree, diploma or equivalent professional experience
* 6-8 years of relevant IT / system administration experience
* Strong Google Workspace administration experience
* Experience managing junior IT resources and/or vendors
* Relevant Google, Microsoft, networking, security or cloud certifications are preferred but not mandatory
* Practical capability, independent problem-solving and demonstrated ownership of real-world IT environments will be valued more highly than certifications alone.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary.
* Health insurance.
* Casual dress code.
* Dynamic, collaboration-friendly office environment.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
As an Engineering Manager, you will provide delivery governance across multiple engineering pods building an enterprise-grade SaaS platform in the data privacy, data governance and AI governance space. You will own delivery outcomes, team health, staffing and continuity, and act as the main point of contact for client and leadership on delivery, risk and reporting. The role needs strong technical credibility combined with people management and engineering operations discipline.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own delivery governance across multiple pods: sprint commitments, release plans, milestones and quality outcomes.
* Manage staffing, onboarding, knowledge transfer, continuity planning and timely replacements so teams stay fully productive.
* Track and manage risks, dependencies and issues across pods, and drive escalations to closure with client and internal stakeholders.
* Define, track and report engineering metrics (velocity, predictability, defect leakage, cycle time, test coverage) and drive improvement actions.
* Prepare regular status reports and steering-committee updates for client and Kanerika leadership.
* Support timesheet management, effort tracking and invoicing reconciliation.
* Partner with Tech Leads and the AI Architect on technical direction, capacity planning and engineering best practices.
* Coach and mentor Tech Leads and engineers, and drive performance management, career growth and team engagement.
* Ensure adherence to SDLC, security, compliance, CI/CD and definition-of-done standards across pods.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years as an Engineering Manager or Delivery Manager.
* Proven experience managing multiple agile teams (20+ engineers) on enterprise software or SaaS engagements.
* Technical background in Java, Python or full-stack development, enough to engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Strong expertise in Agile/Scrum delivery at scale, including multi-team planning, dependency management and release governance.
* Experience with staffing, resource planning, onboarding and people management.
* Hands-on experience defining and reporting engineering KPIs and delivery metrics.
* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot, Python, Angular, microservices and AWS/Azure cloud.
* Understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, test automation and quality engineering practices.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence and delivery reporting tools such as Excel or Power BI.
* Familiarity with Time & Material engagements, timesheets and invoicing processes.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and escalation-handling skills.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience delivering AI/ML, GenAI or data platform programs.
* Domain exposure to data privacy, governance, security or compliance products.
* Certifications such as PMP, CSM, SAFe or PMI-ACP.

description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
  
  
For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.
  
  
**Job Description: HVAC Project Manager**

HVAC Project Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Bang, Gurgaon, Hyderabad
  
  
**Experience:**
7 to 15 Years
  
  
**Industry:**
HVAC, Building Services, MEP Projects
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**HVAC Project Manager**
to lead the execution and delivery of HVAC projects. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in
**chiller installation, testing, commissioning, and project execution**
, with the ability to manage project schedules, resources, stakeholders, and site teams to ensure successful project delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the complete lifecycle of HVAC projects from project initiation to handover.
* Lead the installation, testing, commissioning, and startup of:

+ Water-Cooled Chillers
+ Air-Cooled Chillers
+ HVAC Systems
+ Cooling Towers
+ Pumps and Associated Equipment

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Develop project plans, schedules, manpower deployment plans, and budgets.
* Monitor project progress, quality, safety, and compliance with contractual requirements.
* Conduct site meetings and provide project status updates to management and customers.
* Manage project risks and proactively resolve technical and execution challenges.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of project materials and equipment.
* Support project billing, cost control, variation management, and collections.
* Ensure compliance with EHS and quality standards throughout project execution.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* Project Management certification (PMP/PRINCE2) is an added advantage.

**Experience Required**

* 8-15+ years of experience in HVAC project execution and project management.
* Strong hands-on experience in chiller installation, testing, and commissioning.
* Proven experience managing large commercial, industrial, healthcare, data center, or infrastructure HVAC projects.
* Experience in handling multiple projects simultaneously.

**Technical Skills**

* Chiller Installation & Commissioning
* HVAC Systems
* Pumps & Hydronic Systems
* Cooling Towers
* HVAC Controls Integration
* Project Scheduling and Planning
* Site Execution Management
* Testing & Commissioning
* Vendor & Contractor Management
* Cost Control & Budget Management

**Key Competencies**

* Project Leadership
* Stakeholder Management
* Customer Relationship Management
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Team Management
* Communication & Negotiation Skills

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Demonstrated experience in successfully delivering HVAC projects with a focus on chiller systems.
* Strong technical expertise in installation, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning of chillers.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple stakeholders.

description:
**Why Ryan?**

* Global Award-Winning Culture
* Flexible Work Environment
* Generous Paid Time Off
* World-Class Benefits and Compensation
* Rapid Growth Opportunities
* Company Sponsored Two-Way Transportation
* Exponential Career Growth

**Job Summary**
The Manager – Process Excellence and Transformation is responsible for leading strategic and operational initiatives including technology enabled solutions that improve operations across GCC locations. This hands-on transformation role requires a leader who can translate business problems into practical automation, artificial intelligence, workflow, integration, and analytics solutions; personally build solutions or direct their delivery; and demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cycle time, capacity, cost, risk, client experience, and adoption. The role partners with Service Delivery, Technology and Global Shared Services teams to deliver measurable business outcomes and strengthen GCC capabilities.
  
  
**People**
**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Build and lead a high-performing AI, Automation, and Transformation team by fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Provide guidance and support to Process Excellence team members on project execution, process analysis, documentation, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Build organizational capability by driving training, knowledge-sharing, and adoption of process, quality, and transformation best practices.
* Promote a data-driven mindset and encourage teams to identify opportunities for operational improvement and business transformation.
* Establish and reinforce standards for process documentation, quality management, and knowledge management to ensure consistency and compliance across the organization.

title: Healthcare Community Contracting Manager
description:
Amgen’s Research and Development (R&D) Business Operations organization addresses complex business challenges with outstanding people, tools, and processes. The team delivers on key initiatives and capabilities to support R&D. This position is primarily responsible for owning the end-to-end workflow management and processing healthcare compliance related contracting and payments of proposed arrangements by Amgen staff with Members of the U.S. and global Healthcare Community (i.e. Fee for Service, Scientific Exchange, Consulting, Sponsorship, Donation, Exhibits, Advisory Boards or other similar engagements). We are looking for talent who have play a key role in supporting the healthcare contracting process and ensuring accurate and timely payments to members of the health care community. The HCC Contracting Manager requires a solid understanding of contracting as well as SAP software and its functionalities. The HCC Contracting Manager will collaborate with global, cross-functional teams, including legal, sourcing, accounts payable, and finance, to ensure smooth and seamless contract management and payment operations. We are a team that delivers for our partners!
  
  
Required Competencies and Skills:
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Lead in the review, drafting, and negotiation of contracts for members of the healthcare community. Responsible for complex agreements, requiring extensive knowledge of healthcare regulations, external healthcare engagements at a large biotechnology organization, business requirements and legal compliance. Operates independently, requiring minimal supervision, engaging business partners where appropriate. Oversees timeline management and escalations as appropriate. Engages with senior leadership. Participates in strategy sessions on the execution of work between OUS and US. Engagement with functional leads in OUS and US as necessary, including Responsible Amgen Employees, HCC, Finance, Procurement and country partners to keep requests moving, along with external partners, including professionals, organizations. Ability to effectively explain contract terms and positions to internal stakeholders. Own external administrative communications, including process guidance, missing information follow-up, contract execution, invoicing and payment status. Track FFS hours, contract expirations, aging requests, pending approvals, payment status and required post-engagement documentation. Ability to effectively communicate business risks to internal stakeholders and escalate as appropriate. Extensive document drafting experience (preferably in a fast-paced environment, e.g. consulting firms, biotech, tech companies, etc.) Manage sponsorship, membership and donation workflow, including supplier onboarding coordination, C3/TPS progression, budget-owner follow-up, payment tracking and closeout. Ensure submissions are complete, timely and routed correctly. Coordinate tangible-benefit execution, including deadlines, registrations, asset collection, proof of benefit, TPS closeout and reporting. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with legal, sourcing, accounts payable, and other relevant teams to streamline financial processes and resolve any issues or discrepancies. Ensure effective communication and foster positive working relationships. Ensure compliance with internal controls, policies, and regulations. Develop and enforce policies and procedures related to contracting and payment operations. Maintain complete, compliant and audit-ready documentation through submission, contracting, payment and closeout. Participate in audits and assist with compliance-related activities as required. Contribute to the development and implementation of strategic initiatives to optimize contracting and payment processes.
  
  
Knowledge:
  
  

* Excellent computer and MS Office skills
* Smartsheet
* Excellent writing skills; detail-oriented
* Communicates effectively within and outside department.
* Good understanding of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and healthcare regulations
* Project Management
* Proactive Mindset
* Decision Making
* Self-Starter
* Ability to work independently.
* Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
* Flexibility amidst rapidly changing environment
* Initiative and ability to ask questions.
* Experience with meeting planning and management
* Experience with facilitating vendor contracts and contracts with members of the healthcare community.
* Working knowledge of patient-engagement workflows, sponsorship/donation processes, C3, Cvent, TPS, supplier onboarding and payment requirements.
* Strong understanding of principals of customer service as it applies to internal customers and external partners.
* Vendor Management and oversight experience

Problem Solving:
  
  

* Ability to process complex transactions from end to end, engaging business partners where appropriate.
* Identify and escalate business issues needing resolution, identify potential process improvements and manage multiple assignments at one time.
* Exercises good judgment.
* Interact with business partners to ensure compliance processes and standards are understood and followed.
* Ability to prioritize competing interests and projects and manage a high volume of contract document requests.
* Maintaining oversight of contracts and payments team providing support to Amgen staff.
* Identify and escalate business issues needing resolution, as well as identifying potential process improvements and manage multiple assignments at one time.
* Ability to apply established compliance processes, identify exceptions and route matters to the appropriate HCC, Compliance, Legal or country-level authority.
* Determines actions required to resolve problems or issues and coordinates with other departments as needed to ensure resolution in a timely manner.

Contribution:
  
  

* Maintain key relationships by communicating and collaborating with cross-functional partners such as Law, Regulatory, Global Meeting Management and other Worldwide Compliance and Business Ethics groups, and the International Healthcare Compliance group.

Master’s OR Bachelor's degree and 8 - 12 years of biotech/pharma-related business operations/supplier management experience
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, contract terms, and payment processes.
* Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to effectively manage projects and teams.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Proficiency in contract management software and financial systems.

title: Senior Manager - Reliability Engineering
description:
ABOUT US:
  
  
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
OUR PEOPLE:
  
  
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.
  
  
ROLE PROFILE:
  
  
The Senior Manager - Reliability Engineering is accountable for the reliability, resilience, and operational effectiveness of critical enterprise applications and platforms throughout the service lifecycle.
  
  
The role will drive the evolution of the L2/SRE function from reactive production support towards proactive reliability engineering, using automation, observability, operational learning, and strong engineering partnerships to reduce toil, incidents, and operational risk.
  
  
Working across engineering, product, infrastructure, security, and support, the role will promote shared ownership of production reliability and ensure services are continuously improved to meet agreed levels of availability, performance, resilience, and customer experience.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Lead the L2/SRE function and its continuous improvement, with accountability for improving service reliability, resilience, operational efficiency, and engineering maturity.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing L2/SRE team, fostering accountability, technical capability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Define and mature Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets to support clear, data-led reliability and engineering decisions.
* Reduce operational toil through automation, improved tooling, self-service capabilities, and simplification of repetitive support activities.
* Establish strong observability and alerting standards across logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and telemetry to improve detection, diagnosis, and recovery.
* Define operational readiness standards, ensuring services are supportable, resilient, appropriately monitored, well documented, and have clear recovery and escalation procedures before entering production.
* Lead effective Incident Management within L2/SRE, including response, escalation, post-incident review, and identification of recurring issues. Partner with L3 on Problem Management and RCA, ensuring corrective actions and reliability improvements are tracked through to completion.
* Champion strong ITSM practices and operational hygiene across Incident, Problem, Change, service ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee proportionate, risk-based Change Management and approval processes, ensuring changes are appropriately assessed, dependencies and conflicts are understood, implementation and rollback plans are robust, and higher-risk activity receives the right level of scrutiny while avoiding unnecessary overhead for well-understood, low-risk change.
* Partner with L3 engineering and other technology teams to ensure production learnings, recurring incidents, support trends, and reliability concerns are reflected in engineering priorities and addressed at source.
* Drive resilience improvements through disaster recovery and failover testing, capacity planning, dependency analysis, and clear ownership of reliability-related technical debt.
* Define, monitor, and report on service health and reliability measures, including availability, performance, SLO attainment, incident trends, recovery times, operational risk, and improvement outcomes.
* Apply strong technical judgement, risk assessment, prioritisation, and conflict-resolution skills when making decisions in high-pressure operational situations.

What you'll get in return:
  
  
At LSEG, we invest in excellence. You’ll be part of a high-performing team where your expertise is valued and your impact is visible. We offer:
  
  

* Competitive compensation with performance-based rewards.
* A flexible hybrid work model that supports work-life balance.
* Access to cutting-edge tools and infrastructure to do your best work.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, including certifications, conferences, and internal mobility.
* A collaborative culture that values technical mastery, ownership, and innovation.
* The chance to work on a globally critical system that powers secure financial transactions across markets.

**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**

title: Principal Data Center Facilities Development Manager

Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

title: Director, Project Management
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
**Brief Team/department Description**
Azurity develops unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, to serve overlooked patients. This role is with Azurity R&D project management team, which coordinates cross-functional planning, development and tracking of project plans, considering time, cost, quality and strategy. As we grow and expand, we are building new capabilities to make our processes simpler, faster, and more efficient. We are looking for a dynamic, change-inspired leader, to lead R&D project management, and process improvement initiatives.
  
  
This role will report to the R&D head and act as an internal consultant operating from Azurity’s Hyderabad development center. The role holder provides input on resource (budget, headcount) strategy and support in setting the yearly product delivery KPI. This role will be responsible for managing the R&D Project Management department, defining, and implementing R&D Project Management processes. Holds the overall responsibility in the R&D PM team for ensuring Project Plans, Budgets, Timelines are tracked against baseline and updated as per the Program Management process. Ensure project plan alignment with portfolio and product lifecycle management (PLM) goals.
  
  
The role holder will lead cross-functional initiatives to enhance R&D productivity and streamline product development processes through targeted process improvements, tool evaluation, and vendor coordination. This role acts as the functional lead to ensure that technology-enabled solutions align closely with evolving R&D needs, leveraging a strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical R&D workflows, data and applicable concepts to effectively coordinate with external vendors, internal data science and digital teams. This role focuses on functional leadership and facilitation, responsible for working with the Chief Scientific Officer and science department heads to ensure streamlined processes are in place for meeting yearly KPIs, identifying process improvement & simplification opportunities.
  
  
The scope includes financial governance, reporting, resource planning, and process improvement. An ideal candidate will have experience with leading complex programs within the pharmaceutical development lifecycle, in addition to experience with CMO/CRO/lab operations. A deep understanding of project plans, budgeting / forecasting is a key attribute. This is a collaborative role involving significant engagement with cross-functional heads (such as Quality, finance, accounting, legal and IT), to drive programs and ensure adoption. This role will have the exciting and unique opportunity to drive Management System excellence and adoption within our growing Hyderabad organization. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who can work in an extremely fast paced organization and pivot from one objective to the next quickly.
  
  
**Principle Responsibilities**

* A) Lead project management
* Enable preparation and management of CSO-R&D budget, yearly KPIs and project plans. Enable project managers to identify, document and manage critical path activities. Review project plans, challenge project schedule baseline and assumptions. Ensure project managers have defined all activities with appropriate timelines, costs, risks and mitigation plans aligned with the project stakeholders.
* Through the project managers, prepare month-on-month project forecasts and manage CSO-level variance between forecast vs. actual within thresholds. Facilitate budget decisions and deliverables throughout the yearly cycle. Support the R&D head and science department heads in articulating decisions required, risks and layout options at appropriate level of depth to enable decisions.
* Enable project plan updation in A3 templates for all projects. Support the Franchise Portfolio Management and finance leadership with timeline, and cost evaluations when requested. Responsible for project status reporting to R&D scientific leadership team (SLT), Strategic Portfolio Management and other project stakeholders as required. Maintain management information systems on budget, timelines, key risks, and decisions.
* Partner with the finance leadership and co-own the Long-Range Budget forecast, responsible for R&D opex, capex, and product-level development cost. Align science department leadership on the stage-wise Probability of Technical & Regulatory success.
* B) Management systems & processes:
* Continuously improve the contract and purchase order (PO) management process for R&D, through a periodic review of SLA and goals with the legal and finance teams Facilitate regular and ad hoc project team meetings, ensuring documentation of agendas, minutes, and actions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (internal/external) to track key performance indicators
* Develop/maintain collaboration and nurture relationships with internal partner functions and external entities as required, to support business and strategic goals. Serve as the point person for initial escalation, conflict resolution, project risk mitigation for issues that cannot be resolved in the Project Teams, requiring liaising with department leaders
* Oversight, mentoring, training of PM team members on policies and procedures
* Support R&D operational planning - Lab space management, capex & support internal preparedness for QA audits, leadership visits.
* Responsible for drafting the R&D sections in management presentations, working with the department heads and the Chief Scientific Officer.
* C) Digital enablement initiatives:
* Lead a small team of PMs and manage the R&D digital budget, including annual subscriptions for off-the-shelf solutions as well as custom built solutions (external as well as in-house).
* Champion the evaluation of cutting-edge data tools and data-enabled solutions by working alongside internal digital, data science and technical teams to ensure deliverables meeting R&D’s strategic goals
* Lead end-to-end digital transformations from vendor selection to rollout, engaging with IT, cross functional teams and external vendors. Wherever optimal, lead in-house workflow creation and execution through the IT team.
* Serve as the internal business owner to the Azurity IT team, on R&D / laboratory systems such as E-Lab Notebook, Document mgmt. system. Drive functional oversight on integration projects involving lab systems, ensuring alignment with R&D workflows
* Build and manage vendor relationships through screening, onboarding and on-premises engagements. Define and monitor service expectations from external vendors via functionally aligned SLAs based on R&D user needs. Provide continuous feedback to vendors to ensure tools evolve with R&D processes, without taking direct ownership of the digital systems

**Qualifications/Educational Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* Master's degree preferred:
* MBA (Strategy, Operations, General Management, or Finance)
* MS/M.Pharm in a relevant scientific field
* Certifications (preferred, not mandatory)
* PMP
* PgMP
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt

**Preferred Experience**
15-20 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including:
  
  
**Project and Portfolio Management**

* At least 7-10 years managing cross-functional development programs.
* Experience with R&D portfolios rather than isolated projects.
* Experience leading governance meetings and stage-gate reviews.

**Budget Management**

* Ownership or co-ownership of departmental budgets.
* Experience reviewing forecasts prepared by analysts or PMs.
* Experience presenting budget updates to senior leadership.

**Process and Organizational Change**

* Designing new departmental processes.
* Simplifying complex workflows.
* Implementing systems such as Veeva, TrackWise, Planisware, Smartsheet, Clarity, Microsoft Project, etc.
* Creating governance models and decision-making frameworks.
* Driving organizational adoption of new ways of working.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: KYC Operations Team Lead
description:

title: Senior Manager, Technical Services
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support (India) is a strategic people leadership role responsible for overseeing the India-based Technical Services team and supporting the continued growth and evolution of USP's global Technical Services function. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality scientific product/service inquiry support, operational excellence, and an exceptional customer experience while fostering a high-performing, customer-centric culture.
  
  
The role operates within a matrixed leadership structure, functionally reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Success & Operations (US-based) and administratively reporting to the Director, Scientific Affairs (India-based). The incumbent will provide direct people leadership and administrative oversight for the India-based Technical Services team while partnering closely with the US-based Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides functional direction related to service delivery processes, performance standards, and inquiry management activities.
  
  
As USP continues to expand its global service delivery capabilities, this role is expected to evolve in scope and strategic impact, contributing to organizational scaling efforts, talent development, operational excellence initiatives, knowledge management, process optimization, workforce planning, and the advancement of global scientific and product/service support capabilities.
  
  
The Sr. Manager will collaborate extensively with stakeholders across Customer Success & Operations, Strategic Customer Development, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Reference Material Support, Reference Standards Technical Operations, Reference Standards Production, Distribution, Reference Standards Evaluation, Legal, Documentary Standards and Compendial Policy, Global Biologics, and other cross-functional teams located in both the United States and India.
  
  
The primary working shift for this position is 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support role has the following responsibilities:
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**People Leadership & Team Management**

* Provide leadership, guidance, direction, and administrative oversight to the India-based Technical Services team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity.
* Integrate employee engagement principles into daily leadership practices to cultivate a high-performing, motivated, and inclusive team environment, led by example through visible leadership and active coaching.
* Manage all aspects of employee performance, including goal setting, communicating job expectations, performance evaluations, coaching, mentoring, career development, recognition, corrective action, and succession planning.
* Partner with the Customer Success and Operations leadership team to support workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, employee retention, and capability development initiatives as the Technical Services organization continues to evolve and expand.
* Ensure team members have access to the appropriate resources, tools, training, and support required to effectively perform their responsibilities.

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides the functional strategy and strategic direction for the Global Technical Services, to effectively execute and operationalize the Technical Services operating model within India.
* Translate established strategies, processes, policies, procedures, training programs, and service delivery standards into consistent day-to-day execution, ensuring high-quality, efficient, and scalable service delivery.
* Provide local operational leadership, monitor performance and adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement that strengthen team effectiveness, service quality, and overall customer experience.
* Ensure adherence to applicable USP Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Department Controlled Documents, Operational Manuals, quality requirements such as audit readiness, and regulatory expectations.
* Monitor team performance against established service levels, quality standards, productivity goals, and customer experience objectives, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as needed.
* Utilize operational data, performance metrics, and customer feedback to identify trends, opportunities, and risks that support ongoing optimization of the Technical Services function.
* Support organizational initiatives focused on operational scalability, process harmonization, knowledge management, and service excellence.

**Scientific Inquiry Management & Quality Oversight**

* Maintain a strong understanding of USP products, services, scientific resources, and customer support processes to effectively lead and support the team.
* Remain proficient in the functionality and use of Salesforce, including the Case Management Module and related service technologies.
* Conduct case quality reviews and quality assurance assessments for both US- and India-based Technical Services team members to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance with established standards.
* Support the development and maintenance of knowledge assets, best practices, training materials, and quality improvement initiatives that enhance inquiry resolution effectiveness.
* Serve as a first point of escalation and directly manage customer inquiries as needed based on business demands, inquiry complexity, volume fluctuations, or resource requirements.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Support**

* Collaborate with Customer Success & Operations, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Legal, Distribution, Global Science teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to support customer and organizational objectives.
* Facilitate effective communication and alignment between India-based team members and global stakeholders, helping to ensure consistency in service delivery and execution.
* Contribute to the continued evolution of USP's global Technical Services operating model by identifying opportunities to enhance team capabilities, operational effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
* Participate in special projects, strategic initiatives, organizational transformation efforts, and other duties as assigned, supporting the long-term growth and maturity of the Technical Services function.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
  
  

* Master's degree in chemistry or relevant scientific field
* Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in the pharmaceutical field, which includes hands-on experience and expertise in chromatography, spectroscopy, and other analytical testing methods.
* Minimum of 2 years of management experience.
* Must demonstrate a strong customer-centric mindset with a consistent focus on delivering high-quality service, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction in a regulated or technical environment.
* Must have experience translating scientific or technical expertise into effective customer support, issue resolution, and service excellence outcomes within cross-functional teams.
* Must be willing to work in 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST shift.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Willingness to travel to USP–Rockville for initial training purposes for approximately 2–4 weeks
* Knowledge of USP standards-setting processes, compendial terminology, USP Documentary Standards, and USP reference materials
* Familiarity with laboratory workflows and ability to interpret customer issues related to reference materials and analytical testing to support effective resolution
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage a high volume of work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a matrixed, global team environment
* Ability to maintain composure, professionalism, and positive engagement in high-pressure or time-sensitive situations
* Willingness and ability to work flexible and/or extended hours when required to support global operations and customer needs
* Sufficient typing skills to support efficient case documentation and system usage
* Preferred but not required: experience using Salesforce CRM or similar case management systems

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Will lead a team of 5 scientists responsible for managing customer inquiries related to USP Documentary Standards and USP Physical Materials.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

Chemistry & Scientific Standards
  
  
**Job Type**

* Adhere to all IT governance process including: Global Development & Infrastructure Councils, Change Advisory Board, and Computershare Risk Assessment Methodology (CRAM).
