title: Sr Manager, Software Development & Engineering Lead (PL)
description:
Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Role Description**
The role based in Schwab India, part of our Global Capability Center in Hyderabad, will be part of Schwab Asset Management Technology, which is part of Schwab Technology Services. Schwab Asset Management Technology is aligned to support the technology needs of Schwab Asset Management and the broader Schwab organization. As part of the Charles Schwab organization, we champion the needs of investors and seek to enhance the financial lives of our clients in all we do. Operating our business through clients’ eyes and putting them at the center of our decisions, we aim to deliver exceptional experiences to investors and the financial professionals who serve them.
  
  
SAM Tech enables SAM to deliver investment solutions at scale — powering the full lifecycle comprising trading, portfolio management, research and operations across SAM Funds, ETFs, and Managed Accounts Solutions. The suite of platforms delivers scalable front, middle and back-office capabilities across Advisor Services and Investor Services, including Alternatives and third-party Insurance and Annuities.
  
  
The Data and Distribution Practice Leader will serve as a key leadership point of contact for the India-based Data and Distribution capability, partnering closely with U.S. and India leadership to build local talent, strengthen engineering leadership, and drive a consistent global execution model. This role is less focused on ownership of a single technology stack or platform and more focused on building a scalable practice: developing local leaders, establishing delivery discipline, enabling execution oversight, and advancing delivery excellence across teams. The leader will help shape how work is planned, staffed, executed, measured, and continuously improved across the Data and Distribution domain.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**
Provide people, practice, and execution leadership for the Data and Distribution capability in Schwab India, partnering with global leaders to establish a strong India-based leadership presence and delivery model.
  
  
Serve as the local practice leader and primary point of contact for Data and Distribution leadership needs, ensuring alignment across business priorities, technology strategy, delivery commitments, staffing, and execution health.
  
  
Build, mentor, and develop local talent and emerging leaders across engineering, quality, analysis, and delivery roles, creating a sustainable leadership pipeline for the Data and Distribution practice.
  
  
Drive a consistent global execution model across India and U.S. teams, including operating rhythms, communication practices, delivery planning, dependency management, escalation paths, and execution transparency.
  
  
Provide execution oversight across Data and Distribution initiatives, helping teams manage scope, risks, dependencies, quality, and delivery outcomes in partnership with product, technology, and business stakeholders.
  
  
Champion delivery excellence by promoting disciplined Agile execution, continuous improvement, engineering accountability, operational readiness, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
Partner with domain and platform leaders to ensure India teams are effectively integrated into global operating models, with clear ownership, strong collaboration, and a shared focus on business outcomes.
  
  
Foster a culture of inclusion, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning, ensuring teams are empowered to deliver high-quality solutions and grow as part of Schwab’s broader technology organization.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Proven leadership experience building, scaling, and leading technology teams in a global delivery environment.
  
  

* Demonstrated success as a Practice or Capability Leader with responsibility for talent development, delivery oversight, governance, and business outcomes.
* Strong strategic thinking and business acumen with the ability to align execution to organizational priorities and long-term objectives.
* Experience partnering with senior technology, product, business, and operations leaders across global organizations.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology delivery, including Agile execution, program management, risk management, governance, and operational excellence.
* Proven track record of driving delivery excellence through accountability, execution transparency, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience coaching and developing managers, technical leaders, and high-potential talent to build a sustainable leadership pipeline.
* Ability to establish scalable operating models and execution frameworks across globally distributed teams.
* Strong influencing, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive alignment across multiple organizations.
* Functional knowledge of Asset Management, including investment management, trading, research, operations, performance measurement, client reporting, and compliance.
* Understanding of Front Office, Middle Office, Data & Distribution capabilities and the end-to-end investment lifecycle.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.

**Preffered Qualification**
Experience leading teams within a Global Capability Center (GCC) or similar global delivery model.
  
  

* Experience building and scaling practices, capabilities, or leadership organizations through periods of growth and transformation.
* Demonstrated success driving transformation across people, process, technology, and operating models.
* Ability to establish a compelling vision, inspire teams, and influence change across matrixed organizations.
* Experience creating diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team cultures.
* Deep understanding of Asset Management data domains, including security master, holdings, performance, benchmark, market, pricing, and client reporting data.
* Familiarity with investment distribution capabilities supporting Advisor Services, Investor Services, institutional channels, and client reporting.
* Experience supporting Asset Management functions such as Portfolio Management, Trading, Investment Operations, Distribution, Product Management, and Client Reporting.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
* Experience leading globally distributed teams and establishing effective partnership models across U.S. and India organizations.
* Commitment to high ethical standards, integrity, accountability, inclusion, and a client-first culture.

What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.
  
  
**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more

* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded IT&D Manager to lead the Advanced Annual Planning and Optimization capabilities (referred to as Local Success Model – LSM) of the Revenue Growth Management (RGM) platform globally. The primary role is to act as a bridge between business stakeholders and the technology teams, owning the roadmap of the solution and manage the on-going deployment and adoption within the markets. The ultimate objective is to deliver insights which create value and drive business forward in the space of annual assortment, pricing and promotion planning and optimization, whilst ensuring synergy, cost effectiveness and appropriate levels of data governance.
  
  
This candidate will need to demonstrate an effective communication and delivery skillset and collaborate confidently with mid-senior levels of the organisation. We are looking for someone who can innovate, with the ability to encourage performance and motivate peers and the wider organisation to embrace advanced data & analytics capabilities.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Capability Management
  
  
 Define and own the feature roadmap for the Advanced LSM, price pack architecture & purchase structures of the global RGM platform
  
  
 Gather and translate business requirements from commercial and sales teams into technical user stories and acceptance criteria
  
  
 Prioritize backlogs and make decisions aligned to the business value
  
  
 Partner with the technology teams, data engineers, analysts, and application developers to deliver the capabilities
  
  
 Manage the full technology lifecycle — from discovery and design through build, testing, and deployment
  
  
 Drive adoption of the Advanced LSM module together with price pack architecture & purchase structure across RGM, Trade Marketing and Sales function, ensuring tools are effectively utilized to achieve business objectives
  
  
 Monitor usage and identify opportunities for improvement and enhancement
  
  
 Utilize a deep understanding of FMCG categories and external data to inform development and deployment strategies
  
  
 Manage vendor relationships, including implementation partners and third-party data providers (Nielsen, IQVIA, etc.)
  
  
The experience we're looking for
  
  
 6-8+ years in business analysis, or IT management roles
  
  
 Proven experience in designing, deploying and adopting analytical tools within commercial teams
  
  
 Experience in working with the RGM, Trade Marketing, or Sales functions
  
  
 Proven track record in driving adoption and transformation at scale
  
  
Preferred experience for role:
  
  
** FMCG / Consumer Goods Experience Preferred**
The skills for success
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  

* Familiarity with RGM solutions or platforms
* Understanding of data pipelines, data science models, application development, and cloud environments
* Ability to write or review functional specifications and API requirements
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and cross-functional team collaboration

Business Acumen
  
  

* Strong grasp of RGM levers: annual planning, pricing strategy, promotion optimization, promotion planning, promotion effectiveness, trade investment, pack/price architecture, mix management
* Ability to translate commercial strategy and processes into technology design and decisions

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent stakeholder management across senior commercial and IT leadership
* Strong communication — able to speak both “business” and “tech”
* Analytical mindset with comfort around large datasets

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. .

You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.

title: Supply Chain Manager– After Market
description:
**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
The Supply Chain Manager – After Market will be responsible for managing the end-to-end After Market supply chain process, including demand coordination, inventory planning, allocation, fulfillment, logistics follow-up, warranty support, and service-parts availability.
  
  
This role will ensure that After Market and Warranty requirements are planned, executed, tracked, and escalated with clear ownership and measurable performance. The position will work closely with Service Sales, Asset Management, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, Sourcing, Quality, Product, Finance, and regional Supply Chain teams to improve service reliability, inventory control, and operational execution.
  
  
The role requires strong operational discipline, hands-on supply chain management, analytical capability, and the ability to convert business needs into clear actions, KPIs, and process improvements. While the position is primarily execution-focused, it will also support the development of a more scalable After Market operating model as the business grows and new product lines are introduced.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
After Market Supply Chain Execution
  
  

* Manage the end-to-end After Market supply chain flow from demand intake through allocation, fulfillment, shipment tracking, and delivery confirmation.
* Ensure After Market and Warranty orders are monitored proactively and delivered in line with agreed service expectations.
* Maintain visibility of open demand, blocked orders, aging lines, inventory availability, supplier constraints, and logistics risks.
* Coordinate cross-functionally to resolve execution issues across planning, warehouse operations, logistics, sourcing, and service teams.
* Escalate blockers early with clear facts, business impact, options, and recommended actions.

Demand Planning and Inventory Control
  
  

* Support the After Market demand-planning process using historical consumption, warranty demand, installed base information, customer/service inputs, and forecast assumptions.
* Maintain a rolling view of demand by key part families and critical service items.
* Separate confirmed demand from forecast or potential demand to avoid creating unnecessary inventory exposure.
* Review inventory health, including stock availability, inventory turns, coverage, slow-moving items, excess stock, and obsolete-risk items.
* Recommend actions to consume, rebalance, transfer, hold, replenish, or escalate inventory based on business need and service risk.
* Support inventory policy decisions such as make-to-stock vs make-to-order, safety stock, reorder logic, and preferred stocking locations.

Fulfillment and Logistics Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure timely picking, packing, shipping, and delivery of After Market and Warranty orders.
* Track shipment status and ensure visibility of road freight, last-mile delivery, freight-forwarder updates, and delivery confirmation.
* Identify root causes of service delays, including allocation gaps, warehouse execution, transportation delays, customer readiness, supplier issues, or system constraints.
* Work with Logistics and Warehouse Operations to improve fulfillment lead time, shipment reliability, and cost visibility.

KPI Management and Operating Rhythm
  
  

* Prepare and manage regular After Market performance reviews, including service performance, backlog, aging orders, inventory health, open risks, and action closure.
* Track key KPIs such as on-time delivery, order aging, days to allocate, days to ship, days to deliver, backlog, inventory coverage, forecast accuracy, and root cause of service misses.
* Use reporting tools such as ERP, planning systems, Power BI, Excel, or equivalent dashboards to support decision-making.
* Where system reporting is incomplete, maintain practical interim controls while supporting process and data improvements.

Warranty, RMA/VRA and Reverse Logistics Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate with the teams responsible for warranty returns, RMA, VRA, and reverse logistics to ensure visibility of open cases and inventory impact.
* Support clear handoffs between After Market planning, warehouse operations, logistics, finance, procurement, and service teams.
* Help reduce aging records and unresolved cases by ensuring actions, owners, and blockers are clearly tracked.
* Ensure reverse logistics decisions consider value, cost, service impact, inspection, repacking, refurbishment, scrap, vendor return, or storage requirements.

Process Improvement and Business Growth Support
  
  

* Identify recurring process gaps and drive practical improvements in planning, fulfillment, logistics follow-up, and inventory control.

title: Production lead – Printing & Production Operations
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Production Manager to oversee end-to-end print production operations, including vendor management, cost negotiation, quality control, delivery coordination, and production documentation.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete lifecycle of print deliverables, from understanding client requirements and print specifications to coordinating with printers, monitoring production timelines, inspecting finished materials, and ensuring timely delivery. The ideal candidate must have strong knowledge of paper grades, GSM, printing techniques, finishing processes, binding, packaging, and quality standards, along with excellent negotiation and coordination skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Print Production Management
* Manage end-to-end production of print materials, including scientific journals, medical education modules, calendars, brochures, booklets, newsletters, certificates, conference materials, and other marketing collaterals.
* Understand production briefs, artwork, quantities, dimensions, paper specifications, finishing requirements, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure all print jobs are executed according to approved specifications and quality standards.
* Monitor production schedules and proactively address delays or operational challenges.
* Vendor & Printer Management
* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and maintain relationships with printing vendors, paper suppliers, binding units, packaging vendors, and logistics partners.
* Coordinate with printers at every stage, from quotation and proof approval to production, inspection, dispatch, and delivery.
* Obtain competitive quotations from multiple vendors and assess them based on cost, quality, reliability, and turnaround time.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial terms to achieve cost efficiencies.
* Maintain an updated vendor database, including capabilities, pricing, turnaround times, and performance records.
* Knowledge of Paper & Print Specifications
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of paper types, grades, GSM, thickness, texture, opacity, and suitability for different print applications.
* Understand printing methods, including offset and digital printing, as well as lamination, UV coating, binding, folding, die-cutting, and other finishing techniques.
* Interpret technical specifications accurately, including dimensions, colour requirements, page counts, cover materials, binding styles, and packaging instructions.
* Verify that the paper and materials used by vendors match the approved specifications.
* Identify material substitutions or specification deviations before production and obtain approval wherever required.
* Costing & Budget Control
* Prepare and evaluate print production estimates and quotations.
* Negotiate with vendors to secure competitive pricing without compromising quality.
* Compare actual production costs against approved budgets and identify opportunities for savings.
* Track cost variations arising from changes in quantities, paper specifications, artwork, finishing, or delivery requirements.
* Ensure all commercial commitments and additional costs are documented and approved.
* Quality Control & Inspection
* Inspect samples, colour proofs, paper quality, print alignment, colour consistency, binding, finishing, and overall workmanship.
* Ensure the final output matches the approved artwork, specifications, sample, and purchase order.
* Identify defects such as incorrect GSM, colour variations, misprints, poor binding, damaged copies, and quantity shortages.
* Coordinate corrective actions, reprints, replacements, or vendor claims wherever necessary.
* Ensure that only approved, quality-checked materials are dispatched to clients or designated locations.
* Delivery & Logistics Coordination
* Ensure timely delivery of all print materials to clients, offices, warehouses, event venues, and other designated locations.
* Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners for dispatch schedules, packaging, transportation, and delivery tracking.
* Monitor committed delivery dates and escalate potential delays well in advance.
* Verify delivered quantities against purchase orders and dispatch records.
* Ensure appropriate packaging, labelling, carton identification, and shipment documentation for every delivery.
* Documentation & Reporting
* Maintain complete documentation for every print job, including:

+ Production briefs and approved specifications.
+ Vendor quotations and cost comparisons.
+ Purchase orders and work orders.
+ Artwork and proof approvals.
+ Paper specifications and quality inspection reports.
+ Delivery challans, e-way bills wherever applicable, invoices, and dispatch records.
+ Delivery confirmations, shortage reports, and quality-related claims.

* Maintain a production tracker covering job status, vendor, quantities, costs, deadlines, and delivery status.
* Provide regular updates to management and internal teams on production progress, delays, costs, and pending deliveries.
* Ensure records are accurate, traceable, and readily available for audits and financial reconciliation.
* Internal Coordination
* Work closely with client servicing, medical education, design, accounts, procurement, and operations teams.
* Clarify technical requirements before releasing jobs to printers.
* Ensure approved artwork, specifications, quantities, and delivery instructions are communicated clearly to vendors.
* Coordinate invoice verification against purchase orders, agreed pricing, and actual deliveries.
* Take ownership of production-related issues and ensure timely resolution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Printing Technology, Print Production, Graphic Arts, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Relevant experience in print production, commercial printing, publishing, or production operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of paper quality, GSM, printing processes, binding, finishing, and packaging.
* Proven experience in vendor coordination, quotation evaluation, and cost negotiation.
* Strong understanding of production planning, quality control, inventory, and delivery management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and documentation, with the ability to maintain production trackers and cost comparison sheets.
* Strong communication, negotiation, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple jobs simultaneously.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time delivery rate of print jobs.
* Adherence to approved print specifications and quality standards.
* Cost savings achieved through vendor negotiations.
* Reduction in printing errors, reprints, wastage, and material shortages.
* Accuracy and completeness of production documentation.
* Vendor performance and responsiveness.
* Timely resolution of production and delivery issues.
* Adherence to approved budgets and purchase order values.

title: Showroom Manager
description:
Hiring: Showroom Manager – KOHIRA Diamonds

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Company: KOHIRA Diamonds

Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site

About KOHIRA Diamonds

KOHIRA is a fast-growing premium lab-grown diamond jewellery brand, committed to offering exceptional craftsmanship, certified diamonds, contemporary designs, and an outstanding customer experience.

As we expand our retail presence across India, we are looking for an experienced, dynamic, and result-oriented Showroom Manager to lead our Hyderabad showroom operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales & Business Growth

\* Take complete ownership of showroom sales targets, revenue growth, and profitability.

\* Drive daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance.

\* Improve walk-in conversions, average transaction value, and repeat purchases.

\* Develop strategies to increase customer footfall and showroom revenue.

2. BTL Marketing & Local Business Development

\* Independently plan and execute strong Below-the-Line (BTL) marketing activities to generate showroom footfall and qualified leads.

\* Build relationships with nearby residential societies, corporate offices, premium communities, and local businesses.

\* Organize society activations, corporate exhibitions, promotional events, referral activities, and local customer engagement programmes.

\* Monitor BTL activity performance, lead generation, conversions, and ROI.

\* Proactively develop new local customer acquisition opportunities.

3. Team Leadership & Motivation

\* Lead, inspire, train, and motivate the showroom sales team.

\* Set individual sales targets and regularly review team performance.

\* Conduct daily morning meetings, product training, and sales coaching.

\* Build a high-performance, customer-focused sales culture.

\* Ensure discipline, accountability, grooming, and professional behaviour.

4. Diamond Jewellery Expertise & Customer Experience

\* Demonstrate excellent knowledge of natural and lab-grown diamonds, including the 4Cs, certification, quality, and jewellery craftsmanship.

\* Explain diamond characteristics, product value, and jewellery features confidently to customers.

\* Deliver a premium and personalised luxury jewellery shopping experience.

\* Handle high-value customers, negotiations, escalations, and customer relationships professionally.

\* Ensure effective CRM follow-ups, customer retention, and repeat business.

5. Showroom Operations & Compliance

\* Manage day-to-day showroom operations, including opening and closing procedures.

\* Ensure stock accuracy, inventory control, visual merchandising, and showroom presentation.

\* Maintain compliance with company SOPs, billing procedures, security standards, and cash-handling policies.

\* Monitor CRM updates, customer inquiries, pending orders, and sales reports.

\* Coordinate with Head Office and regional management for smooth operations.

Required Qualifications & Experience

\* Minimum 5–7 years of experience in the jewellery retail industry.

\* Minimum 2–3 years of proven experience as a Showroom Manager / Store Manager with an established jewellery brand.

\* Strong knowledge of diamond jewellery, diamond grading, certification, and jewellery retail sales.

\* Proven experience in achieving sales targets and leading showroom teams.

\* Demonstrated ability to independently plan and execute BTL marketing activities.

\* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

\* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to inspire and develop a team.

\* Proficiency in CRM, retail reporting, and basic showroom management systems.

\* Fluency in English, Hindi, and Telugu preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a hands-on business leader, not just an operations manager.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently driving showroom sales, generating local business through BTL activities, developing a motivated sales team, and delivering an exceptional luxury jewellery customer experience.

Candidates with experience in reputed branded diamond jewellery retail chains will be preferred.

Why Join KOHIRA?

\* Be part of a rapidly expanding premium diamond jewellery brand.

\* Opportunity to lead showroom growth and local market development.

\* Performance-driven work culture with opportunities for career advancement.

\* Opportunity to grow with KOHIRA’s expanding pan-India retail network.

Apply now and become part of KOHIRA Diamonds’ growth journey.

The User Access Manager is a senior individual contributor and people leader responsible for the day-to-day operation, health, and continuous improvement of alterDomus' Identity and Access Management capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of operational excellence and strategic enablement, ensuring that the right people have the right access to the right resources — nothing more, nothing less.
  
  
Leading a team of 10 professionals — 1 Team Lead, 3 Shift Leads and 6 Access Management Analysts — the User Access Manager will own BAU delivery across the three IAM pillars: Identity Governance (SailPoint IdentityNow), Customer Identity (Okta / Auth0), and Privileged Access (CyberArk PAM, EPM & WPM). The role operates within alterDomus' broader Cyber Resiliency Programme and reports directly to the CISO or Deputy CISO.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Team Leadership & BAU Delivery
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10 professionals — comprising 1 Team Lead, 3 Shift Leads and 6 Access Management Analysts — across the three platform domains.
* Own the BAU service model: incident triage, access request fulfilment, certification campaigns, and recertification reviews; maintaining 24×5 operational coverage.
* Define team SLAs, OKRs, and operational KPIs; produce regular MI for CISO and governance forums.
* Manage on-call rotation and escalation paths to ensure 24/7 operational cover where required.

Identity Governance & Administration — SailPoint IdentityNow / Identity Security Cloud
  
  

* Serve as the functional owner of the SailPoint IDN/ISC platform across all production, UAT, and sandbox environments.
* Drive lifecycle management processes: joiner/mover/leaver, access request, approval workflows, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Maintain and extend source/target connectors (Salesforce, Active Directory, ServiceNow, cloud SaaS).
* Lead Separation of Duties (SoD) policy enforcement, access certification design, and audit evidence generation.

Customer Identity & Access Management — Okta / Auth0
  
  

* Own the CIAM platform landscape, covering both Okta Workforce Identity and Auth0 Customer Identity tenants.
* Govern MFA policies, adaptive authentication, SSO federation (SAML/OIDC), and B2B/B2C user journeys.
* Partner with application teams to onboard new integrations, enforce secure token flows, and maintain API security standards.
* Monitor and respond to anomalous authentication events; drive threat model reviews of identity attack surfaces.

Privileged Access Management — CyberArk PAM, EPM & WPM
  
  

* Manage the operational lifecycle of privileged accounts across the enterprise, including service accounts, admin credentials, and secrets.
* Maintain CyberArk vault health, session recording policy, and just-in-time (JIT) provisioning workflows in PAM and WPM.
* Administer CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager (EPM): manage application control policies, least-privilege enforcement on endpoints, and threat protection coverage.
* Enforce least-privilege principles through regular privilege entitlement reviews and attestation cycles.
* Support red-team and penetration-testing activities by providing PAM architecture context and remediation ownership.

Risk, Compliance & Audit
  
  

* Act as the primary IAM subject matter expert (SME) for internal audits, external assessments, and regulatory reviews (DORA, GDPR, SOX, ISO 27001).
* Maintain an IAM risk register; track and remediate control deficiencies to agreed timelines.

* Proven operational experience with Okta and/or Auth0 in an enterprise or multi-tenant environment.
* Experience of working with technical IAM team, with accountability for BAU service delivery.
* Familiriaty with identity protocols: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP/AD.
* Solid grounding in regulatory frameworks relevant to financial services: SOC 1 & 2, ISO 27001.

+ OR equivalent experience.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Experience:**
12+ Years
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Function:**
Technology / Customer Success
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly accomplished
**Technical Account Manager (TAM)**
to serve as a strategic technology advisor and executive-facing leader for enterprise customers.
  
  
The TAM will act as a
**trusted technology and business partner to CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and senior business stakeholders**
, driving technology strategy, operational excellence, service governance, financial performance and long-term customer value across
**AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud**
environments.
  
  
The role will have significant responsibility for
**customer retention, revenue growth, P&L management, billing governance and commercial performance**
, in addition to technical and operational leadership.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of
**OEM technology and service offerings**
, including cloud platforms, infrastructure, security, networking, observability, databases, backup, disaster recovery and enterprise software ecosystems, and should be able to translate these offerings into appropriate customer solutions and commercial opportunities.
  
  
This role requires strong technical credibility, executive presence, commercial acumen and the ability to translate complex technology initiatives into
**measurable business and financial outcomes**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Executive Customer Leadership & CXO Engagement


+ Serve as the senior technical and strategic point of contact for assigned enterprise and strategic accounts.
+ Build trusted relationships with CIO, CTO, CISO and other senior technology and business stakeholders.
+ Understand customer business priorities and translate them into technology and business strategies.
+ Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Executive Steering Committees and strategic account reviews.
+ Present service performance, technology risks, transformation initiatives, financial metrics and improvement opportunities to executive audiences.
+ Act as the voice of the customer internally and ensure strong alignment between customer expectations and delivery teams.
+ Own the overall customer relationship and proactively address risks that could impact customer satisfaction, retention or revenue.
+ Build executive-level relationships that support long-term account growth and strategic partnership.

* Strategic Cloud Advisory & Architecture Governance


+ Provide strategic architectural oversight across AWS, Azure and/or GCP environments.
+ Advise customers on cloud adoption, modernization, migration and cloud-native transformation.
+ Drive adoption of Well-Architected, reliability engineering, security-by-design and automation-first principles.
+ Lead cloud maturity assessments and develop multi-year technology transformation roadmaps.
+ Identify opportunities for application modernization, platform engineering, automation and operational simplification.
+ Provide guidance on high availability, resilience, disaster recovery, scalability and capacity planning.
+ Partner with enterprise architects and engineering teams to ensure architectural decisions align with business objectives.

* OEM & Technology Ecosystem Management


+ Maintain a strong understanding of OEM technology portfolios, product capabilities, licensing models, support models and professional/managed service offerings.
+ Understand the positioning and value proposition of major OEMs across cloud, compute, storage, networking, security, databases, backup, DR, observability and enterprise applications.
+ Evaluate OEM solutions against customer requirements and recommend appropriate technology and service options.
+ Engage with OEMs and technology partners to leverage their technical expertise, support capabilities, professional services and commercial programs.
+ Identify opportunities to combine OEM solutions with managed services to create differentiated customer propositions.
+ Stay current with changes in OEM product roadmaps, licensing models, cloud marketplace offerings and technology trends.
+ Support Sales and Pre-Sales teams in developing technology solutions, proposals and account expansion strategies.

* Service Governance & Operational Excellence


+ Govern SLA, KPI and OLA performance across CloudOps, SRE, DevOps, Security and Platform Engineering teams.
+ Establish and drive continuous service improvement initiatives.
+ Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned practices across Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Management.
+ Lead major incident and escalation management, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and root-cause resolution.
+ Review operational trends and proactively identify service risks before they impact the customer.
+ Govern disaster recovery readiness, business continuity, capacity management and operational resilience.
+ Drive automation and proactive monitoring to reduce recurring incidents and manual operational effort.
+ Establish service improvement plans with measurable outcomes and executive visibility.

* FinOps, P&L, Revenue & Commercial Management


+ Demonstrate strong understanding of FinOps principles, practices and operating models across cloud environments.
+ Drive cloud financial management covering cost visibility, allocation, optimization, forecasting, budgeting and governance.
+ Identify opportunities to optimize cloud consumption and improve customer technology economics without compromising performance, security or resilience.
+ Own or contribute significantly to the P&L performance of assigned customer accounts or service portfolios.
+ Manage account-level revenue, gross margin, cost base and profitability in partnership with business and finance teams.
+ Own revenue management and forecasting, including actuals, run-rate revenue, pipeline, renewals and growth opportunities.
+ Monitor account financial performance and proactively address revenue leakage, margin erosion and cost overruns.
+ Identify opportunities for upsell, cross-sell, expansion and transformation-led revenue growth.
+ Partner with Sales, Finance and Delivery teams to develop account growth and profitability plans.
+ Ensure services are delivered within agreed commercial and financial parameters.

* Billing, Collections & Revenue Assurance


+ Own governance of the customer billing lifecycle, ensuring accurate, timely and complete invoicing.
+ Ensure billing is aligned with contracts, statements of work, consumption, SLAs, milestones and agreed pricing models.
+ Proactively identify and resolve billing disputes, revenue leakage and invoicing discrepancies.
+ Partner with Finance, Accounts Receivable and Delivery teams to improve billing accuracy and collection performance.
+ Monitor outstanding receivables, disputed invoices and payment risks for strategic accounts.
+ Establish governance mechanisms to minimize billing delays and improve DSO / cash realization.
+ Ensure changes in scope, consumption, resources and service levels are appropriately reflected in commercial and billing processes.

* Customer Retention & Account Growth


+ Take accountability for customer retention and account health across assigned strategic accounts.
+ Establish early-warning mechanisms to identify customer dissatisfaction, service risks and competitive threats.
+ Develop and execute customer recovery and retention plans where required.
+ Track customer satisfaction, executive engagement, service performance and commercial health.
+ Build multi-year customer relationships and position the organization as a strategic technology partner.
+ Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships through cloud transformation, modernization, security, automation and managed services.
+ Partner with Sales and Account Management to develop and execute account growth strategies.

* Leadership & Cross-Functional Orchestration


+ Lead and coordinate cross-functional technology teams to deliver seamless customer outcomes.
+ Orchestrate activities across Cloud Operations, Architecture, Security, DevOps, SRE, Service Management, Finance and Engineering.
+ Mentor and coach junior TAMs, service delivery managers and technical leaders.
+ Collaborate closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Enterprise Architecture, Product, Finance and Delivery leadership.
+ Establish an automation-first, reliability-first and customer-outcome-focused culture.
+ Influence without direct authority across geographically distributed teams and customer organizations.

**Required Qualifications & Certifications**
**Mandatory**




+ 12+ years of experience across IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Managed Services, Technology Operations or related areas.
+ Minimum 5+ years in Technical Account Management, Service Delivery Leadership, Cloud Program Management or equivalent customer-facing technology leadership roles.
+ Proven experience managing strategic enterprise customers and complex technology environments.
+ Demonstrated ability to engage effectively with CIO, CTO, CISO and other CXO-level stakeholders.
+ Strong understanding of enterprise cloud architecture, operations, security, reliability and governance.
+ Experience managing large-scale or multi-million-dollar managed services engagements.
+ Demonstrated experience with P&L, revenue management, commercial governance or account financial management.
+ Strong understanding of billing, revenue assurance, collections and customer retention.
+ Strong understanding of OEM technology products, services, licensing and support models.
+ Strong understanding of FinOps principles and cloud financial management.

**Mandatory Professional-Level Cloud Certification**
**At Least One Of The Following**




+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
+ AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
+ Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect

**Preferred Certifications**




+ FinOps Practitioner
+ ITIL Foundation / ITIL Intermediate or higher
+ PMP / PRINCE2
+ CISSP or equivalent cloud/security certification
+ AWS, Azure or GCP specialty certifications

**Core Technical & Business Competencies**
**The Successful Candidate Should Demonstrate Strong Knowledge Across**




+ AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
+ FinOps and Cloud Financial Management
+ Cloud architecture and modernization
+ Cloud migration and transformation
+ OEM product and service portfolios
+ OEM licensing, subscription and support models
+ Cloud marketplace and partner ecosystems
+ SRE, DevOps and platform engineering
+ Infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code
+ Cloud security and IAM
+ Business continuity and disaster recovery
+ Observability, monitoring and operational resilience
+ ITIL-based service management
+ P&L and profitability management
+ Revenue forecasting and management
+ Billing and revenue assurance
+ Collections and receivables management
+ Customer retention and account growth
+ SLA/KPI governance and service improvement
+ Enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps
+ Vendor and stakeholder management
+ Executive communication and presentation

**Leadership Profile**
**We Are Looking For An Individual Who**




+ Can operate comfortably between deep technical discussions and CXO-level business conversations.
+ Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for customer, operational and financial outcomes.
+ Has demonstrated experience managing P&L, revenue and commercial performance.
+ Has strong understanding of FinOps and cloud economics.
+ Has broad knowledge of OEM technology offerings and partner ecosystems.
+ Is commercially aware and able to identify opportunities for value creation, retention and account growth.
+ Can challenge customers constructively while maintaining trusted relationships.
+ Has strong crisis-management and executive-escalation capabilities.
+ Can influence multiple technical teams without relying solely on formal authority.
+ Thinks strategically while maintaining sufficient technical depth to challenge architectural and operational decisions.
+ Is passionate about improving customer experience, reliability, automation and operational maturity.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role will be measured through:
  
  

+ Customer retention and renewal rate
+ Customer satisfaction and executive stakeholder engagement
+ Revenue growth and account expansion
+ P&L performance and gross margin
+ Revenue forecast accuracy
+ Billing accuracy and timeliness
+ Reduction in billing disputes and revenue leakage
+ DSO / collections performance
+ Cloud cost optimization and FinOps outcomes
+ Effective utilization of OEM and technology partner capabilities
+ Consistent achievement of SLA/KPI and service performance objectives
+ Reduction in recurring incidents and operational risk
+ Improved cloud reliability, security and resilience
+ Successful delivery of modernization and transformation roadmaps
+ Improved automation and operational efficiency
+ Strong collaboration and performance across cross-functional delivery teams

* Experience with large-scale organizational change effort

title: Lead - Oracle Fusion Projects
description:
**Job Description**
**Lead – Oracle Fusion Projects**
The
*San Francisco Chronicle*
has recognized Nextpower (Nasdaq: NXT) as one of the Top Workplaces. Join our growing team!
  
  
This is a
**hybrid role (4 days/week in office)**
at our Hi-Tech City office, Hyderabad. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated
**Lead – Oracle Fusion Projects**
to manage the transition of Nextpower’s global project execution process to a new ERP (Oracle Fusion). This is a strategic role partnering with Sales Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain to implement and optimize systems that drive operational growth and efficiency.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical expertise with deep functional knowledge of projects execution to close in a
**project-based discrete manufacturing environment**
. Extensive ERP experience - specifically Oracle Fusion - is essential. As we embark on a large-scale ERP transformation program, this individual will lead the full project lifecycle, from discovery through implementation, stabilization, and continuous improvement for the Projects execution to close process.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead ERP Projects Implementations: Provide technical leadership and functional guidance for Oracle Fusion Projects (Costing, Billing, Project Management, Project Resource Management, RMCS). Drive process definition, configuration, testing, rollout, and adoption.
* Solution Architecture & Configuration: Define and configure ERP modules for WBS Structures, Defining Budgets & Financial Plans, Resource Management, Cost Collection, Invoicing & Revenue generation. Ensure compliance with corporate, tax, and statutory requirements globally. Configure, extend and support ERP Projects modules; build and troubleshoot customizations, reports, extensions and interfaces. Support reporting and analytics requirements.
* Partner with Stakeholders: Collaborate with Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance leadership, as well as system integrators and ERP vendors to document current-state processes, define future-state designs, and create detailed use cases for Projects execution.
* Efficiency in Project Execution : Lead initiatives to standardize project execution processes, improve visibility across project driven supply chain, drive revenue recognition & drive project spend visibility.
* System Optimization & Rollouts: Recommend solutions for system gaps, design phased rollout strategies, and lead Projects tracks across discovery, CRPs, integration, data conversion, UAT, and deployment.
* Integration Leadership: Work with internal development and integration teams to design, test, and deploy interfaces with upstream planning, manufacturing, and downstream financial systems, as well as third-party supplier platforms.
* Data Migration: Develop strategies for migrating customers, open projects, budgets, financial plans, cost, revenue till date into Oracle Fusion, ensuring accuracy, integrity, and smooth transition.
* Governance & Controls: Establish and enforce governance, audit, and compliance controls for Project execution processes. Partner with SOX and Internal Audit teams to build financial and IT controls within Oracle Fusion.
* Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies, including Generative AI and Agentic AI, to identify automation opportunities in project execution

**Mandatory Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 15+ years of IT/Projects systems experience with ERP expertise (Oracle EBS, Oracle Fusion).
* 10+ years of hands-on experience with Projects (Costing, Billing, Project Management, Resource Management, Revenue Recognition).
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Projects
* Strong functional knowledge of end-to-end Projects processes including WBS Structures, Financial Plans & Budgets, Cost Accumulation, Revenue & Billing.
* Experience integrating ERP systems with external platforms like Salesforce or other CPQ Systems
* Proven leadership in ERP transformation programs and cross-functional Procurement/Finance/IT teams.
* Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, global, and highly collaborative environment.

**Preferred Qualifications & Certifications**

* PMP or other Projects certifications.
* Experience in renewable energy, manufacturing, or high-tech industries.
* Certifications such as Six Sigma, or Oracle credentials.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead ERP transformation in projects execution at a high-growth, mission-driven company.
* Collaborate with top talent driving sustainability and innovation.
* Enjoy a dynamic environment with opportunities for global impact and career growth.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and flexible work arrangements.

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.
  
  
**We are Nextpower**

title: Manager, Data Engineering
description:
Manages the activities of a team of data analysts and newer data engineers responsible for developing software code that formats, tags, processes, stores and serves data. Manages the development of data pipelines to ensure that they are scalable, repeatable, and secure and can serve multiple groups at Vanguard.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, Data Engineering is responsible for leading a team of data engineers to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role focuses on enabling high-performance data workflows, ensuring seamless data integration and driving automation to enhance data accessibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Define and execute data engineering strategy, architecture, and roadmaps aligned with business and enterprise data objectives.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integration frameworks, and cloud-native data platforms.
* Drive the development of data warehouses, lakehouse solutions, data products, and analytical platforms that support enterprise reporting and insights.
* Establish standards for data quality, governance, observability, security, and operational excellence.
* Partner with data science, analytics, product, and business teams to deliver reliable and scalable data solutions.
* Ensure data platforms are secure, resilient, performant, and compliant with enterprise technology standards.
* Champion automation, DevOps practices, and modern engineering methodologies to improve delivery efficiency and reliability.
* Provide technical leadership for evaluating and adopting emerging technologies and data engineering best practices.
* Manage delivery planning, stakeholder communications, risk management, and execution of strategic data initiatives.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing data engineering teams and large-scale data infrastructure.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, IT, or a related field or Diploma in Data Science/Data Engineering.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms and data products.
* Strong expertise in ETL/ELT development, data warehousing, data modeling, and distributed data processing.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PySpark, SQL, Apache Spark, Kafka, and modern data engineering frameworks.
* Experience building cloud-native data solutions utilizing AWS and Databricks technologies.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, security, and operational monitoring.
* Experience working within Agile delivery models and leading cross-functional technology teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services including S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, Athena, and Redshift.
* Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Lakehouse architecture.
* Knowledge of Data Mesh, Data Products, Semantic Modeling, and Metadata Management.
* Experience with business intelligence and analytics platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Amazon QuickSight.
* Exposure to AI-enabled data platforms and Agentic AI solutions.
* Financial services or other regulated industry experience.
* Experience leading enterprise data transformation initiatives and globally distributed engineering teams

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

description:

I
**ncident & Problem Management**

* Expertise in distributed middleware, Oracle database, batch scheduling, monitoring.

* Ability to articulate technical concepts to business stakeholders.

**What We Would Like From You**

* Experience supporting large‑scale distributed applications.
* Understanding of audit and compliance processes.
* Ability to prioritize workload and multi-task between projects
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Experience working in and contributing to a team-oriented and collaborative environment

**SEI’s competitive advantage**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including comprehensive care for your physical and mental well-being, hybrid working environment and a work-life balance that enables you to relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
Our benefits include Medical Insurance, Term Life Insurance, Voluntary Provident Fund, 10 Predefined Holidays and 2 Floating Holidays in a year, Paid Time off and more.
  
  
We are a technology and asset management company delivering on our promise of building brave futures—for our clients, our communities, and ourselves. Come build your brave future at SEI.
  
  
**SEI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and so much more…**
After 50 years in business, SEI is a leading global provider of investment processing, investment management, and investment operations solutions. Reflecting our experience within financial services and financial technology our offices encompass an open floor plan and numerous art installations designed to encourage innovation and creativity in our workforce. We recognize that our people are our most valuable asset and that a healthy, happy, and motivated workforce is key to our continued growth. At SEI, we’re (literally) invested in your success. title: WFM Manager, LMAQ
description:
**Description**
Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate’s route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Drive end-to-end workforce management for the entire LMAQ space, designing and delivering short- and long-term labor planning strategies across all lines of business
* Own forecasting, planning, and execution to ensure operational performance meets or exceeds targets
* Build forecast models to drive headcount planning across spaces, programs, and sub-programs with high utilization, and cross-skilling optimization
* Manage headcount planning across the space, ensuring key programs and business needs are driven without impacting SLA, sustaining operational performance with the least churn for managers
* Ability to partner with multiple teams and build strong stakeholder relationships to drive HC planning for the LMAQ space
* Manage the VCC vs. B&M mix across sites, ensuring compliance, driving seating planning across sites, and driving key operational metrics like cross-site reporting, etc.
* Build a data-driven culture by championing automated solutions to drive LMAQ HC planning at a regular cadence with minimal effort
* Own end-to-end delivery of multiple projects focused on performance optimization and cost efficiency
* Guide the design, development, and maintenance of metrics, reports, analyses, and dashboards that inform key business decisions
* Work through and influence WFM leads and analysts across each space without direct authority, aligning them to a common planning and execution standard
* Demonstrate a strong eye for detail, uncovering trends, going beyond the obvious, and identifying root causes
* Thrive in ambiguous environments and proactively take on new challenges
* Influence hiring quality by raising the bar on interviewing standards across the organization

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 7+ years of operational and/or retail management experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Advanced degree in a quantitative field or an MBA
* Ability to think strategically and drive the detailed execution of specific initiatives
* Experience with workforce management tools and platforms (e.g., NICE, Verint, or proprietary systems)
* Familiarity with capacity planning, scheduling optimization, or labor modeling at scale
* Track record of delivering measurable cost savings or efficiency improvements

title: Executive Manager, Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) –Transformation and Optimization
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
The Enterprise Operations Xcellence Transformation and Optimization (ETO) manager leads execution within one or more process areas, delivering initiatives and outcomes while managing stakeholders and progress day to day. The role partners with senior leaders to redesign and reimagine workflows — including the evaluation and use of new technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate — drives continuous process improvement and applies financial and business-case analysis to ensure that reimagined processes are both effective and cost-optimized.
  
  
This role manages people and stakeholder relationships directly, and is accountable for the quality, pace, and outcomes of their assigned process area(s).
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an Executive Manager, Transformation and Optimization on the Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Lead execution of transformation initiatives within an assigned process area, from market research, design through rapid prototyping, implementation, and stabilization.
* Partner with senior leaders to reimagine and redesign end-to-end workflows — including technology, AI-enabled tools, operating model, and talent/role implications — while considering cross-functional (enterprise) impact.
* Manage and develop team members and cross-functional contributors, providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and performance feedback across USI and/or US team members.
* Build and maintain stakeholder relationships across business, operations, and enabling functions; manage expectations, escalations, and communication of progress.
* Identify, prioritize, and drive process improvement opportunities that enhance efficiency, quality, scalability, and employee or customer experience; conduct financial and cost-benefit analysis to size potential opportunities, validate business cases, and confirm that redesigned processes deliver measurable, optimized outcomes.
* Track and report on initiative progress, risks, dependencies, and benefits realization, escalating issues and decisions to the stakeholders; contribute to governance routines, reporting cadences, and delivery standards used consistently across the broader transformation portfolio; apply structured problem-solving and unstructured-work management techniques to bring order and discipline to ambiguous or undefined process areas.

**The team**
Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) focuses on improving operational effectiveness, driving transformation execution, and enabling scalable, consistent, and high-quality outcomes across the organization. The team works across process areas to strengthen governance, improve delivery discipline, and embed more efficient ways of working, including AI-enabled support for reporting, risk visibility, action management, communications, training, and adoption.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business, Operations, Engineering, Technology, Organizational Change, or a related field
* 14+ years of experience in strategy, transformation, enterprise operations, organizational change management, operating model transformation, program leadership, or strategic business operations.
* Prior experience in process improvement, transformation, or enterprise operations, with direct experience managing people and stakeholders.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous or unstructured work environments, with the ability to bring structure and drive outcomes.
* Familiarity with digital, AI, automation, or robotics tools as applied to process transformation is a plus.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: GSOC Supervisor
description:

At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. The GSOC Supervisor, assigned to one of Pinkerton's largest global clients, leads the day-to-day activities of assigned shifts within the client's alarm monitoring centre. The Supervisor is responsible for line-level supervision of up to ten Operators, ensures that all positions are staffed with qualified personnel and operations are conducted within established policies and procedures.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Receive shift pass-down information, and conducting shift briefings to provide updates, assignments, training, and uniform compliance.

* Assist the client's security personnel with the development and/or revision of security operation centre processes, protocols, and systems.

* Provide back-up support and on-call functions, as needed.
* Oversee quality control and oversight for all production, support, and staffing functions in conjunction with BAC Operations Manager.
* Directly assist in developing and maturing the capabilities of the BAC including support for operations and the intelligence/analytics areas.
* Supervise the maintenance and deployment of a BAC knowledge management dashboard.
* Partner with Operations Manager to identify process and quality improvements.
* Represent the BAC in meetings with client personnel.
* Triage and manage incidents of workplace violence or other associate misconduct.
* Develop and execute training for the Operators in all control room functions and conduct training exercises with the field leadership team.
* All other duties, as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Graduate with at least five years of experience in BMS, command centre, and/or security operations including dispatch duties within a Supervisor role.
  
  

* Effective instructional, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Customer service skills.
* Knowledge of security systems for access control, CCTV systems, badging systems, and alarm monitoring systems.
* Knowledge of research and analysis processes.
* Able to multitask in a fast-paced, and at times stressed work environment.
* Comfortable with a high-tech work environment and constant learning of new tools and innovations.
* Self-motivated, curious, and knowledgeable pertaining to news and current events.
* Dependable team leader with business maturity, enthusiasm, and a positive attitude.
* Computer skills; Microsoft office.

With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
  
  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.

* Travel, as required.

title: Engineering Manager IT
description:

Works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems. Acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals.
  
  
**About Vanguard**

**Vanguard India**

**Responsibilites**

* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.

* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.

* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Must have skills: Node.js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes,Kore.AI, Android, iOS development
* Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards.

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**

**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.
