title: Front Office - Team Leader
description:
**URGENT REQUIREMENT - FEMALE APPLICANTS MAY BE PREFERRED**

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

Administration

* Ensures information on restaurants, hotel facilities and other miscellaneous are updated periodically.
* Submits all guests/employee’s incident reports.
* Reports and records “Lost and Found” items.

Customer Service

* Ensures that all Front Office employees deliver the brand promise and provide exceptional guest service at all times.
* Ensures that Front Office employees provide excellent service to internal customers as appropriate.
* Ensures that all Front Office employees are familiar with the hotel’s products and services, current promotions, policies and other important information
* Assists to implement consistent guest recognition programmes and maintains a relevant guest history database.
* Handles all guest and internal customer complaints and inquiries in a courteous and efficient manner, following through to make sure problems are resolved satisfactorily.
* Personally, and frequently verify that guests are receiving the best possible service during check-in and check-out.
* Ensures that the area is managed well by the respective team and deliver the brand promise.
* Maintains positive guest and colleague interactions with good working relationships.
* Ensures that guest history records are accurately maintained and all repeat guests are pre-registered.
* Coordinates VIP movements with relevant Departments as advised.

Financial

* Assists to maximise employee productivity through the use of multi-skilling, multi-tasking and flexible scheduling to meet the financial goals of the business as well as the expectations of the guests.
* Focuses attention on improving productivity levels and the need to prudently manage utility/payroll costs within acceptable guidelines ensuring optimum deployment and energy efficiency of all equipment.
* Ensures that hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to money handling are adhered to, including the timely and accurate reporting of information.

Operational

* Assists the Front Office Management Team in efficiently managing the department according to the established concept statement providing a courteous, professional, efficient and flexible service at all times
* Ensures the strict control of room keys.
* Liaises and organises with Housekeeping Department that the established cleaning schedules for VIP’s in - house and arrivals are strictly adhered to.
* Coordinates all Repair and Maintenance and reports maintenance job orders.
* Understands rate structure and promotional rates available.
* Assists in making sure that all Touches of Hyatt and the Rooms Top 20 have been implemented.
* Responds to the results of the Consumer Audit and ensures that the relevant changes are implemented.
* Ensures that Front Office employees work in a supportive and flexible manner with other departments, in a spirit of “We work through Teams”.
* Works closely with other management personnel in a supportive and flexible manner, focusing on the overall success of the hotel and the satisfaction of hotel guests.
* Ensures that all guest details are entered correctly in accordance with the principles of clean data.

Personnel

* Assists to ensure the punctuality and appearance of all Front Desk employees, making sure that they wear the correct uniform and maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene, according to the hotel and department’s grooming standards.
* Assist to conduct annual Performance Development Discussions with Grand Club employees, supports them in their professional development goals.
* Assist in the planning and implementation of effective training programmes for all Front Desk employees in coordination with the Departmental Trainers.

**Personnel (continued)**

* Supports Departmental Trainers through ongoing feedback and assistance at monthly meetings.
* Assist to develop the skills and effectiveness of all Front Desk employees through the appropriate training, coaching, and/or mentoring.
* Assist to prepare and posts weekly work schedules, making sure that they reflect business needs and other key performance indicators.
* Encourages employees to be creative and innovative, challenging and recognising them for their contribution to the success of the operation.
* Supports the implementation of The People Philosophy, demonstrating and reinforcing Hyatt’s Values and Culture Characteristics.
* Ensures that employees have a complete understanding of and adhere to employee rules and regulations.
* Ensures that employees follow all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to fire and hazard safety, and security.

Other Duties

* Attends and contributes to all training sessions and meetings as required.
* Is knowledgeable in statutory legislation in employee and industrial relations.
* Exercises responsible behaviour at all times and positively representing the hotel team and Hyatt International.
* Reads the hotel's Employee Handbook and have an understanding of and adhere to the hotel's rules and regulations and in particular, the policies and procedures relating to computer resources, fire, hygiene, health and safety.
* Ensures high standards of personal presentation and grooming.
* Responds to changes in the Rooms function as dictated by the industry, company and hotel.
* Carries out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

title: Team Lead – Paid Search
description:
**Team Lead / Team Coordinator – Paid Search & Performance Marketing**
to lead high-impact campaign operations, drive performance excellence, and manage a talented team of digital marketing professionals.

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience:**
7–10 Years

**Work Model:**
Work From Office (WFO) mandatory for the initial 3 months

**Shift:**
US Night Shifts – EST / CST / PST aligned

**Joining Preference:**
Immediate Joiners

What to expect at MediaMint?

At MediaMint, we value people who define their surroundings, stay curious, and continuously look for opportunities to learn and grow.

Honesty, integrity, self-awareness, and continuous improvement are central to how we work. If professional and personal growth motivates you, MediaMint could be the right environment for your next career move.

As a
**Team Lead / Team Coordinator – Paid Search & Performance Marketing**
, you will take ownership of paid search campaign delivery across multiple client accounts while leading a team responsible for campaign execution, optimization, analytics, quality, and operational excellence.

This role brings together
**hands-on platform expertise, performance marketing strategy, analytics, client communication, and people leadership**
.

What You’ll Own

**Paid Search & Performance Marketing**

• Lead the planning, execution, optimization, and ongoing management of paid search campaigns across multiple client accounts.

• Drive campaigns across Google Search Ads, Performance Max (PMax), Shopping Ads, and YouTube Ads.

• Manage campaign budgets and ensure accurate budget pacing.

• Optimize performance against CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversions, and conversion value.

• Identify performance trends, opportunities, and risks and translate them into actionable optimization strategies.

**Conversion Tracking & Analytics**

• Build, implement, validate, and troubleshoot conversion tracking.

• Work extensively with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).

• Investigate discrepancies across Google Ads, GA4, and other reporting platforms.

• Partner with relevant stakeholders to implement and QA tracking requirements.

**Microsoft/Bing Ads**

• Manage and optimize Microsoft/Bing Ads campaigns.

• Own campaign setup, targeting, bidding, budgets, reporting, and optimization.

• Apply cross-platform learnings across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.

**Account & Performance Management**

• Manage multiple client accounts and significant advertising budgets.

• Translate campaign data into meaningful insights and recommendations.

• Present performance updates and optimization opportunities to internal and client stakeholders.

• Proactively identify delivery, performance, and operational risks and develop mitigation plans.

**Team Leadership & Operations**

• Lead and develop a team of approximately 15–20 campaign management professionals.

• Drive productivity, utilization, quality, SLA adherence, and timely delivery.

• Establish strong SOPs, QA frameworks, workflows, and campaign-management best practices.

• Coach and mentor team members while identifying skill gaps and development opportunities.

• Support hiring, onboarding, training, and career development.

• Champion process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency.

What We’re Looking For

• 7–10 years of experience in Paid Search / Performance Marketing.

• Strong hands-on expertise in Google Ads.

• Strong knowledge of Search, PMax, Shopping, and YouTube Ads.

• Hands-on expertise with GA4 and Google Tag Manager.

• Strong understanding of conversion tracking implementation, validation, and troubleshooting.

• Good experience with Microsoft/Bing Ads.

• Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and significant advertising budgets.

• Strong command of CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversions, and budget pacing.

• Experience managing and developing teams of approximately 15–20 members.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, presentation, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

• Strong coaching, mentoring, and training skills.

• Ability to perform effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Preferred Background

Experience working with startups or high-growth organizations, familiarity with linear platform workflows and operations, and the ability to thrive in rapidly evolving environments will be advantageous.

Why MediaMint?

MediaMint is an
**AI-powered Revenue Operations services company**
helping platforms and publishers accelerate innovation, operational efficiency, scalability, customer satisfaction, and revenue growth through technology, automation, data, and AI.

With
**3,000+ professionals**
and a global presence, MediaMint partners with organizations ranging from high-growth startups to Fortune 500 companies.

Our Hyderabad office serves as our primary delivery and operations center.

Ready to Lead Performance at Scale?

If you bring strong Paid Search expertise, people leadership experience, and the ability to turn campaign data into measurable business outcomes, we’d like to hear from you.

**Immediate joiners are strongly preferred.**

title: Director
description:
**Company Description**
Nova Agri Tech Ltd is an agricultural inputs company focused on the manufacturing and marketing of micronutrients, water-soluble fertilizers, pheromones, and bio-enriched organic manures suitable for a wide range of crops. The company supports sustainable and productive farming by offering scientifically developed products aligned with modern agricultural practices. Its portfolio is designed to improve crop health, yield, and soil fertility for diverse farming conditions. Nova Agri Tech Ltd serves growers and agricultural businesses seeking reliable, performance-driven solutions for crop management.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Director role based in Hyderabad. The Director will provide strategic leadership across manufacturing, marketing, and distribution functions, ensuring that product lines in micronutrients, water-soluble fertilizers, pheromones, and organic manures align with business goals and market demands. Daily responsibilities include overseeing operational performance, guiding senior managers, setting targets, and monitoring key metrics related to production quality, sales growth, and customer satisfaction. The role involves developing and executing long-term business strategies, managing budgets, and fostering partnerships with suppliers, distributors, and key stakeholders. The Director will also drive innovation, ensure regulatory compliance, and promote a culture of safety, ethics, and continuous improvement within the organization.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong leadership, decision-making, and people management skills, with experience guiding cross-functional teams at a senior level.
* Proven ability in strategic planning, business development, and market analysis within agriculture, agribusiness, or related industries.
* Experience in operations management, including production oversight, quality control, and supply chain optimization.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance tracking using key business metrics.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to represent the organization externally.
* Knowledge of agricultural inputs such as fertilizers, micronutrients, and related products; familiarity with regulatory standards and compliance requirements is an advantage.
* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Management, or a related field; substantial relevant industry experience in a senior leadership role is expected.
* Ability to work on-site in Hyderabad and collaborate closely with manufacturing, sales, and field teams.

* BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

* Strong understanding of operational infrastructure, metrics, processes, systems and tools for running a global Support organization.
* Must be capable of dealing confidently and professionally at executive level internally and with customers.
* Consistent track record leading sophisticated processes and driving continuous process improvement.
* Excellent project management skills, including demonstrated ability to run projects across teams where influencing skills are required.
* Ability to respond to high-profile, high-impact customer/product partner concerns in a way that drives customer happiness.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* Consistent record of leading support teams and creating collaborative relationships with peers on the Support leadership team as well as Engineering, Product, Success, Services, Documentation, and Business Technology (BT).
* Acts as a work-redesign orchestrator — continuously rethinking how support work gets done as AI capabilities evolve, rather than treating AI as a bolt-on tool.
* Highly organized and an effective communicator and doer.
* Has a beginner's demeanor; always looking for new ways to make things better, challenges the status quo, and is willing to experiment with and learn alongside emerging AI agent capabilities.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: WFM Planning Manager
description:
**Our Global Structure**
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our Workforce Management team's primary focus is to ensure we have the right people in the right place at the right time, so customers, merchants, and delivery partners get help as quickly and reliably as possible. The team brings a people-first mindset paired with strategy and operations to achieve its goals, moving quickly, applying first-principles thinking, and focusing on problem-solving to ensure seamless execution. The team manages workforce capacity planning, scheduling, and real-time operations for a large and growing global network of in-house and outsourced support centers, with the goal of delivering an outstanding customer experience reliably, at scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Manager, Workforce Planning, you will lead planning for our rider and merchant support ops, own KPI performance, and partner cross-functionally to keep staffing supply aligned with business priorities.
  
  
This role flexes across two tracks depending on team needs and where your strengths lie: an Audience-facing track, where you act as the primary bridge between a specific line of business and the Workforce Management function, translating business goals into capacity plans and performance reporting; and a Technical track, where you directly supervise the in-house and outsourced sites, focusing on the technical accuracy of capacity models and the tools behind them. Both tracks require a leader who can navigate ambiguity, identify root causes through data, and manage up and across with clarity and confidence.
  
  
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
  
  

* Own capacity plans and scheduling coverage across an integrated scope spanning in-house and outsourced/vendor sites
* Own KPI performance — service level, occupancy, over/under staffing, and quality — and lead root-cause analysis and recovery planning when performance slips
* Anticipate staffing risks and deviations before they affect service, and put proactive mitigation plans in place
* Lead goal-setting for your area and track progress, translating results into clear updates for leadership
* Partner cross-functionally to align staffing supply with evolving business priorities, and drive process and efficiency improvements
* Communicate performance, blockers, and root causes clearly to leadership while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships
* Act as the primary bridge between your assigned line of business and the Workforce Management function
* Translate business goals into capacity plans and performance reporting that keep service levels on track
* Manage outsourced/vendor relationships tied to your audience, holding partners accountable to staffing commitments and service level targets
* Build trust and influence with business stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and risks clearly and proactively
* Own the technical accuracy of capacity models, forecasting methodology, and underlying assumptions
* Ensure planning tools and systems are used to their full potential, and lead improvements to the models, templates, and tools themselves
* Translate high-level goals into precise, data-driven staffing blueprints the broader team can execute against

We're excited about you because…
  
  

* You have 5-7 years of experience in workforce management, capacity planning, or operations, including experience leading or directly managing a team
* You're fluent in workforce management fundamentals: capacity planning, forecasting, scheduling, shrinkage, and occupancy
* You bring strong analytical rigor and are comfortable with data tools such as SQL, Excel, and Tableau
* You have a track record of driving measurable performance improvements across cross-functional teams
* You're a confident, clear communicator, able to influence and align stakeholders across functions and levels
* You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and enjoy solving complex problems
* You have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* You have experience managing outsourced/vendor relationships, including staffing commitments and service level accountability
* You're a skilled business partner, comfortable owning KPI outcomes and communicating trade-offs to stakeholders outside of WFM
* You bring hands-on experience with workforce management software (e.g., NICE, Verint, Genesys, or Aspect) and forecasting/capacity modeling methodology
* You've improved planning tools, models, or templates, and enjoy going deep on the technical mechanics behind a capacity plan

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
  
  
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
  
  
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
  
  
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Sr. Content Manager
description:
**About WPP Production**
We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
  
  
**About WPP**
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
  
  
**A hybrid working model**
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around three days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
**What does Senior Content Manager do at WPP Production?**
The Content Management organization at WPP Production is responsible for publishing creative assets, experiences, and critical digital content to our client websites and other platforms across the globe. A Senior Content Manager reports to the Manager, Content Management and manages a team that works closely with both the Content Management organization and external teams to ensure all client interactive deliverables are completed accurately and on time. This includes ownership of the content management and publishing operations in support of our client’s product launches and other digital marketing programs, including setting up and managing page structure and content in a CMS (content management system).
  
  
Core responsibilities of a Senior Content Manager include managing team resources and performance, day-to-day content management tasks, cross-functional collaboration across the Marcom organization, leading projects or initiatives from the content management perspective, and maintaining full knowledge of an ever-changing set of tools and processes.
  
  
(Note: This is a role focused on top-quality content production and publishing, with strong experience in managing a team and optimizing processes and productivity. It is not a content creation, design, or marketing job.)
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own day-to-day content management operations and tasks in support of product launches, other marketing initiatives, and regular page maintenance
* Ensure the quality of deliverables to client
* Collaborate cross-functionally and proactively with internal and external teams
* High attention to communication standards
* Work with developer teams to plan page structures and agree upon project approaches
* Lead multiple projects with the support of the team
* Manage a team of Content Managers and other individual contributors across multiple projects, taking responsibility for meeting deadlines, driving quality and accuracy, estimating project resourcing, and overall performance of the team
* Actively balance the work of multiple projects, assignments, and launches in a fast-paced, ever-evolving work environment
* Build strong partnerships and increase satisfaction with our client by providing support, intelligent recommendations, and operational efficiencies.
* Work within the content management org to improve documentation and training
* Maintain complete understanding of the complexities of CMS and other internal tools
* Troubleshoot system issues as a part of the first line of defense
* Contribute to the evolution of internal platforms and processes by providing feedback on toolsets, UI, best practices, and workflow optimization

**Requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher; preferably with a focus on marketing, design, or communication
* 5+ years experience working on web production teams
* 2+ years team and people management experience
* Experience with localization and managing content for a global audience, using a CMS
* Deep knowledge of how content management and other related system processes work
* Experience working with a git client application (Tower, SourceTree, etc.) a plus
* Knowledge of HTML, XML, JSON, and enterprise CMS
* Record of troubleshooting and diagnosing CMS issues, and communicating those issues to both technical and non-technical personnel
* Demonstrated success in business process improvement and re-engineering
* Demonstrated experience in assessing and optimizing team resources and time commitments, with an eye to increasing productivity and reducing costs
* Proven ability to manage ambiguity effectively
* Experience creating/managing internal tools a plus
* Excellent communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to work with others in an unpredictable environment
* Flexible personality and schedule to deal with rapidly-changing, time-constrained launch schedules
* High degree of ownership and accountability
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and diplomacy skills
* Must be a self starter and have a positive, energetic approach
* Ability to balance multiple projects or assignments
* Highly detail-oriented, organized, and patient
* Experience working with offshore teams

**Why work here:**
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
  
  
**Inclusion and Impact**
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
**Data**
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
  
  
**Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.**

Kolkata & Hyderabad

\* Lead PKI engineering teams and oversee technical delivery.

\* Manage enterprise Certificate Authority (CA) hierarchies, HSMs, and key management processes.

\* Manage code-signing, device certificates, and user certificate services.

\* Define cryptographic standards, certificate policies, and approved algorithms.

\* Coordinate with vendors and Certificate Authority providers.

\* Ensure platform availability, audit readiness, and certificate expiry prevention.

\* Support cryptographic agility and post-quantum cryptography migration planning.

Required Skills

\* Strong expertise in PKI architecture and certificate lifecycle management.

\* Knowledge of X.509 certificates, TLS, certificate validation, revocation, and trust stores.

\* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).

\* Familiarity with platforms such as Venafi, Keyfactor, DigiCert, Entrust, or HashiCorp Vault.

\* Experience with ACME, certificate automation, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).

\* Strong knowledge of cryptographic key management and code signing.

\* Experience in technical leadership, vendor management, and security operations.

Experience & Qualifications

\* 15–18 years of experience in infrastructure or security engineering.

\* At least 3 years of team management or technical leadership experience.

\* Experience managing enterprise-scale PKI platforms and production certificate services.

\* CISSP, CISM, or relevant PKI certifications are preferred.

Inceptial Tech is a global technology solutions company operating across the UK, USA, Germany, and India, delivering IT consulting, software development, Testing-as-a-Service, and managed Oracle Cloud services.

  .

Educational Qualification

Behavioural Skills:

  **Execution**
  skills

Finance**

title: Platform Solutions – Payments Operations–Vice President–Hyderabad
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Platform Solutions, a division of Goldman Sachs, is seeking a
**Vice President**
to lead and scale our
**Payments Operations**
team in India. The Payments team is critical to safeguarding customer trust and platform integrity by governing money movement, managing complex payment remediation, and maintaining operational control across lending and credit card products.
  
  
As a Vice President, you will provide strategic direction, operational leadership, and end-to-end governance for regional and global payment functions. You will oversee the remediation of payment exceptions, drive automation and workflow modernization, and manage risk and control frameworks across multiple payment rails. In this role, you will act as a senior regional leader partnering closely with global counterparts across Engineering, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Product Controllers, and Credit Delivery Solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and inspire a multi-tiered operations organization (including managers, associates, and analysts), establishing clear OKRs, performance benchmarks, and succession plans.
* Champion an inclusive, high-performance, and motivating team culture focused on continuous development and operational excellence.
* Represent India Payments Operations in global governance meetings, steering committees, and business reviews.

**Payment Operations & Financial Control Governance**

* Drive end-to-end operational oversight of critical payment rails, including ACH, Fedwire, Wires, Check/Lockbox, and Bill Pay, supporting consumer lending and credit card product lifecycles.
* Own the books and records integrity by establishing stringent reconciliation frameworks; govern suspense account risks, investigate systemic breaks, and enforce strict ledger-posting standards.
* Ensure strict adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs), managing critical daily settlement and cutoff deadlines with 100% operational resilience.

**Risk, Controls & Regulatory Oversight**

* Ensure operations strictly comply with US consumer banking regulations and frameworks, including Reg Z, Reg O, Reg V, Reg E, TILA, ECOA, and CFPB guidelines.
* Design, enhance, and maintain a proactive Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) framework, anticipating failure points and preventing control breakdowns.
* Lead audit preparedness and regulatory examinations; drive comprehensive root-cause analysis and remediation for audit findings and operational losses.

**Operational Transformation & Metrics**

* Drive strategic automation, digitalization, and process optimization initiatives using modern analytics tools to eliminate manual casework and enable scalable volume growth.
* Define, track, and synthesize key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) into actionable executive dashboards for senior business leadership.
* Act as the final regional escalation point for high-severity payment breaks, customer remediation casework, and complex money movement inquiries.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive operations experience within banking, financial services, or fintech environments.
* Leadership: Minimum 6+ years of direct people management experience, with proven capability in leading teams of managers and specialists.
* Domain Knowledge: In-depth technical and operational expertise in US payment systems (ACH/NACHA, Wires/Fedwire, Bill Pay, Checks) and credit/lending operational lifecycles.
* Regulatory Acumen: Strong working knowledge of US consumer lending regulations (e.g., Reg Z, Reg E, TILA, ECOA, CFPB).
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated experience influencing executive leadership globally.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (Master’s, MBA, CA, or equivalent).
* Professional industry certifications (e.g., AAP – Accredited ACH Professional, APRP – Accredited Payments Risk Professional, or CRCM).
* Hands-on experience leading large-scale business transformation, workflow redesign, or low-code automation initiatives (e.g., SQL, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI).
* Proven expertise managing complex general ledger (GL) reconciliations, suspense account monitoring, and accounting break resolution.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguous, high-pressure situations while sustaining high operational control and regulatory compliance.

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs.
  
  
Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

The Delivery Excellence Director is responsible for defining and implementing a comprehensive Delivery Excellence Strategy & Governance framework for healthcare provider clients across all the services life cycle process stages (Lead to Order, Order to Delivery, Order to Cash). This includes establishing standardized delivery frameworks, methodologies, and playbooks, as well as instituting governance models and mechanisms to review the delivery health, risk, and performance, while embedding patient safety, clinical impact, and provider operational realities into the delivery standards.
  
  
The position involves engaging with Account Leadership, client executives and stakeholders on delivery assurance and improvement initiatives, and representing delivery excellence in executive steering committees, audits, and QBRs.
  
  
Overall, the goal is to ensure high-quality, compliant, and efficient delivery of healthcare IT services that meet client needs and drive business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilites
  
  
**Strategic**

* Drive excellence in healthcare IT services such as EHR, clinical and business applications, data analytics, and Cybersecurity,
* Institute governance models, cadence, and review mechanisms for Delivery health, risk, and performance (SLA, SLO, CSAT, etc.).
* Oversee delivery excellence across multiple clients and act as the escalation authority for systemic delivery issues impacting multiple accounts.
* Partner with Account delivery Leadership to foster a culture of continuous improvement, automation (SOPs, Knowledge Management, GenAI), and skill development (Learning paths).
* Govern the implementation of policies, processes, and procedures for the overall client delivery while tracking cost, margin, and utilization outcomes.
* Partner with Account Leadership to anticipate changing demands from the client’s organization and business environment and creatively realign delivery objectives as needed to align with client’s organizational strategic objectives

**Leadership**

* Promote and foster an organizational culture that is innovative, agile, flexible, and aligned to the mission and values of the organization
* Collaborate with the Account Delivery teams and pre-sales teams to create compelling delivery process governance and standards collaterals to be leveraged while responding to RFPs aligned with Providence India’s strategic goals
* Drive efficiencies continuously through account leadership and delivery teams
* Ensure security, privacy and compliance policies are well adhered to across the teams
* Develop tools and guidance supporting effective delivery of services, such as service level management. Manage key vendor partner relationships as required in doing so.

Leadership Characteristics
  
  

* Collaboration and Influence : The executive must be able to build strong and enduring relationships across the organization and facilitate collaborations, transparent communications, and alignment between diverse constituents. S/he must have the ability to move seamlessly between various stakeholders, gaining support for key initiatives.
* Driving Results : Knows how to get things done in the organization; successfully mobilizes people, processes, culture and technology. Effectively navigates relationships and organizational politics within a matrixed organization.
* Inspirational Leader : Demonstrates emotionally intelligent leadership and interactions. Courageously communicates and inspires an ever evolving and changing organization. Is action-oriented; consciously and effectively urges others toward the goal.
* People Focused : Clearly sets direction and expectations for direct reports and holds them accountable for results. Provides feedback and coaching to both good-performers and under-performers. Conscientiously builds a diverse talent pipeline of highly capable caregivers. Demonstrates the value of diversity and inclusion in leadership efforts.
* Thought Leader : Knowledgeable about current business and healthcare practices. Capable of critical operational and financial analytics. Leverages best business practices to solve problems. Leverages strategies that grow and develop the organization. Stays on top of emerging business and healthcare trends. Thinks innovatively and facilitates creativity in others. Is mentally agile; “thinks well on their feet.” Introduces break - through thinking, enabling new mental models to emerge.

**Professional Experience/Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s in engineering / MBA with excellent communication skills
* 18+ years of overall IT experience, with progressive leadership responsibility.
* 5+ years in a delivery excellence, quality, or operations leadership role serving multiple US healthcare provider clients (provider side or services partner).

* Executive-level stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

* Strong communicator with high emotional intelligence, that builds relationships and trust and collaborates with all stakeholders.

* Relevant certifications (ITIL, PMP, Six Sigma, SAFe, healthcare compliance) are a plus

description:
**Job Description**
**Vulnerability Management Lead**
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Vulnerability Management Lead**
with
**6–10 years of cybersecurity experience**
to lead enterprise-wide vulnerability management operations. The role is responsible for driving vulnerability discovery, risk prioritisation, remediation governance, SLA management, executive reporting, and cross-functional coordination with infrastructure, application, IAM, endpoint security, and patch management teams. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise with
**Tenable, Rapid7/InsightVM, Tanium, TruOps**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end Vulnerability Management programme across servers, endpoints, networks, cloud environments, applications, IAM, and privileged access platforms.
* Define and manage vulnerability scanning strategies, authenticated scan coverage, remediation governance, and exception management.
* Analyse and validate vulnerability findings from Tenable and Rapid7/InsightVM, prioritising risks based on CVSS, exploitability, asset criticality, and business impact.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, patch management, application, endpoint security, and IAM teams to drive timely remediation.
* Track remediation SLAs, risk acceptance, and compliance using TruOps or similar GRC platforms.
* Partner with patch management teams using Tanium and Automox migration workflows to ensure effective remediation.
* Develop and present executive dashboards and reports covering vulnerability trends, ageing, SLA compliance, remediation performance, and asset coverage.
* Review identity and privileged access vulnerabilities involving Okta and CyberArk.
* Collaborate with endpoint security teams using CrowdStrike and SentinelOne to correlate vulnerability exposure with endpoint risks.
* Define and enhance vulnerability management processes, playbooks, operational runbooks, and reporting standards.
* Lead weekly and monthly vulnerability review meetings with internal stakeholders and US-based customers.
* Mentor Vulnerability Management Engineers and review technical assessments, remediation recommendations, and reporting.
* Ensure alignment with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS.

**Requirements**
**Job Requirements**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 6–10 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations, or Infrastructure Security.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading teams, coordinating security operations, or managing vulnerability programmes.
* Strong hands-on experience with Tenable, Rapid7/InsightVM, Tanium, vulnerability assessment, CVE/CVSS analysis, remediation governance, and SLA management.
* Experience in executive reporting, stakeholder management, and customer-facing engagements.
* Exposure to TruOps, Cyberfusion, Okta, CyberArk, CrowdStrike, and SentinelOne is highly preferred.
* Experience supporting US-based customers and working during US business hours is preferred.

**Tools & Technologies**

* Vulnerability Management: Tenable, Rapid7/InsightVM
* Patch Management: Tanium, Automox
* Risk & GRC: TruOps, Cyberfusion
* IAM/PAM: Okta, CyberArk
* Endpoint Security: CrowdStrike, SentinelOne

* Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, GSEC, Tenable, Rapid7, ITIL Foundation, or equivalent industry certifications.

title: Breakdown & Repair Maintenance
description:
**About the Role:**

Breakdown, Repair & maintenance is to ensure that equipment and machinery in a Café set up are maintained and repaired efficiently when they break down or experience unexpected failures. The role involves a combination of technical, managerial, and organizational tasks. Here are the key responsibilities.

**Roles and Responsibility:**

* Break down maintenance: Responsible for 450 cafes and 200 CCD outlets across the country .
* Repair & maintenance: Responsible for 450 cafes and 200 CCD outlets across the country .
* Supervision: Building program of all heating and A/C and Refrigeration based on daily schedules
* Equipment Inspection and Assessment: Conduct regular inspections of supplies, tools, machinery and equipment to identify potential issues.
* Emergency Response: Quickly respond to breakdowns or unexpected equipment failures, ensuring that downtime is minimized to maintain
* Diagnosis: Identify the root causes of equipment failures and breakdowns by working with maintenance teams and using diagnostic tools.
* Coordination: Coordinate with maintenance technicians, mechanics, and engineers to ensure prompt repair and maintenance activities
* Resource Allocation: Allocate resources, such as personnel, tools, and spare parts, to address breakdowns efficiently.
* Scheduling: Develop and maintain a maintenance schedule to prevent future breakdowns by conducting routine maintenance activities and predictive maintenance.
* Cost Management: Monitor and manage the budget allocated for breakdown maintenance, making sure it is used effectively and efficiently.
* Vendor Management: Work with external vendors and suppliers to source replacement parts and services as needed for repairs.
* Documentation: Maintain detailed records of equipment breakdowns, repairs, and maintenance activities for future reference and analysis.
* Reporting: Provide regular reports to higher management on breakdown statistics, downtime, and measures taken to address them.
* Safety Compliance: Ensure that all maintenance activities comply with safety regulations and standards to protect the well-being of maintenance staff and other employees.
* Training: Develop and implement training programs for maintenance personnel to enhance their skills in diagnosing and repairing equipment.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process and equipment improvement to reduce the frequency of breakdowns.
* Inventory Management: Oversee the inventory of spare parts and supplies required for breakdown maintenance to ensure an adequate supply.
* Root Cause Analysis: Conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurring breakdowns by addressing underlying issues.
* Quality Control: Ensure that equipment repairs and maintenance are done to high standards to prevent frequent breakdowns and maximize equipment lifespan.
* Collaboration: Work closely with other departments, such as production and engineering, to understand their needs and coordinate maintenance activities accordingly.
* Overall, the breakdown maintenance manager plays a crucial role in minimizing equipment downtime, ensuring the reliability and efficiency of production processes, and reducing maintenance-related costs QSR (Quick Service restaurant) environment.

**Experience & Qualification:**

1. Any bachelor's degree (mechanical, electrical, industrial, etc.) is preferable.
2. 4 to 6 years Overall 2+ Years - experience in Retail chains.
3. Good Arithmetical & Reasoning Ability
4. Effective communication skills to convey technical information to team members, other departments, and stakeholders.
5. Clear communication during breakdown situations to coordinate activities and provide updates.
6. Extensive Experience in A/C and Refrigeration for Repair and maintenance of equipment in Cafés
7. Capability to assess the technical skills of the maintenance team.
8. Knowledge In Troubleshoot
9. Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) for tracking and managing maintenance activities.
10. Ability to leverage technology for planning, scheduling, and analyzing breakdown maintenance data.

**Language Fluency: English, and local language. Open to travel**

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. **Your Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day IAM operations, including user onboarding, offboarding, and access provisioning.
* Ensure appropriate access controls are implemented and maintained across applications and systems.
* Lead periodic access reviews, certifications, and compliance activities to meet audit requirements.
* Monitor and resolve IAM-related incidents, service requests, and operational issues within agreed SLAs.

title: Manager II, ROC,DSS
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s Surface Transportation Operations team is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Supply Chain Manager to assist in the management of daily freight movements flowing into and out of our NA fulfillment centers and our associated fulfillment network.
  
  
People Manager role handing about 50-75 HC in a 24 X 7 shift Operations at HYD office. Role involves managing daily Service Levels, driving KPI’s apart from driving continuous improvement process and cost initiatives in the network.
  
  
The candidate should have a background in Supply chain/ transportation, loss prevention and excellent program management skills. He/she has the ability to pull and analyze data with ease, drive process improvements, standardize our processes and eliminate the root cause of defects within the current systems. This job will require exceptional communication skills while having the ability to work independently in a high-pressure environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Continual, tactical communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers ( Finance, Tech, Fulfillment Centers)
* Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
* Develop Key performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
* Lead initiatives to re-engineer business processes, and identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to drive efficiency in Amazon’s transportation operations.
* Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.
* Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions.
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs.
* Excellent communication, both verbal and written as you will be required to create a narrative outlining your weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
* Propose improvements to our existing process and utilize AI tools for enhancing productivity

A day in the life
  
  
You lead a shift cluster of frontline team managers who keep Amazon's middle-mile trucking moving in real time. Your day runs on three rhythms that blend from the moment you log in: live operations, people, and mechanisms. You open with a handover from the prior shift and walk the queue of active disruptions — drivers stalled in transit, equipment failures, regulated driving-hour limits, accidents, and safety escalations. When a team manager needs assistance, you will assess the situation the provide the right guidance or escalate further if needed. In between, you coach — 1:1s, floor-walks, and live feedback on speed, quality, and customer handling. The rest of your day belongs to mechanisms. You measure what matters — service-level attainment, resolution time, escalation volume — and own the weekly and monthly business reviews for your scope.
  
  
**About The Team**
Driver Support Services (DSS) is a dedicated ROC unit that keeps Amazon's most strategic mile capacity moving — Amazon Freight Partner (AFP) carriers and TOMY drivers. AFP is Amazon's committed-carrier program: contracted partners who operate trucking fleets to Amazon's safety, sustainability, and delivery standards, providing capacity that protects the network from rate volatility and scales with our growth. TOMY drivers are Amazon associates within Transportation Operations Management running shorter- transit legs where DSS acts as their dispatch. We are a white-glove dispatch and disruption-resolution team operating 24x7 across three shift bands.

title: Loan Administration Manager
description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  
With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
**Job Description**
The loan administration manager will lead a team responsible for processing of agent bank notices of syndicated loans in loan platforms. This role requires blend of strong managerial skills and technical knowledge and will be instrumental in building a high-performing team, designing robust processes, and implementing efficiency improvements across the loan function. Will be the first level managerial role and will be responsible for the accurate deliverables and the people involved. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in funds administration, a strong background in loan admin processes, and a proven track record in managing large-scale transitions and process optimization initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Supervise, mentor and develop a team of loan administrators, fostering a positive and collaborative work environment.
* Utilise your strong technical knowledge to ensure accurate and timely processing of agent bank notices in client portfolio.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and provide insights into open items. Also, ensure seamless knowledge transfer and minimize disruption during the transition phase.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies. Prepare and review process documents and sign off during month ends/ quarter end
* Maintain agreed KPI and SLA metrices for internal monitoring and enhance the current workflow of loan administration.
* Identify opportunities for process enhancements, implement best practices and drive automation to increase efficiency.
* Ensure a 24-hour operating model to support global operations and improve service coverage.
* Build and lead a high-performance loan processing/ admin team in India, focused on achieving month-end targets.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence within the team.
* Provide mentorship, coaching, and career development opportunities to team members, promoting professional growth and retention.
* Lead the identification, design, and implementation of process improvement initiatives.
* Use data-driven insights to enhance the reconciliation process, reducing errors, cycle times, and operational costs.

**Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CPA, CFA) are a plus.
* Minimum of 12 - 15 years of experience in funds administration, financial operations, or related areas, with a strong focus on loan servicing/ administration business.
* Sound knowledge of Syndicated Loans/ private loans, structured credit products like CDO’s and CLO’s.
* Working knowledge of different Loan platforms like Sentry would be an added advantage.
* Proven experience in managing large-scale transitions, preferably in a global context.
* Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to build and motivate high-performing teams.
* Excellent project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on process optimization and efficiency.
* Experience in developing and implementing KPIs and SLAs in a financial operations environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and drive change across different levels of the organization.

**Leadership & Behavioural Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to create and work in a high-volume, collaborative, deadline-driven environment.
* Budgeting experience at team level or higher.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong understanding of global financial services regulations and technology trends.
* Commercial acumen, influencing and acting with confidence with diverse and challenging stakeholders.
* Proven track-record of working autonomously in a matrixed organisation and demonstrate strong partnering skills, using them to build internal networks to achieve objectives.
* Possess intellectual curiosity and a global mind-set, flexing your style accordingly and operating with agility and tenacity.
* Possess personal learning agility and an ability to adopt and champion new skills and ways of working to role model and inspire others.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to high integrity and ethics.
* Manage competing demands, actively prioritising and remaining calm under pressure while navigating complexity and challenges with confidence and resilience.
* Drive, monitor and maintain a culture of compliance and risk control.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to high integrity and ethics.
* Hands-on leader capable of taking on a wide range of tasks with humility and flexibility.

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
  
  
**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

**Equity In Every Sense Of The Word**
We are in the business of equity, in every sense of the word. For us, this means taking action to ensure every colleague has equal opportunity, valuing every voice and experience across our organisation, maintaining an inclusive culture where you can bring your whole self to work, and making Alter Domus a workplace where everyone feels they belong.
  
  
We celebrate our differences, and understand that our success relies on diverse perspectives and experiences, working towards shared goals and a common purpose. We take pride in creating a workplace where all our people are empowered to be truly invested in the alternative and bring their whole selves to work.
  
  
We are committed to ensuring a welcoming recruiting and onboarding process for everyone. Please contact our hiring team if you require any accommodations to make our recruitment process more accessible for you.

This role will oversee team performance, workload distribution, service quality, and adherence to contractual KPIs, governance requirements, and RWO standards.
  
  
The Team Leader will ensure consistent service delivery, strong accountability, and operational discipline across the US shift. This includes independently managing escalations, supporting capacity planning, identifying performance or quality concerns, and partnering with the Account Manager where additional guidance or escalation is required.
  
  
This role will also serve as the primary point of contact for team process questions, support new hire onboarding and refresher training, and drive continuous improvement across all supported functions to streamline processes, strengthen controls, and enhance the overall employee, candidate, and stakeholder experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance management for the team, fostering accountability, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.

* Uphold RWO standards across the US shift, ensuring consistent attendance, availability, productivity, and adherence to expected working practices, including appropriate break management.

description:

Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
Seismic is seeking an experienced, hands-on IT leader to serve as the senior technical presence for our India offices. This is not a pure people-management role — it is a high-level systems administration position with a people-leadership component. The Senior Manager, IT Operations will be the final escalation point for all technical IT issues in India, personally own day-to-day operations and troubleshooting, and lead a team spanning systems administration and helpdesk/support by doing the work alongside them — not simply directing others to do it.
  
  
This role operates under Seismic’s India dual solid-line operating model: the Senior Manager reports solid-line to the Sr. Director, IT (functional direction, standards, and technical strategy) and solid-line to the India GM (day-to-day people management, coaching, hiring within budget, and local escalations).
  
  
**Who you are:**

* 8+ years of hands-on IT systems administration, infrastructure, or end-user support experience, including current, active technical work — not purely managerial.
* 3+ years leading or mentoring a technical team, ideally spanning both systems administration and helpdesk/support functions.
* Working knowledge of core enterprise IT tooling: identity/SSO (Azure AD), MDM (Jamf and/or Intune), ITSM/ticketing (Freshservice or similar), major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and security tooling.
* A demonstrated track record as a doer — someone who resolves issues directly and leads by example, not someone who only delegates.
* Experience operating within a US-headquartered multinational’s India office; SaaS or enterprise software company experience preferred.
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed, dual solid-line reporting structure, balancing global functional direction with local execution and people leadership.
* Strong troubleshooting, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills under time pressure.
* Clear, direct communicator, able to escalate risk transparently to both local and global stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Serve as the final escalation point for all technical IT issues across Seismic’s India offices, spanning systems, network, endpoint, identity, and helpdesk-tier issues.
* Own day-to-day IT operations for India — infrastructure administration, incident response, and end-user support — personally diagnosing and resolving issues rather than only assigning them.
* Directly manage, coach, and mentor India-based IT staff across both systems administration/integrations and helpdesk/support, setting the standard by leading from the front.
* Partner closely with the Sr. Director, IT and global IT functional leads to align India execution with global IT strategy, standards, and tooling (Jamf/Intune, Azure AD, Freshservice, Rapid7, 1Password, and similar).
* Own local hiring, performance management, and workload prioritization for the India IT team within approved budget, consistent with the India GM operating model.
* Drive local IT security posture and compliance execution (patching, endpoint management, incident response) in partnership with global Security and IT leadership.
* Identify and implement automation and self-service improvements (Workato, Freshservice Service Catalog, AI tools) to reduce ticket volume and manual effort rather than defaulting to added headcount or process.
* Provide clear, timely communication to global IT leadership on India IT health, risks, incidents, and escalations.
