title: Catering & Events Associate
description:
Are you passionate about creating exceptional food experiences and unforgettable events? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, people-centric environment where no two days are the same? If you have a flair for hospitality, a sharp eye for detail, and a love for bringing people together — we want to hear from you!
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Catering & Events Associate at Swiss Re, you will be at the heart of our workplace experience, delivering world-class food & beverage services and orchestrating seamless corporate events. From strategic planning to hands-on execution, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the day-to-day hospitality experience for our employees and guests in Hyderabad. This is your opportunity to combine your passion for food, events, and people into a role that truly makes an impact.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and execute food & beverage strategies that align with organizational standards and cater to the diverse needs of our internal customers
* Champion sustainable gastronomy practices, driving initiatives that align with our environmental and organizational objectives
* Plan and manage end-to-end corporate events, including developing event plans, timelines, and conducting venue inspections and evaluations
* Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors — including kitchen staff, caterers, decorators, and audiovisual providers — to ensure timely and flawless service delivery
* Ensure full compliance with ISO 22000 and all applicable food safety, health & safety regulations, licensing, tax obligations, and labour laws
* Organise FOSTAC training for all food handlers and manage Background Verification documentation
* Create and manage budgets, track financial performance, analyse trends, and prepare regular financial and dashboard reports
* Build and nurture strong vendor and partner relationships, negotiating contracts and establishing KPIs to ensure cost-effectiveness and service excellence
* Drive process improvement initiatives, including automation and streamlining operations to enhance efficiency and overall experience
* Gather and act on feedback from employees and guests to continuously elevate the hospitality and events experience
* Lead and develop contract staff, fostering a positive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture
* Stay current with industry trends and best practices in catering, sustainable gastronomy, and event management

**About The Team**
The Corporate Real Estate and Services (CRES) team is on a mission to create and sustain a world-class office environment that aligns with Swiss Re's strategic vision and goals. Our diverse team of experts spans real estate, security, facilities management, and hospitality operations — working collaboratively to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions that make a real difference.
  
  
We believe that a well-maintained, secure, and thoughtfully designed workspace — paired with exceptional service offerings — is a powerful driver of employee well-being and productivity. As trusted advisors and partners, we are committed to consistently exceeding service standards by leveraging our collective expertise, fostering open communication, and embracing continuous learning and improvement.
  
  
**About You**
You are a hospitality professional who leads with warmth, precision, and purpose. You bring a solution-focused mindset, a genuine passion for customer service, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with grace. You take full ownership and accountability for your work, demonstrating strong leadership in everything you do — whether managing a high-profile event or resolving a day-to-day operational challenge. You thrive in dynamic environments, build strong relationships effortlessly, and are always looking for smarter, better ways to deliver exceptional experiences.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in catering, food & beverage management or a related corporate role, with demonstrated experience managing large teams
* Strong knowledge of food safety regulations, including ISO 22000 standards, and experience implementing and enforcing safe food handling procedures
* Proven budget management and financial analysis skills, with the ability to create, oversee, and report on budgets and financial performance
* Experience in vendor and contract management, including negotiating contracts and managing relationships with external partners and suppliers
* Proficiency in event planning and execution, including developing event plans, timelines, and coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and leadership skills — the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, lead by example, and drive results even in ambiguous or challenging situations

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field
* Certifications such as ServSafe Food Handler or similar food safety credentials
* Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) or equivalent event management certification
* Experience working in diverse, multi-geography environments
* Familiarity with MSME vendor payment regulations and compliance requirements
* Knowledge of local occupational health and safety regulations in India
* Experience with automation and process improvement initiatives in a hospitality or facilities management context
* Proficiency in preparing dashboards and data reports for consumption and budget tracking
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and the local language
* A collaborative, empathetic approach to teamwork across virtual and in-person environments

Nice to have: Exposure to Event Planning
  
  
**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per wee**
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
  
  
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

title: Manager IT Business Services
description:
**Who We Are**
Solera is a leading global technology and data solutions provider, specializing in the automotive industry that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.
  
  
**The Role**
The Manager is responsible for leading global
**Tier 1 and Tier 2 IT support operations**
, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, efficient, and scalable support services for end users across the organization.
  
  
The role directly manages
**4 Team Leads**
and provides overall leadership for a team of approximately
**24 IT Business Services professionals located in Hyderabad, India**
. The Senior Manager oversees the Service Desk and Remote Services functions while partnering with HR, Security, Enterprise Applications, and other IT organizations to drive operational excellence, service automation, access management, employee lifecycle services, continuous improvement, and an exceptional end-user experience.
  
  
This leader is responsible for developing talent, driving accountability, improving service delivery performance, and ensuring the organization continues to mature its support operations while delivering reliable global IT services.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Core Requirements**
**Leadership**
Lead and develop a global team of Tier 1 and Tier 2 support professionals through multiple team leads, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and exceptional customer service.
  
  
**Global Service Delivery:**
Ensure timely and effective resolution of incidents and service requests while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and adherence to established SLAs, KPIs, and operational targets.
  
  
**Remote Operations:**
Provide strategic oversight of Service Desk and Remote Services functions, ensuring consistent support experiences and efficient service delivery across multiple regions and time zones.
  
  
**Employee Lifecycle Management**
Lead global IT onboarding, offboarding, contingent worker provisioning, leave-of-absence support processes, and employee technology enablement activities to ensure a secure, seamless, and consistent employee experience.
  
  
**Access & Identity Services**
Oversee account provisioning, access management, role-based access models, access personas, entitlement reviews, and identity-related support processes while ensuring compliance with security and audit requirements.
  
  
**Incident, Request & Problem Management**
Drive operational excellence across incident, request, escalation, and problem management processes, ensuring recurring issues are identified, analyzed, and addressed through sustainable solutions and root cause analysis.
  
  
**Service Request Triage & Escalation Management**
Own support intake, ticket triage, escalation governance, and routing processes to ensure requests are assigned to the appropriate support teams and resolved efficiently while reducing unnecessary escalations and ticket transfers.
  
  
**Process Optimization & Service Automation**
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate support processes, onboarding workflows, reporting activities, and employee lifecycle services to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance service quality.
  
  
**Knowledge Management & Training**
Establish and maintain knowledge management programs, operational documentation, and training initiatives that improve first-contact resolution rates, accelerate team development, and ensure consistent support practices globally.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement**
Partner closely with IT leadership, HR, Security, Finance, Enterprise Applications, and business stakeholders to align support services with organizational priorities and business objectives.
  
  
**Reporting & Service Analytics**
Develop and maintain operational dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting to provide visibility into service performance, support trends, team productivity, and customer satisfaction while enabling data-driven decision making.
  
  
**Compliance, Audit & Governance**
Support SOX, ISO, security, and internal audit requirements through the implementation of appropriate operational controls, access governance processes, asset management standards, and policy compliance activities.
  
  
**Technology Enablement**
Leverage and support enterprise technologies including Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD), Teams, Zoom, Jira, endpoint management platforms, and automation tools to continuously improve end-user support capabilities and experiences.
  
  
**Timings**
Must be open to working in different shift timings to support USA/EMEA/APAC regions, as per business needs.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
**Required Qualifications**
8+ years of progressive experience in IT support, service management, or IT operations leadership.
  
  
5+ years of experience managing global support organizations, including geographically distributed teams.
  
  
Proven experience leading Tier 1 and Tier 2 support operations in a large enterprise environment.
  
  
Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills with experience leading leaders.
  
  
Deep understanding of ITIL-based service management principles and operational best practices.
  
  
Experience managing incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge management processes.
  
  
Strong analytical and reporting skills with experience using service metrics to drive operational improvements.
  
  
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
  
  
Experience working cross-functionally with HR, Security, Infrastructure, and business teams.
  
  
Ability to balance strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational responsibilities.
  
  
**Technical & Professional Expertise**
**Identity & Access Management**
Strong experience administering Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and identity governance solutions.
  
  
Experience managing user provisioning, deprovisioning, group management, entitlement reviews, and access control processes.
  
  
Proficiency with identity and access management tools such as ADManager and similar administration platforms.
  
  
**Microsoft 365 Administration**
Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and related administration functions.
  
  
Ability to troubleshoot and support complex user, collaboration, and productivity-related issues within Microsoft 365.
  
  
**IT Support Operations**
Advanced understanding of Tier 1 and Tier 2 support processes, service operations, incident management, request fulfillment, escalation management, and troubleshooting methodologies.
  
  
Experience supporting Windows, macOS, Microsoft Office, collaboration platforms, printers, remote access technologies, and end-user productivity tools.
  
  
**Service Management Platforms**
Strong experience with Jira Service Management, including workflow creation, queue management, SLA administration, service request design, reporting, and operational process optimization.
  
  
Reporting & Analytics
  
  
Experience building, maintaining, and enhancing Power BI dashboards, operational reports, and executive reporting solutions.
  
  
Ability to analyze support trends, service metrics, workforce data, and operational KPIs to drive decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Automation & Workflow Solutions**
Experience implementing and managing workflow automation solutions to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance service delivery.
  
  
Understanding of automation concepts, business process improvement, and service orchestration.
  
  
**Artificial Intelligence & Modern Technologies**
Demonstrated understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and their practical application within IT support and service management functions.
  
  
Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to improve productivity, knowledge management, reporting, automation, and user experience.
  
  
**Operational Excellence**
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-improvement skills.
  
  
Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement scalable solutions across global support teams.
  
  
**Communication & Leadership Skills**
**Communication**
Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills.
  
  
Ability to communicate effectively with executives, technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and end users across global regions.
  
  
Strong presentation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
  
  
**Leadership**
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop managers, team leads, and support professionals within a global organization.
  
  
Proven ability to drive accountability, collaboration, customer service excellence, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Strategic Thinking**
Ability to balance operational responsibilities with strategic initiatives.
  
  
Experience leading organizational change, service transformation, and process improvement programs.
  
  
**Timings**
Must be open to working in different shift timings to support USA/EMEA/APAC regions, as per business needs.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
ITIL Foundation Certification or higher.
  
  
Microsoft 365, Entra ID, or Power Platform certifications.
  
  
Experience building and maintaining Power BI reporting solutions.
  
  
Experience with workflow automation platforms, including Power Automate or similar solutions.
  
  
Experience supporting global onboarding, offboarding, and identity management processes.
  
  
Experience leading globally distributed support teams across multiple regions and time zones.
  
  
Experience working within SOX, ISO, audit, or compliance-driven environments.
  
  
Experience leveraging AI-driven tools and automation within enterprise support organizations.

title: Senior Manager, Operations & Digital Transformation
description:
SENIOR MANAGER – OPERATIONS \& DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION
   








 Location: Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad
   

 Experience: 2–5 Years
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| Work From Office – 5 Days
   

 Reports To: Operations Head
   

 Bond: 3 Years
   






 ABOUT GUARDIAN CAPITAL
   





 Guardian Capital is an Elite Wealth and Asset Management firm offering Wealth Management, Financial Planning, Portfolio Advisory, and Taxation services. We work closely with clients and families to provide customised financial solutions built on trust, discretion, and long\-term relationships.
   





 As a growing financial services firm, Guardian Capital offers employees the opportunity to take ownership, work closely with senior leadership, and contribute directly to building scalable systems and processes.
   





 ABOUT THE ROLE
   





 We are looking for a Senior Manager – Operations \& Digital Transformation who can manage a team while driving operational efficiency, process improvement, and automation.
   





 The role will oversee key operations including client onboarding, transaction processing, AMC coordination, reporting, and query resolution. The ideal candidate will combine people\-management skills with strong process thinking, attention to detail, risk awareness, and an automation mindset.
   





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
   




- Operations \& Team Management
   

 • Manage, mentor, and develop the operations team.
   

 • Set goals, review performance, and build team capability.
   

 • Own overall operational performance across platforms such as MFU and Investwell.
   

 • Oversee transaction processing, reporting, query resolution, and SLA adherence.
   

 • Personally handle escalations, high\-risk transactions, and documentation requiring accuracy.

- Process \& Automation
   

 • Identify manual, repetitive, and error\-prone workflows.
   

 • Improve and automate processes across onboarding, execution, reporting, and reconciliation.
   

 • Drive adoption of Excel, Zoho, Investwell, AI\-assisted workflows, and other digital tools.
   

 • Develop SOPs that reduce manual dependency and improve scalability.

- Vendor \& Stakeholder Management
   

 • Manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
   

 • Coordinate with AMCs and resolve operational escalations.
   

 • Manage service expectations and ensure timely resolution of queries.
   

 • Support the evaluation and analysis of Mutual Funds, PMS, and other products.
   

 • Ensure transactions and onboarding processes comply with applicable SEBI requirements.

- Reporting \& Business Insights
   

 • Build and maintain reporting infrastructure and dashboards.
   

 • Manage monthly database updates, factsheets, and company reports.
   

 • Analyse operational data and provide insights to support leadership decision\-making.


 KEY SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES
   








 • Attention to Detail \& Accuracy
   

 • People \& Team Management
   

 • Stakeholder Management
   

 • Process Improvement \& Automation
   

 • Business \& Systems Thinking
   

 • Risk Management
   

 • Reporting \& Data Analysis
   

 • Integrity \& Discretion
   

 • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
   

 • AI Prompt Engineering
   

 • Ability to work with digital platforms and workflow tools
   






 EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION
   








 • B.Tech / B.E. / B.Sc. in Computer Science or related field, with an MBA.
   

 • NISM Mutual Funds Distributor certification is not mandatory; willingness to obtain it after joining is a plus.
   






 EXPERIENCE
   








 • 2–5 years of experience in technology/automation consulting, business transformation, or general management.
   

 • Direct people\-management experience is required.
   

 • Prior experience in BFSI, Investment Advisory, or Asset Management is an advantage.
   

 • Experience in redesigning, automating, or scaling processes will be a strong differentiator.
   






 TOOLS \& TECHNOLOGY
   








 • Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets
   

 • Zoho
   

 • Investwell
   

 • MFU
   

 • Process automation and workflow tools
   

 • AI\-assisted platforms
   

 • Transaction tracking and reporting systems
   






 WHY JOIN GUARDIAN CAPITAL?
   








 • Work directly with senior leadership in a growing financial services firm.
   

 • Opportunity to take ownership of an operating function.
   

 • Exposure to wealth management, investment operations, automation, and business transformation.
   

 • Opportunity to build and improve systems and processes from the ground up.
   

 • ESOP opportunities for eligible employees.
   






 LOCATION
   








 Guardian Capital
   

 Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad
   






 To learn more, visit: www.gcia.in

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Company:** 
  We Connect
 



**Location:** 
  Hyderabad, Telangana
 



**Employment Type:** 
  Full\-Time, On\-Site
 



**Open Position:** 
  1
 



**Experience:** 
  4\+ years preferred
 



**Salary:** 
  ₹45,000\-50,000 per month based on Experience.
 



**Working Days:** 
  Monday–Saturday
 



**Working Hours:** 
  10:00 AM–7:00 PM
 



**Probation:** 
  3 months
 



**Weekly Off:** 
  Sunday
 



  





**About We Connect** 




 We Connect is a Hyderabad\-based event management company delivering corporate events, exhibitions, brand activations, seminars, promotions, sports events and other experiential projects.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an Operations Lead to oversee the day\-to\-day functioning of We Connect and ensure that teams, projects and resources work together efficiently. The role will bring structure to operations, improve coordination between departments and ensure that commitments to clients are delivered effectively.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Oversee day\-to\-day operations across event, production, client relations, business development and support functions.
* Establish clear processes, responsibilities and workflows across teams.
* Monitor ongoing projects and ensure timelines, deliverables and commitments are being met.
* Coordinate between departments to prevent communication gaps and operational delays.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement practical solutions to improve efficiency.
* Oversee resource allocation, manpower requirements and operational priorities.
* Monitor vendor, material and logistics requirements in coordination with relevant teams.
* Ensure events and projects are adequately staffed and operationally prepared.
* Track operational costs and identify areas for better resource utilisation.
* Establish and monitor basic operational reporting, trackers and performance metrics.
* Handle escalations and support teams in resolving critical operational issues.
* Ensure company processes, policies and operational standards are followed.
* Work closely with leadership on operational planning and business requirements.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve systems, productivity and accountability.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4\+ years of experience in operations, event management, project management or a similar role.
* Experience managing multiple teams or functions.
* Strong understanding of event operations and execution is preferred.
* Excellent planning, coordination and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong ability to manage people, priorities and deadlines.
* Good understanding of budgets, resources, vendors and operational processes.
* Strong communication and leadership skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with changing requirements.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and basic reporting tools.
* Experience in a growing company or event/agency environment is an advantage.



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 A structured, proactive and hands\-on leader who can see the bigger picture while keeping track of operational details. The ideal candidate should be comfortable taking ownership, holding teams accountable and solving problems before they affect clients or events.
 



  





**Success in 6 Months** 



* Establish clear and consistent operational processes.
* Improve coordination and accountability across teams.
* Reduce avoidable delays, errors and communication gaps.
* Ensure projects and events are adequately planned and resourced.
* Introduce effective operational tracking and reporting.
* Build a more organised and predictable day\-to\-day operating system for We Connect.



  





**Selection Process** 




 Candidates will undergo an interview and practical assessment focused on operational planning, team coordination, problem\-solving and handling real\-world event scenarios.
 



 Overtime will be compensated as per company policy. Benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

title: MSP Team Lead
description:
**Role:** 
 MSP Team Lead
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (Hybrid)
 



**Work Shift:** 
 Shift (5:30 PM \- 2:30 AM IST)
 



**Employment:** 
 Full Time
 



 Work Experience
 



 Minimum Years of Experience \- 7\+ Years
 



  





 The Assistant Manager (Team Lead) \- North America MSP is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership to the MSP delivery team supporting North American client programs. The role will directly manage and supervise team members, providing day\-to\-day direction, coaching, performance management, and career development to build a high\-performing and engaged team. The Assistant Manager will ensure consistent, high\-quality service delivery by managing operational performance, workload allocation, SLAs, KPIs, quality, and client commitments.
 



  





 This role will also act as a key escalation point for complex operational and client\-related matters, partnering closely with clients, internal stakeholders, and leadership to drive effective resolutions and maintain strong client relationships.
 



  





 The Assistant Manager will play a critical role in strengthening operational governance, identifying process gaps, and driving continuous improvement across North America MSP operations. The role will proactively identify opportunities to leverage automation, data, reporting, and technology\-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, increase productivity, and enhance the overall client and stakeholder experience. The successful candidate will bring strong MSP expertise, strategic thinking, operational discipline, leadership presence, and the ability to translate business and client requirements into effective and scalable operational solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Directly manage and supervise MSP team members supporting North American client programs. ● Provide day\-to\-day leadership, operational direction, prioritization, and guidance to the team.
 



 ● Coach, mentor, and develop team members through regular feedback, one\-on\-one discussions, performance reviews, and structured development plans.
 



 ● Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance.
 



 ● Monitor team workload, capacity, utilization, productivity, and resource allocation to ensure effective operational coverage.
 



 ● Manage team performance against defined KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, and client expectations. ● Review operational metrics and dashboards to identify performance trends, risks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
 



 ● Act as a key escalation point for complex operational, process, and client\-related issues and ensure timely resolution.
 



 ● Partner with clients, internal stakeholders, and leadership to understand business priorities and deliver effective MSP solutions.
 



 ● Participate in client governance meetings, operational reviews, business reviews, and performance discussions as required.
 



 ● Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and maintain a high level of client satisfaction.
 



 ● Ensure consistent and accurate execution of MSP processes across the North American client portfolio.
 



 ● Support new client implementations, transitions, process migrations, and changes in scope, ensuring operational readiness.
 



 ● Partner with leadership on workforce planning, hiring, backfills, onboarding, cross\-training, and succession planning.
 



 ● Identify and implement process improvements that simplify, standardize, and optimize MSP operations.
 



 ● Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, reporting, dashboards, and technology\-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
 



 ● Partner with automation and technology teams to implement scalable solutions that improve productivity, accuracy, turnaround time, and service quality.
 



 ● Promote data\-driven decision\-making by using operational reports and analytics to identify trends and drive meaningful business actions.
 



 ● Ensure effective utilization of VMS platforms and maintain process and data accuracy across systems.
 



 ● Drive root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring operational issues.
 



 ● Ensure compliance with internal policies, client requirements, contractual commitments, and established MSP processes.
 



 ● Support the development of standard operating procedures, process documentation, and operational governance frameworks.
 



 ● Identify risks proactively and implement appropriate mitigation plans to ensure business continuity.
 



 ● Develop team capability through knowledge sharing, cross\-training, mentoring, and continuous learning.
 



 ● Identify high\-potential team members and support the development of future MSP leaders.
 



 ● Ensure the team remains adaptable and responsive to changing client requirements and evolving MSP industry practices.
 



  





**Experience \-** 




 ● 6\+ years of overall experience in MSP, contingent workforce management, staffing operations, recruitment operations, or related workforce solutions.
 



 ● 2\+ years of experience in a Team Lead / Assistant Manager, Operations Lead, or people management role.
 



 ● Proven experience directly managing, coaching, mentoring, and developing team members.
 



 ● Strong experience managing operational delivery for North American clients or stakeholders.
 



 ● Hands\-on experience managing KPIs, SLAs, productivity, utilization, quality, and service delivery metrics.
 



 ● Experience managing client escalations and working with senior internal and external stakeholders.
 



 ● Experience with Vendor Management Systems (VMS) such as VNDLY, SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar platforms.
 



 ● Experience supporting new client implementations, operational transitions, process migrations, or program expansions.
 



 ● Experience driving process improvements, operational efficiencies, automation, or technology\-enabled solutions.
 



 ● Experience working in a fast\-paced, multi\-client, or complex MSP environment with competing priorities.
 



  





**Qualifications \-** 




 ● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Operations, Management, or a related field.
 



 ● Strong understanding of North American MSP and contingent workforce operations.
 



 ● Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end contingent workforce lifecycle and MSP operating model.
 



 ● Knowledge of VMS platforms such as VNDLY, Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar systems.
 



 ● Strong understanding of SLA, KPI, quality, productivity, and performance management frameworks.
 



 ● Demonstrated ability to manage and develop high\-performing teams.
 



 ● Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to use data to drive decisions.
 



 ● Ability to manage escalations, resolve complex operational issues, and make sound business decisions.
 



 ● Strong stakeholder management and client relationship skills.
 



 ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 



 ● Ability to work effectively with North American clients and stakeholders across multiple time zones.
 



 ● Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables.

title: Services Assistant Manager - Corporate Services - Executive Service Center - Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Key Role Description**
 The Assistant Manager – Executive Service Center is a people and operations leader within the Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) team, responsible for leading approximately 30\-40 Executive Experience Coordinators who provide integrated administrative and office experience support to Partners, Principals, and Managing Directors (PPMDs). This role ensures consistent, high\-quality, and seamless service delivery across US and USI teams by balancing workforce capacity, setting clear performance expectations, coaching team members, resolving operational issues, and building trusted relationships with PPMDs, US and USI Managers, and Executive Service Center (ESC) stakeholders.
   

  

 The successful candidate will serve as the shift lead and subject matter expert for Executive Service Center processes, Deloitte business knowledge, tools, policies, service standards, and escalation pathways. This position requires sound judgement, strong communication, a collaborative leadership style, and the ability to lead teams effectively in both virtual and in\-person environments.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Services Assistant Manager, Corporate Services on the Executive Service Center team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading, engaging, and developing a team of approximately 30\-40 Executive Experience Coordinators across virtual and in\-person environments
* Managing daily work allocation, staffing coverage, schedules, leave planning, and shift handoffs to support accurate and timely service delivery
* Monitoring quality, productivity, responsiveness, compliance, and stakeholder feedback; providing coaching, documenting performance, and addressing employee matters
* Serving as the shift lead and subject matter expert for Executive Service Center processes, tools, policies, service standards, and escalation pathways
* Building relationships with PPMDs, US and USI Managers, and cross\-functional support teams while identifying workflow improvements and supporting business continuity


**The team**
 The Executive Service Center (ESC) team delivers integrated administrative and office experience support to Partners, Principals, and Managing Directors (PPMDs), helping enable efficient day\-to\-day operations across the organization. Within Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX), the team focuses on consistent, high\-quality service delivery, operational discipline, and a seamless support experience across US and USI stakeholders. This team works in a fast\-paced, highly collaborative environment and partners closely with business leaders, managers, and cross\-functional support teams to address evolving service needs. The Assistant Manager role helps strengthen team performance, service quality, and workforce effectiveness while supporting a culture of accountability, development, and client service.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad, India**

 Required:

* Ability to work evening and night shifts aligned with US business hours

 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience supporting PPMDs, executives, or senior leaders in a large, complex, or matrixed professional services organization
* Knowledge of Deloitte’s businesses, operating model, internal systems, service channels, and administrative support processes
* Experience leading teams across US and USI locations or other cross\-time\-zone environments
* Experience using workforce, workflow, reporting, or performance management tools
* Experience supporting service transformation, process standardization, change management, or operational improvement initiatives


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. title: Service Delivery Lead (AMS)
description:
Mivada is seeking a high\-performing Service Delivery Lead to champion the end\-to\-end success of our Application Managed Services (AMS) portfolio. You will become the trusted advisor to a portfolio of post\-implementation customers, driving strategic outcomes, operational excellence, and long\-term partnership value. You will serve as the operational backbone of our service management function, ensuring dependable, scalable, and measurable service delivery aligned with ITIL best practices. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer success, delivery governance, and team leadership.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer Success \& Delivery Excellence
   

  

* Strategic Account Ownership: Serve as the primary point of contact for AMS clients, ensuring their ERP investment evolves with their business priorities.
* SLA \& Performance Governance: Monitor service delivery performance against SLAs, proactively identify risks and resolve constraints, and ensure consistent "Green" account health.
* Quality Assurance: Lead Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), presenting insights, performance metrics, and strategic recommendations.
* Incident \& Problem Management: Oversee triage for complex incidents, ensuring high\-quality Root Cause Analysis and permanent resolutions from both onshore and offshore teams.
* Change Management: Should be aware of the end\-to\-end process of handling changes, i.e., planning, approving, implementing, and reviewing changes to IT services to minimize risk and disruption.


 Engagement Management
   

  

* Change Request: Scope, plan, and govern small\-scale project work and ongoing enhancements within your accounts.
* Enhancements: Scope, plan, and oversee small\-scale projects, enhancements, and service improvements within client accounts.


 Leadership \& Collaboration
   

  

* Operational Orchestration: Maintain a single consolidated view of account KPIs, budgets, risks, and reporting across your portfolio.
* Service Efficiency: Drive high\-velocity ticket resolution and enforce operational standards across the AMS team.


 People Leadership:
   

  

* Lead and mentor a young, diverse, and ambitious global AMS team, creating clarity, structure, and growth pathways.
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Coach team members on managing escalations, prioritising workloads, and refining their consulting skills.
* Maintain effective communication rhythms, handover processes, and aligned expectations across time zones.


**Benefits**
**WHY JOIN US**
 Everyone who joins our team is treated as a trusted member of the team, not a number. Ultimately your success is our success, so we invest in our People heavily. Here are the top reasons to join us:
   

  

* Developing you is a key focus \- we help you craft your career
* Pioneers in Parental Leave benefits \- we provide equality in our parental leave for all genders and parental types
* Doona Days \- additional two days off for your mental health
* Fun is an everyday experience \- we challenge you in a positive way so you enjoy your growth journey
* Competitive Compensation \& Pay for Performance
* Opportunities to be more for yourself and others


**Who We Are**
 At
 **Mivada** 
 we believe that when you bring technology and the right people together, there's no limit to what you can achieve.
   

  

 Mivada is a high\-growth technology consultancy, headquartered in Australia, offering services to both high\-growth, mid\-sized and global blue chip clients. We run a hybrid model with the majority of our team onshore, as well as an offshore capability in India. We have the ability to support global businesses 24/7 365\. Our flexible approach and strong reputation have led to repeat work and growth.
 **Our clients are our advocates.**
**We believe cultural fit is as important as technical skills.** 
 We operate as a team, supporting and learning from each other and we genuinely care about our clients’ success. Our Leaders are accessible, humble, and sometimes pretty funny! We like to enjoy our time at work, which means we encourage each other to shoot for the moon!

* Vendor Management: Negotiate and manage relationships with external vendors and service providers.
* Collaboration: Work closely with other departments to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights.
* Reporting: Develop and deliver reports, dashboards, and presentations that communicate data insights to stakeholders.
* Tool Management: Evaluate and implement data analysis tools and technologies to enhance team efficiency and effectiveness.
* Performance Monitoring: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and make recommendations for improvements based on data analysis.
* Compliance: Ensure compliance with relevant data protection laws and regulations.

title: Senior Manager - Control Tower
description:
**Job Title: Senior Manager – Control Tower** 




**Location: Hyderabad** 




  





**About Gamlaa Bioscapes** 




 Gamlaa Bioscapes (https://gamlaa.com/) is India’s leading integrated biophilic solutions company, creating refined, nature\-led environments across workplaces, commercial, hospitality and premium spaces. We combine design, horticulture, execution and long\-term maintenance to transform spaces into living environments that elevate wellbeing and everyday experiences.
 



  





 Our vision is to make biophilic design an essential part of the built environment—creating spaces that are healthier, more human and meaningfully connected to nature. Today, Gamlaa is powered by 1,500\+ people, serving 1,250\+ enterprise clients, delivering 5,800\+ projects and managing 100Mn\+ sq. ft. across India. We’re building a team that brings curiosity, ownership and craftsmanship to breathe life into spaces.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Senior Manager \- Control Tower will lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, stakeholder coordination, and commercial control to ensure timely, cost\-effective, and quality delivery of projects. The role requires strong leadership across project teams, vendors, internal functions, and customers, with a strong focus on risk mitigation, contract compliance, and operational excellence.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead multiple projects from planning to completion while ensuring adherence to scope, timeline, cost, and quality parameters.
* Manage project teams including Project Managers, Engineers, and site execution teams across regions.
* Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, legal teams, and internal stakeholders for smooth project delivery.
* Prepare and review project schedules, resource plans, recovery plans, and progress reports.
* Track project milestones, identify delays, and implement corrective and rescue actions.
* Oversee subcontractor management, vendor coordination, procurement follow\-up, and post\-order execution.
* Handle contract administration, project\-related notices, closure documentation, EOT claims, and cost claims.
* Support warranty, DLP, and O\&M phases as required.
* Review BOQs, estimates, technical specifications, and commercial proposals.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, quality standards, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct regular review meetings and present project status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership.
* Maintain MIS dashboards, documentation, and reporting for all active projects.
* Build strong customer relationships and ensure high levels of client satisfaction.
* Mentor junior project staff and drive cross\-functional collaboration and process improvement.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
* Postgraduate qualification in Project Engineering, Project Management, or Construction Management preferred.
* Strong background in project execution, planning, and site coordination.
* Required Experience
* 8–12\+ years of experience in project management, planning, and execution.
* Proven experience in leading multi\-location or multi\-project operations.
* Strong exposure to project planning, subcontractor management, billing, vendor management, and contract administration.
* Experience in handling EOT, claims, recovery planning, and stakeholder negotiations.



**Desired Skills** 



* Project planning and scheduling.
* Cross\-functional coordination.
* Contract management and claim handling.
* Vendor and subcontractor management.
* Resource forecasting and allocation.
* Cost control and budget tracking.
* Risk assessment and mitigation.
* MIS reporting and documentation.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Working knowledge of Primavera P6, SAP, and project reporting tools.

title: E-commerce, Marketplace Growth & Listings Manager
description:
**E\-commerce, Marketplace Growth \& Listings Manager
 
 ﻿**




 📍 Hyderabad \| Full\-time
 



  





**A Note from the Founders** 




 Most marketplace roles eventually become coordination roles.
 



 Listings get uploaded, campaigns go live, sales happen — but very few people truly think about how catalogue quality, platform visibility, and operational execution directly impact long\-term revenue growth.
 



 At SkinBae, we are building this differently.
 



 We are looking for someone who naturally thinks about:
 


* how brands scale across marketplaces
* how listings influence conversion and discoverability
* how marketplace growth and operations connect together
* how systems can be built to reduce errors and improve efficiency at scale



 This role is not just about managing listings or operations. It is about building scalable marketplace growth engines across multiple Korean beauty brands.
 



 If you enjoy ownership, growth strategy, optimization, and execution, you’ll enjoy being here.
 



  





**About SkinBae** 




 SkinBae is building a curated Korean skincare platform in India. We work closely with global Korean beauty brands and focus on education\-led storytelling, strong visual identity, and long\-term brand building across D2C, marketplaces, and offline retail.
 



 As we continue scaling across marketplaces, we are looking for people who can combine growth thinking with operational excellence and execute at a high level across multiple brands and channels.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 This role combines marketplace growth, commercial strategy, catalogue management, listing optimization, and operational execution across major marketplaces including Amazon, Nykaa, TIRA, Myntra, Flipkart, and emerging quick\-commerce channels.
 



 You will own marketplace performance, catalogue quality, visibility optimization, and launch execution across a portfolio of Korean beauty brands.
 



 You will work closely with marketplace teams, operations, marketing, design, and leadership to ensure strong revenue growth while maintaining operational accuracy and scalability.
 



  





**What You Will Own1\. Marketplace Growth \& Revenue Ownership** 



* Own GMV growth and marketplace performance across platforms
* Drive revenue growth while balancing profitability and operational efficiency
* Build marketplace\-specific growth strategies based on:
* Consumer behaviour
* Category trends
* Platform dynamics
* Brand positioning
* Identify hero SKUs, growth opportunities, and expansion areas



  





**2\. Commercial Strategy \& Marketplace Management** 



* Lead marketplace discussions around:
* Margins and commissions
* TOTs / MDF
* Sale participation
* Visibility spends
* Assortment expansion
* Ensure marketplace investments are ROI\-driven
* Build strong relationships with category and account managers
* Support brand scaling through better commercial planning



  





**3\. End\-to\-End Listing \& Catalogue Management** 



* Manage the complete listing lifecycle:
* Creation
* QC
* Go\-live
* Optimization
* Maintenance
* Handle:
* Bulk uploads
* Variation mapping
* Catalogue updates
* Listing maintenance
* Suppression resolution
* Ensure all listings are:
* Accurate
* SEO optimized
* Marketplace compliant
* Conversion\-ready



  





**4\. PDP Optimization \& SEO** 



* Optimize:
* Product titles
* Bullet points
* Descriptions
* A\+ content
* Backend keywords
* Brand stores
* Improve:
* Organic ranking
* Discoverability
* Click\-through rates
* Conversion rates
* Ensure PDPs align with:
* Marketplace algorithms
* SEO best practices
* Brand positioning



  





**5\. Catalogue Data \& Compliance Management** 



* Maintain Master SKU Tracker across brands and marketplaces
* Standardize:
* SKU naming
* Attributes
* Category mapping
* Barcode structures
* Ensure compliance with:
* MRP regulations
* Country of origin requirements
* Ingredient declarations
* Importer details
* Shelf\-life requirements
* Maintain:
* MSDS documents
* Certifications
* Product documentation



  





**6\. Brand Launches \& Go\-to\-Market Execution** 



* Manage launch readiness for:
* New brands
* New product launches
* Marketplace onboarding
* Ensure:
* Timely go\-live
* Content readiness
* Compliance approvals
* Inventory mapping
* Marketplace coordination
* Align launch timelines with campaigns and sale events



  





**7\. Marketplace Visibility \& Demand Generation** 



* Coordinate with marketing teams for:
* Marketplace campaigns
* Influencer initiatives
* Sale visibility
* Banner opportunities
* Search ranking improvements
* Support demand generation activities across marketplaces



  





**8\. Listing Health \& Operational Excellence** 



* Monitor and resolve:
* Listing suppressions
* Catalogue mismatches
* Mapping issues
* Content rejections
* Account health concerns
* Coordinate with marketplace teams for faster issue resolution
* Ensure minimal listing downtime and operational disruption



  





**9\. SOP Building \& Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Build and improve SOPs for:
* Catalogue workflows
* Listing management
* QC processes
* Marketplace execution
* Introduce systems and process improvements to reduce errors
* Coordinate closely with:
* Operations team
* Marketing team
* Design team
* Brand team
* Finance team
* Ensure smooth execution across departments



  





**Key KPIs (Non\-Negotiable)** 



* Monthly GMV growth
* Contribution margin improvement
* Listing accuracy rate
* PDP conversion improvement
* Organic ranking growth
* Reduction in listing suppressions/errors
* Time\-to\-live for new SKUs
* ROI on marketplace spends



  





**What We Are Looking ForExperience** 




 4–7 years in:
 


* Marketplace growth
* E\-commerce operations
* Catalogue and listing management
* Category management
* Business development



 Experience across Amazon, Nykaa, TIRA, Myntra, Flipkart, and beauty marketplaces is preferred.
 



  





**Skills** 



* Strong commercial and negotiation skills
* Understanding of marketplace ecosystems and algorithms
* Strong understanding of:
* SEO
* PDP optimization
* Marketplace operations
* Catalogue management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills:
* VLOOKUP
* Pivot Tables
* Bulk uploads
* Reporting
* Data validation



  





**Preferred Mindset** 



* Strong ownership mindset
* Detail\-oriented and execution\-focused
* Ability to manage multiple brands and large SKU volumes
* Comfortable working in fast\-paced growth environments
* Strong coordination and communication skills



  





**Work Details** 



* 5\-day work week
* Work from office – Hyderabad
* High ownership role with direct business impact
* Exposure to founders and key decision\-making
* Competitive salary
* Quarterly team outings



  





**Growth** 




 As SkinBae scales across marketplaces and multiple brands, this role will evolve into larger ownership across marketplace business growth, category expansion, and operational strategy.
 



  





**Hiring Process** 



1. Initial conversation
2. Practical marketplace/case discussion
3. Final discussion with founders



  





**Final Note** 




 If you enjoy building scalable marketplace systems, driving growth through optimization, and owning both business performance and execution, we would love to hear from you.
 



  





**Office Address** 




 8\-2\-277/24, Plot No. 24, Road No. 3, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana \- 500034, India

title: Digital Production Manager
description:
Eyeline is a global team of risk takers, innovators and perfectionists who achieve creative visions and have fun doing it. A dynamic workforce nestled within the industry’s most intriguing cities, united by a drive to push the boundaries of storytelling. Learn more.
   

  

 The Production Manager (DPM) reports to the VFX Producer and Head of Production and assists the VFX Producer in managing assigned VFX projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Works in tandem with the VFX, CG and compositing supervisors to foster the partnership between the creative and production arms of the Production Supervision crew
* Assist VFX producer in managing VFX projects, along with maintaining the schedules of deliverables milestones and dates
* Mentors and collaborates with VFX coordinators to create clear daily and weekly plans to ensure work schedule is on track as discussed with VFX producer and supervisory team
* Organizes and manages day\-to\-day meetings, and ensures clear agenda with follow up plans
* Identifies and assists production supervisors crew with any project roadblocks and create detailed plans to ensure effective and efficiency schedules
* Ensures clear communication flow and follow up with various teams/department regarding goals and deadlines


**Qualifications**
* Minimum two (2\) years experience in a Digital Production Manager role (or in a similar)
* Minimum five (5\) years experience working on high profile feature films and television
* Strong technical understanding of the VFX pipeline across multiple departments as well as interest and knowledge of VFX software packages
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Advanced Excel skills
* Shotgun, or other production management software experience


**About Us**
 Eyeline is a global creative studio partnering with storytellers to turn their ambitions into stunning reality. By blending the time\-honored craft of filmmaking with breakthrough technologies, we unlock bold, cinematic visions at scale. Our three pillars \- VFX, Studios and Labs \- form the creative spine of Eyeline, guiding how we think, work, and show up in every frame.
   

  

 At Eyeline, we believe technology serves artistry and our people are the soul behind everything we do, deepening creative connection, rather than replacing it. We build worlds with exceptional craft and precision, working hand in hand with our creative partners from concept to final pixel.
   

  

 Netflix Investment\- Eyeline
   

  

 With the support of Netflix’s investment in our pipeline, infrastructure, and workforce, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in visual effects and virtual production technology. In addition to our work with Netflix, we continue to partner with a wide range of long\-standing and new clients worldwide.
   

  

 Come as you are
   

  

 We are looking for those seeking to take risks with us, those driven by passion for their craft. To us, these are key ingredients that we look for in our team. We are committed to ensuring fair and equal treatment of your application. When you apply for a role with us, you will receive consideration based solely on your qualifications.

title: Software Support Manager
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
 We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
   

  

 We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
 **Want to be part of it?**
**Purpose of the Role**
 This is an opportunity to lead and transform support within the Korean market. As Software Support Manager, you will be responsible for developing a high\-performing team, building trusted customer relationships, and driving initiatives that improve both customer outcomes and operational performance. We are not looking for someone to simply manage a support queue; we are looking for a leader who will challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement through data and AI\-driven insights, influence cross\-functional change, and help shape the future direction of support for our customers.
   

  

**Key Duties And Responsibilities**
**Lead and Develop a High\-Performing Team**
* Build an engaged, accountable, and customer\-focused support team.
* Coach and develop team members to maximise performance, capability, and career growth.
* Recruit, onboard, and retain top talent.


**Shape the Future of Support**
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational effectiveness.
* Use data, customer feedback, and AI\-driven insights to identify opportunities for case reduction, process improvement, and product enhancement.
* Challenge existing ways of working and influence positive change across the support organisation.


**Own The Customer Experience**
* Take ownership of customer challenges and escalations, ensuring customers receive timely updates, clear communication, and effective resolutions.
* Build trusted relationships with customers, becoming a credible advisor and advocate who understands their business, challenges, and goals.
* Drive actions that improve customer satisfaction, strengthen customer confidence in Keyloop, and support long\-term customer retention.


**Drive Operational Excellence**
* Ensure service levels, quality standards, and key performance indicators are achieved.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through analysis of support performance data.
* Implement improvements that increase efficiency and reduce customer effort.


**Influence Across the Business**
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams to resolve systemic issues and improve the customer experience.
* Use customer and operational insights to influence product direction and business priorities.
* Contribute to the strategic development of support within the Korean market.


**Skills, Knowledge And Experience**
* Proven experience leading and developing high\-performing teams.
* Previous experience in a customer\-focused, support, service delivery, or technical support environment.
* Demonstrated ability to drive change, lead continuous improvement initiatives, and influence positive outcomes.
* Strong customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience handling escalations and managing complex customer situations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
* Experience using reporting, metrics, and insights to improve operational performance.
* Confidence using AI\-powered tools and technology to identify trends, improve efficiency, and drive better customer outcomes.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multiple business functions, including Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.
* A proactive mindset with a focus on accountability, ownership, and delivering results.


**Qualifications Required**
* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Previous experience leading a team in a customer\-facing environment.
* Experience within a software support, technical support, service delivery, or customer operations role is desirable.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and business productivity tools.
* Experience working with customer support or case management systems is advantageous.
* Degree\-level qualification or equivalent professional experience preferred.


**Why join us?**
 We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space \- and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
   

  

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
 We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles \- not just on key days, but every day.
   

  

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
 We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
   

  

 Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

title: Diamond Jewelry Retail : Store Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 House of Quadri is a contemporary lab\-grown diamond jewelry brand based in Mumbai, India. The company designs, manufactures, and directly retails its jewelry, maintaining close control over quality and craftsmanship. As a small, dynamic team, House of Quadri is building a direct\-to\-consumer brand with an online\-first approach. Team members work in an environment that values innovation, modern aesthetics, and customer\-centric thinking. The company offers opportunities to contribute to a growing brand at the intersection of jewelry, fashion, and technology.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Store Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. The Store Manager will oversee daily store operations, including opening and closing procedures, visual merchandising, inventory management, and coordination with the production and online teams. This role involves leading and training store staff, ensuring high standards of customer service, and maintaining a welcoming, brand\-aligned store environment.
 



  





 The Store Manager will manage sales targets, track performance, handle customer inquiries and escalations, and support in\-store events or promotions. The role also includes monitoring product quality, coordinating quality checks/repairs as needed, and providing feedback to design and manufacturing teams to enhance the customer experience.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess skills in diamond jewelry product and an understanding of pricing ind detail.
* Candidates should possess strong customer service skills, including client engagement, relationship\-building, and after\-sales support.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of basic jewelry finishing standards to ensure product quality on the sales floor.
* Candidates should possess training and team leadership skills to coach staff, conduct product and service trainings, and maintain performance standards.
* Relevant experience in retail store management, preferably in jewelry, luxury, or fashion, is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work in a collaborative environment.
* Comfort with digital tools, CRM, POS systems, and coordination with online sales or e\-commerce channels.
* A diploma or degree in retail management, business, fashion, or a related field is an advantage.

title: Fund Services Assistant Manager
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 As a member of the Private Equity team, you will be accountable for an efficient processing and review of end\-to\-end PE funds NAV delivery, including capital events, annual financials, support year end audit process and specifically supports the team during process migration to India CDC and overseeing the NAV delivery:
   

  

* Supervise and mentor a team of Fund Accountants and Senior Fund Accountants, ensuring strong technical capability and client service orientation
* Oversee quarterly and annual financial statements under US GAAP/IFRS, including partner capital accounts and waterfall allocations.
* Review and approve capital activity (calls, distributions, equalizations) and ensure compliance with side letters and bespoke investor economics
* Implement and monitor internal controls for an efficient NAV accounting process and exception management to maintain audit readiness
* Identify and execute process improvements to reduce cycle times and enhance reporting accuracy
* Support system optimization initiatives (Investran, Allvue, and other Nav accounting tools) and other NAV process automation projects
* Sign off as reviewer on SOC1 checklist and support SOC external audit requests
* Ensure compliance with internal audit procedures and requests
* Develop leadership skills by demonstrating willingness to lead projects and offer input; and
* Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the governing agreement(s) between Alter Domus, the clients and their investors
* Foster a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.


**YOUR PROFILE**
* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in accounting, Finance, any other professional accounting qualification (i.e. CA, CMA or ACCA or equivalent)
* Minimum of 10\+ years’ experience in accounting for the financial services sector, particularly Private Equity, Asset Management or Fund Administration.
* Supervisory skills with experience in managing and/or leading staff for 3\-4 years and should have conducted minimum 1 performance appraisal cycle for junior staff
* Private equity fund experience, Exposure to complex fund structures
* Expertise in US GAAP/IFRS, waterfall mechanics, carried interest, and investor economics.
* Familiarity with PE accounting platforms (Investran, Allvue) is highly preferred
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to perform multiple projects, navigate unexpected challenges, and bring about viable solutions that provide the best results.


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

title: Quality Manager IRC298730
description:
**Description**
 GlobalLogic is looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Management professional with strong expertise in quality assurance, audit frameworks, performance management, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will be responsible for governing quality standards, monitoring operational performance, driving corrective actions, and ensuring consistent quality delivery across service operations.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Quality Management, or a related field.
* Proven experience in quality management, quality assurance, or operational excellence within a service industry.
* Experience managing quality performance.
* Strong knowledge of quality management systems, audit methodologies, and root cause analysis techniques.
* Proficiency in analyzing quality metrics, identifying trends, and driving improvement initiatives.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience leading and developing quality teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and project management capabilities.
* Proficiency in reporting tools and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and influence operational teams to achieve quality objectives.


 Job responsibilities
   

  

  

* Define and govern quality standards, processes, and audit frameworks for quality operations.
* Monitor quality performance through audits, scorecards, and key quality metrics.
* Identify quality risks, analyze error trends, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, operational procedures, and contractual quality commitments.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects and enhance overall quality performance.
* Drive training, calibration, and capability\-building programs based on quality findings.
* Provide regular quality reporting and insights to operational and client stakeholders.
* Manage and develop the quality team to ensure consistent and effective quality oversight.
* Work closely with internal and external stakeholders on deliverables.
* Prepare and present reports on quality metrics, performance, and improvement initiatives.


 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

 of overall experience in Data Engineering / Technology Delivery

 **large distributed technical teams**

 Experience in
