title: Lead, Client Service Operations
description:
Client Service Operations (CSO) enables Kroll's business units through operational excellence, standardized processes, and centralized support services. As part of CSO, the Business Support Services (BSS) function provides high\-quality business enablement services that enhance operational efficiency, improve consistency, strengthen governance, and elevate the internal stakeholder experience.
   

  

 Business Support Services operates as a centralized shared services organization supporting internal teams across a broad range of operational activities including business administration, sales support, document production, presentation services, workflow coordination, reporting, operational data management, and business process support. Through a customer\-centric approach and continuous improvement mindset, the team enables business units to focus on delivering value to clients.
   

  

 The Lead, Business Support Services is responsible for the day\-to\-day management and successful delivery of one or more Business Support Services offerings. The role provides operational leadership by ensuring service requests are delivered accurately, within agreed service levels, and in accordance with established quality standards. The Lead is accountable for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts, overseeing workload allocation, monitoring operational performance, conducting quality reviews, and acting as the primary operational contact for assigned stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to ensuring consistent service delivery, the Lead is expected to identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen governance, enhance team capability, and drive operational excellence across their service portfolio.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned Business Support Services offerings, ensuring work is completed within agreed service levels and quality expectations.
* Manage day\-to\-day operational activities, balancing workload, priorities, and resource allocation to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Monitor work queues, request volumes, turnaround times, and service performance, taking proactive action to address delivery risks.
* Ensure business continuity through effective workload planning and resource management.
* Support transition of new services and operational activities into the Business Support Services operating model.
* Establish and maintain high standards of quality across all team deliverables.
* Conduct quality reviews of complex or high\-risk deliverables and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
* Monitor quality trends, identify recurring issues, and implement actions to reduce rework and improve delivery consistency.
* Ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational controls, data handling requirements, and governance standards.
* Support audit requests and ensure operational documentation is accurate and maintained.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts to achieve operational and professional development objectives.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, individual capability, and team capacity.
* Monitor individual and team performance against established goals and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing capability development within the team.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Operations Head — Culinary Cousins Private Limited** 




**Sainikpuri, Hyderabad \| Full\-time \| On\-site** 




**₹60,000 per month** 




  





**About the role** 




**Culinary Cousins Private Limited (CCPL) runs a cloud kitchen operation out of Sainikpuri, Hyderabad. We're looking for an Operations Head to run the business day to day — the team, kitchen output, delivery platform performance, food cost, and hygiene.** 




**This is the person accountable for whether the numbers work. You'll lead the team, own the operating P\&L levers, and be on the floor during peak hours. If you want a desk job, this isn't it.** 




  





**What you'll own** 




*Team* 



* Hire, train, roster, and manage kitchen staff, stores, and packing team
* Set daily targets and hold people to them
* Reduce attrition and build a bench so one absence doesn't break a shift
* Build the discipline and standards the kitchen runs on



*Kitchen and output* 



* Kitchen throughput during peak hours, and the SOPs that make it repeatable
* Order accuracy and preparation time; drive down kitchen prep time and late dispatches
* Recipe standardisation and portion control across every menu item
* Menu engineering alongside the chef — what to push, what to reprice, what to remove



*Delivery platforms* 



* Swiggy and Zomato performance: ratings, visibility, rejected and cancelled orders, RTO
* Discounting and ad spend on both platforms, and the return on it
* Customer complaints and review response; fix the root cause, not just the review
* Account relationships with platform managers



*Financial* 



* Food cost percentage, packaging cost, and wastage — set targets, track them weekly, and close the gaps
* Vendor negotiations, rate cards, and purchase decisions
* Labour cost and shift planning against order volume
* Monthly operating P\&L review with management, with reasons behind every variance



*Compliance and hygiene* 



* FSSAI compliance and audit readiness at all times
* Daily hygiene and housekeeping standards
* Statutory documentation, licences, and renewals
* Equipment maintenance schedules and downtime management



*Reporting* 



* Daily sales, order count, AOV, food cost, and wastage reporting to management
* Petpooja data accuracy — the reports are only useful if the entries are right



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 7\+ years in food service operations, with at least 2 years running a kitchen, outlet, or cluster independently
* Experience in a cloud kitchen, QSR, or delivery\-first format strongly preferred
* Demonstrated control of food cost — you should be able to tell us what your food cost percentage was and how you moved it
* Hands\-on with Swiggy and Zomato partner dashboards, not just aware of them
* Working knowledge of Petpooja or a comparable restaurant POS and inventory system
* Comfortable with Excel and numbers; able to read a P\&L and explain what's driving it
* Track record of managing and retaining a kitchen team
* Understanding of FSSAI norms and food safety compliance
* Available during peak service hours, weekends, and festivals
* Fluent in Telugu and Hindi; working English for reporting



  





**Good to have** 



* Prior experience working as a chef, with real kitchen craft behind the management experience
* Degree or diploma in hotel management, culinary arts, or food production
* Experience opening a new kitchen or launching a new brand on delivery platforms
* Exposure to running multiple brands out of one kitchen
* Experience with catering or bulk orders alongside delivery

title: Supervisor - Document Intelligence
description:
**About This Role**
 GHX is standing up a new Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HiTL) operations team in Hyderabad to support its ADM (Automated Document Management) platform — an AI\-powered document processing system replacing legacy UiPath automation for GFax North America. The platform processes over 2\.2 million Purchase Orders per year and targets a 75–85% fully\-automated (touchless) rate. The team handles every document the AI cannot process autonomously.
   

  

 The Operations Supervisor is building this team from zero and is accountable for everything within it: throughput, field accuracy, team development, day\-to\-day operations management, and real\-time coordination with GHX Engineering and Product teams in the United States. This is a high\-visibility, inaugural role — the team’s accuracy and throughput directly determine the speed and confidence with which GHX can expand the ADM platform beyond GFax North America.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**People** 
**\& Performance Management — 70%**
* Directly supervise 15\-20 Document Review Specialists; own rostering across rotational shifts, attendance tracking, and queue capacity planning against daily document volume
* Manage operations SLA – TAT, Quality, along with people metrics
* Own day\-to\-day operations management: shift rosters and week\-offs, leave planning, planned \& unplanned shrinkage, absenteeism control, and real\-time reallocation of staffing to protect SLAs \& operations performance metrics
* Set and communicate daily, weekly, and monthly throughput, AHT, and accuracy targets; monitor individual and team performance against SLA and productivity standards
* Participate in and present at weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews (WBR / MBR / QBR) — performance against KPIs, root\-cause analysis of misses, and committed corrective actions
* Own the full performance cycle for direct reports, including goal setting, mid\-year and annual appraisals, with documented performance ratings, development plans, and calibration against peer supervisors
* Conduct weekly 1:1s and team calibration sessions; coach on accuracy, field interpretation, and escalation judgment
* Manage performance improvement plans for specialists not meeting accuracy, AHT, or throughput standards; drive engagement and retention to control attrition
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members; maintain a bench and cross\-skilling plan to cover leave and attrition
* Proactively escalate capacity gaps and SLA risk to GHX US management before they impact queue throughput


**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement— 20%**
* Identify patterns in AI extraction errors that indicate model weaknesses (e.g., systematic misread of specific templates); surface findings as structured product feedback to GHX Engineering
* Develop and maintain team SOPs, job aids, audit checklists, and the GHX field\-standards reference guide
* Recommend tool and process improvements to reduce per\-document review time (AHT) and improving accuracy
* Contribute to the ADM continuous improvement cycle by translating on\-the\-ground operational insight into prioritized product feedback
* Own team field accuracy at or above 99% for mandatory (Tier 1\) fields; track and report accuracy, throughput, and SLA attainment in a weekly dashboard
* Conduct periodical audits of each team member's work on a defined cadence (daily sampling, weekly per\-specialist audit, and monthly deep\-dive) with documented findings, scores, and feedback logged per specialist
* Conduct structured quality audits — sampled review of completed documents across team members — to detect systematic errors and training gaps
* Run audit\-driven coaching loops: convert audit findings into individual feedback, refresher training, and re\-audit to confirm the correction held
* Maintain and execute the escalation protocol for documents that cannot be resolved by specialists (damaged images, ambiguous formatting, novel document types)
* Own the error log: categorize error types, track frequency and trend, deliver structured feedback to GHX Engineering as actionable product input


**Cross\-Functional Coordination — 10%**
* Serve as the primary GHXI point of contact for GHX US Product and Engineering on Document Queue status, error patterns, and team capacity
* Participate in ADM platform update reviews; translate tool changes into updated team procedures and retraining plans before each release
* Deliver clear, data\-backed written status updates to US stakeholders; communicate GHX US expectations and standards to the Hyderabad team
* Coordinate with GHXI local management on workspace, IT, HR, compliance, rostering, transport, and facilities matters


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS OWNED BY THIS ROLE**
 The Supervisor Is Accountable For The Standard Operational KPI Set Of a Production Contact\-center / Transaction\-processing Environment, Reported In The Weekly Dashboard And Reviewed In WBR, And MBR, Forums
   

  

* Productivity \& throughput: documents processed per specialist per hour, daily/weekly volume completed
* AHT (Average Handling Time) and average review time per document type
* SLA / TAT attainment: % of documents completed within committed turnaround; queue aging and backlog carried over
* Service level and queue wait for real\-time\-facing work; abandonment rate where applicable
* Quality: field\-level accuracy (Tier 1 ≥ 99%), audit score per specialist, critical vs. non\-critical error rate, rework %, first\-pass yield, FCR (First Contact / First Pass Resolution)
* Occupancy and utilization; schedule adherence and conformance
* Shrinkage — planned (leave, training, meetings, breaks) and unplanned (unscheduled absence, late logins, system downtime)
* Absenteeism — planned and unplanned — and attrition (voluntary, involuntary, and early\-life attrition)
* Forecast vs. actual volume accuracy and staffing variance (required vs. rostered vs. actual)
* Escalation rate, reopen rate, and aging of escalated or exception items
* Customer\-impacting measures: CSAT / internal stakeholder satisfaction, NPS where measured, and downstream EDI failure or defect leakage rate
* Cost per transaction and productivity per FTE against the operating plan
* Training and certification: nesting graduation rate, time\-to\-proficiency for new hires, cross\-skilling coverage %


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate qualification in Operations, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
* Minimum 6 years of total experience in BPO, KPO, shared services in a document processing operations
* Minimum 2 years in a confirmed Supervisory or Team lead role with accountability for 10 or more staff
* Demonstrated understanding \& ownership of core operational KPIs — SLA, AHT, quality/accuracy, shrinkage, absenteeism, and attrition — in a production environment
* Experience running periodical quality audits and sample\-based audit methodologies, with documented feedback and coaching loops
* Experience in owning the people\-management cycle: rostering, leave and shrinkage planning, mid\-year and annual appraisals, and performance improvement plans
* Experience in preparing for and presenting in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews
* Strong business English — written and verbal — for regular written and video communication with stakeholders
* Comfortable building and presenting weekly operational reports (throughput, AHT, accuracy trend, error categories) in Excel or Google Sheets
* Demonstrated ability to write clear SOPs, job aids, and team process guides from scratch
* Willing and able to work rotational shifts, including US Mountain Time night rotations, on\-site 5 days per week


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to AI\-augmented operations: annotation platforms, RLHF review queues, AI quality assurance, or document intelligence tools
* Experience coordinating with US\-based counterparts across time zones on a regular basis
* Background in procurement or supply chain document processing (Purchase Orders, invoices, order acknowledgements)
* Understanding of how AI confidence scoring works and the relationship between human corrections and model retraining
* Workforce management exposure — forecasting, capacity planning, and roster optimisation experience
* Six Sigma, Lean, or equivalent process improvement certification
* Greenfield experience — prior role that required standing up a new team or operations function with minimal existing infrastructure


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
**Location:** 
 GHX India (GHXI) office, Hyderabad, Telangana — on\-site, 5 days per week;
 ***no remote or hybrid option***
**Shift:** 
 Rotational shifts on a 24x7 roster, including night rotations aligned to US Mountain Time (\~8:30 PM–4:30 AM IST (MDT) / \~9:30 PM–5:30 AM IST (MST)); week\-offs rotate with the roster
   

  

**US Coordination:** 
 Regular video calls with GHX US Engineering, Product, and Director, Automation \& Scalability (functional line)
   

  

**GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare**
 Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
   

  

 GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud\-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe \- who rely on smart, secure healthcare\-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.
   

  

 It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce \- not shift \- the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

* Conduct periodical audits of each team member's work on a defined cadence (daily sampling, weekly per\-specialist audit, and monthly deep\-dive) with documented findings, scores, and feedback logged per specialist
* Conduct structured quality audits — sampled review of completed documents across team members — to detect systematic errors and training gaps
* Run audit\-driven coaching loops: convert audit findings into individual feedback, refresher training, and re\-audit to confirm the correction held
* Maintain and execute the escalation protocol for documents that cannot be resolved by specialists (damaged images, ambiguous formatting, novel document types)
* Own the error log: categorize error types, track frequency and trend, deliver structured feedback to GHX Engineering as actionable product input


**Cross\-Functional Coordination — 10%**
* Serve as the primary GHXI point of contact for GHX US Product and Engineering on Document Queue status, error patterns, and team capacity
* Participate in ADM platform update reviews; translate tool changes into updated team procedures and retraining plans before each release
* Deliver clear, data\-backed written status updates to US stakeholders; communicate GHX US expectations and standards to the Hyderabad team
* Coordinate with GHXI local management on workspace, IT, HR, compliance, rostering, transport, and facilities matters


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS OWNED BY THIS ROLE**
 The Supervisor is accountable for the standard operational KPI set of a production contact\-center / transaction\-processing environment, reported in the weekly dashboard and reviewed in WBR, and MBR, forums:
   

  

* Productivity \& throughput: documents processed per specialist per hour, daily/weekly volume completed
* AHT (Average Handling Time) and average review time per document type
* SLA / TAT attainment: % of documents completed within committed turnaround; queue aging and backlog carried over
* Service level and queue wait for real\-time\-facing work; abandonment rate where applicable
* Quality: field\-level accuracy (Tier 1 ≥ 99%), audit score per specialist, critical vs. non\-critical error rate, rework %, first\-pass yield, FCR (First Contact / First Pass Resolution)
* Occupancy and utilization; schedule adherence and conformance
* Shrinkage — planned (leave, training, meetings, breaks) and unplanned (unscheduled absence, late logins, system downtime)
* Absenteeism — planned and unplanned — and attrition (voluntary, involuntary, and early\-life attrition)
* Forecast vs. actual volume accuracy and staffing variance (required vs. rostered vs. actual)
* Escalation rate, reopen rate, and aging of escalated or exception items
* Customer\-impacting measures: CSAT / internal stakeholder satisfaction, NPS where measured, and downstream EDI failure or defect leakage rate
* Cost per transaction and productivity per FTE against the operating plan
* Training and certification: nesting graduation rate, time\-to\-proficiency for new hires, cross\-skilling coverage %


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate qualification in Operations, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
* Minimum 6 years of total experience in BPO, KPO, shared services in a document processing operations
* Minimum 2 years in a confirmed Supervisory or Team lead role with accountability for 10 or more staff
* Demonstrated understanding \& ownership of core operational KPIs — SLA, AHT, quality/accuracy, shrinkage, absenteeism, and attrition — in a production environment
* Experience running periodical quality audits and sample\-based audit methodologies, with documented feedback and coaching loops
* Experience in owning the people\-management cycle: rostering, leave and shrinkage planning, mid\-year and annual appraisals, and performance improvement plans
* Experience in preparing for and presenting in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews
* Strong business English — written and verbal — for regular written and video communication with stakeholders
* Comfortable building and presenting weekly operational reports (throughput, AHT, accuracy trend, error categories) in Excel or Google Sheets
* Demonstrated ability to write clear SOPs, job aids, and team process guides from scratch
* Willing and able to work rotational shifts, including US Mountain Time night rotations, on\-site 5 days per week


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to AI\-augmented operations: annotation platforms, RLHF review queues, AI quality assurance, or document intelligence tools
* Experience coordinating with US\-based counterparts across time zones on a regular basis
* Background in procurement or supply chain document processing (Purchase Orders, invoices, order acknowledgements)
* Understanding of how AI confidence scoring works and the relationship between human corrections and model retraining
* Workforce management exposure — forecasting, capacity planning, and roster optimisation experience
* Six Sigma, Lean, or equivalent process improvement certification
* Greenfield experience — prior role that required standing up a new team or operations function with minimal existing infrastructure


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
**Location:** 
 GHX India (GHXI) office, Hyderabad, Telangana — on\-site, 5 days per week;
 ***no remote or hybrid option***
**Shift:** 
 Rotational shifts on a 24x7 roster, including night rotations aligned to US Mountain Time (\~8:30 PM–4:30 AM IST (MDT) / \~9:30 PM–5:30 AM IST (MST)); week\-offs rotate with the roster
   

  

**US Coordination:** 
 Regular video calls with GHX US Engineering, Product, and Director, Automation \& Scalability (functional line)

We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe \- who rely on smart, secure healthcare\-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

title: NOC Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
 CTS is seeking a hands\-on Network Operations Center (NOC) Manager to build and operate a centralized, global 24x7 NOC based in Hyderabad, India. This role reports to the VP of Operations and is accountable for establishing the people, processes, and performance required to support more than 50 global customer programs delivering transit fare collection and payment card processing services.
   

  

 The NOC Manager will lead a team of approximately 40–60 Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC analysts operating around the clock, with defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional field services teams. The role requires prior experience building or significantly maturing a 24x7 operations center and enforcing disciplined, repeatable operational practices aligned with ITIL 4, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS v4 operational monitoring expectations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This is a build\-and\-operate leadership role responsible for end\-to\-end NOC effectiveness, including:
   

  

* Build and lead a centralized Hyderabad\-based NOC organization (40–60 staff) with Tier 1 and Tier 2 roles and defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional operations.
* Design and manage 24x7 shift coverage, staffing models, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance management.
* Establish and operate 24x7 monitoring and event management for networks, systems, cloud services, applications, and OT/edge devices supporting transit payments.
* Implement and enforce ITIL\-aligned Incident Management, including triage, severity assignment, escalation, major incident coordination, communications, and post\-incident review.
* Ensure continuous verification of operational controls including log management, monitoring coverage, backup success, recovery testing, change control discipline, and DR readiness.
* Ensure NOC operations support PCI DSS v4 monitoring requirements and are executed in a manner consistent with ISO 27001 operational control and evidence expectations.
* Lead operational response to emergent incidents, ensuring rapid containment, service restoration, and accurate executive and stakeholder communications.
* Define and maintain runbooks, SOPs, escalation matrices, and shift handover standards.
* Establish KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadences; drive continual improvement through trend analysis and postmortems.
* Coordinate closely with Security Operations (SOC) for escalation of operational anomalies with potential security implications.


**Essential Job Duties**
* Operate a 24x7 NOC covering monitoring, performance and capacity management, incident management, logging, change coordination, backup verification, and DR readiness.
* Ensure rapid identification, escalation, and resolution of outages and degradations affecting customer\-facing payment and transit services.
* Lead major incident bridges and enforce structured communication and restoration validation.
* Ensure logging, monitoring, and telemetry failures are treated as operational risks and remediated with urgency.
* Produce and maintain incident records, reports, and operational evidence suitable for audit and compliance review.


 General Duties and Responsibilities
   

  

* Operate effectively under limited supervision in a high\-availability, mission\-critical environment.
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and consistency in process execution and documentation.
* Communicate effectively in English, including written incident updates and executive\-level operational summaries.
* Motivate and lead teams across multiple shifts, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
* Escalate issues appropriately while maintaining productive working relationships.
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to motivate activity to meet the needs, and adept at escalating in an effective manner that preserves relations.
* Able to reliably demonstrate ethical behavior and accurate communications even when complex factors are involved.
* Able to operate in a professional manner, even in crisis settings.
* Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures


**Essential**
 Skills / Experience / Knowledge
   

  

* Proven experience building and leading a 24x7 NOC or equivalent mission\-critical operations organization.
* Strong command of monitoring \& event management and incident management, including major incident leadership.
* Experience operating hybrid environments including customer\-site data centers and Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated operational ownership of log management, backup verification, change/configuration control, and DR readiness.
* Experience working in regulated environments with strong audit and evidence requirements (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC, etc.).
* Establishes operational objectives, policies, procedures and work plans and delegates assignments to subordinates. Develops, modifies and executes company policies that affect immediate operations and may also have company\-wide effect. Accountable for department budget which may be broad and have far reaching impact on the business segment.
* Works on issues where analysis of situations or data requires conceptual thinking and an in\-depth knowledge of organizational objectives. Problems are not clearly defined and may lack strategic direction. Implements policies and selects methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Drives the strategy and success of larger projects which contribute to multiple areas of the organization.
* Interacts regularly with lower and/or senior management on matters concerning multiple functional areas, department, and/or customers. Requires the ability to persuade others in sensitive complex situations while preserving relationships. Applies knowledge to convince other stakeholders on desired departmental outcomes.
* This position must be able to create networks involving coordination among groups and provide thought leadership to pursue organization projects. This will require understanding of wider business and conveying advanced information and persuading several diverse stakeholders or audiences. The position must be recognized internally as a subject matter expert and will direct the activities of others.
* Demonstrated competency in strategic thinking and leadership with strong abilities in relationship management


 Desirable
   

  

* Experienced in operations supporting payments or high\-volume transaction processing operations experience.
* Experience monitoring Operational Technology (OT) or distributed edge device ecosystems.
* Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent operational practice experience.


**Qualifications**
 Essential
   

  

* 12\-15\+ years of experience in mission\-critical IT or service operations, including people leadership in a 24x7 model.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.


 Desirable
   

  

* Formal ITIL, ISO 27001, or operations management certifications.


 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Responsibilities may change based on business needs
   

  

 ‎
   

  

**Worker Type:**
 Employee

 Aribo is looking for a highly experienced and hands\-on Production Manager to take complete ownership of our garment production from planning and worker allocation to quality control and final delivery.
 



  





 This is a senior execution\-focused role for someone who can manage multiple styles and orders simultaneously, lead workers firmly and respectfully, identify delays before they occur, and ensure every garment is completed to the required quality and timeline.

* Create detailed daily, weekly and monthly production plans based on order priorities and delivery dates.

* Coordinate between designers, masters, karigars, vendors, stores and management.

* Provide management with accurate daily progress updates and immediately report risks or delays.
* Improve production efficiency, worker productivity and overall workflow.

 Minimum 3 years of proven experience in garment production, fashion manufacturing or a designer\-label production unit.

title: Director Delivery Management - RTSM Operations
description:
**About Signant Health** 




  





 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
 



 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
 



 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
 



  





**About The Role** 




  





 The Director, Delivery Management ensures the on\-time delivery of all published services within our Global Technical Delivery (GTD) organization. Reporting to the Head of Global Technical Delivery, Endpoint Solutions, you will build and lead a scalable organization that flexes with changing needs. Drawing on deep delivery expertise, you will partner closely with the Global Project Management organization to ensure client expectations are met, collaborate with teams across and outside Signant Health, and drive the adoption of delivery best practices throughout the organization. This is an inspirational leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, leads change through influence, and operates autonomously.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function** 




  




* Own on\-time delivery of all technical delivery commitments, applying deep expertise in enterprise solution delivery — including large\-scale, complex resource scheduling, forecasting, and risk mitigation.
* Enforce industry and regulatory best practices and consistency of standards across your pods, with deep expertise in one or more major competencies (Solution, Engineering, Testing, Delivery).
* Lead geographically dispersed teams, with direct management responsibility or indirect oversight of deliverables for two or more concurrent projects at a time.
* Manage exacting client expectations and execute resource\-management solutions that allow teams to scale in response to changing needs.
* Set and drive strategic and tactical direction using industry\-standard delivery and team\-performance metrics, continually adjusting to raise team performance.
* Represent your teams at Delivery Cross\-Portfolio Planning exercises, focusing on release coordination and critical\-path alignment, and act as decision\-maker and escalation point for resolving implementation impediments.
* Partner closely with Global Project Management, Sales, Product, and R\&D to create a closed\-loop feedback cycle of innovation.
* Coach technical teams on capability and implementation best practices, emphasizing agility to improve quality, productivity, and efficiency.
* Implement financially sound resource\-utilization solutions indexed on low\-cost operations and a progressive skills\-management framework.
* Influence direction and decisions without reliance on hierarchy, executing courageously and fostering a culture of agility, growth, and accountability through transparent leadership.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 




  





**Essential:** 



* Twelve or more years of combined, progressive experience in enterprise solution delivery, software engineering, and/or solution architecture — preferably including consulting services delivery.
* Eight or more years of progressive, global departmental and personnel management experience within engineering and delivery organizations of 25 or more reports.
* Experience in significant practice\-building and/or organizational\-redesign efforts, preferably including successful agile delivery transformations in high\-pressure environments.
* Demonstrated success defining and rolling out quality strategy, standards, regulatory compliance, and best practices for enterprise software development.
* Track record of creating “Communities of Practice” around software development and delivery competencies and leading their global rollout across at least two countries or locations.
* Hands\-on leadership managing concurrent end\-to\-end projects and/or turning around failing engagements with minimal collateral damage.
* A passion for staying current on trends in engineering, automation, professional services, agile processes, and project management.
* Excellence in organizational management, including coaching senior\-level staff to build and develop high\-performance teams.
* Exceptional operational and business leadership skills, including change leadership, stakeholder influence, and innovation in project\-management approaches.
* An innovative mindset that challenges the status quo and drives sustainable change across the organization.



  





**Desirable:** 



* Strong work ethic with high levels of initiative to lead in a changing workplace.
* Ability to operate within a matrixed organization using organizational thinking, influence, self\-management, collaboration, customer focus, and empathy.
* Flexibility to accommodate a global workforce across time zones, with approximately 25% international and domestic travel.
* Strong presentation and negotiating skills.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written.



  





**Why Signant Health?** 




  





 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
 



 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
 



 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
 



  





 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
 



 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Associate Manager / Manager - Collections
description:
**About CleanHarbors**
 Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO.
   

  

 Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
   

  

 Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
   

  

**Overview**
 As a Collections Manager, you will be instrumental in managing and optimizing the collections process for our organization. This role requires a professional with deep domain knowledge, team leadership capabilities, and a proactive approach toward process optimization and stakeholder alignment. The candidate will play a critical role in driving
 **cash flow improvement, reducing DSO** 
 , and
 **minimizing bad debt** 
 while ensuring a culture of
 **accountability, transparency, and customer\-centricity** 
 within the team. Your primary responsibility will be to lead a group of Team Leads to effectively manage our outstanding accounts receivable. You will collaborate with various stakeholders, including Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal teams, to ensure that the collections function aligns with the company's financial goals and objectives. You will be called on to demonstrate your leadership skills, contribute to our financial success, and ensure the stability of our accounts receivable.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Pre\-requisites:**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Collections Manager or in a similar leadership role within a large organization, preferably in a multinational environment.
* 12\+ years of total experience with at least 5 years in leading collections teams in a shared services or multinational environment.
* Hands\-on experience in managing large portfolios / teams
* In\-depth understanding of end\-to\-end collections processes, credit risk assessment, dispute management, and customer account reconciliation.
* Familiarity with O2C cycle and its integration with upstream/downstream finance processes (invoicing, cash apps, billing, customer master data).
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and develop actionable insights.
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills to interact with internal stakeholders and key customers.
* Demonstrated success in building and leading high\-performing, customer\-focused teams.
* Ability to coach, mentor, and retain talent, with a focus on performance metrics and engagement.
* Proficiency in using collection tools, software, and financial systems.
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills to deal with customers, sales teams, and senior finance leaders.
* Conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills in a cross\-functional setup.
* Problem\-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations.
* Data\-driven approach to collections strategy and decision\-making.
* Experience in root cause analysis, aging trend analysis, and defining collection effectiveness KPIs.


**Responsibilities/Expectations From The Role**
* Oversee and manage a group of Team Leads, providing leadership, guidance, and support to ensure efficiency and effectiveness in the collections process.
* Drive and execute effective collections strategies to achieve cash collection targets, reduce DSO, and minimize aged receivables.
* Monitor collection activities, track performance metrics, and generate reports for management, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
* Collaborate with Operations, Sales, and Customer Service teams to identify and resolve disputes, billing discrepancies, and payment delays, ensuring timely resolution and maintaining positive customer relationships.
* Lead interactions with key customers, especially on escalated or high\-value accounts, with clear action planning and resolution pathways.
* Generate and present weekly/monthly dashboards on collection performance, risks, and opportunities to leadership.
* Provide insights and forecasts to support working capital and cash flow planning.
* Stay updated on industry best practices, regulations, and changes in credit reporting and collections laws to ensure compliance and make necessary adjustments to the collections process.
* Coach Team Leads to lead their teams in pursuit of continuous improvement, and to develop existing talent.
* Represent team for Business Governance meetings with on\-site. Deep understanding of the business to be able to address issues being raised by On\-site partners. Play the role of POC at GCC
* Ensure key collection strategies are being implemented and adhered to by the team. Should proactively work with leads and AMs and collate feedback on strategies and report to management.
* Identify automation and process improvement opportunities across collections workflows.
* Ensure adherence to audit, compliance, and internal control standards.


**Qualifications**
**Preferred Attributes:**
* Resilient leader with a strong bias for execution
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and matrixed environment
* Agile mindset to adapt strategies to business realities
* Strong customer orientation with commercial acumen
* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement initiatives

 Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 




  





**Role Description** 




**We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven Pod Manager with 5\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.** 





 The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.
 





 If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.
 




**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
* Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
* Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
* Not a task manager or execution coordinator
* Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership** 



* Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
* Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
* Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing
* Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
* Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
* Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity



**2\. Client Growth Strategy** 



* Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
* Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
* Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
* Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
* Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls
* Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
* Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update



**3\. Escalation Leadership** 



* Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues
* Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
* Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
* Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
* Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
* Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level



**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management** 



* Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
* Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
* Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
* Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
* Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
* Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes



**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight** 



* Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
* Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
* Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
* Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
* Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution



**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy** 



* Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure
* Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets
* Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction
* Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome
* The character in sitcom is Ross



**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention** 



* Own client retention across all pod accounts
* Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times
* Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation
* Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations
* Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate



  





**Key KPIs** 



* Pod Revenue vs Target
* Pod Gross Margin and Profitability
* Client Retention Rate
* Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated
* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)
* On\-Time Delivery Percentage
* Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency
* Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams
* Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control
* Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing
* Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients
* Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
* Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations
* Experience with project management and reporting tools
* Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* **Agency experience is mandatory.**
* Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people
* Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals
* Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery
* Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating
* Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session



  





**Reporting Structure** 



* Reports To: Founder / CEO
* Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists
* Coordinates With: Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team
* Escalation Authority: Final internal point before the CEO

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

 Office
   

  

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you will perform meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our colleagues bring our Mission to life every day by enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

 The Senior Electrical Engineering Manager will provide technical and people leadership for the PCBA Center of Excellence in Hyderabad. * Ensure VAVE opportunities are supported by appropriate technical analysis, risk assessment, verification, validation, and implementation planning.
* Ensure that proposed changes meet performance, quality, regulatory, reliability, and manufacturability requirements.

* Strong technical background in electrical hardware design, product development, testing, and validation.

* Experience in scientific instrumentation, diagnostics, medical devices, or other regulated products.

title: Operations Fulfilment Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 AdOnMo is one of India's largest and fastest\-growing Out\-of\-Home (OOH) advertising companies, backed by marquee investors like Zomato, Ant Financial, and Astarc Ventures.
 



 We operate a vast and expanding network of 33,000\+ digital screens (outside lifts) and 20,000\+ static frame posters (inside lifts) across 24\+ major cities, including Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Kochi, Jaipur, and more.
 



 Our ad formats are installed in high\-visibility public locations, including:
 


* Residential societies
* Corporate buildings and coworking spaces
* Cult.fit gyms
* Goa beaches
* Shopping malls
* Bike parking areas with branded standees and digital hoardings



 We work with 2,000\+ brands, including Amazon, IKEA, Meta, and Zomato, helping them build real\-world visibility through innovative and targeted outdoor advertising campaigns.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Operations Fulfilment Manager to join the Acumen team and take ownership of the fulfilment journey end\-to\-end.
 



 The role will involve coordinating closely with production, warehouse, installation, Operations and Customer Success teams to ensure orders move as planned, timelines are met, and client escalations are resolved effectively.
 



 The ideal candidate should be organised, dependable, hands\-on, and comfortable working across multiple teams, with strong ownership of execution and follow\-through.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience: 3\+ years



  





  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* *1\. Own Fulfilment End\-to\-End*
* Track every order from production and dispatch through delivery, installation and go\-live.
* Maintain complete visibility on the status of every open order.
* Ensure orders progress through each stage as planned and are successfully closed.



  




* *2\. Drive Coordination and Timelines*
* Work closely with Production, Warehouse, Installation, Operations and Customer Success teams.
* Identify potential delays and bottlenecks early.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure orders move as planned and timelines are met.



  




* *3\. Own Client Escalations*
* Take complete ownership of client escalations related to fulfilment.
* Communicate clearly and calmly with stakeholders.
* Drive issues through to closure and ensure that escalations do not remain unresolved.



  




* *4\. Keep the Team and Process on Track*
* Support the existing Operations team in managing day\-to\-day fulfilment activities.
* Maintain a simple, accurate and up\-to\-date order tracker.
* Follow up on pending actions and ensure clear accountability for every next step.
* Maintain visibility on pending orders and ensure timely follow\-ups.



  




* *5\. Identify and Improve Recurring Issues*
* Identify patterns and recurring challenges in the fulfilment process.
* Proactively highlight issues to leadership.
* Suggest practical process improvements to reduce recurring fulfilment challenges and improve operational efficiency.



  





  





  





**Required Skills** 



* 3\+ years of experience in Operations, Fulfilment, Client Delivery, Service Delivery or a similar role.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end fulfilment or delivery processes.
* Strong coordination skills with the ability to work across multiple teams.
* Experience handling client/stakeholder escalations and driving them to closure.
* Strong follow\-up and execution skills.
* Comfortable maintaining trackers, monitoring pending actions and managing multiple orders simultaneously.
* Ability to identify operational challenges and suggest practical solutions.
* Highly organised, dependable and hands\-on approach to work.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in a similar Operations, Fulfilment, Service Delivery, Client Delivery, Logistics, Installation or Project Execution role would be preferred.



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 AdOnMo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Factory Liaison & Coordination Manager
description:
**Factory Liaison \& Coordination Manager** 
 – 500 MW PERC Solar Cell \& Module Plant
 



 Location \- Hyderadbad
 



**Company** 
 \-
 **Junna Solar System LTD** 




  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\) Supplier \& Vendor Coordination (Cell \& Module)
 



 Serve as the primary liaison for equipment vendors (diffusion, PECVD, screen printers, stringers, laminators, testers, etc.).
 



  





 Coordinate with Procurement and Planning to align purchase orders, delivery schedules, and material readiness for both cell and module lines.
 



  





 Track vendor performance (quality, delivery, uptime support, spares availability) and maintain vendor scorecards; drive corrective actions and escalation where needed.
 



  





 Arrange vendor visits, FAT/SAT discussions, AMCs, and technical reviews; ensure vendors support commissioning, ramp\-up, and O\&M needs.
 



  





 2\) Factory Coordination \& Operations Support (PERC Context)
 



 Coordinate day\-to\-day activities across Cell (texturing, diffusion, PSG removal, edge isolation, PECVD passivation, screen printing, firing, testing \& binning) and Module
 



  





 Ensure alignment between production plans and material availability (wafers, chemicals, encapsulants, BOM items) to minimize line stoppages.
 



  





 Support implementation and adherence to SOPs, safety norms, cleanroom discipline, and housekeeping standards across cell and module shops.
 



  





 Track key operational metrics (line utilization, yield, efficiency binning distribution, downtime reasons) and share concise updates with leadership.
 



  





 3\) Presentations \& Stakeholder Communication
 



 Prepare and deliver clear presentations for internal reviews (production, quality, capacity, capex, expansion plans) and external stakeholders (investors, partners, customers, lenders).
 



  





 Create status decks, dashboards, and one\-pagers on factory performance, supplier issues, project milestones, and PLI/ALMM/BIS\-related updates as needed.
 



  





 Represent the factory in meetings with government bodies, utilities, and industry associations when required (TSRECO, TSPCB, local bodies, MNRE\-related interfaces).
 



  





 4\) Team Development \& Coordination
 



 Coordinate training schedules for shop\-floor teams (operators, technicians, quality inspectors) in coordination with HR and department heads, focusing on PERC process understanding and safety.
 



  





 Support onboarding of new team members and ensure smooth handover of responsibilities across shifts and departments.
 



  





 Facilitate cross\-functional coordination between Production, Quality, Engineering, Procurement, Maintenance, and Logistics to resolve issues quickly and reduce response time.
 



  





 Drive a culture of accountability, timely communication, and continuous improvement (lean, 5S, Kaizen) on the shop floor.
 



  





 5\) Compliance \& Liaisoning (Factory \& Schemes)
 



 Coordinate with authorities for factory\-related approvals, renewals, and inspections (Factories Act, Pollution Control, Fire NOC, local bodies).
 



  





 Support documentation and follow\-up for incentives, subsidies, and scheme\-related requirements (PLI, ALMM, BIS, state policies) in coordination with Corporate/Strategy teams.
 



  





 Maintain good relations with local bodies and manage community\-related issues around the factory.
 



 Required Qualification
 



 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical / Mechanical / Industrial / Production / Chemical) or MBA with operations/supply\-chain focus.
 



 Preference for candidates with exposure to solar cell/module manufacturing or high\-volume process manufacturing (semiconductor, electronics, chemicals).
 



 Experience
 



 5–9 years of experience in manufacturing / operations / vendor management / liaison roles, ideally in solar cell/module manufacturing or related sectors.
 



 Prior experience coordinating with suppliers, vendors, and cross\-functional teams in a factory setting; exposure to 200–500 MW\+ lines is a strong plus.
 



  





 Key Skills \& Competencies
 



 Strong coordination and follow\-up skills; ability to manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
 



 Excellent verbal and written communication; confident in making presentations to senior leadership and external partners.
 



 Good understanding of PERC cell and module process flows, BOMs, and basic quality/yield concepts.
 



  





 Vendor management and negotiation skills; ability to drive accountability from suppliers and equipment vendors.
 



  





 Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); comfortable with basic data analysis and dashboards.
 



 Problem\-solving mindset; able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
 



  





 Preferred Add\-ons
 



 Hands\-on exposure to PERC cell process stations (texturing, diffusion, PECVD, screen printing, firing, testing \& binning)
 



  





 Familiarity with Telangana industrial ecosystem, local authorities, and logistics corridors around Mahbubnagar/Hyderabad.
 



  





 Exposure to ERP/MES systems, vendor portals, and PLI/ALMM documentation workflows.
 



  





 KPIs / Success Metrics
 



 On\-time material availability for cell \& module production plans (supplier\-side).
 



 Reduction in line stoppages due to material/vendor/equipment issues.
 



 Quality and frequency of presentations and updates to leadership and stakeholders.
 



 Timely closure of vendor issues, action items, and compliance requirements.
 



 Feedback from internal teams on coordination effectiveness and responsiveness.
 



  





 Working Conditions
 



 Primarily on\-site at the 500 MW PERC cell \& module factory with occasional travel to Hyderabad, vendor sites, and government offices.
 



  





 May require flexible hours during critical production runs, audits, commissioning, or ramp\-up phases.

description:

 Title: Manager, SCM\-Business Excellence
   

  

**About The Role**
 Leads team of intermediate to experienced Procurement professionals, setting objectives and guiding others on RFPs, negotiation strategy, cost accountability, and/or program execution. Reviews prices, manufacturing processes, and contracts and makes recommendations for changes to ensure a successful procurement process.
   

  

 The Manager, SCM – Business Excellence: Data \& Process Transformation will lead the supply chain transformation agenda across Productivity \& Cost Savings, Price Change Governance, Payment Terms, and Master Data (Vendor Master \& Supplier Onboarding). This role demands deep experience in supply chain operations, strong people leadership, and the ability to execute high\-impact programs that drive measurable business value.
   

  

 The Manager will own strategy, design, and execution of supply chain data and process transformation initiatives spanning procurement, sourcing, and category management, including price change governance, payment\-term centralization, vendor master management, and supplier onboarding, with direct accountability for portfolio delivery across global sites and stakeholders. The role includes managing a team of specialists/analysts, leading cross\-functional programs, and partnering with global supply chain, finance, and operations leaders to deliver scalable, digitally enabled business solutions.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Manages execution of processes, standards, and operational plans in support of Procurement strategy, including RFPs, negotation strategy, cost accountability, and/or program execution.
* Directs programs for effective vendor selection and management with a view to minimize purchasing costs without compromising quality or reliability of supply.
* Reviews changes in price trends and manufacturing processes and makes recommendations to ensure successful procurement process.
* Manages resolution of client issues or problems.
* Monitors and coordinates suppliers to schedule or expedite deliveries to ensure resolution of problems such as shortages and missed or late deliveries.
* Authorizes purchase orders, negotiates prices and approves payments to support the procurement process in large territories.
* Reviews and assesses request for proposals (RFP) and bid packages.
* Analyzes and monitors contract performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and to help determine need for changes.


**Responsibilities**
* Strategy \& Leadership in Process Transformation
* Define and own the transformation roadmap across the core pillars: Productivity \& Cost Savings (reporting, value\-capture tracking \& automation), Price Change / Price Updating Governance, Master Data governance \& standardization (vendor master, item, and contract data), Supplier Onboarding centralization, and Payment Terms \& Working Capital optimization (DPO, 1x centralization).
* Lead a team of specialists/analysts and drive portfolio execution against business targets for these pillars: \-
* Productivity \& Cost Savings: Centralize productivity and cost\-savings reporting across factory, indirect, and logistics sites; run the stage\-gate / value\-capture process end to end, and identify and recover clawbacks and missed opportunities to convert pipeline into realized savings.
* Master Data \& Vendor Master: Standardize and govern supplier, vendor, item, and contract master data; own data quality, validation rules, and de\-duplication to maintain a clean, reliable vendor master consistent across systems and regions.
* Payment Terms \& Working Capital: Expand payment\-term (DPO) initiatives, centralize 1x governance, and target WAPT improvements with measurable working\-capital impact.
* Supplier Onboarding: Centralize and simplify the supplier onboarding process; standardize intake, documentation, and data setup with clear SLAs and controls to enable faster, compliant onboarding across regions.
* Price Change / Price Updation Governance: Own the end\-to\-end price change process and controls; ensure timely, accurate price updation in the system with the right approvals, audit trail, and exception management, working closely with category, materials, and finance teams.
* Analyze end\-to\-end supply chain processes to identify structural improvement opportunities; drive strategic changes to improve cost, speed, compliance, and operational resilience.
* Lead, coach, and develop specialists/analysts; allocate resources, prioritize work, and review deliverables to ensure high\-quality outcomes and meet business milestones.
* Reporting, Governance, and Oversight
* Lead the design and implementation of Power BI/Excel dashboards for executive\-level analytics, insights, and business metrics across procurement and inbound supply chain.
* Own the governance model for critical procurement metrics, including cadence, definitions, and alignment with finance and category teams.
* Drive transformation and centralization of reporting with a strong focus on automation, data integrity, and auditability.
* Own procurement master data quality KPIs and governance processes, ensuring consistency across systems (e.g., SAP/Oracle) and regions.
* Advanced Stakeholder \& Team Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for global and regional procurement, category management, and sourcing leaders on master data and reporting topics.
* Align transformation projects with business priorities; provide regular updates to senior leadership on progress, risks, and impact.
* Promote effective collaboration and communication across global teams; facilitate workshops and steering meetings to harmonize processes and standards.
* Influence stakeholders to adopt standardized processes, data definitions, and tools, balancing global governance with local business needs.
* Technical Competencies \& Advanced Analytics
* Oversee the use of Excel, ERP, Power BI, and other tools for scalable enterprise reporting and analytics.
* Lead advanced analytical initiatives driving business value across the key projects owned.
* Sponsor and guide automation and system\-integration efforts to reduce manual work and improve data reliability.
* Champion digital and analytics innovation in supply chain reporting and master data (e.g., standardization, data quality rules, exception management, and workflow).


**Qualifications**
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
* 12\+ years’ experience in supply chain or manufacturing, with significant exposure to data/process transformation, procurement, sourcing, and category management.
* Deep expertise in supply chain management, master data governance, procurement analytics, and operational finance with hands\-on experience in data quality initiatives and reporting automation.
* Proven experience managing teams (5\+) and leading complex programs or transformation initiatives in a global environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; advanced experience with Power BI, ERP systems (SAP/Oracle), and emerging digital tools strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of driving transformation, simplifying complex data landscapes, and delivering measurable business impact.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational change.
* High learning agility, accountability, and strong collaboration skills across cross\-functional and cross\-regional teams.


 Additional Comments
   

  

* Full time role
